In this paper, we propose a method to reduce the gap by reformulating the monocular 6DoF vehicle pose estimation problem as a depth-aware imbalance learning. We integrate classification networks with regression networks to solve the imbalance. To address the problem of inaccurate prediction depth with a monocular image, we further design a depth-aware structure, which extracts a more reliable feature of location and improves 3D surroundings perception. As a result, our method surpasses the state-of-the-art methods, even with straightforward end-to-end training and limited imbalanced data. The experimental results on the challenging Apollocar3d [1] dataset show that the method outperforms the state-of-the-art significantly, achieving improvements on the standard metric up to 37.4%.

articleTitle: Decentralized Tracking Control of Modular Robot Manipulators with Unknown Environmental Contacts Based on Event-triggered Mechanism
abstract: In this paper, an event-triggered decentralized optimal tracking control method of modular robot manipulators (MRMs) with unknown environmental contacts is proposed. The dynamic model of MRM subsystem is established based on joint torque feedback (JTF) technique. The performance index function is designed including the tracking errors, the model estimation under the proposed radial basis function neural network (RBFNN)-based Romberg observer, and the environmental contacts. On the basis of adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) algorithm and event-triggered mechanism, the corresponding Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation is solved by utilizing the critic neural network (NN) structure. Therefore, the event-triggered ADP-based decentralized tracking controller is obtained. Moreover, the closed-loop MRM system is proved to be asymptotically stable using the Lyapunov stability theorem. Finally, the experimental results verified the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Research on attribute-based encryption access control technology in edge computing environment
abstract: In order to solve the security problem of the data access between edge nodes in edge computing, in view of the distributed characteristics of edge computing, this paper combines edge computing and complex cryptographic computing environment, and proposes an attribute-based encryption in edge computing environment. The access control method ensures the encryption of data communication between edge nodes and at the same time realizes the fine-grained access control function between edge nodes that can be accurate to the attribute level. This solution can flexibly control data access, the edge node sets the access control strategy, and proposes the access control to the data access of other edge nodes.

articleTitle: Imperfect Information Game in Multiplayer No-limit Texas Hold’em Based on Mean Approximation and Deep CFVnet
abstract: Imperfect information game in multiplayer no-limit Texas Hold’em is a critical challenge in AI research. Recent advanced solving approaches, such as deep CounterFactual Value networks(CFVnet) combined with continual resolving, provide a way to conduct depth-limited search in imperfect-information games. However, CFVnet has limited deployment in Heads-Up No-Limit Texas Hold’em, and is hard to scale to multiplayer setting. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm, mean approximation, that effectively converting multi-agent interactions to two-agent interactions, and introduce a useful trick virtual action generation to solve conflicts occur in this conversion. Furthermore, we introduce several improvements to deep CFVnet applied in Texas Hold’em Poker. We combined all above improvements and extensions of CFVnet to create our poker AI MuCFVnet, unlocking the potential of deep CFVnet. Experimental results show that MuCFVnet has strong performance, successfully beats some available public multiplayer poker AI.

articleTitle: Enabling Multi-scale Features and Double-Attention for Single-image 3D Urban Reconstruction
abstract: 3D reconstruction from a single RGB image for urban scenes has been a foundation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving and city planning. It is essential to develop 3D reconstruction models that are accurate for these applications. The most recent single-image 3D reconstruction models leverage representative neural networks to address the problem and have achieved promising results. However, these approaches cannot correctly calculate the segmentation map and reconstruct depth for ambiguous scene regions and when scene information gets lost going through down-sampling layers. To solve this problem, we propose EMERALD, an end-to-end single-image 3D reconstruction framework, in which we empower the fully convolutional networks (FCN) with multi-scale contextual features and a novel double-attention mechanism to advance its discrimination capability on ambiguous scene regions and loss of scene details. The evaluation results on two leading urbanscene data sets, Cityscapes (Segmentation Covering (SC)1 of 61.2%) and SYNTHIA (SC of 81.9%), demonstrate the optimized network architecture’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Robust Guidance Control of Vertical Landing Aircraft with Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
abstract: The working environment of vertical landing aircraft may contain strong uncertain disturbances which may lead to the out of control of aircrafts. To address this problem, we proposed a reinforcement learning based algorithm to design controllers for the trajectory following control of vertical landing aircrafts. The simulations indicated that the algorithm is stable in the training process after the network models are converged and the controller generated by the algorithm is robust with uncertain noisy environments. This algorithm can be utilized as a potential method to control complex systems with unpredictable noisy environment.

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Carbon Content in Pr-Nd Alloys Based on MFCC and BP Neural Network
abstract: The carbon content in rare earth praseodymium neodymium alloy is a key indicator to define whether the alloys are qualified. In order to improve the measure efficiency of the carbon content in alloys and reduce the cost of quality inspection, this paper proposes a soft measurement method of carbon content in praseodymium-neodymium alloys based on the extracted Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient (MFCC) features. and BP neural network. A three-layer structure of BP neural network was established according to the input and output requirements to classify the MFCC features of different carbon content alloys. Lastly, a number of 539 signals from praseodymium neodymium alloys with varied carbon content were used to verify the neural network and the accuracy of classification reached up to 97.44%. This paper also introduced the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) to comprehensively evaluate the trained BP neural network model. The ROC showed that the probability of identifying a negative sample as a positive sample was 2.56% and the area under the ROC curve line accounted for 85.5%, which indicated that the proposed non-destructive testing (NDT) method was effective and had potential for practical application.

articleTitle: Robust Flame Video-based Sintering Condition Recognition Method Based on Fractal Theory
abstract: The sintering condition of the rotary kiln reflects the characteristics of product quality and energy saving. Due to the harsh environment of coal-fired kilns and complex production processes, it is difficult to detect the sintering condition in industrial site. To solve this problem, we propose a robust flame video-based sintering condition recognition method based on fractal theory. First, we extract the intensity sequence from the flame video and analyze the sequence. We find that some denoising methods may remove some chaotic fractal features instead of noise, resulting in the loss of part of the information in the recognition of the sintering condition. Therefore, we decide to develop a recognition algorithm, which can be directly applied to the original data without denoising. The algorithm uses the wavelet p-leader method and constructs several new indicators to identify the sintering condition. Experimental results on real-world data show the effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared with other methods, the recognition accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: FoG Recognition Based on Time-frequency Analysis and Convolutional Neural Network Combined with Attention Mechanism
abstract: Freezing of gait is one of the most common movement disorders in Parkinson’s disease. In this paper, with the use of attention mechanism, a neural network detection method is proposed for time-frequency data of FoG events. The acceleration signal collected by the IMU is firstly converted into a two-dimensional image representing the time-frequency information through continuous wavelet transform, and then sent to the convolutional neural network combined with the attention module for feature extracting and model training. Finally, the effectiveness is demonstrated with an accuracy of 91.37% and geometric mean of 88.73% on the test set.

articleTitle: A Flow-Appearance Fusion Defect Detection Method for Substation Equipment in Multi-Scene
abstract: In the daily maintenance process of substation, the defect detection of substation equipment is a critical problem. This task is challenging considering of the variety of defects, the rarely sample of various defects and the complex environment. This paper presents a flow-appearance fusion defect detection method for substation equipment in multiple scenes, which contains a Siamese optical flow module and a defect location module. The Siamese optical flow module is a pretrained optical flow network, which is utilized to obtain forward and backward optical flow between the normal image and the detect image. The optical flow represents the common changing features of different types of defects in multiple scenes. The defect location module utilizes MI-darknet53 to realize the extraction and fusion of appearance and flow features. Then the extracted multiscale features are used to build the feature pyramid network (FPN), which combines semantic defect information in high level and geometric defect information in low level. Finally, FPN is utilized to predict object-level defect areas in three different scales. Experiments show that our proposed method has good reliability and superior performance in the defect detection for the dataset of multi-scene substation equipment.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Fitting Correction of Binocular Ranging Error for Visual SLAM
abstract: The visual SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) has high requirements for real-time performance. Aiming at the binocular vision ranging error caused by the pixel accuracy of the binocular camera, a method for real-time correction of the error using nonlinear fitting is proposed. First, the binocular camera needs to be calibrated to obtain the intrinsics, extrinsics, and distortion coefficients of the binocular camera. Then, fix the target and take multiple sets of pictures at equal intervals. Next, rectify these pictures and extract ORB (Oriented Fast and Rotated Brief) features, through feature matching and filtering to calculate the measurement distance corresponding to each group of pictures. And finally, more than one error correction models are obtained through the nonlinear fitting, and one of them which has best performance is chosen as the final model. The results show that within the effective measurement range, the proposed correction model decreases the error of binocular vision ranging from 14.9% to 0.4%, which greatly improves the accuracy of binocular ranging. Compared with other methods to improve accuracy, it has a simple principle, low cost, good real-time performance, and nice error correction effect.

articleTitle: Identifying environmental homologous complaint reports based on Siamese network
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to efficiently identify homologous complaints in complaint reporting, this paper proposes a Siamese Text Convolutional Neural Network (TextCNN) method to detect homologous complaints in complaint reporting. TextCNN is good at capturing local features in text, while two TextCNN with the same structure can capture similar features in two complaint reporting samples and judge whether the two complaint reporting events are homology events by comparing these features. Meanwhile, attention mechanism is used to enhance model performance. This paper compares the accuracy of multiple neural networks in complaint reporting data, and the experimental results of these neural network models show that the Siamese TextCNN model in this paper has better effect and stronger stability.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Identification Method of Four-Thruster AUSV Dynamics Model
abstract: In order to study the motion of the four-thruster Autonomous Unmanned Surface Vehicle (AUSV), an inertial reference coordinate system and an appendage reference coordinate system have been established. According to the model proposed by Fossen, the three-degree-of-freedom dynamics model of the four-thruster AUSV is simplified by ignoring the movement and external interference in the three degrees of freedom according to its actual state of motion. Using the auxiliary variable method combined with the MATLAB system identification toolbox and the three-degree-of-freedom dynamic model, we designed the model parameter identification experiments for the three degrees of freedom of swaying, swaying, and yaw, and built a four-thruster based on the MATLAB/Simulink platform. The simulation model of the ship motion model and the simulation experiment of parameter identification experiment under ideal conditions verify the feasibility of the identification scheme. In view of the navigation data measurement errors that the AUSV may face in actual navigation, it is discussed that the parameter identification experiment is feasible under the condition of how much interference the AUSV's navigation experiment is subjected to.

articleTitle: Meal estimation based on UKF and postprandial glucose control for patients with type I diabetes
abstract: Meal detection is essential for the automatic control of artificial pancreas (AP). In some studies, dietary has been treated as perturbations, but this is not accurate enough for glycemic control in diabetics. In this paper, in order to make the patients’ postprandial blood glucose return to normal more quickly, Untraceless Kalman filtering(UKF) is used for prediction based on the Bergman minimum model and estimate personalized parameters.Meal detection is determined by the predicted value of meal interference and the difference between the predicted blood glucose concentration of ukf and the actual blood glucose concentration. The results show that all meals are detected by UKF. Finally, after the diet is detected, the bolus insulin that needs to maintain the patient’s blood sugar level is calculated. The algorithm was tested on the UVa/Padova simulator and compared with a proportional integral derivative (PID) controller. The simulation results have proved that compared with PID controller, the performance of this algorithm is improved greatly.

articleTitle: BIM-based optimization of passenger flow organization in urban rail transit stations during the epidemic prevention and control phase
abstract: As a high-density crowd collection and dispersal carrier, rail transit is characterized by airtight confinement, which will provide an suitable environment for the potential spread of coronavirus disease. The virus distribution inside stations needs to be analyzed in order to adopt effective passenger flow organization strategies to reduce the risk of virus infection inside stations. With the help of aerodynamic principle, according to the virus transmission theory, the BIM simulation technology has been used to simulate the air flow direction of a certain station of Wuhan metro using Fluent software to qualitatively analyze the station’s virus-prone gathering area and provide reference for station daily disinfection.The daily passenger flow organization of the station has been simulated considering the social force model. Comparing the overlap between the concentrated area of passenger flow density and the virus-prone area,a targeted imrovement plan of passenger flow organization has been proposed. The improvement measures have been verified quantitatively by two evaluation indexes: the average dwell time and virus susceptibility in pedestrian stations. The results show the effectiveness in reducing the probability of virus infection of passengers traveling in the station by disabling the station vending machines, reducing the number of passengers in the station, increasing the escalator rate, and optimizing the flow lines of passengers entering and exiting the station. The simulation results can provide inspiration and reference for normalized epidemic prevention in the daily operation of rail transit.

articleTitle: Multi Mode Travel Recommendation Method for Passengers at Hub Airport under the Constraint of Public Transport Timetable
abstract: The complex transportation mode and low travel efficiency in the hub have become the focus. In the past, the study focused on the relationship between the time distribution of passenger travel or the travel behavior and the travel chain construction. This study focused on the travel service of individual passenger multi-mode transfer. Under the constraints of public transport timetable, a multi-objective path construction method for airport passenger travel based on Dijkstra algorithm was proposed. At the same time, taking Daxing airport to Beijing South Railway Station as an example, the multi-objective optimization algorithm is tested and verified, and the implementation results prove the reliability and correctness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Analysis of Brain Functional Networks in Schizophrenia Based on Spectral Graph Wavelets
abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious mental illness whose pathological mechanism is still unknown. In this paper, we study brain functional networks of schizophrenic patients from a new perspective of graph signal processing. We use fMRI data of 71 schizophrenic patients and 74 healthy subjects to represent their graph signals and calculate their Laplace matrices by Pearson correlation coefficients. Based on the maximum Laplace eigenvalue, we construct spectral graph wavelet and decompose graph signals into five frequency scales. We compare the energy distribution of brain functional network in schizophrenic patients and healthy subjects. We find that, compared with healthy subjects, the energy distribution of brain functional networks in schizophrenic patients is significantly different at different scales, especially abnormal activities in brain regions: Cortex Left, Parahippocampal Gyrus and Anterior Division Right.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Control Modeling of Thermal Power Plant Production Process Based on MAS
abstract: The production technology of thermal power plant is complex; the production process is closely coupled; and all kinds of production equipment are large-sized and intensive. By means of distributed control mode of PLC and fieldbus control system, the function of local optimization can be realized. Aiming at the research of the composition, function, objective, method and distribution characteristics of the production process control system in thermal power plant, a hierarchical system topology structure based on multi-agent control is presented. The production process control of thermal power plant is divided into two groups: thermal subsystem control agent and power subsystem control agent. The realization mechanism of multi-agent control system coordination process is established. Combined with the field practical application experiment. The results of operation show that the system has an obvious guiding effect on production by comparing the sampling data adjusted by load power factor of unit with the original data sampled by random sampling. The effectiveness of MAS in the process control of thermal power plant is proved.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Tracking Control of Wall-Climbing Robot Based on Dual-Track Magnetic Adsorption
abstract: The dual-track magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot is applied to the magnetic wall, and the robot has a large moving resistance. To meet the needs of small volume and large torque, a brushed DC gear motor is usually selected as the actuator. Due to the external uncertainty interference and the mechanical characteristics of the brushed DC geared motor, there are complex nonlinear time-varying problems during the robot movement. The traditional PID controller is limited to a linear system, which is difficult to fulfill the trajectory tracking requirements of the wall-climbing robot. Aiming at the trajectory deviation of the dual-track magnetic adsorption wallclimbing robot, this paper proposes a Kalman filter based RBF-PID control method, which uses the system identification ability of the radial basis function neural network to adaptively adjust the PID parameters to achieve Closed loop speed control of dual-track wall-climbing robot. In order to analyze the feasibility of the proposed control scheme, this paper builds a hardware control system with STM32F407 as the control core based on the motion characteristics of the wall-climbing robot, and develops a software control program in the Keil environment. Three sets of experiments are designed on this experimental platform, including PID control experiment, RBF- PID control experiment, and RBF-PID control experiment based on Kalman filter. Through the analysis of the experimental results, it is verified that the control scheme has good robustness and load immunity to the complex nonlinear wall-climbing robot motion control, which provides a valuable reference for the research on the motion control of the wallclimbing robot on the magnetic wall.

articleTitle: State-based Event-triggered Trajectory Tracking Control for the Stratospheric Airship
abstract: This paper studies the trajectory tracking problem of the stratospheric airship based on event-triggering mechanism. An event-triggered stratospheric airship trajectory tracking control algorithm is designed based on the adaptive back-stepping control framework, state observer and auxiliary system. The state observer is used to estimate the system state within the trigger interval and the auxiliary system is used to handle the actuator saturation problem. Stability analysis shows that the tracking error of the system and the observation error of the observer are bounded, and there is no Zeno phenomenon in the flight process. The simulation results show that the control algorithm proposed in this paper can significantly reduce the working time of the sensors while ensuring that the airship can track the desired trajectory.

articleTitle: Cooperative Entry Trajectory Planning for Multiple Hypersonic Gliding Vehicles Using Convex Programing Method
abstract: The cooperative trajectory planning method is proposed based on sequential convex optimization technique for multiple hypersonic glide vehicles with coordinated flight time. Firstly, based on the differential equations of dynamics, a new independent variable and a control variable are defined, and the dimensional time is added to the state equations as a state variable. Secondly, the process of linearization and discretization is derived, where the non-convex trajectory planning problem is transformed into a series of convex optimization sub-problems. Then, considering the path and coordinated flight time constraints, the convex optimization sub-problems are solved iteratively in order to realize the state-coordinated entry trajectory planning. Finally, a numerical simulation example is given to verily the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Redundant-Manipulator Minimal Motion via Different-Precision Discrete-Time Zhang Neural Dynamics Algorithms Especially Ten-Instant One
abstract: As a significant and basic robotic sub-topic, the problem of optimal MPC (motion planning & control) of ordinarily redundant manipulator widely exists in many fields, such as industry and daily-life applications. Following previous work, the aim of this paper is at solving the problem of velocity-level minimal joint motion planning & control (VLMJMPC) in a way of discrete time. Firstly, the VLMJMPC problem is introduced and analyzed using Zhang neural dynamics (ZND) method, and the motion scheme is then given. Secondly, by using ZND and Lagrange-multiplier methods, a continuous-time (CT) model for real-time solving the problem is established. In order to realize on digital computers, we use a ten-instant Zhang time discretization (abbreviated as ZTD) general formula with the fifth-order precision to discretize the model, and a special algorithm with high precision is derived, developed and analyzed. Finally, five discrete-time ZND (DTZND) algorithms are further acquired by adopting this ten-instant ZTD formula and other ZTD formulas, and the corresponding theoretical analyses are given. Computer experiment results numerically verify the online effectiveness and correctness of the developed five DTZND algorithms.

Author Keywords: velocity-level minimal joint motion planning & control (VLMJMPC)

articleTitle: Deep Learning of Binary Hash Codes for Fast Handwritten character Retrieval
abstract: With the fast growing number of Offline Handwritten characters picture uploaded every day, it is very difficult to employ any existing traditional techniques to retrieve them.Hash based approximate nearest neighbor retrieval is an effective method in the field of characters image retrieval,meanwhile it has been shown that the activations invoked by an image within the top layers of a large convolutional neural network provide a high-level descriptor of the visual content of the image The propose network that can efficiently extract highlevel semantic features of character images and generate binary hash codes The learning mode of the network is from one end to the other one piont At the same time, it is also suitable for large-scale data sets Take into account the retrieval time and precision, two-level retrieval to ensure the retrieval speed and high precision The performance of the proposed method is better than that of the existing hash algorithms and traditional feature algorithms on MNIST and CHARS74K datasets The scalability and effectiveness of the proposed method are further verified on the HWDB dataset of large-scale Chinese characte

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control for a Coaxial Tilt-Rotor UAV Transporting a Slung Load
abstract: The tilt-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is a special kind of UAV whose rotors can be tilted to realize fast Flexible and high-speed flight. In this work, we concentrated on the control problem of a coaxial tilt-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (CTRUAV). The CTRUAV consists of two tiltable coaxial rotors and a rear rotor. In this paper, a new control strategy for a CTRUAV with a slung load (CTRSL) is proposed with a cascade structure. The designed control law includes following sub-controllers: a UAV attitude controller, a swing angle controller and a load velocity controller. The stability of the system is proved theoretically by the Lyapunov method. Simulation tests are implemented in to demonstrate the performance of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: An improved cuckoo search combing artificial bee colony operator with opposition-based learning
abstract: Aiming at the existed drawbacks of the cuckoo search (CS) algorithm, an improved CS combing artificial bee colony operator with opposition-based learning (ICS-ABC- OBL) is proposed to overcome the problems of low convergence efficiency and weak ability to jump out local optimum. The proposed algorithm uses the artificial bee colony (ABC) operator to replace the random migration stage for improving the local exploitation efficiency of the CS algorithm. On the other hand, the opposition-based learning (OBL) operator and dynamic search domain adaptively are introduced, the modified ICS-ABC-OBL can effectively avoid falling into the local optimum by expanding the search solution space and enhancing the balance between exploration and exploitation of the CS algorithm so that the convergence accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm are further improved. Finally, ten classic benchmark functions are used to test the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The results show that the ICS-ABC-OBL has strong robustness and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Optimal Design of Park Multi-energy System
abstract: With the demand of the world's energy production and consumption, the combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) system plays an important role in promoting the consumption of clean energy and improving energy efficiency. In this paper, the curve fitting method is used to analyze the multi- energy-stream characteristics by equipment modelling of the combined cooling, heating and power system. And the optimal configuration based on the optimization objectives such as the annual reduction rate of C02, the annual saving rate of primary energy and the annual saving rate of operating cost is carried out. The simulation model was established by using the annual energy consumption data of an office building and compared -with the sub supply system. The results showed that the model has obviously benefits in terms of C02 emission reduction and primary energy saving, and the comparison proved the rationality of the proposed optimization scheme.

articleTitle: The Development Review of Airborne Fire Control Radar Technology
abstract: Three development stages of airborne fire control radar were summarized, based on the analysis of the multi-functional mission requirements, the need to combat strong surface clutter, and the limitations of the platform. Based on the mission characteristics of future fighters, the development needs of airborne fire control radars were analyzed, including full stealth, environmental adaptation, stronger detection capabilities, stronger cooperation capabilities, and reduced aircraft requirements and costs. Finally, the development trend of airborne fire control radar was predicted from two aspects of advanced radar system and integrated design, so as to provide technical reference for the development of airborne fire control radar.

articleTitle: Resilient Consensus Control for Multi-Agent Systems Against Attacks and Noises
abstract: In this paper, the resilient consensus control problem for multi-agent systems against actuator attacks and measurement noises is studied. Under some existing consensus protocols, attacks and noises have great influences on the consensus performance of multi-agent systems. Therefore, an observer-based resilient consensus protocol is designed for each agent to mitígate the adverse effects of attacks and noises. The proposed observer can estímate the system state and attack signal by using the contaminated measurement output Meanwhile, the observer gain is designed to suppress the amplitude of the noise. Based on this observer, the proposed consensus protocol can make the consensus error bounded in the presence of attacks and noises. Finally, an illustrative example is provided to demonstrate the availability of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Research on Infrared Image Processing Algorithm of Generator Carbon Brush Based on Adaptive Stochastic Resonance Array
abstract: The safe and stable operation of the generator set is related to the national economy and people's livelihood. As an important part of generator excitation system, carbon brush and slip ring temperature monitoring can effectively evaluate the state of the generator, which plays a vital role. Most of the current researches use infrared images to monitor carbon brush temperature, but there are often problems such as high noise and unclear focus. According to the requirements of infrared image display, this paper combines the method of bistable stochastic resonance to denoise the image, and on this basis, introduces the adaptive stochastic resonance array method to denoise the gray image. Experimental results show that compared with common image denoising methods and classic bistable stochastic resonance, the adaptive stochastic resonance array method has improved both visual effects and peak signal- to-noise ratio (PSNR), which further proves the good application of stochastic resonance in weak signal detection and extraction.

articleTitle: A Sparse Taxi Trajectory Data Recovery and Calibrate Algorithm
abstract: Data sparseness is a common problem in many taxi trajectories. After analyzing the characteristics of taxi operation, this paper proposes a sparse taxi trajectory recovery and calibrate algorithm which based on the reference systems (RS) and used heterogeneous data sources. The algorithm increases the number of points in the original trajectory through searching and selecting RS points. Then the trajectory is interpolated and calibrated to improve accuracy and solve sparsity. We test our algorithm by real taxi trajectory data and display visual results in experiment. The all-day trajectory is restored and showed with its high accuracy, feasibility and credibility. It can effectively reduce the candidate paths and recover the taxi trajectory.

articleTitle: A Novel Safety-enabled Belief-based Behavioral Decision-making Method for Autonomous Driving
abstract: The behavioral decision is one of the challenging tasks in autonomous driving because multi-sensors data for decision making may be uncertain and in high conflict. In this case, how to fuse the information to achieve a reasonable and cautious decision is an important issue. In this paper, we propose a novel belief-based behavioral decision-making method aiming to fuse the data from multi-sensors at the decision level to obtain a more cautious result. The data from multi-sensors is mapped to corresponding behavioral decisions which are taken as multiple pieces of evidence. Multiple pieces of evidence can be divided into several groups according to the most belief class. As the new evidence by combining the pieces of evidence in the same group is in conflict, a new belief-based biased combination rule is proposed to solve the conflict evidence fusion problem. On this basis, uncertainty is represented by committing the result to the proper meta-classes. The conflict and uncertain behavior decision will be reasonably committed to some proper results. The effectiveness of the proposed method has been tested and compared with other combination rules through a series of experiments.

articleTitle: Demand Charge Control for Energy-intensive Enterprises based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: With the advancement of the dual-carbon goal and energy consumption revolution, demand-side management relying on smart grids has gradually become the focus of related research. Due to the obvious surging and high uncertainty of the power load of energy-intensive enterprises, it is difficult to obtain the best control strategy for demand charge. In this paper, we solve the problem of multi-equipment demand charge control for multi-batch tasks with discontinuous production by controlling the load of controllable equipment to reduce electricity costs. To solve the problems of long-time sequence with time coupled and complex systems with difficult modeling, we established a Markov decision process (MDP) model for real-time demand charge control innovatively. To avoid the curse of dimensionality caused by the increasing state space, we introduced the deep Q learning (DQN) algorithm, which successfully solves MDP problems with large state space. Moreover, we introduced constrained deep Q-learning (CDQN) aiming at a large number of action constraints in the problem, which selects the optimal action from the feasible action zone instead of the whole action space to improve the training efficiency and data utilization. Finally, we conducted experiments on simulation case experiments. Under the basic day-ahead production scheduling plan, real-time demand charge control can reduce costs by 10.4% compared with uncontrolled, indicating that this method has achieved excellent performance in obtaining demand charge control strategies.

articleTitle: Impulsive Consensus of Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems with Hybrid Delays
abstract: The global and exponential consensus problem of a kind of nonlinear multi-agent systems is intensively investigated by applying a valid distributed impulsive pinning control strategy. Due to different kinds of information transmissions in some real networks and systems. In addition to the general time-varying delay, the distributed delay is also considered for the purpose of increasing the universality of the system model. Based on the theories of the parametric variation, the Lyapunov function method, the comparison principle with delay and the average impulsive interval, sufficient conditions for the global and exponential consensus of nonlinear multi-agent systems with hybrid time-varying delays are derived by considering the positive and negative impulsive effects, respectively. Correspondingly, different convergence rates are precisely calculated with thinking significantly different roles of the impulsive effects. Moreover, the sufficient rationality of the main theories are illustrated successfully according to some numerical examples.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal T-S fuzzy Controller of Nonlinear Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motor for Speed Tracking
abstract: This paper investigates the multi-objective control of the nonlinear permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) system. To this end, the T-S fuzzy approach is introduced to tackle the synthesis of the speed control under nonlinear dynamics. Then, a novel multi-objective bat algorithm (NMOBA) is proposed for optimizing the constructed T-S fuzzy controller. Specifically, the virtual desired variables are utilized for developing the fuzzy tracking control to trace the desired speed profiles. Theoretical analyses demonstrate that the proposed control strategy can simplify the nonlinear controller design. Furthermore, the challenge in the optimization of the T-S fuzzy controller is addressed, that is, complex adjustable parameters usually lead to multiple local optima. To avoid premature convergence without losing efficiency, the hybrid mechanism is designed for the proposed NMOBA to enhance convergence and diversity of the swarm. Experimental results on a real-world PMSM system illustrate that the proposed controller has a significant advantage over the traditional LMI-based T-S fuzzy controller.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of time fractional heat conduction equation for monocrystalline silicon
abstract: In this paper, a time-fractional heat conduction model is established to describe the heat transfer process of monocrystalline silicon in the Czochralski method. The numerical solution of the fractional-order model is obtained by using implicit difference scheme. In addition, an improved grey wolf algorithm is proposed to estimate the parameters of the fractional heat conduction model using the experimental temperature data. The numerical experiment results show that the time-fractional heat conduction model has a higher explanatory ability, compared with the classical heat conduction model. The Improved Grey Wolf algorithm proposed in this paper is effective in solving the parameter estimation problem of the time-fractional heat conduction equation.

articleTitle: Flow pattern identification of oil-water two-phase flow based on multi-feature convolutional neural network
abstract: In order to extract the multivariate characteristics of oil-water two-phase flow accurately and improve the accuracy of flow pattern identification, in this paper, we combine complex network and multivariate fluid feature to propose a multi-feature convolutional neural network. Firstly, we construct a 1D-CNN model for network input, and discuss the influence of each parameter setting on classification performance. Then the original signal (X), the energy signal (ES), the power spectrum signal (P) and the fused signal (M) are selected as the input of the 1D-CNN model respectively. The experimental results show that when we select fusion feature information as network input, the performance of two-phase flow pattern classification is the best. Finally, through multiple sets of experiments to verity the recognition performance of fusion feature information, it can reach 97.6% accuracy on the existing test set. Therefore, the 1D-CNN method based on deep learning theory provides a new idea for flow pattern identification.

articleTitle: Unsupervised feature selection based on robust self-representative dictionary pair learning with application to aluminum electrolysis
abstract: The purpose of feature selection is to remove the irrelevant and redundant features, and find the compact representation of the original features with good generalization ability in the high-dimensional data. In practical applications, a large number of high-dimensional data lead to the curse of dimensionality. Besides, the real data are much more complex, which is characterized by redundant, less labeled data and containing noise and outliers. To eliminate these unfavourable factors, an unsupervised feature selection method based on robust self-representative dictionary pair learning is proposed and applied to classification. The method does not require data labels, and uses representation coefficients to model the clustering structure and data distribution. The synthetical dictionary is used for data reconstruction, and the analytical dictionary is designed to analytically code data and assign probabilities to data features. Then, sparse regularization constraint is applied to the analytical dictionary to ensure robustness against noise and outliers in the data. Meanwhile, a regularized self-representative weight strategy is proposed, which uses the self-representative weight matrix to enhance the significance of important features. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experiments on the benchmark datasets and the anode current data in aluminum electrolysis.

articleTitle: Research on Precise Control Architecture of Servo Master Cylinder Hydraulic Pressure for Integrated Electronic Hydraulic Brake System
abstract: A precise control architecture of servo master cylinder hydraulic pressure for integrated electronic hydraulic brake system (IEHB) is proposed in this paper. First, we design a position-pressure dual-loop switching controller. The position loop is used to quickly eliminate the idle stroke, and the pressure loop uses a fuzzy-PI control method to achieve rapid and accurate follow-up for different target pressure. Then, the speed loop of the motor is designed by the improved sliding mode control method and nonlinear disturbance observer. The current loop adopts the PI control method combined with voltage feedforward. In order to increase the motor’s speed, a field weakening control by the gradient descent method is adopted, and the current is restricted to avoid the demagnetization of the permanent magnet. Finally, the co-simulation results of AMESim and MATLAB/Simulink show that under different ramp target pressure or sinusoidal target pressure conditions, the errors of pressure following and speed following are controlled within 1.45bar and 25rpm, respectively, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed control architecture.

articleTitle: Ground-to-air-Defense Firepower Assignment Decision Based on Non-cooperative Game
abstract: The key problem of ground-to-air defense is how to make accurate and effective firepower assignment decision for attacking targets. A multi-objective optimization model of ground-to-air defense firepower assignment is established with the aim of maximizing the damage probability and minimizing the weapon consumption, and non-cooperative game theory is used to solve the problem. A non-cooperative game model is established by mapping the two objectives to players, and weapon assignment schemes to strategy profiles. An improved tabu genetic algorithm based on Nash equilibrium is designed to get the assignment scheme. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better convergence and stability than the improved genetic algorithm based on tabu search for multi-objective optimization model.

articleTitle: Stabilization of A Class of Nonlinear Systems Subject to Periodic Disturbances
abstract: In this paper, we study the stabilization of a class of nonlinear system in a chained integrator form subject to linear parameterizable nonlinearities and continuous and periodic disturbance. By Fourier expansion, the periodic disturbance is divided into two parts. The dominate part consists of a constant bias and finitely many sinusoidal components with large amplitudes. While, the residual part consists of infinitely many sinusoidal components with comparatively small amplitude. By combining the internal model approach and the sliding mode control approach, we can handle the nonlinear system with exact disturbance rejection by a sliding mode controller with reduced gain in contrast to the solely sliding mode controller.

articleTitle: Adaptive Forwarding Output Feedback Control for Single Machine Infinite Bus System
abstract: In this article, an adaptive forwarding output feedback control strategy is investigated for a single machine infinite bus (SMIB) system with thyristor controlled series compensation (TCSC) device. A novel adaptive forwarding control strategy is proposed for the SMIB system. The order of the system is reduced gradually by implementing the immersion and invariance (I&I) control theory repetitively, and a requirement of solving the partial differential equations is obviated. Furthermore, an I&I observer is presented on the basis of adaptive I&I technique. By drawing an appropriately selected attractive manifold in the extended state space, an asymptotic estimation of the immeasurable state could be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on dual-arm robot coordinated transportation method based on admittance control
abstract: This paper presents a force coordinated operation control method based on admittance controller to complete the transportation tasks using dual-arm robot. Firstly, the D-H model of the robot is constructed to build the kinematics model about the dual-arm robot. Then, the forward and inverse kinematics of the robot are analyzed according to the above kinematics model. Furthermore, the constraints of the position and orientation for each arm are established. Lastly, based on the admittance control framework, the force controller between the end-effector of each robotic arm and the object is developed. The feasibility and effectiveness of the presented controller are verified by the simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Design of gain-type Smith predictor-fuzzy PID controller for heat exchanger test system
abstract: In the heat exchanger testing process, temperature control is characterized by time lag, nonlinearity, and time-varying parameters, which makes it difficult to achieve fast and stable PID control through conventional means. For this reason, a second-order mathematical model is constructed for the heat exchanger test system through mechanism analysis and experimentation, and a Smith predictive compensator is introduced into the loop for compensating the time lag in the controller in advance and improving the controlled speed. In the meantime, the gain method is used to correct the system model, thus compensating for the inaccuracy of the model and improving the robustness of the control system. As for the controller, it imposes fuzzy PID control to achieve the self-tuning of control parameters and improve the stability of the system. As revealed by the Matlab/Simulink simulation experiments, the gain-type Smith prediction-fuzzy PID control has a small overshoot and no oscillation period, in addition to reaching stability fast. According to the field test, the system is quick to meet the requirements on working condition, eliminate the risk of overshooting, and satisfy the testing requirements for heat exchangers.

articleTitle: Smart Infrared Temperature Measurement System Based On Elastic Compute Service Platform
abstract: In the fight against the novel coronavirus, this paper designs a smart infrared temperature measurement system based on the Elastic Compute Service platform. In the perceptual layer part of the Internet of Things(IoT), the system uses infrared temperature sensors to quickly collect the temperature of the forehead or arm of the human body and Uses the MCU to automatically transmits the measured data to the Elastic Compute Service through the WiFi module. In the network layer part of the Internet of Things,the data written into the database of the Elastic Compute Service through the program deployed on the Elastic Compute Service. In the application layer of the Internet of Things, the remote management terminal monitors the collected body temperature data in real-time and provides quick warnings. Finally, the User can log in to the applet on his mobile phone to quickly and easily obtain personal information.

articleTitle: 3D Tunnel Surface Reconstruction Method in Complex Scenarios
abstract: Three-dimensional reconstruction of a tunnel is an indispensable process to the understanding of tunnel environment. A 3D surface reconstruction algorithm based on an improved Iterative Closest Points (ICP) algorithm and Greedy Projection Triangulation (GPT) algorithm is proposed to obtain the information of tunnel surface, which is the critical foundation of an automation tunnel shotcrete construction system. Firstly, tunnel arched surface features are extracted by an improved Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) algorithm, whose key parameters are selected by a proposed strategy. Then, we have improved the ICP algorithm on the basis of geometric features of tunnel to register the tunnel point cloud, specifically, the error metric is reformed by the non-linear least squares and the change of normal angles between a point and its neighboring points. With the output result of registration, a GPT algorithm is used to reconstruct the tunnel surface. Finally, we compared the time and fineness of the reconstructed surface with existing methods and our algorithm performs more balanced between running time and the fineness of the reconstructed surface.

articleTitle: Function Projective Synchronization of Chaotic PMSMs with Certain and Uncertain System Parameters
abstract: In recent years, driven by huge engineering demands, industrial Cyber-Physical System (iCPS) has developed rapidly. As an important energy conversion device in iCPS, stable operation of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is very important to ensure the availability of the whole iCPS. In this paper, based on Lyapunov stability theory, the function projective synchronization (FPS) of chaotic PMSM systems with certain and uncertain system parameters are investigated, respectively. The proposed control method is proved by using explicit numerical theory and then applied in numerical simulations. From the results of simulations, effectiveness of the control method is obviously. Our study can solve the synchronization and motors coordination problem in industry manufacture.

articleTitle: An automatic segmentation algorithm for high-throughput digital PCR fluorescence images
abstract: Digital polymerase chain reaction (dPCR) fluorescence images are interfered by uneven illumination, which is difficult to be accurately segmented by traditional threshold methods. This paper developed a gray fluctuation threshold segmentation algorithm to solve this problem. Firstly, the image is preprocessed based on the Gaussian scale space (GSS) theory, which deeply improves the contrast of the image. Then the grayscale fluctuation curves of the image are extracted from the horizontal and vertical directions respectively, and all the fluctuation curves are iteratively searched for the large-scale wave peaks satisfying the specific fluctuation amplitude. Finally, each wave curve is segmented by the floating threshold, and the final segmented image is formed by the logical operation of the segmentation results in the two directions. Experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method is highly accurate compared to the traditional methods. The segmentation accuracy of the proposed method is above 97%, which is much higher than traditional segmentation methods.

articleTitle: Research and experiment on a new method for position measurement of magnetic suspension and balance system
abstract: magnetic suspension and balance system technology is a new wind tunnel balance test technology, which uses electromagnetic force to hang the tested aircraft model, which can theoretically solve the problem of mechanical support interference of aircraft models in traditional wind tunnel test technology. The magnetic suspension and balance system needs to measure the position of the hanging object in real-time. Generally, a Charge-coupled Device(CCD) sensor is used to obtain the linear marker, but this method can not adapt to the operation of the model with a rolling direction. In order to eliminate the influence of hanging object rolling motion on vertical position measurement, a new CCD position extraction method is designed. In view of the influence of noise on the gradient value extraction of image gray, it is difficult to extract the hanging object pixel position signal from the gradient value, so the tracking differentiator is introduced to effectively extract the gradient value from the CCD image gray value signal. According to the characteristics of the CCD image gradient signal, a pattern matching method is studied. The pixel position signal of the hanging object is extracted from the gradient value to prevent the wrong extraction of the pixel position signal and then mapped to the corresponding real coordinate value of the hanging object according to the function. Finally, the proposed method is verified and analyzed by experiments.

articleTitle: An Improved PageRank Algorithm for Critical Nodes Identification in Railway Timetable with Disturbances by Multilayer Complex Networks
abstract: This paper studies the railway timetable from a network science perspective. A multilayer model, consisting of different layers of trains, is proposed to describe the activities (i.e., arrival, departure, and pass through) within and among trains in the railway timetable as a railway timetable network (RTN). A new node centrality measure, called improved PageRank (i-PR), is introduced to determine the set of critical nodes which have a significant effect on the train delay caused by the disturbances in RTN. This measure will be higher when fewer time supplements in sections/stations or buffer time between trains. We analyze the performance of RTN by simulating the possible delay propagation under a FSFS (first-scheduled-firstserved) policy. The results provide an assessment of the delay in the railway system, which helps the railway dispatcher find the critical nodes in the timetable and improve the operation of the trains.

articleTitle: Research on NO2-NO Conversion Mechanism and Conversion Efficiency Measurement Control of Diesel Nitrogen Oxide Detector
abstract: Nitrogen oxides have always been one of the important indicators for evaluating ambient air quality, and strict quality control measures are an important guarantee for the accuracy of automatic monitoring results. This paper discusses the conversion mechanism of NO2-NO in diesel vehicle nitrogen oxide detector and introduces the calculation method of molybdenum furnace conversion efficiency. By optimizing the design of experimental steps and measuring process control, a reliable measurement scheme of conversion rate is developed. The experimental results show that the standard gas method is a relatively reliable test method of conversion efficiency. The concentration of NO2 standard gas, reaction time and other factors will affect the conversion rate measurement results. In addition, during actual use, the conversion efficiency of the molybdenum core of the detector catalyst will aging and decay with time. The relevant regulatory authorities should design corresponding management mechanisms to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the detection results of such equipment.

articleTitle: Control for Saltatory Speed Profile Tracking under Equipment Failures for High-speed Automatic Train Operation
abstract: This paper presents a new switching control scheme for curve tracking problem of automatic train operation under equipment failures. Saltatory speed profile means the abrupt change of reference trajectory of speed when equipment failures occur or removed. To ensure the safety of train operating, ATO have to adopt a reliable method. The proposed scheme holds three stages: high-speed train’s operation with no failure, deceleration and operation under speed restriction and acceleration and adjustment of position and speed after equipment failures are removed. The designed control scheme can be guaranteed to be stable in the closed-loop systems based on the Lyapunov stability analysis. Simulation results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed control approach.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Method Based on Image Processing and SIFT-SVM
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the accuracy of gesture recognition is not high due to the camera's shooting angle and depth information being affected by illumination, this paper proposes a gesture recognition method based on image processing and SIFT-SVM. First construct a gesture recognition data set, perform image processing such as denoising and segmentation on the collected pictures, then extract the geometric features of gestures through the Scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) algorithm, and finally use the support vector machine (SVM) to classifies and recognizes different detected gestures. The simulation experiment results show that the accuracy of the method proposed in this paper reaches 99.89%, it has strong robustness, and the recognition speed is faster to meet the needs of general applications.

articleTitle: Robust composite control of telescopic wing morphing aircraft with control allocation
abstract: In this paper, the problem of anti-disturbance, anti-saturation and fixed-time control for a class of telescopic wing morphing aircraft is studied. The telescopic wing morphing aircraft treats the variable wingspan as an extra control input to construct the dynamic model of the morphing-aided maneuver. According to the model characteristics, the controller design is divided into two loops: the speed loop and the attitude loop. Through a fixed-time continuous feedback control scheme, fixed time of the tracking reference trajectory is ensured. By combining the integral sliding mode control (ISMC) method with super-twisting control (STC), the uncertainties of aerodynamic coefficients and external disturbances are overcome. In addition, the anti-saturation problem of the aircraft actuator is solved by the initial solution correction method based on Null-space augmented solutions. The simulation result shows that the designed algorithm has great tracking performance, while the robustness and anti-saturation performance are guaranteed.

articleTitle: A Hybrid System Framework for Event-triggered Control of Polynomial Systems
abstract: This paper proposes an event-triggered controller method to polynomial systems via a hybrid system framework. Firstly, an event-triggered rule is proposed to design a controller within the framework of the hybrid systems. Secondly, the local asymptotical stability of the hybrid system is guaranteed via Lyapunov-based theory. Finally, the validity of the proposed event-triggered controller is demonstrated with two examples.

articleTitle: Application of simulated annealing artificial fish swarm algorithm in pulp concentration control
abstract: To obtain the optimal controller parameters to meet the pulp concentration field control requirements, better overcome the control difficulties. In the paper, a simulated annealing artificial fish swarm hybrid algorithm is proposed. Because of the poor convergence of AFSA in late-stage and the strong ability of the SA algorithm to escape local optimal, SA mechanism is introduced, with AFSA as the main framework, and the SA_AFSA hybrid algorithm is combined. The algorithm is applied to the pulp concentration control system and compared with other tuning methods. The optimization method combines the advantages of the two algorithms, has a fast convergence speed and is not easy to fall into local optimal. The PID controller parameters adjusted by this method can get a relatively ideal control effect. The system is excessively stable, has fast response, slight overshoot, meets the requirements of practical application.

articleTitle: PDE Model-based Adaptive Control for Rigid-flexible Manipulator with Actuator Fault and Asymmetric Output Constraint
abstract: This article considered a PDE-based adaptive control method for the coupled rigid-flexible manipulator system with actuator failure and asymmetric output constraint. By using the coupled ordinary differential equations and partial differential equation (ODEs-PDE) model to describe the dynamics of the system. To deal with the actuator failures, adaptive direct joint control strategy is studied to ensure the position tracking and vibration suppression. Besides, a piecewise barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) candidate method is proposed to guarantee asymmetric output constraints. The semigroup theory and the extended LaSalle’s Invariance Principle are applied to prove the asymptotic stability of the coupled rigid-flexible system. The contrast simulation shows that the controller is effective.

articleTitle: Integral sliding mode ADRC of modular robot manipulators using joint torque sensing: an experimental verification
abstract: Aiming at the uncertain terms of the modular robot manipulator (MRM) system model and the interconnected dynamic coupling (IDC) terms between subsystems, the extended state observer (ESO) is used to estimate and compensate the IDC term and friction term. Integral sliding mode ADRC is proposed in this paper, which can reduce the steady-state error and solve the problems of large overshoot and long adjustment time. Under the condition of large initial error situation, by adjusting the integral term factor, and the system is stable. Theoretical analysis and experimental research verify the effectiveness of the proposed integral sliding mode ADRC of MRM using joint torque sensing method.

articleTitle: A Novel 6D Pose Estimation Method for Indoor Objects Based on Monocular Regression Depth
abstract: Estimating the 6D pose of known objects has attracted a lot of research attention since it is important for intelligent robot manipulation and virtual reality. In this paper, in order to improve the performance of 6D pose estimation using RGB image, we propose a novel 6D object pose estimation framework based on monocular regression depth. To get the depth map of the RGB image, we use a U-Net framework to regress the depth information effectively. For 6D pose estimation, our approach has two steps, which first uses the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract the feature of the RGB data and the regressed depth data, respectively. Then we adopt a pixel-wise dense fusion module to extract the dense feature to estimate the final 6D object pose. The experiments conducted on the YCB-Video dataset have demonstrated the effectiveness of our approach, and the experiment results show that the proposed method achieves an outstanding performance using only RGB images.

articleTitle: SAR Ship Detection Based on Attention Pyramids Network for Complex Scenes
abstract: As one of the core tasks of ocean monitoring, Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) ship detection can provide important clues for military intelligence acquisition and ocean exploration, which plays a vital role in both military and civilian fields. However, the current ship detection method in complex scenes always suffer the inaccurate feature extraction. In this paper, we proposed a new SAR ship detection method for complex scenes based on attention pyramids network(CSAPN). The CSAPN adopts the pyramid structure, and the convolutional block attention modules are applied into each process of multi-scale feature map extraction. In this way, the related features to objects will be enhanced and the unrelated features will be suppressed. The results on real Gaofen-3 SAR data demonstrate the algorithm proposed in this study have the capability to suppress the interferences in complex scenes with a excellent accuracy.

articleTitle: An improved weighted iterative algorithm for Riccati matrix equation in discrete-time Markov jump system
abstract: This paper has come up with a novel iterative method which can obtain the unique solutions of the discrete coupled Riccati matrix equations. Firstly, with introducing a weighted parameter between the latest estimated information and the past information, we propose an iterative algorithm to solve the discrete coupled Riccati matrix equations. Then, the weighted parameter can be replaced with a diagonal parameter matrix to accelerate the convergence rate of solving the matrix equations. It makes further shown that the matrix sequence in the proposed algorithm can converge to the unique solutions of the matrix equation. In the end, a numerical example is shown to illustrate the feasibility of the iterative algorithm.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control of yarn’s tension based on improved reaching law
abstract: When the sliding mode control method based on the traditional exponential reaching law is applied to the yarn’s tension control system, chattering phenomenon will increase the output fluctuation of the controller and reduce stability of system. The problem of slow convergence speed will reduce the dynamic response speed and increase the adjusting time of the system. To solve these problems, the sliding mode control method based on improved reaching law is proposed. In improved reaching law, reasonable reaching terms are designed and the continuous function is used instead of symbolic function. The stability of improved reaching law is proved by Lyapunov stability theory. The simulation results show that, compared with the sliding mode control method based on traditional exponential reaching law, the improved method can not only effectively suppress chattering phenomenon, but also improve the convergence speed and robustness. The yarn’s tension control system has better convergence characteristic, dynamic performance and stability.

articleTitle: Composite Radix Tree-A Storage Method for Efficient Retrieval of Massive Data
abstract: The surge of massive data brings difficulties in data storage and data processing for academic researches and applications in plenty of fields. The storage and retrieval of massive data are the important keys for data analysis and data processing. The lack of a suitable data storage solution will lead to a bottleneck in the development of technology based on big data. In the current era, solving the problem of massive data storage and efficient data search is a crucial problem that exists in various fields, and the existing data structures still have many shortcomings in these aspects. In order to innovate and optimize the commonly used data structure—radix tree for data storage, in this paper we design composite radix tree to reduce the data storage space as much as possible while improving the efficiency of massive data retrieval. The composite radix tree data structure provides a new solution for massive data storage and data search.

articleTitle: A Pose Synchronization Control Method for the Approach Phase of Lunar Lander
abstract: Aiming at the problem of autonomous obstacle avoidance in the approach phase of lunar soft landing, a dynamic autonomous obstacle avoidance strategy of "open-loop first, closed-loop afterwards " is proposed in the accurate obstacle avoidance stage, and the pose synchronization control problem in the open-loop control stage of this strategy is studied. First, establishing the dynamic model of the approach phase in the local coordinate system of the target point, and on this basis, describing the field-of-view constraint of the visual sensor, boundary conditions and performance index in the pose synchronization optimal control problem. Then based on the improved salp swarm algorithm (ISSA) and the compound penalty function, the global optimization of the pose synchronization optimal control problem is performed. Finally, a variety of simulation examples are used to verify the performance of the proposed algorithm, and the simulation results show the effectiveness of the designed algorithm

articleTitle: Robust Discriminative Object Tracker Optimized with KL Divergence
abstract: Object tracking is to evaluate the state of a target object in a video sequence at each frame. Despite the astonishing improvements in visual tracking over the years, trackers remain vulnerable to target drift in target estimation when confronting similar distractors or intricate backgrounds. To address these problems, We disaggregate the object tracking task into a conjunction of a classification task and a regression task. For the classification task, Our online multi-layer fusion branch makes the most of target and contextual information. For the regression branch, we adopt the IoU-based method optimized with Kullback-Leibler divergence using Monte Carlo sampling, which models label noise stemming from inaccurate annotations. This simple and effective tracker is termed as MInet. Without bells and whistles, MInet enables leading performance with realtime speeds on five tracking benchmarks comprising OTB2015, VOT2018, LaSOT, UAV123 and GOT-10K, achieving an NP of 0.706 on LaSOT and AO of 0.656 on GOT-10K.

articleTitle: Mapless navigation based on continuous deep reinforcement learning
abstract: This paper proposes a map-free navigation scheme based on continuous deep reinforcement learning to solve the problem that robots cannot flexibly avoid obstacles and navigate in a dynamic environment. The reinforcement learning algorithm used in this article is near-end strategy optimization (proximal strategy optimization, PPO), and the benchmark algorithm is the discrete deep reinforcement learning algorithm Deep Q network algorithm (Deep Q network, DQN).Experiments in the Gazebo simulation environment prove that the training efficiency and success rate of the PPO algorithm are much higher than that of the DQN algorithm. In this paper, the trained strategy model in the simulation environment is directly transplanted to the actual robot. The experimental results verify that the physical robot can have good navigation and obstacle avoidance capabilities without training again. The tested single-target navigation success rate is 80%, and the multi-target navigation success rate is 70%.

articleTitle: End point inference control in the process of argon-oxygen refining low carbon ferrochrome based on adaptive fuzzy neural network
abstract: In the process of argon-oxygen refining low carbon ferrochrome, the temperature and carbon content control of end point are the core of the whole blowing process, however refining process is very complex, multiphase and high temperature and the boundary conditions are constantly changing in the control process, the carbon content of molten iron can not be detected continuously online, the reaction process is affected by many uncertain factors ,it brings great difficulty to the end point control of refining process, for the above question, Based on mathematical models, this paper presents an adaptive fuzzy neural network inference control method, Control the end point temperature and carbon content of molten iron, select the temperature of molten iron as the secondary output, select carbon content as the main output, the carbon content of molten iron is controlled indirectly by controlling the temperature of molten iron, an inference controller is designed, for when the model is mismatched, the filter parameters of the controller remain always be unchanged, for characteristics that affects control performance of the system, an adaptive fuzzy neural network is proposed to dynamically adjust the filter parameters online, the simulation results showed that this method has good performance of anti-interference, robustness and set value tracking, the method also provides an effective way to solve the control problem of industrial objects whose output and disturbance are unmeasurable.

articleTitle: Event-based guaranteed cost control for semi-Markov cyber-physical jump systems with redundant channels
abstract: This study investigates the problem of guaranteed cost control for event-triggered semi-Markov jump systems with redundant channels. The dynamic event-triggered methodology is applied to solve the problem of redundant network communication. Based on delay system methodology and free-weighting matrices, the collaborative design of guaranteed cost controllers and the dynamic event-triggered strategy can be generated under reasonable linear matrix inequalities. Redundant channels have been utilized to increase the success rate of the network release date, meanwhile, they can also be followed by two unrelated Bernoulli distributed random variables. In order to guarantee the stochastic stability of event-triggered semi-Markov jump systems, some prerequisites are given. Finally, the simulation result is shown to illustrate the performance of the collaborative design method.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Robust Dual-graph Concept Factorization via L2,1 Norm
abstract: Recently, as an effective paradigm for representation learning, Concept Factorization (CF) has attracted a great deal of interests in the areas of machine learning and data mining. However, it is difficult for existing CF related algorithms to effectively learn data manifold and feature manifold while utilizing the label information of data to learn more discriminative features. To overcome this problem, we propose a novel method called semi-supervised robust dual-graph CF (named RGCCF), which considers the manifold of data and features and combines the limited label information. Furthermore, an effective optimized method is proposed to solve the RGCCF problem. The experimential results on real-world datasets shows that RGCCF can achieve better clustering performance compared with the other CF-based methods.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient control of dual-motor electric vehicles considering slope information
abstract: The availability of traffic information provides a good opportunity for vehicles to improve their energy efficiency. In this paper, a speed-optimised control strategy that takes into account information about the slope of road ahead is designed for a dual-motor electric vehicle (EV) to achieve maximum efficiency. Based on the vehicle dynamics model, the dual motor torque and the vehicle braking torque are selected as control variables, the expressions and boundary constraints of the control problem are constructed, the efficiency of the dual motors is considered, and then the optimisation problem is solved iteratively in a non-linear model predictive control framework combined with Pontryagin’s maximum principle and the dichotomy method. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed control strategy is able to improve energy consumption per distance compared with the conventional adaptive cruise control strategy, thus ensuring the combined performance of vehicle dynamics and economy.

articleTitle: Using External Attention in Vision-based Autonomous Driving
abstract: Imitation learning (IL) method provides a concise framework for autonomous driving, and it learns the policy from human demonstration via mapping from sensor data to vehicle controls. However, how to achieve effective learning is an ongoing challenge in driving policy learning. A feasible solution is to introduce attention mechanism, which enables the deep model focus on the features related to the driving task. In this paper, we propose to train a driving policy model with latest external attention joining the policy network as blocks. The experimental results on CARLA driving benchmark demonstrate our external attention guided driving policy model has better performance and costs less training time than the model without attention mechanism. Moreover, our method outperforms the state-of-thearts self-attention driving policy methods.

articleTitle: A Spectral Pre-processing Method Based on Transfer Dictionary with application to the Quantitative Analysis of TN within Freshwaters
abstract: During the online quantitative analysis of total nitrogen, numerous data is needed for dictionary learning to better represent the spectrum. However, the amount of on-site sampling data is limited, which cannot meet the requirement of dictionary learning. Therefore, this paper proposes a pre-processing algorithm based on the transfer dictionary, which can update the source dictionary with small samples to perform online spectral pre-processing. To better measure the effectiveness of the method, the experiment executes classical pre-processing algorithms separately, and then combines with partial least squares to predict the concentration of total nitrogen. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can improve the accuracy of total nitrogen detection.

articleTitle: Finite time control based on dual-layer adaptive disturbance observer for uncertain nonlinear systems
abstract: A finite time backstepping sliding mode control strategy for a class of non-integral cascade high-order uncertain non-linear systems is proposed. First, for the system disturbances, a dual-layer adaptive disturbance observer (DLA-DO) is designed. Then a backstepping control strategy via a distributed fast terminal sliding mode is presented. And the closed-loop system achieves semi-globally uniformly ultimately finite time bounded. Finally, simulation results show the validity of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Industrial Robot based on Fuzzy Multi-attribute Decision-making of Knowledge Graph
abstract: The internal structure and functions of industrial robots are complex, and the traditional text lookup method is inefficient in fault diagnosis because of knowledge is too scattered. Fragmented knowledge can be effectively integrated by knowledge graph. Therefore, knowledge model is designed based on text data and the fault knowledge graph of industrial robots is stored in the Neo4j database. Aiming at the shortcomings of low accuracy of knowledge graph decision-making, a fault evaluation methods combining knowledge graph and fuzzy multi-attribute decision-making (KG- FMADM) is proposed.
