The analytic hierarchy process(AHP) theory and the TOPSIS method are selected to establish an evaluation system. Then the sequencing results of multiple fault chains are inferred and analyzed in detail. Finally, the effectiveness of KG-FMADM in the fault evaluation is verified with the sets of fault chain data. The results show that the proposed method can improve the accuracy of fault assessment, so that it can ensure the scientiflcity and rationality of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Inverter Fault Diagnosis Strategy Based on Compressed Sensing and Wavelet Packet Decomposition
abstract: To solve the open circuit fault problem in the inverter system. a three-phase inverter fault feature extraction method based on compressed sensing and wavelet packet decomposition (CS-WPD) is proposed. Take the open circuit fault diagnosis of insulated gate bipolar type (IGBT) in three-phase inverter as an example. Firstly, a simulation model of the three-phase inverter topology is established, the phase voltage is adopted as the fault signal, and convert the three-phase voltage signal to two-phase through Clark transformation, and then use the CS algorithm to sample the data. Compression is used to improve the signal processing speed. Secondly, the WPD of energy entropy is used to extract the characteristics of the voltage signal. Finally, the BP neural network is optimized by the beetle antennae search algorithm (BAS) to implement fault diagnosis and compare it with the traditional BP neural network. Network identification methods are compared. The simulation results show that the accuracy and robustness of the system are effectively improved. The accuracy of IGBT tube fault diagnosis reaches 98.29%, the results show that the proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Finite and infinite clusters mean field control problems via graphon theory
abstract: In this paper, we study the social optimality for mean field linear-quadratic control systems following direct method, where subsystems are coupled via individual dynamics and costs. A graph is introduced to represent the large-population system, where nodes represent subpopulations called clusters and edges represent coupling relationship. First, a gauge transformation is used to decouple the mean field system in the finite clusters case then the optimal controller under the centralized information pattern is obtained. Based on centralized results and graphs, distributed and decentralized controller are further designed by mean field approximations, and the asymptotically social optimality of the decentralized controller is further proved. Finally, the situation of infinite clusters is studied through graphon theory. The results show that two Riccati equations are needed, one of which is a low-dimensional calculated by its own subpopulation information and a high-dimensional calculated by all population information.

articleTitle: Bone lesion detection using attention mechanism and multi-scales feature fusion network
abstract: From the radiographic appearances, bone lesions may occasionally be possible to make a diagnosis. One of the challenges in computer aided diagnosis of bone disease lies in inaccurate lesion detection due to insufficient number and types of training samples. In this work, we aim to improve the detection accuracy and efficiency by constructing a new multi-scale detection network that integrates attention mechanisms and features fusion into the cascaded R-CNN. First, according to the characteristics of orthopedic medical imaging and the characteristics of lesion annotations in the data set, more original bone lesion data were screened out. Secondly, through experimental analysis, the most favorable three scale features are selected for multi- scale detection, and a fusion method called Y-FPN for this work is proposed. Then, the attention mechanism module is used to improve the basic unit of backbone. Finally, random multi-scale training strategy is used to cover different sizes of target lesions. Experiments have been performed on bone CT images from NIH Deep Lesion Dataset. The recall of our model on the test set is 0.879, which is better than the existing model’s results for bone lesions detection.

articleTitle: Learning to Find Good Correspondences Based on Global and Local Attention Mechanism
abstract: We are committed to designing a method for establishing a set of reliable correspondences between two images in this paper. Previous work proposes an outlier removal network based on global and local attention mechanism. It normalizes the feature map under the guidance of attention weight, as a result the robustness to outliers is improved and inliers are better preserved. However, element-wise multiplication of these two different attentions makes them unable to perform their original functions. In order to overcome this limitation, a network based on attention mechanism has been designed in our work. Firstly, global attention is employed to compute a global weight which can help normalization focus on inliers and reduce the influence of outliers on context information. Secondly, to extract channel information, we use local attention to learn a channel weight for each correspondence. Finally, the above structures and residual network modules are combined for correspondence establishment. Experimental results show that our method is better than other SOTA methods.

articleTitle: Observer Design of Nonlinear Vehicle System with Unmeasurable Premise Variable
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of observer design for autonomous ground vehicles with unmeasurable premise variables. A new design method of fuzzy observer is proposed, which can not only effectively solve the research difficulty of observer synthesis of vehicle TS fuzzy system with unmeasurable premise variables, but also obtain an observer with fewer fuzzy rules, so as to reduce the computational burden of the existing design method and overcome its limitations in complex vehicle control system. Therefore, the nonlinear terms in the vehicle lateral dynamics model are divided into three categories: the measurable nonlinear terms related to longitudinal velocity and yaw velocity, the measurable nonlinear terms unrelated to longitudinal velocity and yaw velocity, and the unmeasurable nonlinear terms related to lateral velocity. Then, they are used as local nonlinear submodels of the vehicle system fuzzy model about the measurable nonlinear terms independent of longitudinal velocity and yaw velocity and the unmeasurable nonlinear terms related to lateral velocity, and only the measurable nonlinear terms related to longitudinal velocity and yaw velocity are used as anther variables of the vehicle fuzzy model. It is effectively solved that the research difficulty of vehicle TS fuzzy system observer with unmeasured premise variables.

articleTitle: Combining FEM and GA for Small PCR Temperature Unit Thermal Cladding Thickness Optimization
abstract: Accurate, fast and uniform of polymerase chain reaction (PCR) instrument control temperature are the key factors for high-efficiency DNA amplification. Although thermal cladding of a temperature unit can improve the stability of temperature control, the improper material thickness will also introduce negative influence, such as large dynamic error, slow respond. It is still a challenging of thermal coating thickness design in a miniaturized PCR instrument. Here, we propose a new coating thickness calculation method, which combines the finite-element method (FEM) and the genetic algorithm (GA) to pursuit the optimal coating thickness. Firstly, the temperature related units, which include a base, a heat dissipation, and a thermal cover, were modeled; Sequentially, to obtain the temperature field transient solution, the rules of heat transfer conditions were established; Furthermore, coating thickness, steady- and transient-state temperature fields are obtained through a GA optimization with temperature parameter constrained. In the numerical simulation experiments, the proposed method is verified by using a 16 holes, 40*40mm, aluminum PCR base. The results indicate that the optimal coating thickness is 19mm; the transient temperature control error is lower than ±0.15°C; and the uniformity of the base surface is lower than ±0.1 °C. The proposed method has significance for using in FEM-based manufacturing parameter or control parameter calculation.

articleTitle: Modeling and temperature control of a distributed solar trough field
abstract: The temperature control of the collector field plays an important role in the safe and economic operation of solar thermal power plant. This paper focuses on the modeling and the temperature control strategy of a distributed solar trough field. To begin with, both a distributed parameter model and a lumped parameter model are established for the collector field. After that, by combining a steady-state-calculation-based feedforward controller with multiple local PI controllers, a total How control scheme is proposed. In addition, the outlet temperatures of the collectors are used as state feedback to promptly reflect the influence of solar radiation and How changes. Subsequently, two temperature homogenization control methods for the collector Held are put forward. Simulations are carried out to show the effectiveness of the proposed temperature control and homogenization schemes of the collector Held.

articleTitle: Feedback quasi-consensus of first-order nonlinear heterogeneous multi-agent systems
abstract: The quasi-consistency problem of heterogeneous multi-agent system is solved by the state feedback control method in this paper. Based on Lyapunov function method and inequality technique, the design method of feedback gain is analyzed, and a new control protocol is proposed. The heterogeneous multi-agent system is connected and coupled together by the designed control protocol and a reliable coupling weight is designed for the coupling between different agents in the coupling protocol The quasi-consistency of the whole heterogeneous multi-agent system is realized by adjusting the state information between the coupling agents and the convergence range of the heterogeneous multiagent system is obtained according to the designed control protocol and coupling edge weight. Finally, the results of numerical simulation prove the effectiveness and feasibility of the design method.

articleTitle: A dulcimer keys positioning method based on improved Roberts operator
abstract: It is important for the dulcimer robot to obtain the spatial coordinates of the dulcimer phonemes. However, the traditional manual positioning method is both inefficient and does not meet the intelligence requirements of modern robot. A visual positioning method based on improved Roberts operator is proposed in this paper on account of solving these problems, which can obtain the 3D coordinates of the dulcimer keys in a short time. First, an improved Roberts edge detection operator is designed, which fully detects the edge information of the target by transforming the scale. Further, this paper proposes a dulcimer keys positioning method by fusing RGB and depth image information. This method has a better positioning effect for dulcimer keys with complex background and small size. The experimental results show that the visual positioning method proposed in this paper can effectively identify and locate the dulcimer keys, and it has better robustness to the lighting environment.

articleTitle: Distributed Fault Estimation of Multi-Agent System Based on Intermediate Estimator
abstract: In this paper, a distributed fault estimation observer based on intermediate estimator method is studied, which eliminates the constraints of observer matching conditions on fault estimation. First, the relative output estimation errors of MASs and intermediate estimator system are established based on communication topology. Second, we constructed a new Lyapunov function containing both original system state and intermediate estimation variables, the sufficient conditions for the stability of the global dynamic error system are obtained, and the gain matrix of the distributed fault estimation observer is calculated. At the end of this paper, the effectiveness and feasibility of the developed method are illustrated in two cases: the system satisfies and not satisfy the observer matching condition.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of High Myopia in Primary School Students using Bayesian Network Inference
abstract: The prevalence of myopia is increasing substantially among young adults and progressive high myopia can cause sight-threatening ocular complications. Hence, an accurate and effective risk assessment for high myopia is important to the control of the myopia progression. In this paper, a Bayesian network-based risk assessment model (BNRAM) was developed by integrating domain knowledge and clinical data. Specifically, association rules were applied on a real data set containing clinical records of primary school students with myopia. The valuable and meaning association relationship between risk factors and the severity of myopia was mined. Then, the risk analysis based on a complex network was illustrated to explore the evolution regularity of myopia. Bayesian network inference was further utilized to achieve the risk prediction. Experimental results showed that the proposed BNRAM could predict the onset of high myopia. This research provides evidence for personalized interventions to control myopia in primary school students.

articleTitle: Study on the Operation of Left-turn Vehicles at Signalized Intersections Based on the Car-following model
abstract: Urban intersections are the bottleneck of the urban road network, and the traffic flow of turning vehicle is the key factor affecting the operation of intersections. This study seeks to bridge this critical gap from the following three aspects. First, we review potential left-turn intersections and traffic flow model. The proposed model integrates an improved optimal velocity model to improve the accuracy of the analysis. Second, we use the multi-intersection signal state function to describe the association between mixed left-turn signal and main signal, and use the curved road model to describe vehicles entering the exit lane for left-turn(EFL), in addition, we introduce the microscopic emission model to calculate the pollutant emission value. The third aspect focuses on simulation analysis of some parameters on the model, which demonstrates our model can describe the actual traffic flow operating state.

Author Keywords: Mixed left-turn signal and main signal

articleTitle: Tool-face control for slide drilling based on fuzzy sliding mode controller
abstract: Slide drilling is widely used in the process of directional drilling, during which tool-face adjustment is almost completed by the driller and has not been controlled automatically yet. The main difficulty is to obtain an accurate dynamic model, due to a large amount of contact and friction between the drill string system and the wellbore. Therefore, in this paper, a fuzzy sliding mode control (FSMC) method that does not depend on the dynamic model is designed, and the selection criteria of the control parameters are proposed. The FSMC method only needs the tool-face angle as feedback and rotates the top drive angle in a limited control period by the top drive positioning, thus realizing the automatic adjustment of the tool-face. Then a small-scale experimental system is established to simulate the control process of tool-face angle. Finally, the FSMC method is used to control the tool-face on this experimental platform. The results prove that the FSMC method can automatically adjust the tool-face angle to the right position without overshooting and that the steady-state error is less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">◦</sup>. The proposed method is expected to be applied in actual field drilling and achieves automatic control of tool-face, reducing the burden of drillers and improving work efficiency.

articleTitle: Discrete-time heterogeneous multi-agent system formation control with high-fidelity simulation
abstract: This article studies formation control for the discrete-time heterogenous multi-agent system, where the components are unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) and unmanned air vehicles (UAVs). Based on the neighboring states, a discrete-time formation control protocol is presented. Sufficient conditions are listed for the heterogeneous multi-agent system to complete the specified formation. A simulation platform with high fidelity using Gazebo is introduced, where the components are structured with respect to the fidelity of the air-ground collaboration scenario. A numerical example is presented to confirm the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation method of power grid dispatching automation software based on Dual-process model under malicious data attack
abstract: Power dispatching automation software system is a software-intensive system. The safe and stable operation of the software system is related to the security and stability of the whole power system. The degree and scope of the damage caused by malicious attacks are also constantly deepening and expanding, so the evaluation and prediction of the reliability of the software is particularly important. In this paper, the dual-process model is used to evaluate and predict the reliability of the software of power grid dispatching automation system, and the two models are weighted and mixed to improve the accuracy and robustness of the software reliability model.

articleTitle: Naive Bayesian Classification Based Performance Assessment of Cascade Control System
abstract: Cascade control is a commonly used control strategy in chemical engineering processes. Compared with the single loop configuration, cascade control has obvious advantages in improving dynamic response performance and anti-interference. Although the technique of single loop performance assessment based on minimum variance theory is relatively mature, the research concerning cascade loop performance assessment is still rarely. Aiming at overcoming the drawback of excessive manipulator, weak robustness and huge computation burden caused by minimum variance performance index, this paper innovatively proposes a method of cascade control system performance assessment based on Naive Bayesian Classification(NBC), which owns the ability of predicting the performance of the control system in advance. Based on the above work, identification and retuning process of the unreasonable parameters are employed afterwards to further enhances the control quality of industry process. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are demonstrated by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Dynamic SLAM System Using Histogram-based Outlier Score to Improve Anomaly Detection
abstract: It is well known that the traditional visual SLAM systems have performed well in a relatively ideal environment, but for the dynamic environment, there are some problems in the instance segmentation algorithm such as incomplete segmentation or wrong segmentation which will result in outliers. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposed a dynamic SLAM system using Histogram-based Outlier Score (HBOS) to improve the reprojection residual constraint to increase the robustness in removing outliers. In this method, HBOS method is used to process the reprojection residual, and the feature association data obtained after the segmentation mask processing is further filtered to improve the robustness. This method can combine the semantic segmentation network with traditional geometric methods to solve the data association problem caused by the wrong information generated from the dynamic objects. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the experiment is carried out on the public TUM data set and the results show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of SLAM positioning in the dynamic environment.

articleTitle: Preliminary Discussion on Research Progress of Intelligent Robots
abstract: This paper studies the development history of intelligent robots. First, the various key technologies of intelligent robots are analyzed, including autonomous positioning and navigation, human-computer interaction and multi-sensor information coupling. Furthermore, the main problems existing in intelligent robots are discussed, and corresponding solutions are proposed for the application of intelligent robots in the fields of industry, service industry, and agriculture. Finally, the research shows that intelligent robots have broad application prospects in the future.

articleTitle: Industrial Field Video Transmission System Based on OpenDDS
abstract: The paper proposes a video transmission system based on publish/subscribe mechanism and verifies related modules. The system controls the camera to take industrial images which are compressed by the H.264 encoder, and transmits the compressed video stream in LAN (Local Area Network) through OpenDDS; based on the QoS policy provided by OpenDDS and the control of the code rate by the H.264 encoder, the system adds an adaptive mechanism to dynamically adjusts the OpenDDS QoS strategy and the code rate of the H.264 encoder according to the node network throughput, so as to achieve the balance between video quality and bandwidth utilization. Experiments show that the average delay of video transmission under the LAN is 620 us.

articleTitle: Online Fault Detection of A Three-tank System Based on Extended State Observer
abstract: This paper proposes a fault detection method based on an extended state observer (ESO). This method of fault detection is achieved in two-stage process, residual generation and fault prediction. Residual generation uses an ESO to estimate the state variables of the three-tank system. Fault prediction uses an ellipsoid threshold method to predict the faults. Twelve kinds of stepwise faults are detected successfully in the three-tank system. The experimental results elaborate the effectiveness of the online fault detection based on ESO.

articleTitle: A self-tuning guidance method based on an onboard update of pseudospectral trajectories
abstract: The guidance of gliding vehicles in the gliding segment is studied in this paper. A positive feedback effect of the pseudospectral (PS) optimal feedback guidance is revealed for the case where the internal bias of the model is considered. A self-tuning guidance method based on an onboard PS trajectory update is proposed for this effect. In the method, the critical parameters of the model are identified online by observing the input and output of the practical system. Moreover, the identified parameters are applied in PS trajectory planning and tracking guidance. The entire process is a typical self-tuning control process. Grid inheritance and initial value update are proposed to improve PS trajectory planning efficiency. Finally, a guidance process with minor and major planning cycles is designed to increase the method's reliability. The simulation verified the effectiveness of the method and showed the potential and prospect of online implementation.

articleTitle: Real Deep K-means with Multiple Auto-Encoders
abstract: K-means clustering separates a set of samples into several groups based on the similarities between samples. To further assess the nonlinear correlation between high-dimensional samples, existing deep K-means algorithms just exploit an auto-encoder to extract the inherent features of samples, and then perform K-means on it. From this letter, we present the real deep K-means clustering model with K auto-encoders where K is the number of clusters, which is named as DKMA. Specifically, the centroid of each cluster is acted by one auto-encoder, rather than the constant vector in the traditional K-means. Each sample decides its category by choosing one auto-encoder which reconstructs the sample point best. The extensive experimental results indicate that the our present approach performs better than the other clustering algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimization algorithm of convolutional neural networks based on momentum and fractional order gradient
abstract: In order to study the optimization algorithm of convolutional neural networks, this paper combines the traditional stochastic gradient descent method with momentum and fractional order optimization, and deduces the momentum based fractional order stochastic gradient descent (MFSGD) algorithm for the full connection layer and the convolution layer in convolutional neural networks, respectively. The recognition accuracy and training loss for MFSGD with different orders are compared. The results show that the MFSGD is better than the fractional order gradient descend method, and there is an optimal order with a best recognition accuracy and training loss.

articleTitle: Agile satellite attitude sliding mode control based on CMGs
abstract: Low-orbit satellites can offer higher resolution, but at the expense of imaging width. In order to realize wide area detection, CMGs with large output torque and angular velocity capability are adopted to make the satellite perform overall fast swing sweep for wide and wide imaging.Moreover, the exponential approach law sliding mode control based on CMGs is designed. The simulation results show that the convergence rate of surface satellite attitude and angular velocity is faster and the convergence error is smaller than the traditional sliding mode control.

articleTitle: Modeling of nonlinear dynamic system based on Deep Operator Network
abstract: In this paper, we focus on solving the problem of learning operators to approximate nonliner system. In the neural architecture called DeepONets, we add the CNN(Convolutional Neural Networks) network to speed up the traning set and we use the lakey-relu to awake more information to gain better convergence performance. We build two subnetworks, one for encoding the input functions, another for the location variables, and then we do a mergement to get the output. When the system gains various input functions, and the response which we can get are some signal points,we can apply this architecture to modeling the system. We test DeepONets on a nonliner system which is a gravity pendulum with an external force, and show that DeepONets can achieve better convergence performance. The Test MSE(Mean Square Error) can achieve 5.518e-08, while the Train MSE is 5.712e-08.

articleTitle: Iterative learning control tracks the slowly varying reference trajectory of linear parabolic distributed parameter systems
abstract: Up to now, based upon the existing results on iterative learning control (ILC) of distributed parameter systems have not been fully utilized for the variable reference trajectory case. This paper proposes a new ILC algorithm for a parabolic distributed parameter system that assumes that the reference trajectory changes slowly with the number of iterations. The sufficient conditions are established such that the tracking error convergent to a bounded domain. And the detail theoretical analysis of the algorithm convergence is also presented clearly under some given conditions. Numerical examples verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Perspectives on the Development of Intelligent Control Technology in the Field of Artificial Intelligence
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the development of artificial intelligence and intelligent control in each stage. Artificial intelligence and intelligent control need coexist and influence each other. The problems faced by artificial intelligence in intelligent control methods are analyzed. The development of intelligent control in artificial intelligence method is used in theory research and practical applications. The paper gives the future development direction of artificial intelligence in intelligent control.

articleTitle: Patch Group-based Simultaneous Sparse Model for Image Denoising
abstract: This paper presents a patch group-based simultaneous sparse model (PG-SSM) for image denoising, which can accurately characterize image information and further recover the high-quality images from their noisy observations. In the proposed PG-SSM, to tap both the local and the nonlocal sparsity simultaneously, two adaptive dictionaries are learned to sparsely represent similar patch group. With an insight into the distribution of the simultaneous sparse coefficients, the Exponential distributions with different parameters are exploited to model the sparse coefficients, and thus an adaptive threshold function is derived to solve the sparse coefficients, thereby achieving denoising. Moreover, a preprocessing step is introduced to overcome the influence caused by noise, including the collection of patch groups and the parameter estimations of the Exponential distribution. Experimental results demonstrate that PG-SSM outperforms not only the related sparse-based works, but also the low-rank- based as well as the deep learning-based methods.

articleTitle: Pigeon-inspired Formation Control for Multi-UAVs under Obstacle Environments
abstract: In the real world, neighboring individuals with communication links determine the state and the weight of different individuals in the group. There are closer relations between the status of neighboring individuals in a collective system. To imitate this situation, a strategic model of collective system coordination and control was proposed by imitating the decision- making mechanism of pigeon flocks. Each individual changes its situation based on the weighting and distance to the neighboring individuals in the collective system. This paper mainly studies the problem of formation control inspired by the decision-making mechanism of pigeon flocks under obstacle environments. By designing the control law of fixed relative position and speed consistency and integrating it with the decision-making mechanism of pigeon flocks, formation control of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm is realized. A judging mechanism is proposed to determine whether it is necessary for UAVs to avoid obstacles. The simulation results show that the UAVs can generate, maintain and reconstruct the desired formation in a real-time manner under consideration of avoiding obstacles.

articleTitle: Cardioprotection study of Panacis Quinquefolii Radix based on grey relational analysis
abstract: In this article, the grey relational analysis method was used to identity the key components of Panacis Quinquefolii Radix for cardioprotection by in vivo zebrafish models. 34 components with effect on cardioprotection were ranked by calculating grey relational grades. In addition, a comparison of grey relational analysis and correlation coefficient methods implies that the former is more reliable for this research.

articleTitle: Synchronization Analysis and Aperiodically Intermittent Synchronization Control of Multi-Weighted Coupled Cohen-Grossberg Neural Networks
abstract: This paper deals with synchronization problem of multi-weighted coupled Cohen-Grossberg neural networks (MWCCGNNs). Firstly, by constructing suitable Lyapunov functional and related mathematical inequality tricks, we analyze the synchronization of MWCCGNNs and derive a synchronization criterion for this kind of network. Then, an aperiodically intermittent synchronization condition is presented for the considered MWCCGNNs based on a well designed aperiodically intermittent controller. Furthermore, the robust synchronization of MWCCGNNs with uncertain parameters is also been considered and some corresponding robust synchronization criteria are established. Finally, the accuracy of the obtained synchronization conditions in this paper is verified by an example with MATLAB simulation results.

articleTitle: Balancing diversity and accuracy of the recommendation system based on multi-objective optimization
abstract: Recommendation systems are used in every aspect of people's lives in the context of today's Internet boom. However, most of the research on recommendation algorithms focus on improving the accuracy of algorithms, while the diversity and novelty of recommendation quality are more or less ignored. In addition, the accuracy and diversity of recommendation algorithms are usually contradictory. Therefore, the paper proposed a novel multi-objective framework to balance accuracy and diversity. Under the framework, similar products and diverse products are recommended by user clustering. Two objective functions are designed to represent the similarity and diversity of clustering. One objective function is to bring together users with similar preferences. Another objective function is to recommend diverse items to users. The novel multi-objective evolutionary algorithm can return a series of different trade-off solutions in one run. The proposed algorithm is applied on a real-world baseline dataset: MovieLens. Experimental results show that diversity and novelty are improved without sacrificing too much precision

articleTitle: Design and Development of STM32-based Intelligent Material Workbench
abstract: At present, the development orientation of the workbench has been directed towards intelligent progress. Nevertheless, it is not well developed in terms of integrating the two parts in industry and laboratory, which is very inconvenient. The baffle part remains unautomated and requires manual flipping, being inefficient. In this paper, through an in-depth study of the working principle of the material workbench, the STM32 microcontroller control function is analyzed and utilized to realize the precise identification and opening of the material box, designing a hardware structure that can achieve its function. In this system, the STM32 controller is adopted to realize automatic control of the workbench system, which controls various parts of the system by connecting the STM32 controller on the computer terminal. The electronic tag information corresponding to the material box is inputted at the computer terminal, which activates the Hip module and takes out the material to achieve highly efficient operation.

articleTitle: An efficient image-based indoor positioning approach using ORB and LSH
abstract: Indoor localization has recently gained much attention in academia and business. Here, we raise a new approach to deal with this problem, using a variety of indoor images with localization information. Different from previous research, we use Oriented FAST and rotated BRIEF(ORB) instead of SIFT, which saves much time in feature extraction stage. Moreover, we apply Locality Sensitive Hashing(LSH) to do matching work. It reduces time complexity and further improve efficiency. With this novel combination of ORB and LSH, we significantly shortened process time. To test our approach, we use the images in Yorkdale, a shopping mall in Toronto. All the images are labeled with indoor localization information, the coordinate. The result shows that the whole processing time of our approach can be within 0.6 seconds, and all the test images can be matched to the closest picture in the database.

articleTitle: Architecture of The Industrial Controller Development Platform
abstract: In this paper, the technologies of the industrial controller development platform are studied, and a rapid development architecture of controller is proposed. The architecture consists of four layers: the hardware device layer, the communication layer, the development layer and the application layer. Each layer contains its core tools and interaction methods. The development platform based on this architecture has been verified, which can effectively accelerate the development and production process of industrial controller.

articleTitle: Intelligent test technology requirement and current situation for hypersonic wind tunnel
abstract: In order to improve the test efficiency of hypersonic wind tunnel, standardize wind tunnel test management and enhance the data analysis ability, achieve experimental synergy and make full use of data resources, it is necessary to develop the intelligent test technology of wind tunnel experiment. According to the characteristics, the experiment process and the experiment management requirements of four hypersonic wind tunnels, this paper summarizes the application current situation of intelligent technology in the fields of the data acquisition and data processing, test information comprehensive management, external data transmission for hypersonic wind tunnels. A future plan and thought which include remote experiment platform application and data reuse project are proposed. The wind tunnel test mode can be transformed through information management. The intelligent wind tunnel experiment test system can be gradually established with high experiment efficiency, coordinated and standardized management, convenient remote access and remote collaboration.

articleTitle: A Bio-inspired Ostrich-like Biped Robot
abstract: To look for the reason why the biped animal in nature can run with such high speed and to design a bio-inspired biped prototype which can behave the high speed running and jumping ability, this paper take the fastest bipedal animal in nature: ostrich as the research subject. Firstly, the body structure and motion characteristics of ostrich are investigated. Secondly, a simple mechanical structure of bio-inspired ostrich robot is designed based on the above biological investigated results. The robot is under-actuated with one actuator each leg, with a spring on the tarsometatarsus and a torsion spring on the metatarsophalangeal joint at the foot end. Finally, the high speed running and jumping running gait is planned and comparative simulations are implemented with different design requirements among pure rigid and rigid-flexible coupling scheme, which are rigid, only with spring, only with torsion spring, and with spring and torsion spring both, in detail. Simulation results show that the rigid-flexible coupling design scheme can achieve better high speed performance. It provides an insight for the design for legged robots.

articleTitle: Application and Prospect Analysis of Vanadium Battery Technology in Photovoltaic Power Generation
abstract: The output power of photovoltaic power generation is fluctuating, and it is easy to affect the stability of the power system when it is connected to the grid on a large scale. In order to smooth the photovoltaic output power and effectively improve the power supply reliability and power quality of photovoltaic power generation, it is proposed to equip the photovoltaic power generation system with a vanadium battery energy storage system of appropriate capacity. This article first analyzes in detail the characteristics and working principles of the new all-vanadium redox flow battery energy storage system, and establishes an equivalent circuit model of the vanadium battery, then simulates and analyzes the charge and discharge characteristics of the vanadium battery, which is based on MATLAB/Simulink software, finally the application advantages and development prospects of vanadium battery energy storage in photovoltaic power generation systems under the background of "carbon peak and carbon neutrality" policy in my country are summarized.

articleTitle: Analysis of memristive chaotic system with conditional symmetry and offset boosting
abstract: In this paper, memristor chaotic systems with bias enhancement are studied, including voltage bias, sine function of one dimensional bias, two dimensional bias, conditional symmetry and amplitude adjustment. First, the absolute value function was added into the bias boost system, and three different bias are constructed. The influence of bias parameters on the system output polarity was analyzed. Then the memristor system with conditional symmetry was constructed by introducing absolute value functions satisfying F(x + h) = -F (x). The influence of conditional symmetry on the system was studied, and the multi-stability of conditional symmetry system is proved by analyzing bifurcation diagrams and Lyapunov exponents of each parameter under different initial conditions. Finally, by scaling y and z, the system has the amplitude adjustment characteristic, and qualitatively analyzes the influence of scaling parameter f on each output variable.

articleTitle: Research on prognostics technology of spot-welding system in automotive manufacturing based on statistical process control
abstract: This paper presents the use of Hadoop based prognostics technology of spot-welding system in an industrial equipment maintenance setting. Beijing Benz plant faces issue of equipment failure for spot welding robots installed at lines in Body shop. This unexpected failure creates considerable losses in terms of productivity and cost. There is need to predict such failures well in advance to reduce downtime and cost associated with these failures.

articleTitle: Stability of switched positive systems with unstable subsystems
abstract: The stability problem of switched positive systems (SPSs) with unstable subsystems is studied. Two kinds of SPSs are studied, of which the subsystems are partially unstable and all unstable. For stability analysis, a delicate time-scale multivariate linear copositive Lyapunov function (TSMLCLF) is established. The constructed Lyapunov function changes with time in some designed time intervals, and is time-invariant outside these time intervals. Fast and slow mode-dependent average dwell time (MDADT) techniques are used to solve stability problem with unstable and stable subsystems, respectively. Moreover, some improved conditions to ensure the stability of the system are proposed. Finally, two examples are given to verify the effectiveness of our presented method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Robust Control Strategy of Cable-Driven Single Joint Continuum Robot
abstract: In the application of an unstructured environment, a continuum robot has more advantages than a conventional robot. However, its dynamic modeling and control are more complex. In this paper, -we design a cable-driven single, joint continuum robot and take it as a research object. First, based on the constant curvature hypothesis, the dynamic model of the continuum robot is established according to the structure using the Lagrange method. Then, a robust H,, controller based on LMI is proposed by considering the model perturbation in the modeling process,. Finally, the availability of the designed controller is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired Trajectory Generation for Robotic Manipulators Based on Intrinsic Tau Exponential Guidance Strategy
abstract: In this paper, a novel bio-inspired trajectory generation method is proposed based on the intrinsic Tau exponential (Tau-E) guidance strategy. The intrinsic guidance movement (IGM) of the Tau theory is firstly selected as an exponential function, which shows the feasibility to choose a function without physical significance. The Tau-E is derived to generate the trajectories of robotic manipulators and capable of guiding other objects. Tau-E guidance strategy can achieve the benefits of faster computation and fewer parameters with the similar performance in comparison to other similar Tau-based guidance strategies. Moreover, the feasible interval of coupling coefficient is enlarged and can be calculated according to the motion gap by using the proposed Tau-E guidance strategy. The simulation and experimental tests demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Tau-E guidance strategy.

articleTitle: LQG Control of Vehicle Active Suspension Using Whale Optimization Algorithm
abstract: A nonlinear dynamic model of whole-vehicle active suspension is set up. Firstly, the model is simplified and linearized. Secondly LQG (linear quadratic gaussian) controller of the active suspension system is designed via optimal control theory. In view of the deficiencies in the selection of weighting coefficients, WOA (whale optimization algorithm) is used to calculate each weight coefficient. Then the proposed scheme is verified by MATLAB/Simulink software. Finally, the results of simulations revealed that the designed controller can further driving stability and ride comfort.

articleTitle: Deep Hashing Based Model for Image Similarity Retrieval in DNA Storage
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the total amount of data generated by human society is growing at an incredible rate, and will soon exceed the storage capacity of existing storage media. DNA molecules, as a natural information storage media, have a broad application prospect because of its high theoretical storage density. With the increase of DNA storage capacity, image similarity retrieval is another important image retrieval method besides random access. DNA hybridization is sequence pairing reaction based on DNA sequence similarity, enabling similarity retrieval in DNA storage. In the context of image similarity retrieval in DNA storage, the key problem is how to map images to DNA sequences while maintaining similarity. In this paper, we model this problem as a variant of deep hashing and then propose a novel DNA-encoded image deep hashing model. We test our model on CIFAR-10 dataset and the results show that our performance is comparable to the state-of-the-art binary-encoded image hashing model, proving that DNA-encoded image similarity retrieval is sufficiently efficient. Our work also provides a novel modeling idea and appropriate evaluation metrics for future research.

articleTitle: Generating Waste Heat Energy from CPU Based on Thermoelectric Power Generator
abstract: Heat dissipation is extremely important for electronic component such as CPU or GPU of the computer. Now most researchers only design optimal heat sink for CPU for better heat dissipation, while few of them consider waste heat recycling of CPU. The CPU can be used as the heat source, while the original system has fan and heat sink as the cooling system. Thus, the original CPU working condition is very suitable for thermoelectric power generation and will bring great benefit to system itself. However, adding thermoelectric generator will increase the temperature of CPU, which will decrease the performance of the computer. It is necessary to reduce the hot side temperature while generating energy as much as possible. To achieve this, this paper designed a kind of intelligent waste heat generation system based on thermoelectric power generator. Three different shape heat sinks are designed, contrasted, and tested. By building experimental platform and establishing simulation model, the power of thermoelectric power generation and temperature change of the three heat sink structures are compared. The fin shaped heat sink is considered has the best output performance while keeping the hot side temperature within the acceptance range. The maximum output power is 10.67mW, and the maximum hot side temperature is 72°C during the experiment.

articleTitle: Research on synergy based on correlation analysis of weighted samples of grasping action
abstract: The main research goal of underactuated manipulator is to reduce the number of controllers and improve the bionic ability. In this kind of research, underactuated hand design synergy is the mainstream research direction in recent years. Human hand synergy space is a parameterized representation of human hand motion based on a large number of human hand motion data. In the past synergy meta-analysis, samples were selected only based on grasping classification without considering people's daily habits, which led to the lack of bionic ability. In this paper, based on the most authoritative 33 kinds of grabbing classification, the samples are weighted and reconstructed according to the daily use habits; Principal component analysis is used to analyze the reconstructed samples, and the correlation between joints is calculated to obtain the synergy of human hand. The comparative experiments show that the underactuated transmission scheme based on the synergy design of reconstructed samples has higher similarity and stronger bionic ability than the ordinary sample scheme in most grasping scenes. On this basis, this paper studies the following ability between fingers through the calculation of correlation coefficient and clustering method, so as to further reduce the number of controllers.

articleTitle: TMAC: an Active Defense Architecture adapted to Microkernel Operating System for Power ICS
abstract: Because of its obvious advantages in reliability, security and scalability, microkernel operating systems are becoming more and more popular within power industrial control terminals. However, the application of new technologies such as the Internet of Things has further expanded the exposure of terminal network attacks. In particular, with the development of new power systems dominated by new energy sources, the power grid is shifting from closed to open, and IoT terminals are gradually distributed in untrustworthy physical environments. Aiming at the micro-kernel operating system scenario of power industrial control terminal, this paper proposes active defense architecture named TMAC which integrates functional safety and information security of Power ICS, and describes related key technologies. Experiments show that TMAC can significantly guarantee the security of the microkernel operating system.

articleTitle: New insight into dissipative control for singular Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy systems with time-varying delay
abstract: In this article, the dissipative control problem for a class of singular Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems with time-varying delay is studied. The augmented Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is devised to analyze the admissibility and dissipativity of the system. In order to solve controller gains, an iterative algorithm is proposed, and the corresponding results are derived by using linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) based algorithm. At last, an example is exhibited to show the validity of our method.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligent Cooperative Decision-Making of Large-scale Robots for Individual Customization Mode
abstract: Based on the individual customization mode in industrial Internet, we aim to the task assignment problem of how to make full use of resources and ensure production efficiency of swarm robots system. In order to overcome the bottleneck that it cannot be preset for the global large-scale group in the open, dynamic and complex manufacturing environment. We propose a task assignment mechanism based on local rules which takes the predictive values of user requirement preferences as "leader" and large-scale robots as "follower". Firstly, based on Hegselmann- Krause(HK) model, a prediction model of user requirement preferences for individual customization is proposed to simulate and predict the evolution process of large-scale user requirement preferences. Secondly, a swarm intelligent cooperative decisionmaking model is proposed to realize the task decision-making according to the predictive values of preferences, that is, the number of robots are allocated autonomously for the corresponding preference categories according to the proportion of requirements in different preference categories. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Redundancy based Neuroadaptive Fault-tolerant Control of Nonlinear Uncertain Systems under Actuation Failures
abstract: In this paper, a redundancy based neuroadaptive fault-tolerant control law is proposed for a class of multi-input multi-output (MIMO) nonlinear uncertain systems in the presence of modeling uncertainties and actuation failures as well as unexpected external disturbances. By employing weighted distribution technique, the proposed control approach is able to deal with the situation that some of the actuators completely or partially fail to work, where a spacial matrix decomposition strategy with the aid of neural networks (NN) is used to establish the control design and stability analysis without the need for all system nonlinearities and fault detection/diagnostic. It is shown that all the signals of uncertain systems are uniformly ultimately bounded (UUB). A numerical simulation result is shown to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Pitch Control Based on a New Blade Model Considering Attack Angles
abstract: Pitch control is the key technology of optimizing wind turbine output power. This paper proposes a wind turbine pitch control approach based on a new blade model considering attack angles. First, a new blade model based on the lift and drag force of blades is built. Second, a wind turbine pitch control approach is proposed considering the aerodynamic performance of blades affected by attack angles. Finally, numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: An optimization of DPoS for swarm intelligence
abstract: The issues of managing swarm intelligence are essential to many multiple tasks. The scenarios are complex and dynamic, which is hard for a single agent to satisfy the needs of various tasks. As thus, a practical intelligence cooperative combat scheme, composed of multiple agents, is required to supply a effective and efficient consensus for swarm intelligence with external conditions evolving. Among this scheme, the accuracy of information sharing, transmission, and the integrity of the stored data are all critically significant. The Blockchain, a digital distributed ledger,is distributed on different nodes, and each node holds the same data, which attracts increasing attentions recently. There are many consensus algorithms which is the key part of the blockchain, such as PoW, PoS, DPoS, PoR, etc. However, no matter in terms of performance, security and stability, existing work can hardly support a battle plan oriented to swarm intelligence. To our knowledge, there is no consensus algorithm that takes into account the resources of agent in swarm intelligence collaboration. Therefore, we introduce an optimization of DPoS for swarm intelligence based on agent behavior monitoring and agent’s own resource analysis (Delegated Proof of Stake based node’s Behavior and Resource, DPoSBR). Combining the situation of malicious behaviors of the agent and the resources of the agent, we choose the more trustworthy agent as the captain. Therefore, the captain agent is more secure and the election process is fairer. Finally, the extensive simulations are conducted to evaluate the performance of DPoSBR algorithm, which has good practicability. Meanwhile, it enables more agents to participate, which is beneficial to the decentralization of the system and can promote the enthusiasm of the entire agents, and it prevents the malicious agents from doing malicious behaviors again.

articleTitle: Connected and automated vehicle based dynamic throttling strategy for bottleneck problem under mixed traffic environment
abstract: To improve traffic efficiency in the road bottleneck, this study proposes a dynamic throttling strategy inspired by the operating principle of the throttling valve. In particular, according to the traffic capacity of the bottleneck region, and real-time traffic volume from the upstream region, this strategy can reasonably restrain the traffic stream entering downstream road by controlling a group of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs). More precisely, let the longitudinal gaps among CAVs on adjacent lanes be the adjustable passable gaps (i.e. throttling valve) for others vehicles. In addition, to guarantee the asymptotic stability and safety of the controlled CAVs group, two platoon-like control protocols are developed, respectively. Furthermore, the asymptotic stability conditions for the switched system of state errors, which is formed by the stochastically switching between the two control protocols, are given. Finally, the Vissim-based experiments investigate the effectiveness of the proposed dynamic throttling strategy and platoon-like control protocols.

articleTitle: Research on the Stability Evaluation Method of Train Schedule Based on Delay Propagation Model
abstract: The setting of redundant time in the train schedule can improve the robustness of the railway operation system, reduce the delay caused by random disturbance, and make the existing delays dissipate more quickly. This paper aims to establish a data-based delay propagation model to analyze the stability of each node in the current train schedule, and use the result to auxiliary train schedule optimization decision. In the research, an integrated delay propagation model based on maximum algebra and ensemble learning is proposed, which describes the train delay propagation characteristics in combination with the train schedule and actual operation conditions. The maximum algebra block predicts the delay propagation based on the redundancy of the train schedule. The ensemble learning block uses the delay probability data obtained from actual operating records to predicts the joint delay time. The accuracy of the model prediction is verified on the actual operation data. Different levels of interference are designed as test case to analyze the stability of train schedule based on the model output.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Improved Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor for Flywheel Energy Storage
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional flywheel energy storage system(FESS), such as low power density, long axial length of the motor, and serious coupling between torque and suspension force, an improved flywheel energy storage system is studied in this paper. An improved 12/14 poles bearingless switched reluctance motor(BSRM) is used in the system, and some permanent magnets are inserted into the stator yoke between the stator and suspension poles of the motor. On the basis of the analysis of it's principle and structure, with the aid of finite element analysis software, the inductor, the air gap flux density and torque and radial force are studied and analysised, the structure has the advantages of self-decoupling, short magnetic circuit and small suspension current and stable suspension, which is convenient to simplify the control strategy and realize the high-speed operation of the motor. Through finite element simulation analysis, the characteristics of the motor are verified<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>.

articleTitle: Loop Closure Detection for Visual SLAM Based on Sparse Representation
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is mainly used to solve the problems of positioning and map construction in the unknown environment of mobile robots. It is the basis for solving the autonomous movement of mobile robots, and loop closure detection can reduce the cumulative error generated by the robot during the movement. When encountering large-scale scenes, the current traditional feature extraction method will have problems: the construction of the dictionary which represents the features will be more complicated, and the calculation of similarity will produce large calculation pressure. For this question, this paper uses the method of sparse representation and principal component analysis to compare the similarity of the sparse feature vectors for loop closure detection. Using Oxford University’s public data set for verification, experiments show that compared with the traditional Bag-of-words model, the proposed algorithm effectively reduces the dimension of image features and retain the image information, and can obtain better accuracy in the loop closure detection.

articleTitle: Harmonic suppression of ship electric propulsion frequency converter in DC network
abstract: In networking DC electric propulsion system, the adjustable speed drive is one of the most critical elements of the entire electric propulsion technology, which directly determines the state of the propulsion motor, however, a large number of inverter switching semiconductor device, will cause The generation of harmonics in the power system. This paper explains the source of frequency converter harmonics and their harm. On this basis, an LRC filter was proposed to suppress the harmonics in the ship's power grid, and simulation research was carried out.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Control Scheme In Gas Turbines
abstract: Gas turbines have been widely applicated in industry. In the control of gas turbines, an advanced control algorithm contributes to the stability, safety, and economic benefits. However, it is well known that transition state control methods in gas turbines are intractable to design. In this paper, a hybrid control scheme is constructed and utilized in transition state control of gas turbines. First, a component-level model of gas turbines is established via Toolbox for Modeling and Analysis of Thermodynamic Systems (T-MATS). Second, we introduce the notions of active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) and model predictive control (MPC). Based on the introduced control methods, a soft switch approach is constructed by combining the advantages of ADRC-PID controller and MPC. Finally, in order to demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed control scheme, comparisons between different control schemes and our proposed hybrid control scheme are given.

articleTitle: Automatic Target Recognition in GPR Images Based on Time-Frequency Texture Features and Support Vector Machine
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) images are easily disturbed by noise, which causes a lot of difficulties for target recognition. To improve the target recognition performance in GPR images, a novel recognition method based on time-frequency texture features and support vector machine (SVM) is proposed. The proposed method first extracts texture features from the gray co-occurrence matrix of S transform time-frequency images for the A-scan data, then establishes the SVM model and realizes the target recognition. The proposed method is assessed using synthetic GPR images and compared with other two time-frequency analysis methods, combined with SVM. The expermental results show that the proposed method can achieve higher recognition accuracies than the other two methods in heavily noisy environment.

articleTitle: Multi-target Coverage with Connectivity Maintenance Using Improved Harmony Search Algorithm
abstract: This paper considers a multi-target coverage problem where agents aim to efficiently cover multiple targets while maintaining connectivity. An improved harmony search algorithm is proposed. In particular, the harmony generation part of the harmony search algorithm is designed to generate all the harmony memory and new harmony vectors, so that all decisions are made at the beginning to ensure connectivity. Moreover, we propose a new strategy to dynamically adjust pitch adjusting rate (PAR) and bandwidth (BW). In the initial stage of the algorithm, small PAR and large BW value not only increase the diversity of understanding vectors, but also improve the global search ability of the algorithm. In the later stage of algorithm optimization, we use large PAR and small BW value, so as to improve the local search ability of the algorithm and make the solution vector converge[2]. Numerical simulation is performed to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm. We find that the performance of the proposed algorithm in this paper is close to the traditional greedy algorithm which has no connectivity restrictions.

articleTitle: Sparse Signal Recovery Via Tail Hadamard Product Parametrization
abstract: The Hadamard product parametrization (HPP), together with the profile LASSO, are combined to achieve sparse signal recovery in signal process. Compared with the tail-ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> min-imization algorithm, the tail Hadamard product parametrization (tail-HPP) algorithm can obtain faster signal reconstruction speed and higher signal recovery accuracy. In numerical experiments, the proposed tail Hadamard product parametrization algorithm achieves excellent sparse signal estimation performance, which forcefully shows that the tail Hadamard product parametrization algorithm is a promising method for compressed sensing.

articleTitle: Material State Identification of the Conveyor Belt based on Inception-v4
abstract: For the uneven phenomenon of materials during material transportation on the factory assembly line, this paper proposes an improved model based on Inception-v4 to realize the identification and classification of three material states (more materials, normal materials, and fewer materials). In the image processing stage, the Farneback algorithm is used to capture the moving area, which makes the training of the model focus on effective information. In addition, considering the color bias of materials, the RGB enhancement strategy is proposed. By processing the image data in RGB channels, different weights are given to realize the enhancement of image features. In the network training and testing stage, we use Inception-v4 as the baseline model. The output of the model is modified for the classification task, and a new loss function is designed. In addition, considering the limited sample size, we pre-trained the model on ImageNet. Through experimental comparison, the improved algorithm proposed in this paper has better performance.

articleTitle: Design of a locally interconnected modular neural network
abstract: In order to design a model that is similar to the brain-like neural network while simultaneously enhance the learning performance of neural network, we propose a locally interconnected modular neural network (LI-MNN) model by adding inhibitory connections between the hidden nodes of different subnetworks. Firstly, to be more approximate to the pattern of brain functional division, the LI-MNN applies the Entropy Weighting k-means algorithm to partition all the features into several feature subsets. Secondly, each subset uses a BP neural network to learn and the excitatory hidden nodes in different subnetwork are connected with each other. The parameters in all subnetworks are learned by the improved Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. Finally, the proposed model is tested on several benchmark datasets and a practical dataset in sewage treatment process, and the experimental results show that LI-MNN possesses superior generalization ability when compared with other MNN models.

articleTitle: Unmanned Surface Vehicles Path Tracking Control Based on Second-Order Wave Drift Force Model
abstract: As a key of parallel marine transportation system, unmanned surface vehicles are generally small in size according to actual mission requirements. As a result, they are greatly affected by external disturbances such as wave when navigating at sea. This has a greater test of the accuracy and stability of the path tracking control system of unmanned surface vehicles. This paper considers the controller design of an unmanned surface vehicle path tracking system based on the backstepping method. Nonwhite noise is used to describe the uncertainty interference of an unmanned surface vehicle. The model can accurately describe the effect of the second-order wave force on the unmanned surface vehicle. Nonwhite noise can rather accurately fit the standard wave spectrum than white noise. Therefore, using nonwhite noise to accurately describe wave disturbances has certain advantages. Finally, a simulation is carried out to illustrate that the unmanned surface vehicle path tracking system under the disturbance of the second-order wave force designed in this paper is more effective.

articleTitle: Adaptive prescribed performance dynamic surface control for the uncertain QUAVs with unknown parameters
abstract: A new robust adaptive prescribed performance dynamic surface control (PPDSC) method is proposed for quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle systems (QUAVs) with time variant payloads and unknown uncertainties caused by external wind disturbances in this paper. Furthermore, some parameters of the system are unknown, such as the rotary inertia. With proposed methods, the whole system is decoupled into two subsystems: position system and attitude system. Two subsystems are connected to each other by the attitude extraction algorithms. The adaptive PPDSC control and robust adaptive control methods are designed for position and attitude systems. Using Lyapunov function, it is proved that the tracking errors of uncertain QUAV are asymptotically stable in the sense of ultimately uniform boundedness. At the same time, the positional tracking errors can meet the prescribed performance. The effectiveness of proposed control methods is verified by simulation results in the end.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction Technology Based on Frequency-Temporal Convolution Network
abstract: In the era of big data, we begin to use artificial intelligence algorithms for data mining and prediction of force activities. If we can build a model based on historical data features to predict the deployment of equipment and personnel in key areas, we can preempt and gain an advantage on the battlefield. A frequency-driven temporal convolution network TFCN (Frequency-Temporal Convolution Network) is introduced based on the theoretical framework of deep learning and combining the time and frequency domain features of data in the traditional digital signal processing field. Inspired by Shannon’s sampling theorem, to achieve the purpose of fast learning of time series data features, it is necessary to satisfy the sampling frequency greater than twice the frequency of the principal components of time series data, ie., to ensure that the network structure and parameters sample the features-within at least one-half of the main period of the data, and then optimize the division of the data set and the design of the network structure. In this paper, -we standardize the time series data after data cleaning, and demonstrate that the above process does not affect the frequency distribution of the original data. We build the model to achieve prediction and evaluation, and the experiment result indicates that the TFCN we proposed can learn the characteristics of time series data faster than DNN, LSTM and other models, its loss curve can converge faster, and the prediction results are more accurate.

articleTitle: DOANet: Point Cloud Registration with Deep Overlap Attention
abstract: Pairwise point cloud registration is a fundamental task in 3D computer vision and various approaches have been proposed to handle this problem in recent years. Despite the fast evolution of registration algorithms, little attention has been drawn to align point cloud pairs with a low-overlap ratio (≤30%). In this paper, we propose a new neural network architecture named the DOANet, an end-to-end trainable fully convolutional neural network, to deal with the problem of registration with low overlap. In particular, we leverage sparse convolutions to extract robust and discriminative dense features, and further utilize attention mechanisms to explicitly predict the overlap region for point cloud fragments. The receptive field of our local point patches is constrained within the overlap region generated on the fly, which prevents the local point features from being contaminated by geometric information outside the overlap region. Experiments indicate the effectiveness and advantages of our method on both 3DLoMatch (all pairs under 30% overlap-ratio) and 3DMatch and illustrate obvious improvement over the existing results.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Distributed Robust Consensus Kalman Filtering for Sensor Networks
abstract: This paper mainly studies the distributed robust filtering problem for wireless sensor networks without knowing the variance of the driving noise and measuring noise. A distributed filtering algorithm based on leader-follower consensus strategy is developed. Firstly, from limited sampling data of noises, the empirical distribution of the noises which play a critical role in filtering is given. Secondly, by formulating the problem as a zero-sum game problem and using dynamic programming approach, an optimal distributed robust filtering policy with Wasserstein penalty for the leader is obtained. Then, by using an adaptively weighting average consensus protocol, the filtering algorithm for followers is given. The effectiveness of the proposed filter is demonstrated through simulations.

articleTitle: Indicators of Learning Ability of Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: With the increase of research on autonomous vehicles, the evaluation research of autonomous vehicles has gradually attracted attention. Effective evaluation of autonomous vehicles can ensure the safety of autonomous vehicles and improve their level of intelligence. The current related research focuses on the evaluation of vehicles in terms of safety and comfort, while there are few studies on the evaluation of the learning ability of autonomous vehicles from the time dimension. Therefore, this article proposes three learning indicators: learning time, learning speed and learning capacity. These three indicators are used to measure the learning ability of autonomous driving algorithms. By analyzing the learning curve of the vehicle algorithm, the evaluation results of three learning indicators can be obtained. Thus the learning ability of the automatic driving algorithm can be evaluated. The differences in different vehicle algorithms can also be compared. In this article, taking the parking algorithm based on reinforcement learning as an example, simulation examples and analysis of the three learning indicators proposed are carried out.

articleTitle: The Research on LQR Control of Overhead Crane Based on Interval Type-2 T-S Fuzzy Model
abstract: The traditional T-S fuzzy model is used to describe the overhead crane system with parameter uncertainty and external disturbance, which cannot deal with the uncertain membership function. Compared with type-1 T-S fuzzy model, type-2 T-S fuzzy model has more advantages in solving the uncertainty of membership function. It can better capture the uncertainty of the system and is more suitable to approximate the system with parameter uncertainty and external disturbance. Therefore, this paper presents the LQR control method of overhead crane based on interval type-2 T-S fuzzy model. Firstly, an interval type-2 T-S fuzzy model is designed based on the nonlinear mathematical model to characterize the nonlinear system of the overhead crane. Then, the state feedback gain matrix solver of the system is linear quadratic regulator(LQR). Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An image encryption scheme based on digital fractional Fourier transform and chaos theory
abstract: This research presented an image encipherment technology adopting the fractional Fourier transform and chaos theory. To expand the key space of the encipherment protection technology, we adopt the sampling digital fractional Fourier transform instead of traditional digital Fourier transform. Then, the improved double random phase masks are proposed to achieve the goal of making the encryption result close to the noise image and solve the problems of large key storage space. Based on the above works, we designed an image encryption scheme and the specific implementation details are given. In order to prove the validity and security of our designed encryption algorithm, we analyzed the effectiveness of the designed encipherment algorithm in four aspects through several experiments. The results proved that the designed image encryption algorithm not only has outstanding key safety level and great anti-statistical attack ability, but also has great anti-data loss ability and anti-noise ability.

articleTitle: Full Channel Attitude Control for High-speed Aircraft Based on Back-stepping Theory with Observer
abstract: In this paper, the full channel attitude controller is investigated for the high speed aircrafts’ cruise phase. Taking the complexity of dynamic system into consideration, the back-stepping method is introduced to reduce the difficulty of controller design, thus it would be much easier to directly design nonlinear controller for subsystem. Besides, one of the problems in designing the control law based on back-stepping is the inevitable "explosion of terms", a novel tacking differentiator based on sigmoid function (STD) is introduced to alleviate the problem, which endows the STD with superior advantages comparing to the traditional differentiator. Furthermore, the observer is applied in outer-loop and inner-loop to estimate the "total disturbance" and some immeasurable state. The estimated value will be the compensation controller integrated into the robust adaptive control law. Lastly, to illustrate the feasibility and superiority of the controller proposed, a series of comparative simulations with nominal and positive/negative perturbation are carried out on a high speed aircraft’s full channel attitude model.

articleTitle: End-to-end Visual Navigation with Intrinsic Motivation in 3D Maze-like Environments
abstract: Learning to navigate in visually rich environment with sparse reward is a long-standing problem in developing AI agent. In this paper, inspired by spontaneous exploration behaviour in animals, we proposed an end-to-end visual navigation method which use intrinsic reward to motivate explore-exploit strategy. Firstly, in order to directly obtain control policy from pixel-level input and implement end-to-end training, we take deep reinforcement learning as basic navigation framework. Secondly, we allow the agent to create reward for itself, and the intrinsic reward is related to episode memory and include two parts: (1) the frequency of agent reach a state is recorded, and these counts are then used to compute bonus according to the classic count-based method; (2) we also take temporal distance as a basis for distributing bonus, and the magnitude of it is determined by environment steps between current observation and those in memory. Finally, such intrinsic reward is summed up with the real task reward, thus making agent is able to use the combined reward to learn control policy. We test our approach in 3D maze-like environment in DMlab, and validate its navigation performance through different reward scenarios. The experiment results show our approach can get effective goal-driven behaviour from raw sensory input and outperform the baselines across all tasks. Furthermore, the agent equipped with our intrinsic motivation appear to explore faster in no reward environment.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-based Accurate Approach for Inferring Potential LncRNA-disease Associations
abstract: The identification of underlying disease-associated long non-coding RNA (LncRNAs) helps to understand the underlying molecular mechanisms of disease and thus contribute to its treatment, diagnosis, and prognosis.
