The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by an example of a robot. The results show that the method has good control performance in control accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Mission Arrangement Optimization with Improved PSO for Multiple Plant Protecion UAVs in Heterogeneous Farmlands
abstract: Multiple plant protection Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are often used as a team in protection operation in a large area farmland plant nowadays. Mission arrangement is the first problem should be solved before the operation. In this work, we focus on promoting the operation efficiency of the multiple UAVs, systematically proposed Optimal Spraying Mission Assignment Problem (OSMAP), and try to construct the united problem framework in the mission arrangement of multiple plant protection UAVs. Firstly, the mathematical model of multiple UAVs was established and the OSMAP is defined. Secondly, the acquisition of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) data of farmlands is proposed, and the decision method of pesticide volume based on a farmland’s NDVI map was considered, which heterogeneous features of the sub-areas of a farmland. Thirdly, an improved Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is proposed, and numerical simulations for algorithm analysis are carried out in MATLAB. It is determined that the proposed PSO is more efficient and accurate than the classic PSO. Finally, a mission arrangement test is implemented with a 4-P20-1-P30-UAV system with farmland NDVI data was carried out to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in spraying operation. Test results proved that the proposed PSO performed well, which took only 63.98% of the operation time taken by the general mission arrangement method.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Gradient Compression Approach for Communication-Efficient Federated Learning
abstract: Federated learning is a recent advance in privacy-preserving deep learning. However, recent surveys show that federated learning still has prohibitive communication costs. Since the communication bandwidth of terminal devices is usually quite limited, improving the communication efficiency is critical to model updating. To solve the above issues, we present a novel adaptive gradient compression algorithm, based on non-Independent, Identically Distributed(non-IID) and unbalanced data distributions in federated learning to provide a unique compression rate for each client. Through comparative experiments, we prove that the performance of the adaptive gradient compression algorithm in federated learning is superior to the fixed compression rate method, which significantly improves the communication efficiency while preserving the model accuracy.

articleTitle: A Heuristic AP Deployment Approach for Industrial Wireless Networks
abstract: The deployment strategy of access points (APs) has a direct impact on Wi-Fi network performance, which in turn directly affects the production efficiency of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) system. Most existing researches on the AP deployment problem have more or less deficiencies in considering scenarios, geometric dimensions and optimization goals. Our goal is to achieve an automatic optimization AP deployment mechanism that can be directly applied to actual applications. To achieve this goal, we consider the three-dimensional heterogeneous medium environment, take the overall signal strength of end devices as the optimization goal, and propose a heuristic algorithm to solve the optimization problem. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Incorporating Nesterov’s Momentum into Distributed Adaptive Gradient Method for Online Optimization
abstract: Optimization methods based on adaptive gradients, such as AdaGrad, RMSProp, and Adam, are widely used to solve large-scale machine learning problems. This work aims to improve the recently proposed and rapidly promoted distributed adaptive gradient descent optimization algorithm(DADAM). There are two main components in Adam-a momentum component and an adaptive learning rate component. However, regular momentum can be proved conceptually and empirically inferior to a similar algorithm called Nestrov’s Accelerating Gradient (NAG). We therefore incorporate Nesterov’s Momentum into Distributed Adaptive Gradient Method (DADAM) for Online Optimization and obtain our NDADAM algorithm. Experiments show that the convergent speed of the proposed NDADAM algorithm has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design of Tracking System Based on Embedded Solar Panel
abstract: As China promotes the development of new energy, the solar energy project is one focus of the country. Due to the imperfection of photoelectric and mechanical solar tracking and positioning technology steps, this paper will introduce an intelligent solar photovoltaic tracking device based on an STM32 processor with ARM Cortex-M as the core. The operating principle of the device is that it will determine the rotation direction and rotation angle of the panel around the vertical and horizontal axes based on the voltage output generated by the photoresistor detection of light and have two stepper motor drivers run the dual-axis automatic solar tracking system to complete the operation of the whole system.

articleTitle: Automatic Underwater Acoustic Target Tracking by Using Image Processing Methods with Jamming Targets
abstract: Bearing time record analysis is a commonly used passive sonar information processing method, and is challenged by multi-target jamming. The performance of tracking ability is limited by Rayleigh Limit, which is one of the most frequently stated problems in direction of arrival territory. In this paper, an azimuth tracking framework is conceived by using image pattern recognition methods in order to improve the performance of sonar tracking systems. The new tracking framework first analyzes the target motions according to the recorded azimuths, then the multi-target jamming is mitigated via matched filtering. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method is able to track the trajectory of the interested targets even if the noise of the jamming targets is more powerful.

articleTitle: Identification of root cause alarms by detecting correlations and time delays between alarm variables
abstract: Under an abnormal situation in process operations, it is important to find out the root cause, so as to bring the system back to normal timely. In a typical modern industrial facility, there are configured a large number of alarms. Usually, the presence and propagation of a fault may lead to a series of alarms, which hold certain correlations. Therefore, analyzing alarm correlations can help to track the prorogation of faults among alarm variables and thus find out the root cause. This paper proposes a systematic alarm root cause analysis method based on the detection of correlations and time delays between alarm variables. First, two types of alarm correlations based on time stamps of alarm events are defined and the calculation methods are provided. Then, alarms are determined to be correlated or not by comparing with designed thresholds. Last, a causal matrix is formed to present the causal relations between alarms based on the directions of time delays. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by both a numerical example and the benchmark Tennessee Eastman model.

articleTitle: Car-Following Model Based Analysis of Mixed Traffic Flow Characteristics
abstract: In order to study the characteristics of mixed traffic flow with both autonomous vehicles and manual vehicles, a simulation method is proposed. Firstly, the Krauss model is selected as the car-following model, and we also analyze the model in detail. Secondly, three types of traffic scenarios are reconstructed based on SUMO. By setting corresponding model parameters to distinguish between the two types of vehicles, and then simulation is carried out for each scenario, by changing the proportion of autonomous vehicles increases gradually from 0 to 100 at the rate of 10%. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate that with the increase of autonomous vehicles, road travel time is gradually decreasing while the total number of vehicles remains the same. Therefore, the analysis results strongly prove that autonomous vehicles can effectively improve the travel efficiency of roads.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised bearing fault diagnosis based on Deep neural network joint optimization
abstract: Bearing is an important part of rotating machinery, and fault diagnosis of bearings plays a very important role in the healthy operation of the entire rotating machinery. Since there are less labeled data in the industrial field, it is impossible to train a deep learning fault diagnosis model of good performance. Therefore, semi-supervised fault diagnosis methods relying on less labeled data and many unlabeled data have been widely researched and applied. However, the existing semi-supervised learning methods cannot fully mine the deep features of unlabeled data. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a semi-supervised bearing fault diagnosis method based on DNN joint optimization. Use little labeled data and many unlabeled data to train an improved deep neural network, build a supervised DNN network and an unsupervised DNN network, which are used to extract the deep features of labeled data and unlabeled one, respectively. By expanding the features extracted by the two networks and judging the reliability of results of prediction classification unlabeled data, interactive joint fine-tuning between supervised and unsupervised networks can be realized. And the effectiveness of this method can be verified by using the bearing data set of Case Western Reserve University. Experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the accuracy of model fault diagnosis when there are less labeled data.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Snake Robot with Wheeled Modules
abstract: The long and narrow body and diverse gaits make the snake robot have innate advantages in the detection of dangerous and complex environments such as post-disaster rescue and field exploration. However, it still faces the problem of low movement efficiency. The movement efficiency of its main gait is still lower than it on the ground. There is a big gap with wheeled robots, which greatly limits the endurance and practical application of snake robots. In this paper, a snake robot with wheeled modules is developed and designed to improve the efficiency of the robot's movement. First, we designed the wheeled module of the snake robot, added a wheeled module to the snake robot, and gave the snake robot a wheeled motion mode. Then, a configuration shape that can adapt to a variety of environments was designed to improve the passage of the snake robot, and a parameter was customized to evaluate the designed wheeled configuration. Finally, we verified the designed wheeled configuration in a laboratory environment. This research improves the motion efficiency of bionic robots represented by snake robots, and helps to promote the practical application of snake robots in disaster rescue and field detection.

articleTitle: Cyber-physical security analysis of smart inverters under the pricing attacks
abstract: With the increased proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs) in the power system, the smart inverters play a more important role. A control loop model is applied to describe a solar plus storage system with smart inverter. The cyber-physical security impact of this system is analyzed in four categories. The pricing attack is focused in this paper. A real-time pricing model and a price signal forecast dispatch strategy are introduced for analyzing the electricity expense of prosumer.

articleTitle: Novel Adaptive Dynamic Event-Triggered Bipartite Consensus Protocols with Intermittent Updating and Interaction
abstract: This paper addresses the distributed bipartite consensus control problem faced with some intricate demands, namely, discrete-time control updating for each agent, intermittent interaction among neighbors, and the fully distributed fashion of the protocol design requiring no global information of the network topology. Given that no existing results meet all the three essential demands, we in this paper establish a unified framework on fully distributed adaptive bipartite consensus control with intermittent updating and interaction. The core is a novel dynamic triggering function decoupled with the network topology, based on which a discretely updated controller for each agent is designed accordingly. Then, adaptive dynamic eventtriggered protocols can be modularly designed with the twocomponent framework. Finally, a numerical example is provided to verify the effectiveness of the presented protocols.

articleTitle: Zero energy building design and analysis of economy and environmental protection
abstract: As one of the effective solutions to building energy consumption, zero-energy building has attracted more and more attention in recent years. In order to solve the problem of high energy consumption of buildings in China, this paper takes a small office building in the cold region of northern China as an example, and compares the economy and environmental protection of four types of buildings that meet the conditions of net zero energy consumption and zero energy consumption of general buildings and passive buildings. It is proved that the zero energy consumption building has advantages in economy and environmental protection. According to the data comparison, the net zero energy consumption standard is more relaxed than the zero energy consumption standard, showing great advantages in terms of economy and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Proportional-Integral-Derivative-Incorporated Latent Factorization of Tensors for Large-Scale Dynamic Network Analysis
abstract: A large-scale dynamic network (LDN) involving numerous entities and massive dynamic interactions is an essential data source in many practical industrial applications. It can be represented by a third-order high-dimensional and incomplete (HDI) tensor whose entries are mostly unknown. Yet such a third-order HDI tensor contains wealthy knowledge regarding miscellaneous desired patterns like potential links in an LDN. A stochastic gradient descent-based latent factorization of tensors (LFT) model can extract such knowledge from an HDI tensor. Nevertheless, a stochastic gradient descent-based LFT model commonly suffers from slow convergence that impairs its efficiency on an LDN. To address this issue, this work proposes a Proportional-integral-derivative (PID)-incorporated LFT (PLFT) model. It constructs an adjusted instance error based on the PID control principle, and then substitute it into a stochastic gradient descent algorithm to improve the convergence rate. Experimental results on one LDN generated by a real industrial application show that a PLFT model is able to exceed state-of-the-art models in terms of computational efficiency as well as obtains highly competitive prediction accuracy when handling the task of missing link prediction for a given LDN.

articleTitle: An improved parallel pre-synchronization control for multiple virtual synchronous generators
abstract: Parallel running multiple virtual synchronous generator connected to the electricity grid will make the micro grid showed weak characteristic of the grid. The strong coupling relationship between the phase-locked loop and the nonnegligible grid impedance will cause the instability of grid-connected inverter. In order to solve the grid connection problem, a pre-synchronization control based on virtual synchronous generator and double second order generalized integral frequency lock-loop is constructed. The output frequency of the virtual synchronous generator as the input of the frequency locked loop. And the output speed compensation of the frequency locked loop is imported into the virtual synchronous generators active power-frequency loop to correct the output frequency of the virtual synchronous generator. Thus, an automatically regulating frequency loop is formed. And the adaptive digital filter is used to filter the harmonic and noise of the input signal, which improves the frequency detection accuracy and has excellent dynamic and steady performance. Finally, through theoretical analysis and simulation results, the effectiveness of the pre-synchronization control strategy combined with the virtual synchronous generator algorithm and the frequency lock loop for the grid connection of the virtual synchronous generator is verified.

Author Keywords: double second order generalized integral frequency locking ling

articleTitle: Automatic Segmentation of Dynamic Thyroid Ultrasound Images Based on An Improved DRLSE Model
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of dynamic thyroid ultrasound images with high noise, low contrast, uneven gray distribution, and little change in continuous frame images, this paper improves the Distance Regularized Level Set Evolution (DRLSE) model and applies it to dynamics Segmentation of thyroid ultrasound images, It is of great significance for the correct diagnosis of thyroid disease. The algorithm uses bilateral filtering instead of Gaussian filtering to smooth the image, which protects the edge information of the image while smoothing the noise. Improve the edge indicator function of DRLSE and use the step-by-step method for image segmentation, which improves the speed and accuracy of segmentation. In order to achieve automatic segmentation of dynamic ultrasound images, the centroid of the thyroid segmentation result of each image is used as the initial contour point of the next adjacent frame of image for segmentation. Experiments show that the algorithm solves the problems of poor anti-noise ability of the DRLSE model, long evolution time, and manual modification of the initial contour. It not only improves the speed of segmentation of the thyroid area but also improves the segmentation Precision.

Author Keywords: Distance Regularized Level Set Evolution (DRLSE) model

articleTitle: Imbalanced bearing fault diagnosis based on adaptive cost-sensitive neural network
abstract: When the traditional machine learning model deals with class imbalance problems, there will be a problem of insufficient classification accuracy of rare class samples. The traditional cost sensitive strategy uses weighting on the misclassification cost of rare class samples as a means to solve this problem. There is a problem that the class weight may not be the optimal parameter of the network model. In order to overcome this problem, this paper designs an adaptive cost sensitive strategy, so that the network model can adaptively find the optimal class weight suitable for the current class imbalance problem in the process of training, and balance the proportion of the misclassification cost of large class samples and rare samples by optimizing the class weight, so as to make the network model converge to a set of better parameters, and further improve the classification accuracy of rare samples.

articleTitle: Mathematical Derivation and Simulational Verification for Aggressive Quadrotor Perching Control
abstract: Utilizing small quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for data acquisition and environment surveillance in various situations has become a dazzling application in many fields. However, some applications require UAVs to make aggressive maneuvers to achieve perching landing, which can not be handled well by conventional PID control. A special Euclid group (SE(3)) control method based on geometric tracking method is studied, and the expressions of critical variables are mathematically derived in detail. The trajectory generation is solved by gorubi optimization tool under given constraints, and the effectiveness of this controller is verified by MATLAB simulation. The results show that this control method has very high control accuracy (position tracking and attitude tracking in 0.3s) and robustness, and suitable for the following quadrotor perching control study.

articleTitle: An intelligent hand-washing monitoring platform based on gesture recognition technology
abstract: This paper uses gesture recognition technology based on YOLO v3 to successfully identify and detect the seven steps of the seven-step hand-washing method prescribed by the hospital. The paper also uses TensorRT to improve the trained seven-step hand-washing gestures recognition model and increase its detection frame rate on video files. Finally, the model runs on NVIDIA’s Jetson Nano, a smart mobile terminal, which is able to detect the hand-washing gestures in real time with a camera and other equipment for convenience.

articleTitle: A rolling bearing fault diagnosis model based on WCNN-BiGRU
abstract: Aiming at problems such as poor diagnosis effect of simple models and complex structure of hybrid models in the fault diagnosis of rolling bearing vibration signals, this paper establish a fault diagnosis model, which combines WCNN with BiGRU. First, the model extracts feature of the raw data through a one-dimensional wide convolutional network. Then, the reduced-dimensional fault sequence is sent to the BiGRU for further characteristics extracting. Finally, a classifier is used to categorize the fault diagnosis result. A comparison between our model and other models is given on the CWRU dataset. The experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper has a higher fault diagnosis rate than MLP, GRU, VGGNet-11, CNN-GRU, WDCNN, and with a fewer parameters. Besides, the model is applied to the data generated by the PT300 bearing fault simulation platform for fault diagnosis. Results show that the average accuracy of our model on both datasets exceeds 99%.

articleTitle: A tuning strategy for microwave filter using variable universe adaptive fuzzy logic system
abstract: Microwave filters are the core frequency selection device in 5G base station, which play an important role in the field of communication. The errors of design and processing of microwave filter make it difficult to meet the specific requirements of frequency selection, thus the tuning process before delivery is significant. However, the tuning process relies heavily on skilled workers, resulting in low tuning efficiency and high cost. The automatic tuning method based on fuzzy logic does not depend on the model and has strong applicability. It has great practical value to the production trend of multi-variety, small batch and customization of microwave filters. In this paper, a variable universe adaptive fuzzy tuning method is proposed. First, intelligent optimal contraction-expansion factors based on fuzzy inference are proposed according to expert knowledge. Then, the input universe and output universe are multiplied, and the initial rule is transformed into more effective new rules through the transformation which is adaptive to the variable universe. Last, the effectiveness of the proposed tuning method is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fan-coil Outlet Wind Temperature Control with Correction Module of Thermistor for the ASHPAC System
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the problem of improving the performance of the fan-coil control system in Air source heat pump air-conditioning (ASHPAC) system. Firstly, we introduce a correction module in ASHPAC system to compensate the first-order damp elements in the temperature sensor to capture the temperature in real-time. Then, an adaptive controller is developed for the outlet temperature control of the fan-coil, where the projection adaptation is included for enhancement of the control performance during variation of working conditions. The stability of the studied fan-coil control is guaranteed by rigorous Lyapunov proof. Finally, numerical analysis has been conducted to validate the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Memory-augment convolutional Autoencoder for unsupervised pavement crack classification
abstract: In urban construction, transportation system is an important part. However, the pavement cracks will occur because of using in long time and some external force collision, which has impacts on the safety and reliability of the whole transportation system. Therefore, it is necessary to detect the pavement cracks. The formation of pavement cracks is slow, and it is not concentrated on one place, so it is difficult to obtain enough images containing cracks to train. We propose a new pre-training method based on self-supervision study, which can obtain features closer to the target task from normal pavement images. In addition, we combine a memory-augment convolutional autoencoder and a hard-threshold module to improve the accuracy of the crack classification. Experiments conducted on the Mendeley Concrete crack dataset and Deep-Crack dataset demonstrate the good performance in pavement crack classification task.

articleTitle: Survival prediction of LGG patients based on deep learning of MRI data and genomic data integration
abstract: Low-grade gliomas (LGG) is the most common primary intracranial tumor, with high incidence rate, high recurrence rate, high mortality rate and low cure rate. Therefore, it is necessary to predict the survival of LGG patients in diagnosis. Considering the complementarity of information, the new proposed algorithm in this study is designed to integrate Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) data and gene expression data using deep learning method to predict the Disease Specific Survival (DSS) of LGG patients. Firstly, MRI data of 44 patients is screened from TCIA database, and then the corresponding gene expression data of 44 patients is searched from TCGA database. Then, 724 image feature data extracted from MRI data are filtered and extracted by deep learning method, and DSS tags are used to train the model; deep learning method is used to extract 20530 features of gene expression data, and DSS tags are also used for training. As a contrast, the deep learning method is used to integrate the two features to train the model. Experiments are evaluated on MRI data, gene expression data and the integration data of MRI and gene expression data, respectively. The results show that by using the integration of MRI data and gene expression data performs better than using single data in terms of the time-dependent receiver operating characteristic(ROC) and the area under the curve (AUC) of the ROC curve criteria.

articleTitle: Online Adaptive and Attention-based Reference Path Generation for Upper-limb Rehabilitation Robot
abstract: This paper proposes an online reference path generation method for upper-limb rehabilitation robots considering the initial motions of the subjects. The proposed system is grounded on a Learning by Demonstration (LfD) approach based on an attention-based neural network, and the method presents a high level of generalization allowing the user to perform the point-to-point tasks, as most upper limb motions such as Activities of Daily Living (ADL) tasks can be segmented into multiple point-to-point motions. The proposed approach has been experimentally validated on a robotic arm (i.e., the Franka Emika Panda) attached to a human subject’s hand, and experimental results demonstrate that 1) the path generated by the proposed approach gets higher accuracy (promote approximately 79.18%) compared with the Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMP) in terms of similarity with healthy human motion in the test dataset. 2) the proposed system can guarantee the performance concerning the variation of starting points and target points.

articleTitle: Launch scheme and control law design of small tube launched UAV
abstract: As we have requirement for UAV being on standby to perform tasks in time, with respect to the scenario of launching UAV on the sea surface, we plan to launch the folded UAV from the floating tube to a certain height, and to control the attitude of UAV in the launching process. The three core points of the project are studied: the design of launch scheme, the attitude control during the launch process and the design optimization of the launch window. According to the launch scheme, the combination of the pneumatic ejection and booster rockets are selected. In the launching process, the UAV is at low altitude and low speed, to achieve attitude control in a short time, it is necessary to design the optimal control method and the differential thrust control law is completed. In addition, due to the influence of environment, in order to improve the success rate of launch, it is necessary to consider the movement of waves and choose the appropriate time to launch by predicting the slope of wave in a short time. The simulation results show that the designed UAV launch control system can successfully boost the UAV to a certain height from the sea surface, and realize the stable flight of the UAV.

articleTitle: New Hierarchical Sliding Mode Control Method for Velocity Tracking of the Spherical Robot
abstract: For the spherical robot, a convenient and efficient velocity controller that can be applied to multiple terrains is of great importance. This controller also needs to be applied to the velocity control of spherical robot whether the robot is going straight or turning. In response to the above requirements, we propose a new hierarchical sliding mode controller (HSMC). A more accurate dynamic model is established in order to improve the control effect. We have designed new layer sliding surfaces, which can improve the control effect and stability. The practical experiments show that, compared with PID controller, the HSMC has shorter rise time and setting time, greater control performance and stronger robustness in velocity tracking of the robot, whether the robot is going straight or turning.

articleTitle: A Generative Adversarial Network with Attention Module for Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation
abstract: The Image-to-Image Translation (I2IT) is a challenging image processing task that can be applied to many aspects, such as super-resolution and style transfer. Although several image translation algorithms based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) have been proposed, achieving better translation effects still remains a problem worthy of attention. This work proposes a model that fuses an attention module and ResNet-based generator to enhance the performance of I2IT. Using an attention module after the first downsampling, our model can focus more on important low-level semantic features. After the downsampling, the residual blocks provide contextual supplementary information of the photos. The qualitative and quantitative experimental results on unpaired datasets show that our model is better than the SOTA methods, which further confirms the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on control of electric propulsion permanent magnet synchronous motor of electric aircraft based on genetic algorithm
abstract: With the advantages of low carbon, environmental protection, low noise, comfort, electric aircraft represent the development direction of advanced aircraft technology. To improve the dynamic characteristics of the permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) control system in electric propulsion technology for electric aircraft, the structure of the dual closed-loop vector control system for permanent magnet synchronous motors is investigated, and the system dual closed-loop controller parameters are optimized using an improved genetic algorithm by designing the time-multiplied absolute value integral of error(ITAE) performance index as the fitness function of the genetic algorithm(GA). Simulation and experimental results prove that the scheme converges faster than the conventional double closed-loop controller when the motor is disturbed, which can effectively improve the performance and anti-disturbance capability of the motor control system and provide some reference for the optimal design of future electric propulsion system controllers for electric aircraft.

articleTitle: Singularity Analysis and Singularity Avoidance Trajectory Planning for Industrial Robots
abstract: Aiming at the problem of singular configuration of industrial robot in linear operation, this paper analyzes and studies the singularity configuration and singularity avoidance method of industrial robot, and a dynamic damping least square method singularity avoidance trajectory planning algorithm based on minimum singular value is proposed. The kinematics model of the robot with spherical wrist structure is established. Based on the decoupling analysis of the robot singularity, the singularity mathematical expressions of the wrist, the elbow and the shoulder are obtained respectively. It is closely related to the length and offset of connecting link. The dynamic damped least square method based on the minimum singular value is used to adjust the trajectory of the Cartesian space and the mapped joint space in the singular region. Simulation results show that the velocity of the proposed method is stable near the singular configuration, and there is no uncontrollable phenomenon of motion discontinuity and stability degradation.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of DAB converter based on Wavelet Packet-RBF Neural Network
abstract: Converter fault diagnosis is an important research content for reliable operation of power electronic system. Taking Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter as the object, this paper proposes a Wavelet Packet-RBF Neural Network based open circuit fault diagnosis method for DAB converter. Firstly, the fault signal is decomposed and reconstructed by multi-scale wavelet packet, and the wavelet packet energy is extracted as the fault feature vector. Then, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was used to reduce the dimension. Finally, the fault is diagnosed by RBF neural network. The Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation results show that the fault diagnosis method has the advantages of high accuracy and short diagnosis time, and the feasibility and the advanced nature of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: An ADRC-based Positioning and Anti-swing Control for Tower Crane
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low work efficiency and high safety risk caused by load swing in the working process of tower crane, in order to master the key factors affecting the swing angle, the dynamic characteristics of the hoisting system are analyzed through modeling and simulation, and the influencing factors on the swing angle change such as initial swing angle, rope length change and running speed are obtained. In order to control the swing of heavy objects safely and stably, an auto disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) is designed, and the performance of the designed controller and conventional PID controller in restraining the swing angle of the system is analyzed and compared. The results show that the ADRC is 4s ahead of the conventional PID control in position control and swing angle control, and the control accuracy and robustness are also improved compared with the conventional PID control.

articleTitle: DOA Estimation by Off-Grid Compressive Sampling Matching Pursuit with Impulsive Noise
abstract: A sparse based DOA mathematical model is proposed based on the vectorization of a fractional low-order covariance (FLOC) matrix. The sparse recovery-based method of off-grid compressive sampling matching pursuit was adopted to perform the direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation of the target. In this study, the FLOC matrix was vectorized to construct an over-complete dictionary. The CoSaMP algorithm was improved and successfully applied to DOA estimation. In addition, the alternating iteration method is applied to solve the off-grid model. The proposed algorithm can achieve high-accuracy DOA estimation at low generalized signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR) and small snapshots. The simulation experiments results demonstrated the effectiveness and estimation accuracy improvement of the proposed algorithm in impulsive noise.

articleTitle: Cascaded Design for Robust Trajectory Tracking Control of an Underactuated Surface Vehicle
abstract: The trajectory tracking control problem for an underactuated surface vehicle is addressed in this paper based on the cascaded design. The tracking error dynamics are established with the reference trajectories generated by a virtual target vehicle and converted into a novel cascaded structure, then the primitive control problem can be decomposed into the stabilization problems for the two interconnected systems, which is different from the Lyapunov based recursive design that relies heavily on constructing the Lyapunov function for the overall system. Moreover, the persistent of excitation condition on the yaw angle can be removed in the resulted cascaded structure. Sliding mode control method is utilized to stabilize the states under model uncertainties for the perturbing system. Then, the satisfaction of the sufficient conditions for the the stability of the cascaded system is verified. Finally, the simulation results are presented to show the effectiveness of the proposed robust cascaded control.

articleTitle: Aircraft Dynamic Parameters Identification Based on Adaptive Weight Kalman Filter
abstract: An incremental dynamic parameter identification model is proposed based on the small disturbance equation of pitch channel of the aircraft. The Kalman filter (KF) is used to identify the aircraft dynamic parameters representing the static stability and elevator efficiency. In order to solve the problem of the divergence of identification results using traditional KF, an Adaptive Weight Kalman filter (AWKF) is proposed using rated aerodynamic parameters and prior knowledge. The simulation results show that the identification results of this filter is significantly better than the traditional KF, and can effectively suppress the divergence of the identification results.

articleTitle: Online Learning based GA-BP Neural Network to Predict Ship Trajectory
abstract: Ship’s tracking prediction is an important part of ship navigation. By using neural network to predict ship’s track can avoid building complex mathematical model of ship motion. BP neural network is easy to fall into the trap of local error minimization, and it’s global search ability of genetic algorithm can overcome the shortcomings of BP neural network which easy to fall into local optimum. Experiment is using genetic algorithm to optimize the BP neural network on the number of hidden layer nodes, weights and thresholds. Finally, by training the neural network online learning method to real-time prediction of ship trajectory simulation experiment, through the contrast experiment, prove that GA-BP neural network online learning model has high precision by using the measured data and to verify the practicability and reliability of the GA-BP prediction model. This experimental result is helpful to the research of ship automatic control and comprehensive maneuvering.

articleTitle: RBOA Algorithm Based on Region Segmentation and Point Update
abstract: Robot bean optimization algorithm (RBOA) is a recently proposed cooperative target searching method for swarm UAVs based on bean optimization algorithm (BOA). Considering the shortcomings of low initialization coverage and low efficiency of free space search for RBOA, we propose a region segmentation and point update strategy for RBOA. The region segmentation strategy divides the search space for RBOA initialization to improve the search efficiency. The point update strategy updates the base position in the free space to improve the utilization of UAV information obtained from traversal search. Compared with the RBOA and other target search algorithms, this method is more efficient and effective in unknown environment search.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Observation and Control for Overhead Cranes with Varying Rope Length
abstract: This paper proposes a state observer and controller based on the second-order sliding mode scheme for under-actuated overhead cranes with load hoisting and lowering. The designed state observer can effectively estimate the uncertainty and unmodeled dynamics of crane systems, and provide appropriate driving force compensations for the sliding mode controller designed by coupling the load swing angle. This guarantees an accurate load positioning and residual swing elimination. Based on the Lyapunov stability criterion, the asymptotic stability of the control system is proved. Several simulations are implemented to verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed controller for anti-sway and positioning controls.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Particle Swarm Optimized Fuzzy PID Control for Quadrotor UAV
abstract: Aiming at the problem of blindness in selecting the scale factor and quantization factor in the fuzzy PID control of quadrotor UA V based on empirical knowledge and simulation debugging, an improved particle swarm algorithm is proposed to optimize the parameter factors of the fuzzy controller, method. Using the adaptive inertia - weight method to optimize the particle swarm can avoid the dilemma of local optimality at the beginning. At the same time, the ITAE criterion is selected as the adaptability of the particle swarm algorithm to achieve better control effect. The adaptive particle swarm fuzzy PID is proved to be faster than fuzzy PID and traditional PID, with less overshoot and shorter stabilization time; the particle swarm fuzzy PID algorithm takes less time to recover the stabilization time when disturbing signals are encountered.

articleTitle: Multi-mode Motion Control System Design and Implementation for an Air-ground Amphibious Robot
abstract: This paper presents the design, modeling, control and experimental validation of an air-ground amphibious robot (AGAR), especially the ground-air mode-switching control in the presence of surrounding obstacles. Flight is achieved through a hexacopter unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV); six rotors produce the required thrust. Adding a wheeled mobile robot to the hexacopter makes movement on land possible. The envisioned application scenario includes field reconnaissance/surveillance in coordination with large unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) which utilizes AGAR as a multi-mode sensor. We address the controller design and the short take-off strategy for the transition between two modes of locomotion, allowing the robot to rapidly avoid obstacles in an unknown situation. A series of experiments about the obstacle detection and the mode-switching control were performed with the physical prototype; the experimental results in the field with an obstacle and a cliff confirmed the validity of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Early gastric cancer detection based on the combination of convolutional neural network and attention mechanism
abstract: Gastric cancer is one of the three major malignant tumors in the world. The earlier it is found, the higher cure rate get. However, the early clinical diagnosis is still not good enough. Thus, timely and accurate diagnosis of early gastric cancer lesions using computer-aided technology is urgently needed. This paper proposes an early gastric cancer detection (EGCD) model on the basis of CNN and attention mechanism. Due to the irregular shape of early gastric cancer under the endoscopy, the boundary is not obvious. First, improve YOLOv4, and propose E-YOLO with feature layer fusion. Combine CBAM to design EGCD to enhance the characteristic expression of cancer targets in channel and spatial, highlight cancer targets, and suppress background information. The results elaborate specificity of EGCD model is 77.39% and sensitivity is 82.27%. The average accuracy reaches 94.16%, which is 5% higher than YOLOv4. The method proposed has improved results in early gastric cancer detection and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Marine Main Engines using Improved Semi-Supervised Locally Linear Embedding
abstract: As an important rotating machinery, the frequency domain characteristics of the vibration signals of the marine main engine are important basis for fault diagnosis. In order to improve the speed and accuracy of fault diagnosis as much as possible, features need to be screened. Considering the nonlinear correlation among the dimensions, we use local linear embed-ding(LLE) to reduce dimensions. Some known fault types of data can provide us with more information, which help improve LLE to semi-supervised LLE(SSLLE), but different scales of different features and of different fault types limit the accuracy of traditional SSLLE. Aiming at this problem, we put forward an improved SSLLE algorithm, and have tested it on actual data of ships, obtaining better performance than traditional ways.

articleTitle: Robot Tactile Data Classification Method Using Spiking Neural Network
abstract: The ability of tactile perception is one of the future development directions of robotics, and the research on the classification method of tactile data is to explore the concrete manifestation of its ability. Owing to its event-driven characteristics, the spiking neural network can better process event-based tactile sensing data, but the backpropagation of the network will fail because of the nondifferentiable influence of the propagation function. In this paper, a spiking-graph neural network model for tactile perception is improved, and various differentiable functions are used to approximate the propagation function of the neural network. Finally, the function that achieves the best performance is selected as the backpropagation function through experiments. Our model improves the classification accuracy of tactile data and simultaneously accelerates the convergence speed and reduces the convergence value. The experimental results of the tactile data set collected by the robot show that the performance of the improved model in this paper is better than the original model and classify household objects more accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Detection System of Electronic Thermostat
abstract: As one of the core components of the engine cooling system, the electronic thermostat is in order to achieve the purpose of testing the performance of the electronic thermostat. This paper designs an electronic thermostat detection system. The system uses electrical proportional valves, solenoid valves, relays, acquisition controllers, industrial computers and other hardware devices. The software platform is built based on the Java development environment and MySQL database to realize the storage and display of test data, automatic testing and alarm processing. By detecting the motor current, external leakage differential pressure and flow characteristics, real-time data collection and analysis can be performed on the current value, the change of differential pressure and the flow conditions corresponding to the opening of the ball valve. After testing, this system can realize the inspection of the eligibility of the electronic thermostat, so as to verify whether the performance index of the electronic thermostat can reach the expected design.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning of autonomous vehicle based on Frenét frame system
abstract: With the development of autonomous driving technology, the situations handled by autonomous vehicles are becoming more and more complex. Local path planning is one of the important technologies of intelligent vehicles in the face of complex situations. To integrate more factors into consideration for different scenarios, an optimal trajectory generation method based on Frenét frame system is presented in this paper for trajectory planning of autonomous vehicles. In the optimal trajectory generation method, path is divided into multiple segments along the reference line and the vehicle state is sampled in each path segment. The cost function to evaluate each sampled path point and the vehicle state is established by considering the trajectory smoothness, comfort, energy consumption and the deviation degree of the reference route, and the parameters of the cost function are adjusted according to the different influence degree of factors through different driving modes of the vehicle. The function of obstacle avoidance of the trajectory planning is realized by deleting the trajectory that is less than the safe distance from the obstacles. Simulation verification shows that this method can complete trajectory planning under static obstacles and dynamic obstacles to realize the functions of obstacles avoidance and overtaking.

articleTitle: Uncertainly Guided Multi-Scale Underwater Image Enhancement Network with Tone Mapping Block
abstract: Underwater image enhancement remains a challenging problem for severe color distortions of the underwater images. In this work, an Uncertainly Guided Multi-scale Underwater Image Enhancement Network (UMUEN) with Tone Mapping Block is introduced by us to address this problem. In the proposed framework, a confidence module is induced and the confidence map is utilized as guidance to reconstruct more confident enhanced results in training step. So as to resolve the color distortion problems, we further design a tone mapping block to correct the color shift. The effectiveness of different constituents of the UMUEN is showed through an ablation study. Large quantities of experiment results demonstrate that the proposed UMUEN performs better compare with the state-of- the-art methods on real-world datasets.

articleTitle: An Improved Kalman Filter Based on Sequentially Estimating Measurement Noise Covariance
abstract: It is well-known that the covariance matrix of measurement noise plays an important role in Kalman filter design. Based on recursive covariance estimation, an improved Kalman filter, termed as IKF-RCE, is proposed in this paper to solve the challenging problem of state estimation when the covariance matrix of measurement noise is completely unknown. Finally, the stability of IKF-RCE algorithm is verified by simulation studies to demonstrate that the state estimation obtained from the new algorithm is asymptotically consistent with the optimal estimation obtained from the ideal Kalman filter with exact measurement noise covariance matrix.

articleTitle: Self Organizing Cooperative Obstacle Avoidance Method for AUV Swarm
abstract: In this paper, we propose the Self Organizing Cooperative Obstacle Avoidance Method for AUV Swarm. Bionic swarm control of self organized swarm can simultaneously realize swarm keeping and communication topology connectivity after obstacle avoidance. The AUV and its neighborhood are constrained by biological criteria during the process of swarm moving which realize the external holding and internal collision avoidance of the AUV Swarm. When the perceptual range of several AUVs in the swarm intersects with the influence range of obstacles, local path planning can be carried out by using the improved potential field. The flexibility and communication topology connectivity of the AUV on the edge of a swarm should meet the environmental requirements. As a result, we introduce a dynamic factor which can realize the stability of connectivity and convergence in the process of swarm obstacle avoidance. Simulation results and experiment results show that the AUV swarm self-organizing cooperative obstacle avoidance method is effective.

articleTitle: A RGB-D based 6D Object Pose Estimation and Its Application in Robotic Grasping
abstract: Pose estimation of objects is critical to robotic grasping. Local optimization approach has been widely used to minimize the distance of the point pairs to estimate the 6D pose, which, however, is time-consuming and low-accuracy. To conquer this problem, a novel and time-efficient 6D object pose estimation neural network, PoseNet, is proposed in this paper. The input of PoseNet is the RGB-D image and a novel fusion network with channel attention mechanism is used to extract data. The random-sample-consensus-based voting method and rotation anchors are developed to predict, respectively, the translation of object and the rotation of object. The performance evaluation on the YCB-Video dataset show that the real-time inference and high accuracy are guaranteed. The proposed method is also demonstrated by a practical robotic grasping system, where the experiment video is avaliable at https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1qf4y1s7in.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Cross-validation

articleTitle: Design of Switched Reluctance Generator Control System for Flywheel Energy Storage
abstract: In terms of the unstable output voltage and low power density during the power generation process of the flywheel energy storage system(FESS), a control scheme of an improved flywheel energy storage system is studied. The motor in the system uses the three-phase 12/8 Pole switched reluctance generator(SRG), and integrates the motor’s rotor with the rotor of the flywheel energy storage system. The Hall position state and working principle of the switched reluctance motor(SRM) during power generation are explained in detail. Angle position control (APC) and pulse width modulation (PWM) control are added on the basis of current chopping control (CCC). It overcomes the problems of large output voltage pulsation and low power density when the motor is running at low speed, and the feasibility of the above method is verified through simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Model-free adaptive control of cement mill load based on VRFT method
abstract: Starting from the direction of improving the operating efficiency of the cement pre-grinding system and reducing the energy consumption of cement production, this paper proposes a model-free adaptive control method for mill load based on the analysis of the cement pre-grinding system. First of all, this paper determines the key variables that affect the pre-grinding efficiency through process analysis and uses wavelet filtering to filter the data. After that, a dynamic relationship model between the speed of the circulating fan and the current of the bucket elevator was established by using the neural network method. We designed the controller using the MFAC method based on full-format dynamic linearization, followed by the VRFT method to tune the controller parameters. Finally, the simulation proves that the method has a better tracking effect.

articleTitle: Soft sensor development using novel multi-activation functions based ensemble echo state network
abstract: In recent years, due to the continuous expansion of the scale of chemical industry, chemical industry data presents the characteristics of high dimensionality, large quantity, and strong nonlinearity, which greatly increases the difficulty of process modeling. Data-driven soft-sensing modeling methods have been widely used. Echo State Network, as a typical recurrent neural network, plays an important role in the field of time series prediction. However, the traditional Echo State Network (ESN) only uses a single kind of activation functions. Faced with strong coupling and high nonlinear influencing factors, the prediction performance of ESN will decrease. In order to solve the above problem, this paper proposes a variety of different activation functions into the Echo State Network to improve the ability to deal with complex process data. In the proposed method, three kinds of activation functions are utilized. In order to test the performance, High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) industrial process data is used. The simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve better performance in terms of accuracy than other models.

articleTitle: Piecewise Prediction Control Design for a Class of Spin-Stabilized Projectiles in Descending Segment
abstract: The deviation of ballistic model in the impact point prediction control is an inevitable problem which may incur the loss of control accuracy. In addition, the computing algorithm of canards roll angles in canards-fixed projectiles remains to be coped with. To tackle these challenges, a piecewise prediction control strategy for a class of spin-stabilized projectiles with canards is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the concept of piecewise prediction is obtained by analyzing the section error of impact point prediction model. Secondly, a simple linear formula to compute roll angle of canards is deduced, and piecewise guidance law is designed. Finally, simulations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm, and the results show that the piecewise prediction control achieves outstanding performance, superior to the impact point prediction control with modified point mass model in the given conditions.

articleTitle: An Abnormal Network Traffic Detection Method for Steam Turbine Control System based on Long Short-Term Memory
abstract: The steam turbine control system, as apart of the power control system, is a cyber physical system which relies on communication technology and control technology to control the steam turbine automatically. In order to solve the problem that its communication technology is vulnerable to network intrusion and thus threatens the security and stability of the power grid, a network abnormal detection method for turbine control system based on long- short term memory (LSTM) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an LSTM neural network is established to predict a value based on the historical data of the selected time series, Then, the error between the predicted value and the actual value is calculated. Finally, a network intrusion is determined when the error exceeds the threshold value. Compared -with the results of other common neural networks, the proposed method is proved to be effective and more accurate.

articleTitle: An all-around three-axis over-the-top tracking scheme of Satcom on the move
abstract: In order to solve the over-the-top blindness problem generated by the two-axis "Satcom on the move" in tracking the target, an all-around three-axis over-the-top tracking scheme is proposed in this paper. The kinematic model of the three-axis moving center pass is first established and transformed into a nonlinear programming problem, and then an improved sequential quadratic programming algorithm is used to obtain the angular values of the three axes during the "Satcom on the move" over the top tracking. Finally, the simulation experiments show that the motion angle of each axis in the over-the-top tracking process are within a reasonable range, which can truly realize the three-axis all-round continuous tracking and solve the blind area problem generated by the "Satcom on the move" through the top tracking.

articleTitle: Design of Ambient Intelligence Monitoring System for Park Vegetation Growth Based on Single-chip Microcomputer
abstract: With the continuous improvement of China's economic strength, the quality of the environment has gone from bad to worse, and residents have put forward higher requirements for the quality of their living environment. From parks in residential areas to national parks, parks have increasingly become an important place for people to release their mental stress and experience joy of life as well as a major component of urban greening construction. However, the vegetation in the park grows in the open air, and the plants face complex and changeable living environment for a long time. In addition, the survival rate of the vegetation is often very low without reasonable scientific maintenance. Therefore, in the process of developing park greening vegetation, scientific and standardized planting and caring work is essential.According to the situation, infrared obstacle avoidance sensors are used in the design to acquire road conditions, which are transmitted to single-chip microcomputer and then fed back to QT, DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor and illumination sensor are used to acquire real-time information of plant growth environment conditions in the park, which is processed by single-chip microcomputer and then fed back to QT, and the QT client can also be used to control the forward, left and right direction of the trolley. The environmental information of the whole park has been acquired, fed back in real time at QT client, and alarm processing has been realized.

articleTitle: Adaptive Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Control Based Hazard Avoidance Guidance for Asteroid Landing
abstract: Future asteroid landing and sampling missions will be selected in areas with higher scientific value, such as terrain hazard, and Spacecraft need to have the ability of autonomous hazard avoidance. In this paper, an adaptive super-twisting sliding mode control method is proposed for the asteroid landing with hazard avoidance. The unknown upper bound uncertainty is introduced in the asteroid landing model and the sliding mode surface with artificial potential function gradient is established. Then, the adaptive super-twisting sliding mode controller is designed using quadratic Lyapunov function and the stability of closed-loop system is demonstrated. The simulation results show that the proposed control law has good robustness with unknown upper bound uncertainty, ensures the rapid convergence of the system to the sliding surface and effectively suppresses chattering, and achieves accurate landing and hazard avoidance of the spacecraft.

articleTitle: Hybrid Vision/Force Control of Robotic Autonomous Assembly for 110kV Hot-line Maintenance
abstract: High-voltage transmission lines, also known as hot-lines, are the most important means of electric power energy transmission, the stability and safety of their manipulation and maintenance also have direct impacts on the quality of the power supply, as well as on workers’ lives and productivity. In this paper, A robotic nut tightening operation on a T-connector is taken as an example of live working, a hybrid vision/force controller is then proposed based on a depth camera, a 6-axis force/torque sensor and a parallel gripper. The depth camera is introduced to locate the position of the nut and the bolt to perform grasping, force controller is then used to insert the nut onto the bolt correctly to perform nut tightening. Meanwhile, an operation planning module is introduced to generate the desired trajectory according to the information given by the two controllers. The experimental results show high control efficiency with high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Subspace-aided data-driven robust fault observer design for a typical process system
abstract: Fault observer is an important mechanism for fault detection in industrial process, which plays as the premise in fault diagnosis and system safety monitoring. The fault alarm is raised if the generated residual signal exceeds the assigned fault detection threshold. With the unexpected but inevitable disturbances and noises in industrial process, it may generate increasing false alarm rate. Therefore, a robust fault observer design method is proposed based on the subspace-aided identification via system data in this paper. First the equivalent canonical form of the system is identified via the system data. Then the key parameters of the robust index is derived and the optimal parity vector is solved for constructing the robust fault observer. Finally, the performance of the proposed method is illustrated by the simulation of a typical three-tank flow process system, which indicates the improvement for its possible implementations.

articleTitle: Grade quantification of Parkinson's disease based on principal component analysis
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a common neurodegenerative disease, which seriously affects the life of patients. Whether there is an objective and reliable method to classify and identify the disease grade is of great significance in the clinical diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease. In this paper, principal component analysis was used to comprehensively evaluate the degree of Parkinson’s disease of 28 randomly selected subjects, establish a comprehensive scoring model of Parkinson’s disease degree, and fit it according to HY grade, so as to realize the quantification of Parkinson’s disease grade. Based on the data of vertical ground reaction force, 12 gait features with strong correlation are calculated as the main features to establish the scoring model. The validity of the model is verified by predicting the HY grade of another 12 subjects in the randomly selected data set. The results show that the prediction accuracy is 83.3%, which can effectively predict the Parkinson’s disease level of subjects.

articleTitle: Motion control algorithm for five-axis additive and subtractive hybrid machining
abstract: In this paper, a motion control algorithm for five-axis additive and subtractive hybrid machining of free form surfaces is proposed. After obtaining the contour data of the parts, the machining area is divided by tool accessibility, and then the nonuniform filling method is adopted for additive processing. After that, the subtractive process of the partitioned area is carried out. Experiments show that the algorithm is helpful to improve the process efficiency and to achieve a better process effect.

articleTitle: Fault estimation based adaptive observer for a class of Lipschitz nonlinear systems
abstract: Aiming at the problem of fault estimation for a class of nonlinear systems with Lipschitz nonlinear term, a new adaptive observer is proposed in this paper. The system is subject to sensor fault, actuator fault and unknown disturbance simultaneously. The sensor fault vector is transformed into an augmented state vector, the original system is transformed into an augmented nonsingular system which includes unknown disturbance and actuator fault of unknown upper bound. A new adaptive observer is designed to estimate the states and actuator fault simultaneously, and it can also eliminate (or attenuate) the influence of the unknown disturbance. The solution of the adaptive observer gain matrix is transformed into a multi-objective optimization problem, and the solution method of the observer is given in the form of a theorem by means of linear matrix inequality (LMI). It is proved that the states of the error system are uniformly ultimately bounded. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed observer for nonlinear systems fault estimation.

articleTitle: Signal-to-noise Ratio Analysis of Infrared Small Target Detection Based on Energy Accumulation For High-dimensional Motion Parameters
abstract: Infrared (IR) small target detection in heavy noise has always been a challenging research task. Detection methods based on energy accumulation can effectively suppress noise and improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Unfortunately, the detection performance of such dim and small target detection methods is limited due to the lack of accurate target motion modeling. In this paper, considering that the target motion is complex and diverse, a high-dimensional motion parameter (HMP) target motion model is studied. The HMP target motion model can cover various target motion forms, including constant velocity (CV) linear motion, constant acceleration (CA) linear motion and constant velocity curvilinear motion (CVC). Then, the SNR gain based on the energy accumulation detection algorithm under HMP is analyzed in detail. Experimental results show that when the target motion is non-linear, the energy accumulation method based on the HMP motion model can more effectively improve the SNR compare to the energy accumulation method based on CA motion model.

articleTitle: Differential Evolution Algorithm Optimized ELM Fault Diagnosis of Flight Control System Actuator
abstract: The effect of the algorithm based on ELM (Extreme Learning Machine) and improved differential evolution algorithm on fault diagnosis of the flight control system actuator is studied. As a machine learning algorithm, ELM has the characteristics of fast speed and high precision. In order to further improve the generalization performance of ELM training, the differential evolution algorithm is combined with the ELM algorithm to improve its fault diagnosis effect. First, the 3DOF(three-degree-of-freedom) aircraft fault diagnosis experimental platform is used to collect the fault data of the actuator; then the global iterative optimization of the differential evolution algorithm is used to do optimization on the network parameters trained by the ELM with the fault data as well as the threshold, the training results show that the network algorithm has better generalization performance; finally, the trained model is used to detect the same type of actuator fault data. According to the experimental results, the method performs well in fault diagnosis, which shows the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Combinatorial Optimization Method for Orbital Pursuit-Evasion Game with J2 Perturbation
abstract: The orbital pursuit-evasion game (OPEG) is a research hotspot in space missions with the noncooperative adversaries. This paper proposes a combinatorial optimization method to solve the J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> -perturbed orbital pursuit-evasion game by connecting the analytic necessary conditions under HCW and J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> -perturbed together. Firstly, the dynamics and necessary conditions to solve the two point boundary value problem for J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-perturbed game are presented. Secondly, the parameters to be solved under two dynamics are connected together with the costate. Then the combinatorial optimization method is proposed with the global method for HCW game and the local method for J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-perturbed game to reduce the computation load. Then simulation results demonstrate that this method is effective and high-efficiency comparing to the previous method.

articleTitle: In-container Robot Palletizing with 3D vision-based Datum Point Positioning
abstract: Palletizing inside the container faces inefficiency of manual palletizing and positioning inprecision of robot. To solve these problems, it is necessary to consider two important procedures: robot palletizing scheme analysis and datum point positioning inside the container. A 3D vision-based positioning algorithm, which was combined with robot kinematics was proposed and then executed. A D-H table was built for robot RS050N to achieve the homogeneous transformation matrix; then, whole corner positioning algorithm based on 3D vision was designed, which included segmentation, down sampling, filter and an algorithm designed for boundary fitting in point cloud. It can reduce data volume, improve efficiency, and remove the point cloud which interferes positioning precision, such as stiffeners and bumps at corners. In the experiment, this algorithm can realize precise positioning for industrial robot palletizing in the container, meeting MAE of 1.715 mm and RMSE of 1.976 mm.

articleTitle: Research on pilot protection for single phase to ground fault in low resistance ground active distribution network
abstract: After the multi-distributed generation is incorporated into the distribution network with small resistance grounding at the neutral point, the system structure of the distribution network will change, and the reliability of the original single-phase grounding protection will be greatly affected. Based on the typical structure of small resistance grounding distribution network with multi-distributed generation, this paper analyzes the fault characteristics of zero sequence current at both ends of the protected area section when single-phase grounding fault occurs, and proposes a longitudinal protection scheme based on the phase relationship of zero sequence current according to the fault characteristics. The protection scheme effectively solves the problem of misoperation of single-phase grounding protection in traditional small resistance grounding distribution network after multi-distributed generation is connected to the grid.

articleTitle: Parameter Comparison of Grasping Force Optimization of Hard and Soft Multi-fingered Hands based on Safety Margin Detector
abstract: In order to evaluate the influence of different types of finger contact models to multi-fingered grasping force optimization (GFO), two linear constrained gradient flow algorithms for hard finger (HF) and soft Unger (SF) hands are developed based on defined safety margin detectors. Firstly, based on the nonlinear friction cone constraints, two safety margin detectors for HF and SF are defined respectively, and their initial values can be obtained by iteration of force closure formula. It can be used as an effective initial point to start the gradient flow algorithm. Secondly, the gradient flow optimization algorithms with the safety margin detectors are developed for HF and SF types, which can real time detect the friction constraints and safety margin of each Unger at contact point, and provide early warning of the sliding trend in optimization. Take a three-fingered hand grasping as an example to compare and analyze the grasping force amplitude, safety margin and cost index under the same pose and external force wrench. Simulation experiments show that both two force optimization algorithms can eliminate the unreliable initial values before optimization, and optimize the force amplitude, safety margin and cost index convergence of HF and SF in continuous optimization. Under the same conditions, when the safety margin is positive at contact point, the SF hand can grasp with a smaller optimal grasping forces and obtain accurate force optimization results.

articleTitle: Exponential Stabilization of Delayed Discrete-time Linear System via a Hybrid Impulsive Control
abstract: This paper investigates exponential stabilization problem of delayed discrete-time linear system (DDLS) via a novel hybrid impulsive control. The hybrid impulsive control consists of time-triggered impulsive control (TTIC) and event-triggered mechanism (ETM). A prescribed exponentially decreasing function serves as the event condition determining when the periodic impulse is free. Compared with the TTIC, the designed hybrid impulsive control strategy can reduce the frequency of controller update and communication burden effectively. It is shown that system state ultimately converges to a level associated with the prescribed parameters. The exponential convergence rate depends on the exponentially decaying rate of prescribed exponentially decreasing function. Finally, one numerical simulation is implemented to verify the validity of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Research on Control System of Magnetic Levitation Compound Vibration Isolation Based on Tracking Differentiator
abstract: Vibration isolation technology is widely used in various fields. As an active vibration control technology, magnetic levitation vibration isolation (MLVI) has the advantages of no contact, no mechanical friction, no lubrication, long service life, controllable and adjustable electromagnetic force and support parameters (stiffness, damping, etc.) with the change of control parameters. In order to improve the performance of the vibration isolation system, the control system based on tracking differentiator is proposed. Firstly, the MLVI system is described. Then, taking the developed MLVI test device as the research object, the mechanism and characteristics of the system are analyzed, the modeling of the MLVI system is discussed, and the vibration isolation control strategy based on tracking differentiator is presented. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed controller is verified through the simulation of the vibration isolation system.

articleTitle: MicroMaps: a unified StarCraft 2 micromanagement AI testbed
abstract: The real-time strategy game represented by StarCraft is the frontier and hot spot of Artificial Intelligence (AI) research in recent years, in which micromanagement is the basic and core key problem. The micromanagement technological breakthrough has great and wide application prospects in the field of swarm intelligence game confrontation. At present, in the research of micromanagement in StarCraft, the verification scenarios proposed by various researchers for their own concerns are scattered and independent, and lack of a unified training and testing scenario testbed. In this regard, we propose a unified testbed named micromaps. According to reasonable principles, we systematically and comprehensively design a variety of homogeneous and heterogeneous micromanagement scenarios, and support the comprehensive comparison of AI algorithms in many aspects, such as winning rate, generalization and convergence speed. Finally, the future research direction of StarCraft 2 micromanagement is prospected.

articleTitle: Development of Key Technologies of Unattended Atmospheric Aerosol Sampler
abstract: The unattended atmospheric aerosol sampler is very important for environmental monitoring under special circumstances, such as radiation monitoring. A design scheme of atmospheric aerosol sampler is introduced, and two key technologies are focused on the design and realization of sampling flow calibration and automatic membrane replacement. According to the design requirements, a number of test experiments have been carried out. The test results show that the sampler implemented with the technologies described in this article can meet the development requirements of atmospheric aerosol sampling.

articleTitle: Unknown fault diagnosis based on meta-learning under complex working conditions
abstract: Traditional fault diagnosis methods are often based on multiple hidden layer networks and self-adaptive extract features from massive data, according to the data under specific working conditions, a specific model is learned. When faced with a small amount of unknown fault type data or complex working conditions, effective diagnosis cannot be performed. This paper proposes a meta-learning algorithm that uses known fault type data to build a neural network model during the training phase and determines a threshold, make a preliminary distinction between known faults and unknown faults through basic decision-making, and learn another more robust decision based on the effect of the distinction, and make the machine have the ability to learn to learn, and use the learned decisions under another working condition in the testing phase to also effectively diagnose unknown faults, thus avoiding retraining or learning in new tasks. The feasibility and accuracy of this method are verified in Western Reserve University Bearing Fault Database.

articleTitle: Backstepping Boundary Control of a Coupled Rijke Tube
abstract: In this paper, the boundary control of thermoacoustic instability in the Rijke tube is studied. The PDE Rijke tube model is proposed, which is decomposed into four linear transport partial differential equations. We design a boundary feedback controller to stabilize the thermoacoustic oscillation system exponentially by a backstepping transformation.
