Although camouflaged object detection is more challenging than general object detection, camouflaged object detection has been used in medicine, biology and military, so the research on camouflaged object detection is also of great significance.Since the camouflage object can be regarded as the "salient object" in the camouflage image, this paper combines the characteristics of salient object detection and camouflage object detection, mainly from the three aspects of object edge information enhancement, channel attention mechanism and expansion of the receptive field. Inspired by the idea of U-Net, we design a new camouflage object detection network. Finally, we use the camouflage people data set, and carry out training and testing under the same conditions with other networks, and verify the effectiveness of the method by comparing the results.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Rapid Prototyping Controller for Asynchronous Motor
abstract: The design and implementation of a rapid prototyping controller for asynchronous motor are achieved in this paper. Firstly, the vector controller is verified in MATLAB/Simulink, and then an asynchronous motor test platform is established, which is composed of an asynchronous motor, power driver, the dSPACE system, and a dynamometer. The dSPACE system is used to achieve a rapid prototyping controller for asynchronous motor to replace the traditional DSP controller. The experimental results show that the prototyping system can achieve the rapid verification of complex algorithms of DSP, and greatly shorten the controller development process.

articleTitle: Separation detumbling strategy for nutation space debris
abstract: This paper studies the detumbling strategy for despinning a nutation satellite using a flexible brush. Firstly, a dynamic model of contact detumbling system is established .The attitude dynamics of target is considered and the contact force is set up based on the linear elastic material bending model. Secondly, the contact detumbling control method is designed .In the light of the analysis of a specific nutation target’s motion characteristics, a novel separation detumbling strategy is proposed to damp rotation in two channels separately. A PD controller is applied to each channel. Finally, a numerical simulation is carried out. Simulation results show that the proposed method can attenuate the target angular velocities to less than 1° / s.

articleTitle: Exponential Bipartite Consensus of Linear Fractional-Order Multiagent Systems With Signed Directed Graph: An Output Feedback Approach
abstract: This paper aims to solve the exponential bipartite consensus problem of linear fractional-order multi-agent system (FOMAS) with signed directed graph. Unlike most of the existing works using the relative full state information of neighboring agents, a continuous observer-based output feedback bipartite consensus (OFBC) controller using only the relative output state information of neighboring agents is proposed to address the problem. Under the mild assumption that the signed directed graph has spanning tree, it is theoretically shown that the exponential bipartite consensus of FOMAS with the proposed continuous observer-based OFBC protocol can be achieved if the protocol parameters are selected suitably based on some linear matrix inequalities.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation via Effective Local Consistency and Multi-scale Attention
abstract: Recent studies have shown that pixel-level depth estimators can be learned through the self-supervised method, resulting in progress in depth prediction. However, due to the complexity of realistic scenarios, the assumption of brightness constancy, which is the basis of the optimization function designed by existing methods, is invalid in practice. As a result, the optimization target may be chosen in an inefficient manner, and thus affecting the performance of depth estimation. This paper tackles this issue by integrating local consistency into the framework. Specially, we exploit the gradient from depth map to generate a valid mask, which is capable of locating the key region and optimizing the photometric loss by ensuring the local consistency of masked points between target image and synthesis image. In addition, we combine the depth maps from multiple scales to effectively exploit multi-scale features and excavate detailed information of depth map. Comprehensive evaluation results on the KITTI dataset demonstrate that the proposed algorithm greatly improves the ability of capturing details of depth changes and achieves more accurate results.

articleTitle: Arbitrary Quadrilateral Planar Object Tracking in TV Program via Shallow and Deep Models Ensemble
abstract: Being accurate and efficient arbitrary quadrilateral planar object tracking in TV program has a huge commercial prospect. This is a challenging problem because blur, rotation, scaling, occlusion, visual context and shot change are common phenomena in TV videos. In this paper, we present a practical ensemble method to tackle these challenges. This method is built upon several typical shallow and deep object tracking algorithms. An ensemble strategy is proposed which can fuse different trackers’ results by comparing the difference between different trackers without any human intervention. Different tracking algorithms are able to play their advantages and restrain others’ disadvantages, simultaneously. Moreover, a practical shot boundary detection method is utilized to refine the fused tracking results. Extensive experiments on the large scale real TV program dataset are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed ensemble method.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of the Urban Railway Network Operation
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy, many cities have built and expanded urban rail transit networks. Due to the expansion of the urban rail transit network and the continuous increase of passenger flow, the optimization of metro train operation has attracted much attention from researchers in recent years. There are many problems when the original single-line track train operation mode is applied to the network train operation. It is necessary to study on the train operation problems in the network systems. In this paper, we mainly focus on the optimization problems of urban railway network operation. First, the current literature on urban railway operation is reviewed based on different models and optimization objects. Second, according to the review, we extend the current model to network operation. Finally, we choose the network consisted by Yizhuang Line and Line 5 in Beijing Subway as a case study. The passenger flows are well forecasted and evaluated, and the result shows a good balance between operation cost and passenger waiting time.

articleTitle: Bupleurum Seeds Recognition with Attention Mechanism
abstract: The research on intelligent classification of Chinese herbal seeds with deep learning are usually coarse-grained categories classification. However, these methods only focus on the global feature rather than the local texture details, which leading to a poor performance for the seeds of same genus. In order to solve the problem, in this paper, the Multiple Attentional Pyramid (APN) Networks is applied to complete the fine-grained classification task on the Chinese herbal seeds of the same genus. Specifically, an attention mechanism is applied to the process of information fusion in the pyramid network, where the pyramid mechanism enables the APN networks to focus on information at different scales and the attention mechanism enables the APN network to focus on the local texture details of Chinese herbal seeds. We applied the APN network to discriminate between different species of bupleurum seeds on our bupleurum seeds dataset including 4 kinds of bupleurum seeds. Experiments shows the APN network achieve the better performance (98% accuracy) compared to the traditional networks.

articleTitle: A Multi-Level Semantic Fusion VoteNet for 3D Object Detection on Point Clouds
abstract: In this paper, a Multi-Level Semantic Fusion VoteNet (MLSFVNet) is proposed to detect objects in 3D scenes. The method works on 3D point clouds captured by RGBD camera, which can provide abundant and precise distance information of environments. The proposed method consists of three modules: the multi-level semantics fusion network, voting operation and proposal generator. To overcome the lack of semantic information, the multi-level semantics fusion network is proposed to capture the multi-level features. To predict the object centers, the voting operation is used to map the features into a feature space of the same scale and regress the object centers. The proposal generator is used to generate proposals and then predict the bounding boxes. MLSFVNet is evaluated on the popular indoor datasets SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2. The experimental results demonstrate that the MLSFVNet proposed in this paper is an effective way to promote detection accuracy: 58.1% mAP on SUN RGB-D and 59.8% mAP on ScanNetV2.

articleTitle: A Fractional Order Model Predictive Control Method for Electric-Hydrogen Hybrid Energy Storage System
abstract: A Fractional order model predictive control (FO-MPC) method for electric-hydrogen combined hybrid energy storage system is proposed in this paper. This method can help the converter of HESS to smooth the fluctuations of DG’s output better, improve the control accuracy of the converter output current and improve the stability of DC microgrid. Firstly, the structure of electric-hydrogen combined HESS is illustrated and DC microgrid system is described. Secondly, the concept of fractional calculus is introduced and the predictive model of DC Converter based on fractional order differential equation is established. According to the predictive model, the next current state of bidirectional converter of battery-ultracapacitor and converter of electrolyzer and fuel cell is predicted precisely. Finally, the fractional order model predictive control approach is experimentally verified in Buck/Boost circuit and significantly reduce the current ripple on the DC bus of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Development and application of automatic tapping control system for converter
abstract: automatic tapping control system is a complex heterogeneous system with multiple physical fields and strong coupling, and its reliability is largely dependant on the control accuracy and stability of each single equipment in the operation process. Firstly, this paper introduces the component of automatic tapping control system for converter, the working principle of safety control system and the control mechanism of multiple single equipment linkage. Secondly, based on the mechanical transmission and the working principle of tapping system, this paper adapts the linear regression algorithm to establish the mathematical model of converter, ladle and alloy chute for the production data. Finally, the reliability and stability of the technology is verified through the results of the field test.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Forecasting Based On VMD-GOA-LSSVR Model
abstract: Aiming at the difficult to predict problems caused by the randomness and non-stationarity of the power load sequence, a method based on variational modal decomposition (VMD) and grasshopper algorithm (GOA) optimized least square support vector machine regression (LSSVR) is proposed, Combination forecasting model. Firstly, the historical load sequence is decomposed into several eigenmode subsequences by variational mode. And then the least square support vector machine regression prediction model is established for each mode, and the grasshopper algorithm is used to optimize its key nuclear parameters. Finally, the prediction results of each sub- sequence are superimposed and combined to obtain the final power load prediction value. The VMD-GOA-LSSVR prediction method was used to simulate and verify the daily load data of Hangzhou in 2013 on the MATLAB R2018b software. The results show that the method has high prediction accuracy.

Author Keywords: least square support vector machine regression

articleTitle: Adaptive Lyapunov-based MPC With Constraint Updating For FCC Unit
abstract: This paper focuses on the Learning MPC design of the FCCU regenerator for automatically searching for the optimal stabilizing control law, which contains strong nonlinear characteristics and slow time-varying dynamics due to the catalyst aging or component changes. In order to guarantee the decreasing of the variance of the prediction of the identified model, which could relax the stability constraint and reduce conservatism, the FCCU is transformed into a parametric linear form by means of the polynomial fitting, then Set-Membership identification is used to update the system model, the variance bound of the updated model is deduced. According to the decreasing variance bound, the Lyapunov constraint is designed and is used in the optimization problem of MPC. The proposed method could still guarantee feasibility and stability during updating. Besides, the decreasing of the unstable region, which represents the steady-state error, could also be achieved based on the decreasing identification variance. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed ALMPC with constraint updating performs better than the MPC without constraint updating.

articleTitle: Distributed Uncertainty Set for Load Scheduling of a Smart Home with New Energy System
abstract: This paper addresses the load scheduling problem in smart home with the uncertainty of photovoltaic power generation system. A distributed uncertain set is proposed to coordinate the robustness of uncertain sets. Based on the digital characteristics of the historical data of multiple small samples, each agent reduces the impact of singular scenes on the data through information interaction, thereby avoiding the appearance of overprotected scenes. The effectiveness of the method is proved in simulation, and the photovoltaic power generation is estimated.

articleTitle: A Reusable Software Architecture for Spacecraft Control System
abstract: High-density launches have become normal, and spacecraft software productization is imperative. In order to realize the productization of spacecraft control system software, the domain-specific software architecture was introduced into the development process, and a reusable software architecture was designed. Based on the functional requirements of spacecraft control system, the domain analysis was carried out, and the domain foundation and layered structure of the reusable software architecture were discussed. Using the reusable software architecture, the reuse rate of software products is increased, the scalability is enhanced, and the scale is reduced. At the same time, the software development process can be optimized and the development cycle can be shortened. Project practices prove that the reusable software architecture can be promoted.

articleTitle: Real-time guidance for launch vehicles under thrust drop fault via deep learning
abstract: A novel real-time guidance method based on deep learning is proposed to deal with the launch vehicle under thrust drop. The trajectory optimization of the LV is introduced first, and the distinctions of the optimization objective and constraints are proposed when thrust drop happens. Then, design of the deep neural network is motivated by the aim of the trajectory optimization, and a real-time close- loop guidance method is proposed with the flight states introduced into the guidance loop. Next, generous optimal trajectories of all-around fault modes are generated as the sample set to train the DNN. Avoiding handling the atmosphere which is hard to express analytically, the guidance method based on deep learning can accommodate thrust drop even in atmosphere. In the end, the effectiveness and performance of the proposed method are evaluated in run time, guidance error and robustness.

articleTitle: Suspension Performance Monitoring of Embedded Magnetic Balance based on Residual Generator
abstract: The wind tunnel balance is responsible for the measurement of the original aerodynamic data of the aircraft model and is the key instrument for wind tunnel tests. In order to better realize the free roll of the aircraft model in the wind tunnel, this paper proposes a scheme of an embedded magnetic balance and introduces the composition and working principle of the axial suspension system. In order to realize the real-time performance monitoring of the axial suspension system of the embedded magnetic balance, this paper uses a data-driven method to identify the observer-based residual generator offline. When the system is running, the embedded residual generator outputs the residual signal in real time, and the control system can monitor the operating performance of the system by observing the change of the residual signal. After setting the empirical threshold of the system based on the residual signal during normal operation, the operating state of the system can be evaluated by comparing the residual signal during system operation with empirical threshold. Finally, taking the suspension data of the single-degree-of-freedom suspension experimental platform as an example, the algorithm proposed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Robust Stability for Nonlinear Switched Systems with Stable and Unstable Subsystems
abstract: The article studies the robust stability analysis problem of nonlinear switched systems with stable and unstable subsystems in continuous-time. First of all, the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model is used to solve nonlinear problems in the switched systems with the help of local linear models under fuzzy rules. Then, adopting the multiple discontinuous Lyapunov functions (MDLFs) methods and mode-dependent average dwell time (MDADT) switching strategy, the sufficient conditions for robust stability of the switched systems are received. In addition, related corollaries of the system are obtained. Finally, a numerical simulation shows the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: Target Detection Method in BTR based on SVM
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low SNR in complex sea conditions, which leads to low target detection rate and robustness in BTR, a BTR target detection method based on SVM is proposed. The method uses the waveform difference between target and noise in spatial domain to give the feature description; In this paper, SVM is used to train BTR target detection model; The underwater acoustic target point trace detection is completed by region-to-point trace extraction method. The experimental results show that the proposed method can extract underwater acoustic targets in low SNR effectively and robustly.

articleTitle: Sliding mode boundary control of linear parabolic distributed parameter systems with space-dependent parameters
abstract: This paper studies the sliding mode boundary control of parabolic distributed parameter systems with space-dependent parameters. A sliding surface is selected to guarantee that the system is asymptotically stable. The Lyapunov method is used to design a sliding mode boundary controller to guarantee that the trajectories of the system subject to disturbances reach the sliding surface within the prescribed time. Some numerical simulations are finally provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Method of Human Body Characteristic Curve Based on Neural Network
abstract: Body characteristic curve plays a very important role in 3D modeling of human body, which usually needs to be acquired by manual measurement and has certain limitations. In this paper, neural network is used to set up the relationship between 2D image and 3D cross-sectional characteristic curve, and the human model obtained by 3D scanning is used to train the neural network. The trained neural network can directly restore the 3D cross-sectional characteristic curve from user's photos and use it for 3D reconstruction. Experimental results show that the training error of the method is less than 2%, and it can accurately restore the characteristics of body cross-sectional curve.

articleTitle: Dynamic multiobjective optimization by knowledge learning based on factorization machine
abstract: One of the main characteristics of dynamic multiobjective optimization problems is that the optimization objectives will change over time, so tracking the changing Pareto optimal front becomes a challenge. To this end, a knowledge learning prediction strategy based on a factorization machine is proposed (FMP). In the strategy proposed in this article, it reacts to changes by learning from the historical evolutionary process. Specifically, the factorization machine is introduced as a model to extract knowledge from the evolutionary experience of known historical time steps, and the knowledge is applied to the current time step to predict the population at the next time step. The performance of the proposed FMP is evaluated by comparing with two advanced prediction algorithms on 11 benchmark problems. Experimental results show that FMP can obtain a competitive population with good convergence and distribution in a dynamic environment.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Modulation in Two-Quasi-Y Source Three-level Inverter
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional wavelet modulation that the duty cycle adjustment range is extremely small and the output voltage cannot be adjusted so that it cannot be used in impedance source inverters. This paper proposes a new wavelet modulation strategy suitable for dual quasi-Y-source three-phase three-level inverters. By inserting the minimum through zero vector for the normal working of the impedance source inverter, the sampling time is reduced and the insertion through zero vector is increased. Time interval,And the modulation factor is substituted into the non-uniform period sampling, so that the inverter has a greater boosting capacity, and at the same time, the duty cycle and the modulation ratio can be double adjusted, which greatly increases its flexibility. Comparing the proposed new wavelet modulation strategy with the two traditional SPWMs, improvements have been made in terms of voltage gain, modulation factor flexibility, and output voltage distortion rate. Finally, the proposed new wavelet modulation strategy was verified by simulation, and its correctness was confirmed.

articleTitle: Multi-robot formation tracking algorithm and implementation
abstract: We introduce a formation tracking algorithm of multi-robot system based on a partial differential equation (PDE) model, which allows robots to keep a desire formation while moving around the orbit. We discretize the PDE model to get a leader-follower distributed control law, in which the follower robots just need to know their neighbors’ position. And then, we design an experiment to verify the formation tracking algorithm. In the experiment, Kalman filter is used to enhance the accuracy of the positioning, and model predictive control is used to realize the movement control of each robot. During the movement control, we apply the artificial potential field approach to realize obstacle avoidance.

articleTitle: A Feature-Fusion-based Multi-column Convolutional Neural Network for Crowd Counting and Density Estimation
abstract: Due to the scale change caused by perspective distortion, the automatic estimation of crowd density in images with high density population is still a extremely difficult task. To address this problem, Feature-Fusion-based Multi-column Convolutional Neural Network (F2MCNN) is proposed to perform accurate crowd count estimation and provide high-quality density maps. Multi-column convolutional neural network are used to extracted multi-scale features distributed in different regions in a single crowd image. In this paper, the intermediate network nodes of different columns are connected by hopping to fuse multi-scale features and improve the perception ability of images at different scales. F2MCNN is evaluated on four datasets and it achieves better mean absolute error and mean squared error performances compared with MCNN.

articleTitle: Low-impact flow field control method for hypersonic wind tunnel
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the conventional starting method of hypersonic wind tunnel has a large impact, which may damage the aircraft model and internal balance, a method reduces the impact is proposed. In the method, it appropriately reduce the starting total pressure properly and pull up the large flow quickly after starting, so as to realize the flow field control of low starting impact. This method can not only reduce the impact on the test model when the hypersonic wind tunnel How field is established, but also reduce the strength requirements for the model and the balance, so as to meet the needs of some special hypersonic wind tunnel tests.

articleTitle: Adaptive fault-tolerant control for a three-tank system with height and rate constraints
abstract: In this paper, the level tracking problem of a three-tank system with unknown external disturbance, actuator fault and height and rate constraints is addressed. Firstly, In virtue of barrier Lyapunov function, the full-state constrain control framework is constructed. Secondly, an adaptive controller is devised to settle the repeated partial failure of the actuator during the control process. Then, through the Lyapunov-based analysis, all state signals in the three-tank system are bounded. What is worth mentioning, this paper realizes the prescribed constraints on the height and rising rate of the target liquid level by using the full-state constraints. Finally, simulation example is executed to prove the effectiveness of the proposed control.

articleTitle: Improved Fusion Change Detection of Foliage-concealed Target for Low Frequency UWB SAR
abstract: The low frequency ultra-wideband synthetic aperture radar (UWB SAR) has the good foliage penetration and high-resolution imaging capabilities, which can detect the vehicles and other salient targets hidden in the forest. However, due to the detection of the environment in the forest and the low frequency UWB system, the obtained low frequency UWB SAR images often contain many non-target strong scattering points (such as the thick tree trunks). In this paper, we propose an improved foliage-concealed target fusion change detection method based on the Laplacian Eigenmaps Support Vector Domain Description (LE-SVDD) for the low-frequency UWB SAR, which can achieve the better performance compared to the traditional method. Relative experiment is carried out in the CARABAS-II VHF SAR image dataset, and then the detection accuracy of the proposed algorithm is analyzed and discussed. Experimental results prove the superiority and effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Path Following Model Predictive Control of 4WID High Ground Clearance Sprayer Considering the Slippage effect
abstract: The sliding control of the sprayer tire has an important effect on the stability of the sprayer and can effectively prevent the traction loss caused by the sliding of the driving wheel. A new type of high clearance four wheel independent drive (4WID) sprayer for unmanned driving is proposed in this paper. Fuel cell hybrid power, 4WID with front and rear double steering axles are adopted in proposed sprayer. Therefore, the turning radius of the 4WID sprayer is smaller than the traditional one. Moreover, the front and rear wheels of the sprayer move in highly consistent trajectories, which can reduce the phenomenon of seedling crushing during plant protection operation. Based on the linear time-varying kinematics model (LTV), a layered path tracking control and considering driving wheel slip was constructed to deal with the extremely complex operating environment paddy. The upper model predictive controller (MPC) obtains the steering angle and velocity of the sprayer according to the expected path and the current position to realize the path tracking. The lower layer uses fuzzy control and integral separation PID control to construct the slip controller for the driving wheels so as to achieve effective control the driving wheel slip. Finally, the co- simulation results of ADAMS and MATLAB proved that it was feasible to implement the proposed approach, which can improve the stability and path tracking accuracy of the sprayer in a complex operating environment.

Author Keywords: Front and rear double steering axles

articleTitle: Perimeter Control for Single Urban Sub-area Based on Secondary Optimal Timing of Signal Lights
abstract: Based on the macroscopic fundamental diagram (MFD) model and the border feedback control measure. On the basis of considering the total number of vehicles in the sub-area as the overall operation condition of the sub-area. A queuing model of single intersection is proposed to optimize the signal timing considering the actual operation of each boundary intersection. Through the VISSIM simulation experiment, it is verified that the signal optimization strategy can significantly improve the average speed, reduce vehicle delay, alleviate traffic congestion, and greatly improve the traffic condition of the sub-area.

articleTitle: Sequential Convex Programming using Hybrid Trust Region Method for Reentry Trajectory Planning
abstract: The sequential convex programming (SCP) method is adopted to deal with the planning problem of reentry trajectory of a lunar capsule. However, the convergence rate of SCP is very slow for this reentry problem. To improve convergence performance, a hybrid trust region method is proposed. A fixed-radius trust region is first utilized to find the optimal solution coarsely. When the intermediate solution is close to the optimal solution, the trust region is changed to soft type to accelerate convergence rate. The effectiveness of the proposed method has been verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Detection and Mapping of an Uncooperative Spinning Target under Low-light Illumination Condition
abstract: This paper investigates the simultaneous detection and mapping problem for inspecting an unknown and uncooperative target that is spinning in space. First, we apply a new unsupervised generative adversarial network (GAN) to enhance the low contrast and poor visibility images which are captured in low-light space illumination conditions. Second, due to the captured low-resolution (LR) images of the target contain small size of key-components, so that we propose a new small object detection network that combines a GAN-based super-resolution (SR) network and a FRCNN-based detection network to locate these objects. The SR network was used to reconstruct super-resolved images from the original LR images. Third, we utilize a SLAM-based algorithm to map and estimate the pose of the spinning target based on previous image enhancement. In summary, the integrated architecture has three components: a low-light enhancement GAN, a small object detection network, and a real-time SLAM system. The experimental results show that the integrated architecture achieves better visual quality and improves the awareness of an uncooperative spinning target.

articleTitle: Manipulating the Degree Factor to Promote Cooperation in Network Evolutionary Game
abstract: Network structures with strong heterogeneity will be more helpful to the spread of cooperative strategies in evolutionary process. After increasing the benefits of betrayal strategies, networks with strong heterogeneity will better resist the intrusion of betrayers and maintain a higher level of cooperation. In this paper, we introduce a degree factor into the individual payoff to add the heterogeneity, so that individuals with high degrees will obtain higher benefits, while the income of individuals with low degrees will be reduced. In this way, the heterogeneity between individuals will be enhanced during the cooperative evolution of the network, so that the network can better resist the intrusion of betrayers.

articleTitle: SVM Based Human Respiratory Pattern Classification Method for Stereo Radiotherapy Robot
abstract: Radiation therapy for tumors has become a mainstream treatment option at present, and the current method used to predict tumor information is mainly to establish association models by body surface motion information and tumor motion information. Most of the human breathing patterns are divided into thoracic and abdominal respiration, so determining the human breathing pattern before establishing the correlation model is of great help for the accuracy of radiotherapy. This paper proposed a support vector machine (SVM)-based method for classifying human respiratory patterns. It can effectively distinguish the respiratory patterns of test subjects. Two depth cameras were used to collect the point cloud information of human thorax and abdomen, and Octomap was used to reconstruct the surface of thorax and abdomen. A chunking idea was proposed for the respiratory motion characterization of the body surface to make it as the training set of the SVM to bring into training and finally bring out the test set to verify the feasibility of the method. Experimental results on the collected experimental data from three test subjects showed that the proposed method can accurately and effectively discriminate human breathing patterns.

articleTitle: Real-time Electronic Image Stabilization for Spherical Robot Based on Inertial Measurement Unit and Gray Projection Method
abstract: As a new kind of autonomous mobile robot, spherical robot will inevitably sway left and right during walking, and the amplitude will be large sometimes, which brings serious interference to visual systems on the robot, thus real-time electronic image stabilization (EIS) is required. Spherical robot can be used to patrol in complex environments with multiple foreground and background objects, commonly used image-based EIS algorithms often fail under these circumstances. Therefore, this paper proposes a real-time EIS algorithm suitable for spherical robot, according to the characteristics of it. The algorithm divides the task into three subtasks: rotation correction, vertical translation correction and horizontal translation correction. Information from inertial measurement unit (IMU) is used to correct the rotation. Vertical translation correction is based on IMU information, and supplemented by gray projection method. Motion estimation of horizontal translation uses IMU information combining with gray projection, and then mean filter is applied to smooth the translation. Experiments show that the algorithm can effectively stabilize the greatly oscillating images taken by spherical robot, so as to provide a solid foundation for subsequent vision-related algorithms.

articleTitle: Improved Deep Convolution Neural Network with Applications in Fault Diagnosis of Naval Gun Mechanical Components
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex structure and low accuracy of fault diagnosis of mechanical components, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on improved deep convolution neural network, and applies it to the diagnosis of naval gun mechanical components to realize "End-to-End" fault diagnosis. Firstly, the vibration signal is preprocessed by Fast Fourier Transform to get the time-frequency spectrum samples, which are divided into training set and test set. Then, the improved activation function, dropout and other deep learning training techniques are introduced to prevent the model from over fitting, and SVM is introduced to output the fault recognition results. Finally, the improved deep convolution neural network model is established to realize the fault diagnosis of mechanical components. The model proposed in this paper was verified through the bearing data set of Case Western Reserve University, and the results showed that the average diagnostic accuracy rate can reach 97.10% under variable working conditions, indicating that the model has good feasibility and advantages; Moreover, under the training of the laboratory's actual measurement data set of naval gun mechanical components, it has shown a high recognition accuracy, and the diagnosis accuracy rate can reach 98.3%, which can provide a reference for future fault diagnosis work of naval gun mechanical components.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Networked Systems with Asynchronous Sensors and Controllers: the Random Clock Offsets Case
abstract: In this paper, the stabilization of networked systems with asynchronous sensors and controllers is studied, where the offsets between the sensors and controllers clocks are random variables with certain probability distribution. By the Kronecker product operation and confluent Vandermonde matrix, some sufficient conditions for the stochastic stability of corresponding closed-loop systems are given. Meanwhile, a static output feed-back controller is presented. Finally, two simulation examples are given to validate that the proposed design method is effective and applicable.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of pH Neutralization Process based on Manifold Gaussian Process
abstract: pH neutralization process is characterized with strong non-linearity and time-delay. Model Predictive Control is a common method to handle the control problem of such industrial processes. The main difficulty of the Model Predictive Control is to build a suitable predictive model that represents the inherent features of considered plant. In this paper, Manifold Gaussian Process is used to model the pH neutralization process, based on which the Model Predictive Control of system is realized. The first simulation results prove that excellent nonlinear modelling ability of Manifold Gaussian Process, and the following experiments are the further proof of which Model Predictive Control integrated with Manifold Gaussian Process has better robustness, stability and rapidity.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Based on Deep Learning Network with Non-local Networks
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) based Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) has the problem of learning bias towards stronger emotions while giving less weight to relatively faint emotions. This lack of subtleness causes the misclassification of emotions that have similar arousal such as anger and joy. To solve this problem, a novel speaker-independent SER methods consist of CNN with non-local networks and attention-based Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) is proposed. The non-local networks can capture the dependence between any two points globally to enhance the correlation of emotional features at the utterance level. The extracted trichannel Log-Mel spectrograms features include the raw of LogMel spectrums, the Log-Mel spectrums’ deltas and delta-deltas respectively. Finally long-term contextual dependencies, local information and non-local information which is obtained by nonlocal networks is contained in the extracted feature. It was tested on the Interactive Emotional Dyadic Motion Capture Database (IEMOCAP) dataset. The experimental results show that the WAR of SER is 66.85% and the UAR of SER is 61.01%. Compared with several newly proposed SER methods, the effectiveness of the proposed model is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Quasi-Z source H6 photovoltaic inverter
abstract: In order to overcome the insufficient boost capability of traditional Boost photovoltaic inverters and the common-mode leakage current problems of traditional quasi-Z-source photovoltaic inverters, this paper proposes a quasi-Z-source-based H6 photovoltaic inverter. Its topology is to combine the quasi-Z source converter with the new H6 inverter proposed in this paper. First, the topology and working principle of the circuit are analyzed, and its steady-state characteristics are proven through mathematical formulas. The boosting capability is enhanced by the quasi-Z source converter, and the leakage current is suppressed by the new H6 inverter. Then use Matlab/Simulink software for simulation analysis, and the simulation proves the reliability and superiority of the circuit topology.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimization for Economic Dispatch Over Time-Varying Directed Networks With Row-Stochastic Matrices
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of power grid, the power system is also transitioning to a more intelligent power grid. However, the economic dispatching problem of power system needs effective coordination in order to achieve greater benefits. In this paper, a distributed projection gradient algorithm based on row-stochastic over time-varying directed graph is proposed to solve the economic dispatch problem of power system. The algorithm uses row-stochastic condition instead of double-stochastic condition and column-stochastic condition, so that each intelligent power system can independently assign the weight value of neighboring nodes according to the situation, which improves the autonomous controllability of the system. The convergence of the algorithm is analyzed theoretically, and it is proved that the algorithm can match the optimal solution. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the algorithm are verified by numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Semi-physical Closed Loop Simulation Platform Based on Wind Power Converter
abstract: The semi-physical simulation controller (cabinet) of wind power converter is applied to the research of wind turbine grid-connected technology. The semi-physical control platform adopts the actual engineering wind turbine controller hardware. It is mainly the core device of wind power grid-connected: wind power converter controller, which can match various mainstream real-time simulators such as RTDS and RT-LAB. The wind turbine control system of the research platform is consistent with the actual control system used in the wind farm, reflecting the real characteristics of wind power generation. Applicable to: wind power grid-connected characteristics test and research; wind power grid-connected key technology research and development; the impact of wind power scale access on different grid architectures and the technical requirements of different grids on wind turbines. This paper is based on a typical wind turbine controller and RTDS Nova Cor (Real-time digital Simulator Nova Cor) to build an in-loop simulation platform to simulate the response characteristics of a typical primary frequency modulation control system of a wind turbine. According to the response of the unit, the primary frequency modulation control function based on virtual inertia and additional control in the controller can be verified. According to the response characteristics of the controller, the key control parameters of the primary frequency regulation of the wind turbine are optimized and adjusted based on the requirements of related regulations.

articleTitle: Station-keeping of Halo Orbits using Convex Optimization-Based Receding Horizon Control
abstract: In this work, we propose a convex optimization-based receding horizon control method for the station-keeping control of halo orbit in Earth-Moon system. we leverage the advantages of convex optimization and receding horizon control and design the method under the high-fidelity ephemeris model, making it feasible to actual mission. Simulation results show that our method reaches low tracking errors and control consumption and produces better performances than linear quadratic regulation method.

articleTitle: Event-triggered H∞ filtering for a class of singular systems with transmission delay
abstract: The paper is related to H∞ filtering of singular systems. A state space filter is aimed to be designed to force the modeled system satisfy regularity, non-impulsiveness and stability. Constructing a new discontinuous and exponential Lyapunov Krasovskii functional and applying iterative method, we first establish analysis results of exponential admissibility and H∞ performance. The proposed functional makes advantage of the sawtooth characteristic of the sampling induced time delay, which can be used to decrease the conservatism of results. Then, a condition of filter gains is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness is verified by a circuit system example.

articleTitle: XJU-MLSIG: A Multilingual Online Signature Database
abstract: To study the online signature of ethnic minority languages, a multilingual online signature data set is established by using a high sampling rate digital board. The data set includes 162 Uyghur individuals, 58 Kazakh individuals, and 33 Kirgiz individuals. Each individual has 10 real samples and 10 skilled forgery samples, The establishment of the data set fills the blank of online signature for small languages. In this paper, a benchmark algorithm is used to test the data, and compared with other public data sets, for the reference of subsequent researchers. The database is available through https://github.com/cyhnice/XJU-MLSIG

articleTitle: Stability and Hopf Bifurcation of the Fractional Kaldorian Business Cycle Model with Time Delay
abstract: This paper is concerned with a fractional Kaldorian business cycle model with investment and money supply time delay. Through Routh Hurwitz criterion, we give the existence of Hopf bifurcation using delay as bifurcation parameter by analyzing the corresponding characteristic equations. On this basis, the influence of the fractional order on the bifurcation threshold is studied, which displays that the Hopf bifurcation of the system will advance as the order increases. Finally, some numerical simulation examples are provided to substantiate the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Driver's Reaction Time Model for Braking Safety of Electric Vehicle Based on Fuzzy Logic
abstract: Regenerative braking is an effective way to improve the utilization of battery energy of electric vehicles (EVs), but the strength of regenerative braking is relatively weak compared with the mechanical braking, thus, the braking strategy must firstly ensure the braking safety distance, in other words, EV must stop completely within a certain braking distance at a certain speed. The effect of road friction, braking force intensity, and the driver’s reaction time on the safe braking distance should be conducted simultaneously. In this paper, a driver’s reaction time model based on fuzzy logic is proposed, which specifically analyzes the impact of different driving years, ages, and fatigue levels on the driver’s reaction time. The results show that the driver’s reaction time have a great effect on the braking distance, which is useful for the formulation of a regenerative braking strategy of EVs and autonomous driving vehicles.

articleTitle: A Contrai Framework of Polar Opinion Dynamicis Based on Influence Maximization
abstract: The rapid development of social networks has brought a huge amount of information to people's daily lives, which leads people's positions or implicitly assimilates the thoughts of their audiences. We want to speed up the spread of beneficial information and maximize its influence, while for harmful information such as rumors, we want to curb its spread and reduce its influence. By studying the topology of social networks, combining it with the structural control of control engineering, this paper adds the control matrix to the simulation of the polar process of public opinion in order to achieve better guiding purposes.

articleTitle: Real-Time Velocity and Hovering Control for Rotorcraft Based on Visual State Estimation
abstract: The purpose of this thesis is to solve the velocity and hover flight control problem of rotorcraft in GNSS-denied environments by using a low-cost Optical Flow Sensor (OFS) and an RGBD camera. An OFS is employed for velocity estimation and an RGBD camera is employed for pose estimation based on ORB-SLAM2 algorithm. Firstly, the mathematical model of velocity is established, then the classical PID control is applied to realize the velocity and hover control, and the designed embedded control system is installed on the drone for flight verification. We verified the effectiveness of this system for estimating velocity, position and controlling the drone in real-time in an indoor environment, and discuss its limitations.

articleTitle: Word Semantic Similarity Calculation Based on Cilin and HowNet
abstract: In this paper a word semantic similarity calculation method based on the Cilin and HowNet is proposed. In the Cilin part, Cilin after structural transformation is used as the calculation ontology, and the similarity calculation method based on information content is adopted. In the HowNet part, this paper uses the multi-inheritance-based Hownet concept net as the calculation ontology, and adopts the improved similarity calculation method based on information content. Then, according to the distribution of words and the performance of the two algorithms in different scenes, the dynamic weighting strategy considering both Cilin and HowNet is used to calculate the word semantic similarity comprehensively. It has been verified that this method not only expands the range of computable words, but also improves the accuracy of word similarity calculation. In this paper, the parameters are adjusted on the Ruben Stein&Goodenough (RG65) dataset, and the Pearson correlation coefficient between the human judgments in Miller&Charles (MC30) dataset and the calculation results in this paper is 0.944.

articleTitle: Master-slave Control System of Data glove and Manipulator based on Multi-sensor Fusion
abstract: To solve the problems of large measurement error and poor reliability of the traditional data glove using a single sensor, a master-slave control system of the manipulator based on the data glove was designed using multi-sensor fusion technology. The structure of the master-slave system of the manipulator based on the data glove is introduced, and the multi-sensor data acquisition and processing method and the design scheme of the master-slave control system are analyzed. Test results of the manipulator to follow the position of human hand verily the effectiveness of the master-slave control system designed, and provide a good solution for using the data glove to accurately control the manipulator to complete various tasks.

articleTitle: 3D Human Motion Prediction Based on Graph Convolution Network and Transformer
abstract: Extracting, recognizing and predicting human actions from image information plays an essential part in the fields of human intention understanding, behavior emergency avoidance and automatic driving. In recent years, with deep learing method developing rapidly, the methods of behavior detection and intention understanding for human actions are also glowing with new vitality. In this paper, based on spatial-temporal synchronous graph convolution network and multi-head self-attention mechanism, a new method of human skeleton action recognition and prediction is proposed. By extracting the spatial features of short-term time series at the same time, we can predict the long-term time series actions, and also we have achieved satisfactory experimental results. Our experiment is based on Human3.6M dataset for training and testing. At the end of the paper, we put forward the limitations of the current research and some future research directions.

articleTitle: Application of Battlefield Threat Source Assessment Method in Flight Path Planning
abstract: In this paper, a battlefield threat source assessment method is designed and accomplished. Firstly, an uncertain probabilistic reasoning model based on Naive Bayes is studied, and a threat level assessment algorithm is constructed. Combined with fuzzy reasoning technology, the relative threat levels of different threat sources in the battlefield environment are evaluated. Then, a two-dimensional Gaussian probability density function which is defined by combining the threat level assessment results with the geometric model of the threat sources used for modeling. And an UAV flight path planning method based on threat situation assessment is established using genetic algorithm. This paper also compares the artificial potential field method with the genetic algorithm. By analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the two algorithms for path planning, the genetic algorithm is proved to be more effective and adaptable.

articleTitle: Rules-PPO-QMIX: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Mixed Rules for Large Scene Tasks
abstract: Under the StarCraft multi-agent challenge (SMAC), the large scenes with multiple task objectives are obstacles for directly applying the existing multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms. The main challenge lies in that the recent MARL algorithms have a poor performance in these situations. A novel Rules-PPO-QMIX MARL algorithm is designed to 1) determine the optimal target and paths with tools of manual rules and proximal policy optimization (PPO) and 2) perform decentralised micromanagement near the target with monotonic value function factorisation MARL algorithm (QMIX). In such way, the complete decision-making process is divided into several parts, that is, path planning, target selecting and micromanagement, which is yielded by manual rules, single-agent reinforcement learning and MARL, respectively. The effectiveness of Rules-PPO-QMIX is validated by a testing map of SMAC, with QMIX as baseline. To demonstrate the feasibility on small scenes, a classical 8m SMAC environment is also used to test the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Safety Lane Change Method Based on Sensor Date Fusion Designed for Assistance Driving
abstract: Lane change is a challenging task in assistance driving since it influences the safety and the efficiency of highway traffic. In this paper, a safety lane change method based on probability information is proposed to process the data collected from the multiple sensors of the vehicles. Firstly, we analyze the motions of the vehicles during the lane change on a two-lane highway and classify the lane change scenarios into four cases. On this basis, a general algorithm is proposed to calculate the probability of safety lane change. By using this method, we can convert the data obtained from the sensors of the vehicles during the lane change process into the probability of safety lane change, which can be used in data fusion at the decision level. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated through a series of simulations.

articleTitle: Convolutional Self-Attention Neural Network for Multi-Step Forecasting of Environmental Image Series
abstract: Convolutional long short-term memory (ConvL-STM) is an enhancement of the state-of-the-art long short-term memory (LSTM) model, which has been widely used in forecasting spatiotemporal data from natural environments. ConvLSTM captures local correlations within a small receptive field through a convolutional operator, which is limited to extracting global interactions among latent variables. To further improve the prediction performance, the present paper proposes a novel attention-based ConvLSTM model for multi-step forecasting of environmental image series. Particularly, a convolutional self-attention (CSA) mechanism is developed to highlight the dependencies within hidden features during the regression and prediction processes. To validate the performance of the proposed method, experiments using a benchmark dataset and a real-world environmental dataset are conducted. The experimental results demonstrate the improved accuracy and reliability of the proposed method for multi-step forecasting of environmental image series.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of SIMO Networked Control Systems Under Quantization and Packet Dropout
abstract: The performance analysis about single-input multiple-output networked control systems under quantization and packet dropout is studied in this work. Communication channels are affected by packet dropout and quantization. The optimal tracking performance with quantization and packet dropout is derived by frequency domain method. At the same time, the optimal tracking performance expression is described by a variety of decomposition techniques, which is calculated by the controller that stabilizes the system. The obtained result display that the optimal tracking performance is affected by the internal characteristics of the plant, quantization and packet dropout. Finally, the validity of the theoretical results is verified by numerical examples.

articleTitle: An Improved Iterative Maximum Correntropy Cubature Kalman Filter
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of filtering for nonlinear system under outlier. To improve the reliability and precision of state estimation for nonlinear system with outlier, an improved iterative maximum correntropy cubature Kalman filter is proposed. In this work, cubature Kalman filter is applied to estimate the state of system. The sigma-point-based iterative strategy is designed, which uses the sigma points to iterate instead of the state estimation. Considering the effects of shot noise for nonlinear system, the rule of maximum correntropy is utilized to reduce the effect of shot noise existing in the measurement. Finally, the simulation results proves the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of the Disc-shaped Rotor for MSCMG
abstract: The magnetically suspended control moment gyros (MSCMGs) supported by the magnetic bearings (MBs) have the advantages of the high control accuracy and long life. The high-speed disc-shaped rotor (HSDSR) is the core component of the MSCMG. The mass, strength and stiffness of the HSDSR directly affect the overall performance of the system. In this paper, the multidisciplinary optimization design of the HSDSR is studied, and the optimal design scheme is obtained. The weight of the HSDSR is minimized and the mechanical strength is improved. It has practical significance in the design of the spacecraft attitude control system.

articleTitle: Saturation Avoidance Control Law for Spacecraft Euipped with Redundant RWs
abstract: For spacecraft equipped with Reaction Wheel (RW), a saturation avoidance control law based on improved artificial potential function is designed to solve the problem of angular momentum saturation and disturbance torque uncertainty. The state of RW and the attitude information of spacecraft will be fed back to the controller by potential function. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by numerical simulation. The proposed control algorithm can not only effectively avoid the angular momentum saturation problem, but also improves the robustness of the attitude control system.

articleTitle: Light Weight Landmark Detection Method
abstract: Detecting landmarks in images is an important and challenging task for intelligent driving. The difficulty of this task is to locate and classify the landmarks accurately under the limited resources of intelligent driving platform. In this paper, we propose a method of filter pruning for deep neural networks for the real-time landmark detection. The network is based on yolov3 and improved for feature extraction. Then we conduct filter pruning based on the attention mechanism, resulting in the final lightweight model. The experiment on landmark detection datasets shows that the proposed lightweight landmark detection method can achieve high performance in accuracy with fast speed.

articleTitle: Research and improvement of RRT algorithm for mobile robot navigation
abstract: At present, the sampling based fast search random tree algorithm is widely used in robot exploration environment. However, due to the randomness, blindness and time-consuming problems of RRT algorithm, an improved RRT algorithm is proposed in this paper, The algorithm improves the running speed and effect of RRT algorithm through dynamic selection of bidirectional sampling target points,

articleTitle: Underwater Non-uniform Illumination Image Correction Method Based on Dark Channel and Frequency Distribution Prior
abstract: Light -will gradually attenuate in the process of water medium propagation, which will lead to the problems of uneven illumination and low contrast of underwater images during underwater detection. In order to solve these problems, a new underwater non-uniform illumination image correction method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the single image reflection interference separation algorithm, a new optimization algorithm is proposed to separate the reflection layer (the light reflected by the underwater object and the background) and the illumination layer (the light scattered in the water medium) in the underwater non-uniform illumination image. According to the frequency distribution of the illumination layer in the image, a low-frequency filter is introduced into the model as the constrained prior term of the illumination layer to better extract the illumination layer and accelerate its separation. At the same time, the dark channel prior is introduced to ensure that the reflector is separated more thoroughly; Secondly, due to the low contrast of the separated reflector, the adaptive gamma transform algorithm is used to enhance the reflector. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is effective in removing non-uniform illumination and restoring image brightness and detail information.

articleTitle: Improved Approach to Delay-Dependent Stability Analysis of Discrete Time-Delay Systems Interconnected over an Arbitrary Graph
abstract: The paper discusses the improvement of the well-posedness, exponential stability and contractiveness whose condition for discrete time-delay systems interconnected over an arbitrary graph. We use the Wirtinger inequality to handle the non-linear terms in the difference equation of the Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional. A sufficient condition for the well-posedness, exponential stability and contractiveness of this kind of discrete time-delay systems is obtained in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Taking a numerical example to verify the validity of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Target tracking using modified image filtering based on statistical features and GMM image modeling
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm of target tracking using image modeling based on Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) and modified filtering based on statistical feature information designed to improve the accuracy and robustness of the target tracking algorithm in video images for surveillance. The algorithm extracts the pixels of the foreground image including noise through gaussian mixture modeling, and designs template based on the structural element idea of morphological operation to count the sum of pixel values matching the template, then selectively filter out image noise according to the threshold. The experimental results conclude that the algorithm in this paper has good noise filtering performance as well as accuracy of target tracking and effectively retaining target information.

articleTitle: A Detection-Estimation Strategy for Delayed Systems under Spoofing Attack
abstract: This paper investigates the linear state estimation problem for networked system with random delay and the packet sequence is unavailable to the estimator, which is due to spoofing attack destroying the time stamp of the packet. We consider a transmission mechanism that the packet is sent only once, as such the packet arrives at the remote estimator may be the current packet or the previous one or even empty. In this paper, we propose a detection-estimation strategy, which consists of the following two parts: Firstly, we detect the unavailable time stamp under the maximum a posteriori probability (MAP) estimation criterion; Secondly, using the estimated sequence of the time stamp, we propose a filtering algorithm which consists of smooth and estimate. Numerical examples are provided to illustrate the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Visual SLAM Combined with Semantic-Optical Flow Towards Dynamic Environment
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) attracted a growing number of researchers in recent years. Many impressed SLAM frameworks have achieved great performance under static environment. However, due to the interference of a large number of moving objects in the real environment, these moving objects will greatly impair the positioning accuracy of VSLAM, and even the positioning may fail. In this paper, we propose a mechanism for keypoints separation to reduce the negative impact brought by moving object. By estimating the dense optical flow of two adjacent frames of RGB images, the full optical flow of each frame is obtained. On this basis, we designed a lightweight Track module to remove the interference of the camera's ego-motion on the optical flow. We designed a score strategy to get the score of each keypoint, combined with semantic information, the motion area can be filtered out. We integrated the proposed system into the advanced ORBSLAM2 and tested it on the TUM dataset. Experiments reveal that our approach can enhance the robustness of state-of-the-art VSLAM systems in various complicated scenarios.

articleTitle: Event-triggered Control of Teleoperation Systems with Time-varying Delays
abstract: This paper addresses an event-triggered control framework under nonperiodic event-triggered sampling and time-varying delays for bilateral teleoperation systems. The triggering conditions for teleoperators are offered to limit the the frequency of communication so that the manipulators only communicate state information when it is required. By the proposed P-like controllers under the event-based communication mechanism, the master-slave position synchronization is accomplished. The stability condition of the teleoperation system is provided, and it is demonstrated that Zeno behavior is ruled out. Simulation examples are used to test the designed control algorithm’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Gastric Polyps Detection Based on Improved SSD
abstract: Gastroscopy is the main method of detecting gastric polyps. Specifically, the doctor observes the gastroscope image with the naked eye to determine the presence and location of polyps. The detection rate of polyps is affected by the doctor’s experience, fatigue, and other factors. There is a certain degree of missed polyps. Therefore, it is necessary to detect polyps by auxiliary means. In this paper, we report a convolutional neural network for gastric polyp detection, which is based on the Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD). In order to improve the performance of polyp detection, an excellent feature extractor is essential. We adopt EfficientNet instead of VGG16 as the backbone network of the SSD. In addition, the previous loss function is improved, and the PReLU activation function is introduced into the SSD to achieve better detection performance. We conduct extensive experiments on the gastric polyp dataset. The final experimental results show that the improved SSD network for gastric polyp detection can achieve a precision of 90.3% and a recall rate of 85.7%, which is better than the original SSD network.

articleTitle: Adaptive Observer-based Security Formation Control for Multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles under Cyber-Attacks
abstract: This paper addresses the security formation control issue of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles under cyber-attacks. The deception attacks on control input and output channels are considered simultaneously. An adaptive observer is design to estimate the effects of the malicious attacks. The formation control problem is transformed into a tracking control problem rely on a distributed estimator of leader. Based on the adaptive observer, a security formation controller is proposed to remove the effects of attacks by sliding mode control technique, which can guarantee the formation error can converge to zero. Finally, simulation experiment is conducted to illustrate the effectiveness and performance of the security formation control strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A SLAM Method Based on Cardinality Balanced Multi-Bernoulli Filter
abstract: To improve simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) performance of mobile robots, a SLAM method based on cardinality balanced Multi-Bernoulli filter (CBMber-SLAM) is proposed in this paper. First of all, the method is based on the Random Finite Set Theory (RFS), which avoids the problem of complex data association. In addition, this method is based on a Multi-Bernoulli filter, so that the CBMber- SLAM allows reliable and inexpensive extraction of state estimates than the PHD-SLAM method. Then, aiming at the problem of overestimation of the target by the Multi-Bernoulli filter, a potential equalization strategy is used to improve the accuracy of the filter's estimation of the number of targets. Finally, through experimental verification, the CBMber-SLAM method is better than the traditional PHD-SLAM method in terms of target estimation number, robot pose error and real-time performance. It is concluded that CBMber-SLAM method is better than the traditional PHD-SLAM method.

articleTitle: Shadow Removal without Reference
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative algorithm to compose shadow images with only shadow-free images and shadow masks, allowing us to avoid cumbersome annotations and to get more kinds of samples. Based on this algorithm, we create a shadow dataset called No Reference Shadow Removal Dataset (NRSR), which fits both paired and unpaired shadow removal tasks. We also propose an improved CycleGAN based shadow removal network by tailoring the generator network with Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP). Our deep framework ASPP- CycleGAN learns multi-scale feature information and maximizes the overall performance. Experiments validate that our shadow composing algorithm is effective and our shadow removal method outperforms state-of-the-art shadow removal methods.

articleTitle: Research on Key Parameters of the Ejector Geometry in Solid Oxygen Fuel Cell System
abstract: In this study, the influence of the key geometry parameter on the ejector performance in the solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) system is discussed by changing the diameter of the mixing chamber. The simulations gained by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) show that the connection between the diameter ratio and the ejector performance like entrainment ratio and the steam to carbon ratio (STCR) appears an inverted U-shaped line graph and can be divided into three areas. Too small or large the diameter ratio can make the ejector lose entrainment capability. The diameter ratio also has an important influence on the ejector operating mode. Two factors, which are the pressure rise in the mixing chamber and the larger space for entraining the secondary flow as the increase of the diameter ratio, affect strongly the ejector performance and operational mode.

articleTitle: Multi-source Heterogeneous Data Aggregation Method Based on Adversarial Domain Adaptation
abstract: In recent years, with the deployment of ubiquitous sensing, the aggregation method of massive multi-source heterogeneous data has become a hot research topic. At present, although the adversarial domain adaptation in transfer learning can achieve effective results in processing tasks such as data classification, there are few methods that can well apply the adversarial domain adaptation network to the scenario of multi-source heterogeneous data aggregation. The existing adversarial domain adaptation methods are mostly applied to the transfer of homogeneous features in single source domain. However, the samples in actual application scenarios are often heterogeneous data from multiple sources. To achieve feature alignment and the aggregation of multi-source heterogeneous data at the same time, a multi-source heterogeneous data aggregation method based on adversarial domain adaptation is proposed in this paper, by embedding a mapping neural network for heterogeneous data in the adversarial network, and adding weight parameters to measure the contribution of multiple source domains’ features and classes. The feasibility of the network structure is analyzed theoretically, and the effectiveness of the method is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Design and research of updating system based on OpenMBEE online data model library
abstract: The OpenMBEE platform has been widely used in digital model design due to its open-source features. A variety of modeling tools are integrated into the platform, which can quickly and easily realize the visual editing of dynamic models. The management of the designed model is realized through the management of the back-end MMS model database of the OpenMBEE platform. How to integrate and interact the data between different models is also a problem to be solved in the design. It is realized by establishing the unified model data table in the MMS database. Models and data are updated and optimized online. In the research, the interface function provided by OpenMBEE was explored, instead of using various modeling tools, the update of the data in the local and the model database was directly realized. At the same time, the data in the MMS database is updated online through View Editor, and middleware software is designed to synchronize the data content modified by the browser; on the other hand, the API interface provided by VE and OpenMBEE is used to realize local test data and tables. Import and synchronization of content. Using online update and local management tools, it can cross the complex operation process of modeling tools, simplify the process of system design and data management, and improve the management efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Research on improving photovoltaic fault voltage support capability using virtual impedance
abstract: The network connection of photovoltaic power generation system is connected to the power grid through public connection points. If the grid side is short circuited, the system connected to the grid can cause serious accidents, such as shutting down the equipment due to sudden voltage changes. This document introduces virtual obstacles to modify the reference signal of voltage control link and play a role of voltage support during fault. The simulation and test of MATLAB / Simulink shall verify that the proposed control strategy allows the integrated photovoltaic grid system to successfully pass the network error.

articleTitle: Coarse and Fine Structure Combined Model For Full Reference Image Quality Assessment
abstract: The structure is proven to be an effective quality indicator for full-reference (FR) image quality assessment (IQA). Existing FR-IQA methods only extract fine structure for distortion detection. This leads to error detection when the distortion is invisible. To this end, we propose a coarse and fine structure combined FR-IQA method in this paper. In specific, we design a patch based structure detection method to detect the coarse structure in an image, and detect the fine structure using the gradient magnitude (GM). The proposed method is tested on TID2013, TID2018, CSIQ and LIVE databases. The validation results demonstrate that the proposed model have high prediction accuracy, yet have modest computational complexity.

articleTitle: The design of a displaying system for battlefield situation based on ArcGIS Engine
abstract: To facilitate the precise analysis and judgment of battlefield situation for military stuffs inmodern warfare with abundant information, a modularized two-dimension battlefield situation displaysystem is designed based on ArcGIS Engine in this paper. The functions of each module are analyzed, andkey issues of the design are introduced. The real-time dynamic display of moving objects in the battlefield isachieved by reading data from the battlefield.

articleTitle: Scene Exploration Method of Coin Collection Game Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
abstract: In game AI control, sparse-reward environment exploration has been a hotspot for agent control. At present, agents based on traditional deep reinforcement learning are unable to learn appropriate policies when faced with complex continuous action space under sparse-reward. Recently, intrinsic reward stimulation has become a promising direction to solve the sparse-reward exploration problem. But in the complex environment, the agent will still get the local optimal policy. To solve the above problems, this paper designed a coin collection game environment. Based on the Proximal Policy Optimization with Random Network Distillation, paper proposed a method for agents to explore sparse-reward environment. In this paper, custom reward function gives extrinsic rewards to the agent. 3D-sensing rays allow agent to observe environment states. By using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, previous states and current state are fused to estimate the state value. Through comparative experiments, the results show that the proposed method significantly improves the maximum reward convergence rate, and agent obtains the global optimal policy. The agent can explore the scene, and finish the goal more effectively.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive fault-tolerant control of nonlinear teleoperation systems with time-varying delays
abstract: A robust adaptive control scheme for nonlinear teleoperation systems with time-varying delays and fault-tolerant ability is proposed. The system robustness is guaranteed by a prescribed-performance-based control scheme, in which the pre- scribed performance constraints on the synchronization variables rather than the tracking errors are imposed. Adaptive estimation technology is used to collectively accommodate modeling uncertainties, disturbance, and possible additive actuator faults. The stability of the delayed system is analyzed by the Lyapunov technique. Finally, the simulation studies are carried out to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Objective Optimization Management of New Energy Ships
abstract: The power system of the new energy ship generating power by using diesel and storing energy by solar energy and battery, which can save fuel and reduce the cost of operation and transportation, is a most promising system on comprehensive and optimized utilization of ship energy, and is also a research hotspot in the field of ship energy conservation and emission reduction. In view of the actual operating conditions, combined with the economic efficiency of the ship and the stability and reliability of power grid operation, the characteristics of the new energy ship propulsion system are analyzed, the ship energy flow coupling technology is put forward, and the research on the objective optimization strategy and management technology of the ship energy are conducted in this paper. The results of this paper realize the optimal planning and control of the ship energy, meet the safety and stability of the power supply, and realize the minimum consumption and emission of the whole ship operating fuel and the maximum economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Anomalous Signal Detection Method for Slurry Pipelines
