abstract: Targeting the problems of difficult feature extraction, low recognition accuracy, reliance on manual setting of the signal segmentation scale, and inability to obtain the classes and locations of anomalous signals at the same time in slurry pipelines, an object detection-based method for anomalous signal detection in slurry pipelines is proposed. First, a wavelet transform is applied to the original signals to remove the noise in the original signals. Then, the processed signals are converted into images, which converts the time series signal detection problem into an objection detection problem. Finally, the image is input into the YOLOv4 network. The classes and location of the anomalous signal are obtained through the steps of feature extraction and feature fusion. The experimental results show that the method can better identify the classes and locations of two types of anomalous signals, which provides a new solution to the complex anomalous signal detection problem of slurry pipelines. This provides technical support for further solving the problem of false positive rates and false negative rates caused by anomalous signals.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Path Tracking With Application of Quadruped Robot
abstract: Path tracking is a hot issue in the control of robots, especially quadruped robots for their complexity in foot structure and walking gait. Pure-pursuit is widely used in vehicle path tracking, but most of the improvements on pure-pursuit only concern about tracking error. In this letter, we introduce a reinforcement learning-based method using Proximal Policy Optimization(PPO) to adaptively control the preview distance in pure-pursuit and the step length of quadruped robot according to the curvature of the road. Experiments show that we reached a balance in decreasing tracking error as traditional pure-pursuit while maintaining the running speed of quadruped robot.

articleTitle: A novel energy-saving train operation strategy based on particle swarm algorithms
abstract: To effectively reduce the energy consumption of urban rail transit trains and optimize the operation strategy, based on the dynamic model of the urban rail transit train, the energy consumption model of four-stage manipulation strategy is constructed respectively, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model. In this paper, an Atype train with four driving and two pallets are selected as the research object, and a case design is carried out on a flat ramp. The operation strategy is analyzed for the difference between vehicle traction energy consumption, regenerative braking energy storage, and total energy consumption. The corresponding speed-distance curve is obtained by simulation. The results show that the four-stage control strategy is generally helpful to achieve better energy-saving optimization effects.

articleTitle: DV-Hop Localization Algorithm based on Hop Distance Weight and Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: For the purpose of overcoming the issue of lower localization accuracy in the DV-Hop localization algorithm, as well as addressing the problem that the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is easy to slip into local optimization, an enhancement strategy, which is based on hop distance weight and improved PSO, is proposed. The anchor node broadcasts information with a dual communication radius to obtain the optimal inter-node hop value; the proportion of the anchor node’s average hop distance to the communication radius is utilized as the weight utilized to figure out the unknown node’s average hop distance. The enhanced PSO is employed to calculate the unknown node’s location, while the dynamic weight and golden sine algorithm are employed to update the position of particles. On the basis of the simulation results, it is manifest that the proposed calculation has superior localization precision.

articleTitle: A hybrid constraint handling techniques based on differential evolution algorithm for constrained optimization problems
abstract: Many practical engineering problems can be transformed into constrained optimization problems (COPs) , scholars prefer to use evolutionary algorithms (EA) to deal with COPS. Differential evolution (DE) algorithm has strong global search and convergence ability than other EA, however, when dealing with COPs, the search ability of DE algorithm is affected by parameter setting and constraint handling technology (CHT) is needed. In this paper, an improved differential evolution algorithm with a new hybrid CHT (IDE-HCHT) is used to deal with COPs, at the same time, the hybrid CHT replaces the selection step of the DE algorithm, and improves the processing efficiency of the algorithm. To verify its superiority, CEC2017 benchmark function is tested by the novel IDE-HCHT, and two other start-of-the-art algorithms, LSHADE44, UDE. The results show that the proposed method shows better competitive performance against the two algorithms.

articleTitle: A high-accuracy segmentation and size measurement method for green pellet images using a deep cascaded network
abstract: Green pellets are important material for steel industry. Particle size distribution (PSD) is an important quality parameter of green pellets and is usually measured by a machine vision system installed in the production line. Therefore, segmentation of green pellet images plays a key role in such measurements. Many segmentation algorithms including traditional and deep learning ones are limited in processing images with overlapping pellets and uneven illumination, which greatly affects PSD measuring accuracy. In the presented work, we propose a high-accuracy segmentation method for green pellet images using a deep cascaded network. The cascaded architecture of the network can provide deep and abundant features to the decision layer to improve segmentation accuracy; based on the probability map generated by the network, the shape of each pellet (thus pellet size) can be obtained using contour detection and ellipse fitting. The proposed method was tested by 340 pellet images captured from a steel company, and compared with five current deep networks. Results show that the proposed cascaded network achieves higher segmentation accuracy than other compared networks in terms of f1-score, AUC measures, DSC index (about 0.98, 0.97 and 0.94 in average), and the obtained PSD curve agrees better with ground truth.

articleTitle: Multi-robot Cooperative Search Method Based on Biological Heuristic Algorithm
abstract: The multi-robot search problem is one of the key issues in the research of multi-robot systems. In order to find the target effectively, an improved multi-robot collaborative search method based on Beetle Antennae search (BAS) algorithm is proposed. First, the left and right whiskers in Beetle Antennae search algorithm can correspond to the two robots one by one. According to this feature, the position of this group of robots is continuously updated according to the algorithm, and finally the target search task is completed. On this basis, considering the cooperation between multiple groups of robots, the collaborative method of particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is introduced, and a multi-robot collaborative search method based on the improved beetle algorithm is proposed. Simulation shows that the improved algorithm can be effectively completed for static targets Target search task, and the target search success rate is significantly better than particle swarm optimization algorithm when the number of robots is small.

articleTitle: Prediction Method for NOx Emissions in Cement Arotary Kiln Based on EMD and ESNs
abstract: Nitrogen oxide (NOx) is one of the important air pollutants in the calcination process of cement clinker. Accurate prediction of NOx is necessary for optimizing the calcination process to reduce the NOx emissions. Based on the EMD and multiple ESNs, this paper developed a prediction model to predict the NOx concentration in the cement kiln using the history data. First, the EMD is used to decompose the historical NOx content time series into several subsequences. Then, each subsequence is individually predicted by different ESN models, and the outputs of the ESN models are integrated to obtain the final prediction values. Finally, the performance of the proposed prediction model is tested on the actual data in the practical cement clinker calcination process. The experimental result shows that the proposed method has approving performance.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Energy Storage Technology on the Generation Side
abstract: Achieving the integration of clean and efficient renewable energy into the grid can help get the goals of "2030 carbon peak" and "2060 carbon neutral", but the polymorphic uncertainty of renewable energy will bring influences to the grid. Utilizing the two-way energy flow properties of energy storage can provide effective voltage support and energy supply for the grid. Improving the security and flexibility of the grid. To this end, this article first summarized the current status and development scale of energy storage. Secondly classified and described the application of multiple types of energy storage. Then discussed the application mechanism of energy storage on the generation side, from suppressing renewable energy fluctuations to auxiliary frequency modulation and peaking, peak- cutting and valley-filling. Finally, suggestions and conclusions are made for the technical of energy storage on the generation side.

articleTitle: MDFN: Multi-path Dynamic Fusion Network for Face Reconstruction and Dense Face Alignment
abstract: 3D face reconstruction based on single-view in the wild has been a long-standing challenging problem. In the complex and changeable unconstrained state, the traditional 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) parameters regression method lacks the ability to express local details, which is hard to reconstruct the accurate face shape. In this paper, we propose a multi-path pyramidal convolution network with the dynamic fusion of global and local information, which is able to recover richer detail 3D shapes from 2D images. Specifically, we design a multi-path network to extract global discriminative features and local detailed features, respectively. Then, we utilize the attention transformer module to enhance the network’s ability for capturing the correlation between local information. Finally, to boost the regression accuracy of the network, we dynamically fuse the global information that constrains the geometric shape of the face and the local information that enriches geometric details. Extensive experimental results on the AFLW and AFLW2000-3D datasets demonstrate that our MDFN achieves compelling performance in dense face alignment and reconstruction.

articleTitle: A greedy iterative least squares algorithm for multivariable systems
abstract: This paper considers the joint estimation of parameters and time-delays for multi-input output-error systems. By introducing the noise-free outputs and setting an input regression length, an over-parameterization linear sparse identification model can be obtained. A greedy iterative least squares algorithm based on the Householder transformation and auxiliary model is proposed. The proposed algorithm can estimate the multiple time-delays and parameters of the multivariable systems from a few number of sampled data, and has the advantage of avoiding computing the inverse of a high-dimensional matrix at each iteration compared to existing methods. Finally, a numerical simulation example demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive neural control for unmanned surface vessels with asymmetric full-state constraints
abstract: This paper is devoted to solving the tracking control issue for unmanned surface vessels (USVs) subject to asymmetric full-state constraints, in which the uncertainties are explicitly considered. Uncertainties of USVs is handled by neural approximation approach. A new asymmetric barrier Lyapunov function (ABLF) is first established, and it not only solves the problem of state constraints but also avoids the conservative selection of state initial values. Furthermore, a novel adaptive neural backstepping design scheme is put forward by utilizing ABLF and hyperbolic tangent function approaches. The proposed scheme guarantees that all the state constraints are never violated and the system output follows the given reference signal well during the whole control procedure. Finally, simulation results have illustrated the efficacy of our method.

articleTitle: Kalman Based Data Fusion Algorithm for High Accuracy Train Positioning
abstract: The track circuit can automatically and continuously detect the train position occupancy in the track section. Most of the existing train positioning systems are limited to determine which block is occupied, but can not obtain the accurate position of the train in the block section. Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) has the advantages of high precision and real-time positioning, and it can provide an absolute position data. However, in dense areas of tracks, such as stations, it is impossible to accurately determine where the train is located due to GNSS positioning errors. In this paper, an algorithm is proposed to combine GNSS positioning technology with the track circuit positioning method to obtain continuous train position information in the block areas. The position information of the track circuit can also correct the error of GNSS positioning data, and effectively improve train positioning accuracy. What is more, a train positioning simulation platform is developed and applied to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Burden Descent Model for Blast Furnace Based on Swing Radar Measurement
abstract: To solve the invisible problem of burden distribution in blast furnace during ironmaking, this paper presents a model of burden descending combined with the detection results of rotating radar on blast furnace. We designed a calculation method of reconstructing the stockline to solve the problem of coke layer collapse during descending. The mathematical model was optimized for the influence of the shape change of blast furnace on the material layer shape in the procedure of descending to ensure that the model can display the burden distribution in blast furnace in real time. The display of the visual model is compared with the real radar data, which proves the correctness of the model. The results show that the visualized charging model can accurately reflect the burden distribution of blast furnace, providing a basis for guiding the distribution and optimizing production.

articleTitle: Real time counting system of glass bottle based on Multi Objects tracking
abstract: Glass bottle counting is a common work in the field of intelligent manufacturing, but there are also some problems, such as the reflection of glass bottles, high similarity, which makes it difficult to track and so on. Accurate and stable target detection and target tracking is the key technology of glass bottle counting. In order to improve the problems of wrong tracking, missing tracking and low efficiency in the existing glass bottle real-time counting system. In this paper, a real-time tracking and counting system of glass bottle is presented, and we propose the feature pyramid network (FPN) and pyramid attention network (PAN) network, and uses the cross stage local network (CSP) structure for multi-scale feature map to realize the accurate detection of glass bottle mouth. At the same time, the cascade matching module and the union intersection distance (DIOU) module are fused to further effectively distinguish the matched tracking target from the unmatched tracking target and the detection results, so as to improve the speed and accuracy of glass bottle mouth tracking.

articleTitle: Study on Disturbance Rejection Control of the All-Wheel-Steering Intelligent Vehicle against Crosswind Interference
abstract: This paper purposes an anti-interference control strategy of intelligent vehicles. The disturbance in this paper is mainly generated by the crosswind. Uncertainties of the tire forces are also taken into consideration. A novel vehicle dynamic model considering the rear wheels’ steering angle is used, and on the other hand, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance is considered with the anti-interference performance. By modelling the disturbance generated by the crosswind, an augmented vehicle lateral dynamic model is established based on the traditional 2 degree-of-freedom. Finally, simulation results are shown for verifying the performance of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Decoupling Controller Design for BTT Missile With Coupled Channels Based on Sliding Mode and Neural Network
abstract: Aiming at the serious coupled channels control problem in BTT missile, this paper adopts theories of sliding mode and neural network to design missile controller. Firstly, sliding mode control and neural network are introduced, and the joint equation of states for pitch and yaw channels of BTT missile is established. Secondly, the coupling factors are estimated by the linear extended states observer for decoupling and the control laws of coupled channels are designed. Thirdly, in order to decrease the chattering of sliding mode control, the gain term of sliding mode would be adjusted by RBF neural network online. Finally, the performance and robustness of the designed controller are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Data Acquisition Method for Vehicle Geometry Passability Measure
abstract: Geometric passability parameters are key for the terrain adaptability of vehicles. In order to replace the current empirically manual measurement methods, we present an automatic acquisition method for measuring vehicle geometry passability parameters with high quality data. A remote control center and a wheeled robot with lidar are used in this method to obtain a point cloud for geometric passability parameters calcutlation at the bottom of vehicles. The data acquisition in this scene is more likely to be misregistered by the instructor due to the majority of ground points. To have a high quality of point cloud, the point cloud registration algorithm is modified by appropriate matching point distribution and pose constraints. The experimental results show that this method performs well and can reliably complete the data acquisition task efficiently.

articleTitle: Data and Image Classification of Haematococcus pluvialis Based on SVM Algorithm
abstract: The growth process of Haematococcus pluvialis includes cell proliferation stage and astaxanthin accumulation stage. There are differences in cell radius, cell color and cell number between the two stages. In this paper, cell images and cell data of two growth stages were collected, and SVM algorithm was used to establish two classification models of data and image of Haematococcus pluvialis cell. 30% of the data in the samples were selected as the test set. In cell data binary classification problem, SVM classification algorithm was used, and the final classification result was 0.855; In the problem of image binary classification, the accuracy of the model is tested by the method of ten-fold cross validation, and the ROC curve and AUC area are used to evaluate the model. Finally, the classification result of the model for Haematococcus pluvialis cell image is 0.90, and the performance is good.

articleTitle: Research on semiconductor intelligent coating equipment and its key technology
abstract: With the advance of intelligent manufacturing, semiconductor manufacturing industry ushered in a period of rapid development. With the lithography technology as the core, the semiconductor intelligent coating equipment is developed from the aspects of process flow, hardware structure, software layout, user interface, etc. The problems of the important link such as the uniformity, consistency and rapdiness of the coating homogenizer are solved, and constructive suggestions are put forward for the production scheduling algorithm and the optimization calculation of the production capacity.

articleTitle: An Optimal Iterative Learning Control Design Framework for Systems with Varying Trial Lengths
abstract: This paper proposes an iterative learning control (ILC) design framework for systems with varying trial lengths inspired by existent successive projection method. After reformulating the ILC problem into finding a point between two sets, the framework of successive projection is modified for systems with varying trial lengths in random sense. Therefore, the traditional norm optimal ILC can be employed to solve problems with varying trial lengths, whose convergence is thus proved in mathematical expectation sense. A numerical simulation model is employed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed ILC design.

articleTitle: A Fast Optimization Algorithm of Communication Topology for Two-dimensional Persistent Formation
abstract: Agent formation will use the communication links between them to interact with each other in the process of task execution, forming a communication topology. The optimization of communication topology for agent formation is of great significance to reduce the energy consumption of agents, extend the working time of the formation and improve the ability of formation to complete the task. Aiming at the communication topology optimization problem of two-dimensional persistent formation with leader constraint, a new fast optimization algorithm is proposed based on minimum cost arborescence, arc addition operation and path reverse operation. Finally, the simulation results further verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the algorithm. Compared with the average level of existing algorithm, the calculation time of the algorithm is reduced by 64.1%, 52.7%, 40.1%, 36.2% and 37.7%, respectively, when the numbers of agents are 25, 50, 75, 100 and 125.

articleTitle: An Anti-Fall Device of Construction Hoist Based on PM-ECB
abstract: Permanent magnet eddy current braking (PM-ECB) is a new type of non-friction braking technology. It uses the magnetic field generated by the permanent magnet to produce eddy current loss in the process of relative motion for braking. It does not need external excitation power supply. It has the advantages of compact structure, high reliability, no noise, no contact and so on. Based on the electromagnetic theory, the basic principle of permanent magnet eddy current brake is analyzed, and the calculation formula of eddy current brake force of annular magnet moving along the conductor tube is given; At the same time, combined with the specific construction elevator, the dynamic model of permanent magnet eddy current brake for cage falling without initial speed is established, and the influence of magnet array arrangement on magnetic flux density and the influence of air gap between magnet group and conductor tube on cage falling speed are studied. The simulation results show that the magnet group can achieve the braking effect when the load falls without initial speed or overload at rated speed, which provides the basis for the design of permanent magnet eddy current anti falling device of construction hoist.

articleTitle: A Multi-concurrent Fault Diagnosis Scheme for the Parallel Shaft Gearbox Based on Resnet Neural Network and Image Recognition Approach
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to propose a fault diagnosis scheme for the multi-concurrent faults of the parallel shaft gearbox. To be specific, the normal and failure data sets are preprocessed and translated into black and white pixel images first. Then, the data sets are divided into training sets and verification sets with different batch sizes. By applying the Resnet Neural Network, a fault diagnosis scheme is presented for monitoring the gearbox. Finally, a simulating experiment with multiple failure modes is conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of the developed results.

articleTitle: Haematococcus pluvialis cell based on support vector machine Classification research
abstract: The classification of Haematococcus pluvialis cells, a support vector machine was used to construct a model, and 150 groups of Haematococcus pluvialis data were used to fit the model. The data set and test set of Haematococcus pluvialis were used separately. For classification prediction, different kernel functions are selected to compare the classification accuracy of support vector machines, and learning curve are used to adjust the parameters of part of the eucalyptus function. Finally, the model measurement standards of confusion moment and ROC curve are introduced. It is concluded that the support vector machine classifier can classify Haematococcus pluvialis in the proliferation and induction stages, and the classification accuracy under the multi-directional kernel function and sigmoid is the highest, with a classification accuracy of 91.11%.

articleTitle: FVL-OutLoc: Fusion of Vision and 2D LiDAR for Accurate Outdoor Localization
abstract: Precise localization is an essential issue for autonomous driving systems. 2D LiDAR has been widely used in various indoor localization systems because of its accuracy in measuring distances. However, the data of 2D LiDAR in the outdoor environment is very sparse and affected by dynamic objects greatly, which makes it very difficult to find the corresponding points. To overcome this defect, we propose a novel outdoor localization framework based on the fusion of stereo vision and 2D LiDAR, called FVL-OutLoc. This framework first adopts Dempster-Shafer theory to fuse several consecutive frames of 2D LiDAR data into a grid submap by using stereo odometry. Finally, Fourier-Mellin Transform is chosen to match the submap and prior map for further correcting the odometry. The experimental results on the KITTI dataset show that FVL-OutLoc can achieve high localization accuracy and run at a real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on an optimization method for production scheduling of annular heating furnace
abstract: An annular heating furnace is a main energy consuming equipment in hot rolling production processes. The ultimate goals of heating production scheduling optimization are to reduce the gas consumption of the annular heating furnace, optimize the heating quality of the cylindrical billet, and improve the production efficiency per unit time. According to the production process and constraint conditions of the annular heating furnace for heating cylindrical billets, this paper proposes a continuous state machine, which adopts an 8-step continuous state machine and an improved genetic algorithm to realize the production scheduling optimization of the circular heating furnace. Through the comparison and verification with the actual production, the furnace dwell time of the cylindrical billet is effectively reduced, and the energy saving effect is significant.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method using Convolutional Neural Network with Visualized Samples
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN) is a prominent machine vision modelling method for extracting useful image features. In order to overcome the limitation of CNN used in industrial processes, an image conversion strategy is utilized in this work. Firstly, the scaled data is assigned into different numerical segments by setting the data bounds and the division rate. Subsequently, the RGB image is converted by using the mapping relation from the previously divided segment to the graphical dictionary. Then the converted RGB image of the process measurements can be used as the input of CNN. Application to the benchmark Tennessee Eastman (TE) process validates the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Machine learning model to predict electricity demand and thermal generation during the pandemic
abstract: Owing to the global lockdown caused by the pandemic of COVID-19, the electricity demand is greatly affected, and the electricity market is also constantly fluctuating. During the pandemic period, the prediction of electricity demand is crucial to the economy and power dispatching. In this study, we combine the pandemic data and government anti-pandemic policies data to predict the electricity demand of the Contiguous United States by using the artificial neural network and recurrent neural network. In addition, the linear regression method is used to forecast the thermal generation with total generation data. Some experiments have developed to verify the effectiveness of the model. Then the model is used to forecast electricity demand and thermal generation under different policies and pandemic development, and the result were analyzed.

articleTitle: Technical Study and Engineering Practice of New Energy Ships on Electrification Technology
abstract: Shipping enterprises are facing more and more pressure of greenhouse gas emission reduction in the process of operation. Therefore, it is necessary to effectively control and reduce the emission of marine pollutants. In order to promote ecological environment protection and industrial upgrading, China has implemented a series of major measures to protect water resources, control water pollution and restore water ecology. Based on the analysis of the technical framework of new energy ships, this paper puts forward the research on energy saving efficiency of new energy ships, establishes a comprehensive energy production and consumption revolution, promotes the use of clean energy, and constructs a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient modern energy system. The successful application of key technologies of new energy ship power system plays an important role in improving the utilization efficiency of ship energy in transportation industry, reducing fuel consumption and effectively supporting the construction of ship emission control area.

articleTitle: Design of AGC Simulation Platform for Hot Strip Finishing Mills Based on Parallel Control Theory
abstract: Automatic gauge control (AGC) of hot strip finishing mills is of great significance for the improvement of strip steel quality. In view of the complexity of the technological process and production environment of this process, the idea of construction of AGC simulation platform based on parallel control theory is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the framework of AGC parallel system is proposed. Then, according to the mechanism of strip rolling and control, the simulation model of AGC artificial system is established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed artificial system simulation model is proved through the simulation experiments with the aid of Matlab/Simulink. As a result, the key points of parameter optimization identification for the simulation model are extracted, which lays the foundation for the follow-up simulation experiments and results application of AGC artificial system. And it is especially beneficial to the research on system continuous optimization and control based on the real-time production data.

articleTitle: Application Algorithm of Equipment Alarm Data in Power Network Direct Acquisition Data Analysis System
abstract: This paper has presented an idea of using equipment alarm data to support relevant departments find easy-to-fault point. According to the information, make next year's equipment update and maintenance plan. The easy-to-fault point could also help with training and equipment design use. The system assisted people to make decision on which part of power grid system to make further investment. In this way, the power system would grow stronger with limited investment. Firstly, coded information according to the characteristics of power system regulation to prepare for data extraction from the Bayesian model. Secondly, in order to solve the problem of accuracy and reliability, the Bayesian model was adopted to calculate the accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Platoon Control of Unmanned Tracked Vehicles Based on Distributed Model Prediction
abstract: Considering that the current platoon control algorithms applied in unmanned tracked vehicles have poor reliability and stability. There are also few research employing the model predictive control in this field of the tracked vehicles. To accomplish the platoon control of unmanned tracked vehicles, this paper proposed a Distributed Model Predictive Control (DMPC) method for platoon control. Firstly, a platoon control framework of tracked vehicles is constructed including vehicles interaction layer and vehicle nodes layer. We build a communication network topology model based on graph theory in the interaction layer and a instantaneous steering center tracked vehicle model in the node layer. Secondly, a tracked vehicle multi-objective optimization controller based DMPC is designed. The controller solves the trajectory tracking and platoon control problems uniformly. The effectiveness, stability and reliability of the controller are verified by the straight-line changeable speed platoon control experiment and circular path platoon control experiment.

articleTitle: A Position-Based Impedance Control Strategy of Bilateral Teleoperation System with Force Feedback
abstract: A novel position-based impedance control strategy is developed for trajectory tracking and force feedback of a bilateral teleoperation system in contact with the environment. The control scheme consists of the inner loop PD control and the outer loop impedance model. During the process of trajectory tracking, the interaction force between the slave manipulator and the environment is converted into a position correction through the impedance model, which works as the motion instructions of the slave robot together with the reference position of the master device. Meanwhile, the operator can adjust the movement of the master device based on the feedback interaction force, which helps the operator to optimize the trajectory of the salve robot and the interaction force correspondingly. The Lyapunov function is employed to prove the tracking performance and global stability of the teleoperation system. Experiments are carried out on a Novint Falcon master manipulator and a seven degrees of freedom(DOFs) robot. The results demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Distributed Group Formation Tracking Control for Swarm Systems Guided by Multiple Leaders with Bounded Input
abstract: This paper investigates the problems of distributed group formation tracking for swarm systems with multiple leaders, where each leader has bounded control input. Agents in the swarm system are separated into several subgroups, and all subroups are required to track the same target. In addition, each subgroup is composed of followers and one or more leaders, where leaders in a subgroup can not only contact with leaders in other subgroup to track the target collaboratively, but also proposed reference trajectories to their followers in the same subgroup. Based on neighboring state information feedback and sliding-mode control theory, a distributed group formation tracking control protocol is proposed, where gain matrices in the protocol can also be easily determined by several simple conditions. Moreover, the stability of the group formation tracking control system is proven on the basis of Lyapunov stability theory, and a simulation case is shown to verify the effectiveness and correctness of the main research results.

articleTitle: HVAC System Modeling and Fault Simulation Research Based on Modelica
abstract: HVAC (Heating Ventilating and Air Conditioning) system is a multifunctional air conditioning system that integrates several subsystems such as cooling subsystem and air handling subsystem interacting simultaneously. The causal modeling approach is very complex and difficult to establish an accurate physical model for HVAC system. In addition, the actual HVAC is generally not allowed to operate in a fault state. Therefore, it is difficult to obtain comprehensive and adequate fault sample data directly from the actual HVAC system. In order to solve the shortcomings of causal modeling and the inadequate fault samples of the actual system, an acausal modeling method based on the modelica language is proposed and the faults are simulated in the simulation platform to generate fault samples based on the fault types of the actual system. The results show that this method is not only able to build HVAC system models with more similar topology to the actual physical system but also has better scalability for effective fault simulation of the whole system compared to the traditional causal modeling approach.

articleTitle: Prescribed-time Leader-following Control of Second-order Multi-agent Systems under Event-triggered Mechanism
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of leader-following tracking control problem with prescribed-time under the event trigger mechanism. In order to carry out leader-following consistency issue under the directed communication topology including a spanning tree, we propose a distributed prescribed-time control scheme by using an auxiliary variable in this paper. Furthermore, event-triggered mechanism is adopted in this work which Mightens the communication burden greatly. By means of a simulation example, the proposed method is authenticated.

articleTitle: Solving dynamic parameter estimation problems using generalized oppositional BLPSO algorithm
abstract: Dynamic parameter estimation (DPE) problems are often encountered in chemical engineering systems. Due to the nonlinearity and multimodality of the DPE models, it is quite difficult to estimate the parameter values accurately. In this paper, an improved BLPSO algorithm called generalized oppositional biogeography-based learning particle swarm optimization (GOBLPSO) is proposed to address the DPE problems. In GOBLPSO, the generalized oppositional learning strategy is introduced to improve the quality of learning exemplars, and thus enhances the search performance. The GOBLPSO algorithm is applied to solve three chemical DPE problems, and experimental results indicate that GOBLPSO exhibits superior performance compared with the original BLPSO and five other meta-heuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Stabilization Control of Fractional- order Flexible Single-Lever Manipulator System via Vector Lyapunov Function Combined with M-matrix Method
abstract: This paper applies a new asymptotic stabilization control method for a new class of fractional-order flexible single-lever manipulator system, that is, the vector Lyapunov function combined with M-matrix method. First, we extended the integer-order flexible single-lever manipulator system to the fractional order field, and then judged the stability of the fractional-order flexible single-lever manipulator system through the fractional Routh-Herwitz criterion, and finally via the method of vector Lyapunov function combining with M- matrix, a novel feedback control strategy of the stabilization control of the fractional-order flexible single-lever manipulator system is derived. Finally, the validity of the theory is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Multi view 3D reconstruction method for weak texture objects based on "eye-in-hand" model
abstract: Size measurement and defect detection of ceramics are required in the production process of ceramic products. Therefore, it is necessary to perform high-precision and fast three-dimensional reconstruction of such targets with smooth surfaces and weak textures. However, the reconstruction of a large number of point clouds from multiple perspectives is time-consuming due to the matching of adjacent feature points. Based on this, a fast point cloud registration strategy based on the "eye-in-hand" model is proposed, which can obtain RGB-D images at multi-view around weak-textured objects with RGB-D camera for rapid point cloud registration and reconstruction. Meanwhile, a 3D point cloud segmentation method based on voxel-grid and euclidean distance clustering is applied to divide the scene point and obtain an accurate 3D model. The experimental results indicate that the multi view 3D reconstruction speed of this method is faster and the accuracy of objects point cloud is within 2 mm. Hence, this method can be well applied in reconstructing the 3D point clouds model for ceramic products.

articleTitle: PDE-based Multi-agent Deployment in 3-D Space via Bilateral Boundary control
abstract: In this paper, the problem of dynamic deployment control for a large scale multi-agent system (MAS) in 3-D space is studied. We describe collective dynamics by a pair of thermal diffusion partial differential equations (PDEs) which are defined in a 2-D symmetry plane, and this plane allows a leader-follower meshgrid communication topology of the MAS. We apply a bilateral boundary control law, so that the agents located on the upper and lower boundaries are leaders which drive the system from two sides. The H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> exponential stability proves the stability of the system. Simulation results verify that the MAS with the bilateral control shows better performance at the settling time compared to the MAS with single boundary control.

articleTitle: Sampled-data Control for Itô Time Varying Delay Stochastic Singular Markovian Jump Systems
abstract: This paper investigates the sampled-data admissibility of Ito time varying delay stochastic singular Markovian jump systems (Ito SSMJSs). We propose a novel delay-dependent Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional using input delay approach. The stochastic stability criteria are given by developing the technique of linear matrix inequality (LMI). Furthermore, a sampled-data controller is designed for the Ito time varying delay SSMJS by analyzing the admissibility conditions. Finally, numerical examples demonstrate the usefulness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: A Concentration Interval Identification Method of Cobalt Ions Based on Optimal Spectral Bands Selection and Naive Bayes Classification
abstract: The concentration of cobalt ions in the solution after zinc smelting and purification is an important indicator for evaluating the qualification of zinc solution. This paper mainly realizes the online detection of the concentration of cobalt ions in the purified solution of zinc smelting based on spectrophotometry. Due to the complex composition, small concentration change, and small spectral characteristic difference of the liquid, most spectral identification methods are prone to confusion and misjudgment for some samples with similar spectral characteristics. In this paper, the concentration interval identification method based on band optimization selection combined with the Naive Bayesian classification was adopted. Firstly, according to the "fingerprint characteristics" of the molecular spectrum, the characteristic spectral bands of cobalt were selected by the moving window method. The spectral bands containing the most cobalt ion information were selected according to the best prediction performance. Then apply the Gaussian Naive Bayes model to classify and predict the quality level of the liquid after cobalt removal. Comparing the proposed method with other common classification methods, the results show that this method can better capture the subtle differences between spectral features and identify the characteristic properties of cobalt ions. The concentration interval of cobalt can be distinguished with higher recognition accuracy and less computation time. The concentration interval recognition of purified liquid can also be accurately achieved in a relatively small number of samples.

articleTitle: Music Genre Classification Using A One-way Audio-visual Feature Interaction Method
abstract: The existing methods treat the audio features and visual features of audio in isolation so that the corresponding relationship between the two features can not be generated to optimize the model. Finally, the extracted learning features are not enough to support better classification results. Therefore, this paper proposes a one-way audio-visual feature interaction method based on deep learning to explore this problem. That is, different types of learning features extracted from the multi-input model are concatenated for further training. Experimental results show that this method can effectively optimize the model. Compared with the classification accuracy of the benchmark model, the model accuracy of this method is as high as 93.65% on the GTZAN dataset, which is better than most existing methods.

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer Based Trajectory Tracking Control for the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
abstract: This article develops a disturbance observer (DO) based controller for an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) trajectory tracking subject to external disturbances. In particular, an observer is constructed to estimate the time- varying disturbances. Then, the estimated disturbances are incorporated to design the trajectory tracking controller, which can realize the steady trajectory tracking of the UAV under external disturbances. The stability of the proposed controller is analyzed using Lyapunov technology. Finally, the tracking performance is compared with another controller through simulation experiments. The results illustrate the superior tracking performance of the proposed controller in terms of the position and yaw angle profiles.

articleTitle: Simulation on Power Control for Wave Power Generation System
abstract: How to obtain the maximum wave energy under complex sea conditions is the key problem in wave power generation research. In this paper, the direct-drive wave power generation device is studied, and the model is established by buoy dynamics. The simulation model of direct-drive wave power generation device is built. Passive damping control and reactive power control are adopted to realize the maximum power tracking of the device, and the two control effects are compared. It provides a research basis for the design of wave power generation control system in the future.

articleTitle: Simulation of sliding mode control law for seeker predetermined circuit
abstract: For the predetermined circuit of the seeker servo system, the conventional linear control law cannot achieve the ideal control effect because there are many nonlinear links such as saturation and dead time in the existing system. To solve this problem, a sliding mode controller is designed. To ensure that the designed sliding mode controller can reach the sliding surface and make the error convergence stable, the stability of the designed sliding mode controller is verified by combining with the relevant theorems. The simulation model verifies the performance of the algorithm, and the setting process of relevant parameters is given, which lays the foundation for engineering application.

articleTitle: Tongue Fissure Segmentation with Attention Bilateral Network
abstract: Tongue diagnosis plays an important role in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), and tongue fissure is one of the most important features in tongue diagnosis. The segmentation accuracy of tongue fissure area has an impact on the analysis of physical condition. In this paper, we use an Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) module to improve the Bilateral Segmentation Network (BiSeNet V2) for segmenting the tongue fissure area in a tongue image. However, black tongue coating is easy to be identified as tongue fissure. To reduce this interference, a color thresholding method based on HSV color space is proposed. Experimental results demonstrate that our improved network achieves 52.282% IoU and 68.664% F1 score on test set for a 480x480 input in an efficient and effective way, which is better than common networks. Furthermore, the color thresholding method can remove 93.3% of the black tongue coating area.

articleTitle: Dynamic Object Trajectory Prediction Algorithm in Urban Scene Based on Map Features
abstract: Predicting the future trajectory of dynamic objects in a scene is a key capability to ensure safe and smooth driving of autonomous vehicles. Accurately predicting the trajectory of objects is not a simple task due to the complexity of urban scenes and the variety of dynamic object categories. Because objects in a scene are affected by the motion of other objects as well as by static scenes, much of the previous work focused on capturing interactions between objects. In this paper, we combine the map attention mechanism to extract map features, so that the model focuses on the regions in the map that have influence on object motion, thus improving the prediction results. To evaluate its performance, an urban scene trajectory prediction datasets containing map data is produced and we compared with existing prediction algorithms on this datasets.

articleTitle: Tracking Control of Multi-Euler-Lagrange Systems under Time-varying Disturbance and Communication Delay
abstract: This article address the distributed tracking control problem of multiple Euler-Lagrange systems with uncertainty and external time-varying disturbance, taking into account agents under the directed graph of information transmission have time-varying delay. Based on the Lyapunov stability technique, adequate qualification for the gradual astringe of the leader and followers tracking errors are established using the designed distributed adaptive control law. Finally, the availability of the brought forward control protocol is verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Research on BPNN-Based SVM-DTC for Direct Drive PMSG Wind Turbine
abstract: The power loss of the machine-side converter (MSC) seriously affects the power generation efficiency of low-wind-speed maglev vertical-axis wind turbines with PMSG. In view of this, this paper proposes a direct torque control strategy with SVPWM modulation (SVM-DTC) based on BP neural network (BPNN). The inner loop is the electromagnetic torque tracking controller, in which, BPNN is trained off-line to appr-oximate the curve between stator flux reference value and electromagnetic torque to realize variable flux reference value control, so that the d-axis stator current can be controlled to keep zero. The BP-PID controller is designed as the outer loop controller to realize MPPT. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can reduce the power loss of MSC, improve the efficiency of the PMSG, and reduce the overshoot of the electromagnetic torque and speed of PMSG.

articleTitle: Surrogates Aided Constrained Optimization Design for a Crude Oil Distillation Unit
abstract: Crude oil distillation is one of the most economical separation processes in the petroleum refinery industry. In this work, a novel optimization-based design methodology, termed as Surrogates Aided Constrained Optimization Design (SACOD), is proposed for time-consuming objectives and constraints in the evolutionary optimization design of Crude oil Distillation Units (CDUs). By constructing global and local surrogate column models of the CDUs to maximize economic profits, a constraint-handling optimizer is used for infilling operations and optimization search. The framework of SACOD consists of Surrogate Models Construction, Model Management, and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) Mixed-Integer Constrained Evolutionary (PSO-MICE) search. The optimization results of the CDUs indicate that SACOD outperforms the single surrogate column model based approaches. Besides, the results of the proposed method are more consistent with that of the rigorous CDU model optimization approach, whereas the evaluation numbers of the time-consuming rigorous models can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic MPPT Algorithm Based on Wolf Pack Algorithm
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm for photovoltaic power generation system, the convergence speed is slow, the accuracy of the optimal solution is low, the adaptability is not high when the light changes, and the power oscillation amplitude is relatively large when the light changes suddenly. This paper proposes to apply the wolf swarm algorithm (WPA) to the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control of photovoltaic power generation systems to improve the convergence capability and reduce the power fluctuations of the MPPT system. Simulations based on Matlab/Simulink are carried out under uniform illumination and sudden illumination changes, and the simulations show that the WPA method used in this paper has better operation effect compared with the particle swarm algorithm.

articleTitle: A Transformation of Old Diesel Generator Set Based on Internet of Things
abstract: Diesel generator sets are commonly used in all aspects of production and life. However, there are a lot of old-fashioned diesel generator sets that cannot be controlled remotely, which can’t meet the growing unmanned and intelligent demand. This paper introduces a solution of renovation based on the Internet of Things (IoT). A control box including a generator control module (produced by SmartGen company, located in Zhengzhou, China), a PLC (design by Mitsubishi company) and a speed control unit is designed to monitor and control the status of the generator set. The Modbus protocol was used for transmitting measurement data and commands and a user interface was developed in the Kingview configuration software. Field trials were conducted at two sites over 40 kilometers apart and the results met the design objective.

articleTitle: Multiframe Super-resolution Reconstruction Based on Information Fusion
abstract: Multiframe super-resolution reconstruction (SRR) can obtain higher resolution images regardless of limitations of physical sensors, which is widely applied in various fields. Most of the existing algorithms solve the under-determined SRR problem by adding prior information, of which the accuracy easily affects the quality of obtained high-resolution (HR) images. A SRR process through information fusion is proposed in this paper based on multiple low-resolution (LR) images with half-pixel displacements. HR images are generated by fusing the low-frequency estimation and extracted high-frequency information, and the optimal fusion factor are obtained resorting to one-dimensional search. The proposed process realizes more realistic image reconstruction due to the extraction of accurate HR gradient information instead of possibly inaccurate prior information and achieves excellent performance in objective quality. The simulation results show the proposed method achieved improvements of up to 9.2 dB, 18.1% and 7.9% in noise level, structure and feature indicators, respectively.

articleTitle: Spectrogram-based Aging Assessment for Insulations on Stator Coil Bar
abstract: Based on four kinds of spectrograms, this paper studies how to effectively predict the age of insultations on stator coil bar. The prediction of using time can guide the assessment of stator coil bar. In this work, some samples with different ages and temperatures of epoxy insulations are generated in an accelerated aging test. Then the microscopic morphology spectrograms are obtained for the samples. We use the histogram of oriented gradient (HOG) and gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) to extract the features of the spectrograms. Finally, support vector machine (SVM) is used to classify and predict the using time of samples based on HOG and GLCM features. This method with accuracy 90.3333% on the classification and prediction for the age of insulations on stator coil bar.

articleTitle: Distributed Reduced Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
abstract: Extreme learning machines (ELM) are popular in the field of pattern recognition and machine learning. The kernel extension of ELM (KELM) presents a better performance than traditional ELM. Although the KELM is able to solve complex nonlinear problems, it is time-consuming and memorydemanding when dealing with a large-size kernel matrix. Introducing reduced kernel technique can dramatically cut down the computational load and memory usage. However, as the amount of training data grows exponentially, it is not effective for a single worker to store the kernel matrix, making it infeasible for data mining in a centralized manner. In this paper, a distributed reduced kernel method for training ELM over decentralized data (DRKELM) is proposed. In the DRKELM, we randomly assign data to different nodes. The communication between nodes is fixed and does not depend on the size of the training data on each node, but on the network topology. Different from the existing reduced kernel ELM, the DRKELM is a fully distributed training algorithm based on the method of alternating direction method of multiplier (ADMM). Experiment with the large scale data set finds that the distributed method can achieve almost the same results as the centralized algorithm and even takes less time to a large extent. It greatly reduces the computation time consumption.

articleTitle: Research On Audio Denoising Algorithm Of Power Generation Equipment In Thermal Power Plant Based On SGN
abstract: The power generation equipment of thermal power plants, especially the transfer equipment, will produce special noises when the operation fails. This type of sound can be used as an important basis for identifying the operating status of the equipment. However, the environment in the factory is noisy, and the audio data is seriously interfered by noise. Therefore, an SGN-based audio denoising algorithm is designed to remove the serious noise interference in the factory. First, perform Laplace transform on the audio signal, and extract the signal features in the complex frequency domain; then use the SGN network for denoising processing to remove the energy component of the noise. Experiments show that this algorithm has strong resilience to audio signals mixed into common noise models, and it also has obvious suppression of actual noise signals in the factory.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Feature Selection and Combination Method of Aerospace Target Based on K-means Clustering and Information Entropy
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of K-means clustering analysis algorithm, such as unable to effectively suppress noise features in high-dimensional data and difficult to solve irregular shape clustering, a classification selection method based on K-means clustering and information entropy for multi-dimensional target feature information is proposed. In this method, the information content of characteristic samples contained in information entropy is used as the evaluation distance instead of the traditional Euclidean distance. And combined with the time domain, the aggregation degree and diversity degree are defined to objectively reflect and measure the initial value of feature sample sets and the similarity measure among feature sets, so as to get rid of the serious dependence on the initial value problem and the computational redundancy problem. The simulation results show that the calculation process is more intuitive and clearer, and because the calculation process is relatively simple, the calculation amount is small, and the timeliness is good.

articleTitle: A Shallow Spiking Neural Network for P300 Classification
abstract: P300 is widely used in brain-computer interface (BCI) systems due to its high bit rates. Fast and accurate classification of P300 is the key to ensure the performance of P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI). In this paper, a shallow spiking neural network (SNN) model based on ANN-to-SNN method is proposed for P300 detection. Firstly, a shallow convolutional neural network (CNN) is pre-trained, and then its weight is transferred to the equivalent SNN for final recognition. The effect of the model is verified based on the public dataset provided by ITBA University. We compare the accuracy of CNN and SNN on the test dataset. The results show that equivalent SNN shows the comparable performance as the CNN, which proves the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring for Capacitors in Superbuck Converter through LSTM Neural Network
abstract: The power converter plays an important role in the power system of spacecraft, which directly influences the operation of the electronic system. Among the failure reasons in power converter, aluminum electrolytic capacitor (AEC) is one of the most age-effected components. The machine learning method can fully utilize the data mining capability and save the monitoring cost. This paper proposes a health monitoring method for capacitors in superbuck converter through LSTM neural network. Firstly, the operating mechanism of superbuck converter is introduced. The capacitance (C) and equivalent series resistance (ESR) will degenerate within the degradation process. Through Monte Carlo analysis, the influences of capacitor aging are also demonstrated. With the consideration of converter characteristics, a long short term memory (LSTM) neural network is utilized to monitor the health condition of two AECs. Finally, the simulation experiments are carried out to validate the proposed health monitoring method. In comparison with the back propagation (BP) network, the proposed method can achieve better performances.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of continuous time positive switched systems with unstable subsystems
abstract: The stability problem of continuous time positive switched systems composed of unstable subsystems is investigated. By taking advantage of the invariant subspace theory and an assumption, the sufficient stability criteria for positive switched systems with designed periodic switching is presented. Besides, a necessary condition is also proposed with certain hypothesis. Finally, numerical examples are given.

articleTitle: Modeling and verification of Industrial Microservice Architecture Based on Formal Methods
abstract: The microservice architecture has become the mainstream technology of industrial applications development in the Industrial Internet Platform. The test and verification of microservice architecture is the guarantee of industrial application credibility. By analyzing the microservice architecture of industrial applications, this paper proposes an application interface tree model method, which is used to model and verify the microservice architecture. Application Interface Tree supports characterization of the attributes and interactions of microservices, on which the static and dynamic models of microservice architecture can be established respectively. The relationship between microservices and running environment can be expressed by static model, while the dynamic model reflects the interface invocation between microservices. The correctness of the interaction between the model interfaces can be defined by the state transition diagram. Then the correctness of the microservice architecture can be proved by the model detection algorithm. In this paper, an industrial application is modeled, and the Application Interface Tree Model is used for model detection. The results verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Automatic generation control of wind turbines based on pitch angle changes
abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power in the power system, automatic generation control of wind turbines is required to ensure the stable operation of power systems. This paper proposes an automatic generation control of wind turbines based on pitch angle changes. First, the operation characteristics of wind turbines are analyzed. Second, the automatic generation control of wind turbines based on pitch angle changes is determined. For variable pitch actuator modeling, the physical model of the hydraulic variable pitch actuator is used instead of the simple first-order mathematical model to close to the real systems. Finally, numerical examples are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The New Compact Continuously Variable Transmission
abstract: The reducer is widely used in a variety of machinery, which has the function of reducing speed and increasing torque. But due to the expensive price and complex processing technology of the traditional harmonic reducer and RV reducer, the application of the two transmission in the robotics is limited.The reducer discussed in this article is specially for robot thanks to its compact structure which is based on the nested structure. In this paper, the special structure of the reducer will be analyzed which is composed by V-belt transmission and planetary gear train transmission.To realize its function of continuously variable transmission more convenient, a hydraulic system has been established and its function has been tested.

articleTitle: Interference Suppression Analysis of Preparing Gravity Gradient Reference Map in Frequency Domain
abstract: Frequency domain and spatial domain are two common methods for calculating gravity gradient from gravity anomalies. Compared with the spatial domain method, the frequency domain preparation of the gravity gradient reference map has the advantages of simple calculation, high efficiency, easy field conversion, and no edge loss, but it will introduce high- frequency interference. This paper proposes a frequency domain transform method that introduces cosine transform into Fourier transform—Fourier cosine transform method. Based on the gravity anomaly data, the six-component gravity gradient reference maps are derived by Fourier transform, cosine transform, and the mentioned Fourier cosine transform method. The preparation effects of the three sets of gravity gradient reference maps are compared. At the same time, the power spectrum density is used to analyze the interference suppression effects of the three methods. The reference maps of the gravity gradient obtained by the three methods show that Fourier method and the Fourier cosine transform method have similar features, and the latter method has superior interference suppression effects. Cosine transform will cause edge information loss and information offset. The result of power spectrum density also shows that the proposed Fourier cosine transform method has the best interference suppression effect.

articleTitle: SiamTD: Siamese twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient for rubust Object Tracking
abstract: In the last decades, many different algorithms have been proposed to visual tracking. New trends showed that demonstrations of an agent trained by reinforcement learning can be efficiently used in visual tracking. Inspired by those achievements, we propose a novel tracking net SiameseTD(Twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient) which combines the advantages of Siamese framework and reinforcement learning. Different from previous trackers based on Reinforcement learning, the TD algorithm we used builds on a double Q-learning net, by taking the minimum value between a pair of critics to limit over estimation problem of Q-value in the actor-critic methods. The novelty of our method is that we introduce the reinforcement learning algorithm TD into visual tracking and combine the advantages of Siamese framework. Experiments on most benchmarks show that the our tracker performs favorably better than many state-of-arts trackers.

articleTitle: Hopf Bifurcation of A Kaldor-Kalecki Business Cycle Model with Variable Depreciation Rate and Diffusion Effect
abstract: A Kaldor-Kalecki business cycle model with variable depreciation rate and diffusion effect is proposed in this study. Nowadays, most present researches about Kaldor-Kalecki model regard the depreciation rate as constant. However, in practical business cycle model, depreciation rate is variable and related to many aspects. The paper further considers the impact of the gross product on depreciation rate, which describes actual economic model more accurately. The local stability at equilibrium point and the existence of Hopf bifurcation are analyzed. It is obtained that the dynamic behaviors depend on the critical value of bifurcation. Moreover, some conditions to ensure the stability and some criteria of Hopf bifurcation are obtained. Finally, examples and simulations are given to illustrate the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing of Microgrid Based on Typical Monthly Data
abstract: Isolated microgrid plays an important role in solving the problems of energy provide in remote districts or islands. The paper uses typical monthly data to optimize sizing of isolated microgrid. This paper establishes an optimization model with the minimum total cost including initial investment, replacement and operation-maintenance cost. The model includes constraints such as output power of each device, load loss rate, renewable energy penetration rate and so on. Typical monthly data of renewable energy and load demand are obtained through the comprehensive evaluation index. Genetic algorithm solves the model. This case studies are done and the results show that the method proposed in paper can ensure the reliability of power supply, as well as improve the utilization of wind and light resources in this isolated microgrid.

articleTitle: Ball mill load control based on model free adaptive integral sliding mode control
abstract: For the problem of ball mill load control of cement combined grinding system, the diagonal regression neural network (DRNN) is used to describe its mathematical model, and the model free adaptive integral sliding mode control (MFA-ISMC) method is applied to control the ball mill load. Firstly, the system with input delay is transformed into the system with implicit expression of delay link by introducing a discrete-time predictor. The nonlinear system is linearized dynamically based on the concept of pseudo partial derivative (PPD). Then the integral sliding surface is designed and the equivalent control law is obtained. In order to enhance the robustness of the system, a switching control law is designed and used as the control law of the system together with the equivalent control law. Finally, the effectiveness, superiority and robustness of the method are verified by simulation which comparison with PID and model free adaptive control (MFAC) methods.

Author Keywords: Model free adaptive integral sliding mode control

articleTitle: Accessing the Environmental Cognition Ability of Drivers for Intelligent Vehicles Using Brain-inspired Grid Cell Model
abstract: Even driving in the same environment, different drivers may perform differently for encoding the spatial information of environment, which implies different environmental cognition ability (ECA) among drivers. To assess such kind of ECA, a brain-inspired computational grid cell model is used to mimic the neuronal activation in the driver’s brain when driving. Based on the generated activation result, the activation map, some analyses are conducted to assess ECAs of different divers. A typical parking lot is selected for the case study and the data are collected from a driving simulator. The experimental results finally demonstrate the activation difference among the drivers with different ECAs, indicating that the potential of applying grid cell model to assess the ECA of drivers, which will contribute to the development of the brain-like adaptive advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) from the perspective of spatial cognition.

articleTitle: Reentry trajectory planning and guidance method with no-fly zone constraints
abstract: To address the reentry guidance problem of a lifting reentry vehicle that simultaneously satisfies typical path constraints, terminal conditions and no-fly zone constraints, a trajectory planning and guidance method based on artificial potential field and drag acceleration profile is proposed. In the longitudinal profile, a drag acceleration profile tracking guidance is used to calculate the bank angle magnitude that satisfies the flight range. In the lateral profile, an improved artificial potential field method is used to obtain the heading angle corridor, which can determine the sign of bank angle and guide the lifting reentry vehicle to avoid the no-fly zone and sudden threats. The results show that the proposed algorithm is effective to address the reentry guidance problem with no-fly zone constraints.

articleTitle: A Mobile Robotic System for Data Center Thermal Environment Measurement and Reconstruction
abstract: Data centers are the key infrastructure for information services. The monitoring of the thermal environment of the data center computer room is an important work for its safe operation. This paper proposed a mobile robotic system for data center thermal environment measurement, which can freely sample the temperature and humidity data around the facilities within the computer room. On one hand, measuring the temperature and humidity in a mobile way can obtain far more environmental data than fixed-point sensors. On the other hand, the mobile robot can be used instead of manual inspection. In addition, a temperature field reconstruction method is provided based on the sampled temperature data. Theoretically, the temperature of locations that have not been measured can be evaluated by interpolating sample temperature around them. The reconstruction of the temperature field can present the variation of the temperature more clearly and help find the hot spots or locations with low cooling efficiency during the operation. Lastly, experiments are carried out to study the measurement error of the mobile robotic system and an error correction method is proposed. After that, the relationship between the temperature reconstruction error and the layout of sampling points is investigated.

articleTitle: Robustness of Systems with Undirected Graph Under Jamming Attack: A Game-theoretic Approach
abstract: In this aper, based on game theory, a cyber security problem, formulated as a network robustness problem is considered. The H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> norm of the consensus dynamics with undirected communication graph, is related to the effective resistance of the graph, which is used as the objective function of the game. The defender protects single edge from being removed whereas the attacker attempts to remove it. Due to the computational complexity of exhaustive search, an approximate search strategy is introduced. Some numerical examples are presented to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: Initial pose estimation and update during robot path planning loop
abstract: This paper presents a modified path planning algorithm with time spent monitoring of searching loop, estimating initial pose of ego-vehicle and updating reference global path. Modified reference path can be well-used by trajectory tracking module. The advantages of our proposed algorithm are attributed to strict monitor of time spent in path search loop, estimation and update of initial pose and reference path. Monitor of time spent ensures that abnormal information will be detected and reported when desired planning frequency is not reachable because of too much unexpected time spent on path searching. Experiments confirm that our proposed modification shows no obvious extra cost on time spent of the whole algorithm, and significantly decrease distance error between initial pose of reference path and robot actual pose in different scenarios.

articleTitle: IoT Technology Application in Smart Energy Meter System
abstract: Along with the trend of technology development and steps into the information era, the concept of "Internet of Everything" and "Information-Exchanging" is applied in all the aspects of life, more convenience and better operation experience are brought to people by the intelligent and automatic electrical product. Electricity power supply is the foundation of production and living, the development of its management system is moving fast altogether with the innovation of the IoT technology, IoT technology is widely applied on the smart meter-the terminal of electricity management, the difference between the varies of IoT technology provides multiple choice for the system planning, to adapt comprehensive circumstances, to guarantee the stability of electricity power supply, minimize the energy loss and enhance the energy service efficiency.

articleTitle: A memetic algorithm for the balanced minimum sum-of-squares clustering problem
abstract: The balanced minimum sum-of-squares clustering problem (BMSSC) is an important combinatorial optimization problem with many applications. The goal of this problem is to divide N data points in Euclidean space into K clusters such that the sizes of clusters differ at most by one. In this paper, we propose a memetic algorithm (denoted by MABMSSC) for the BMSSC problem. The algorithm employs an iterated variable neighborhood search algorithm (IVNS) as its local optimization method and a crossover operator to generate the offspring solutions. The experimental results on a number of benchmark instances show that the proposed algorithm is very efficient in terms of solution-quality. In particular, the proposed algorithm obtains a better solution compared with the best performing algorithm in the literature for many instances tested.

articleTitle: Adaptive Terminal Sliding Mode Guidance Law with Impact Angle Constraint
abstract: A finite-time convergent guidance law with impact angle constraint based on adaptive estimation of target maneuver is proposed for end-guidance interception under unknown target maneuver interference conditions Firstly, the impact angle constraint is converted into a terminal line-of-sight angle constraint, and a design method of the terminal sliding mode guidance law is given based on the finite-time convergence property of the terminal sliding mode. Secondly, an adaptive law is designed to estimate the upper bound of the target maneuvering acceleration. Finally the finite-time convergence property of the guidance law is proved based on Lyapunov stability theory, and the effectiveness of the guidance law in various interception scenarios is verified by mathematical simulation.

articleTitle: Pre-trained Language Model based Medical Named Entity Recognition
abstract: Medical named entity recognition is an important part of structuring Chinese electronic medical records and construction of medical knowledge graph. The CCKS2019 conference organized a medical named entity recognition evaluation task to extract six types of medical entities from unstructured Chinese electronic medical records. Based on the data set of this evaluation task, pre-trained language model based entity recognition approaches are studied. First, select the BiLSTM-CRF model based on random initialized word embedding as the baseline system; secondly, apply word2vec to the baseline system; thirdly, apply ELMo to the baseline system. Experimental results show that the pre-trained language model is comparable to the best approach of this evaluation task, and the context-related pre-trained language model performs better.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Based on ETM for Nonlinear CPSs under DoS Attacks
