Since most complex engineering design problems rely on time-consuming simulation calculations, the two-level robust optimization may become computationally expensive. In order to solve this problem, an incremental Kriging multi-objective robust optimization algorithm based on the fast Kriging surrogate model(IKA-MORO) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, we introduce an incremental learning based fast Kriging modeling approach. Combining the Kriging models, we propose a model management strategy for the two-level robust optimization framework, and then, a new infill criterion to improve the approximate accuracy of the surrogate models is proposed. The results of the benchmarks show that IKA-MORO can effectively reduce the computational cost for the most of the complex multi-objective robust optimization problems.

articleTitle: Rateless Codes for Reliable and Secure Packet Transmission in Industrial Control Systems
abstract: With the growing digitalization of industry and stronger demand for interconnection between people, machines and products in future smart factory and cloud control scenarios, wireless communication technology is thriving and shows tremendous advantages in terms of flexibility, versatility, usability and efficiency. Nonetheless, wireless communication still faces great challenges on communication reliability and security under certain use cases. Most traditional methods focus on hardware like communication devices to enhance communication reliability. Therefore, these methods are less configurable and lacks ease of use. This paper provides a universal methodology on enhancing reliability and security of data transmission by applying fountain code encoding on applications, regardless of hardware configuration. Then, an overall comparison is given on several fountain code schemes in terms of complexity, security, robustness, adaptivity and extensibility.

articleTitle: Development of GPU Enhanced AI Education Platforms for K-12 Schools
abstract: Recently, with continuous implementation of education reform, AI (Artificial Intelligence) has been included in K-12 (Kindergarten to 12th grade) curricula and AI education is in full swing in China. However, standard, cost-efficient AI education platforms for K-12 schools are still not available. So in this paper, based on Jetson Nano, we developed a GPU-enhanced AI teaching platform including AI learning computers for students to develop AI-related algorithms and applications, AI computer clusters for whole classes, and modular auto-driving cars to run and test algorithms and applications.

articleTitle: A Topology Control Algorithm Based on Minimum Spanning Tree for Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: Aiming at the topology control problem of wireless sensor networks, a topology generation algorithm based on minimum spanning tree (MST) is proposed, and the calculation complexity of the algorithm is analyzed. Compared with the existing algorithms, this algorithm can generate the optimally topology which is in shorter time. Finally, the effectiveness and efficiency of the algorithm is further verified by comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Localization of coal mine rescue robots based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract: This paper investigates the multi-sensor fusion positioning problem coal mine rescue robots to deal with the complex catastrophic underground environment subject to poor illumination and slippery road. A multi-sensor fusion positioning system is designed by combining lidar, IMU, and wheel encoder and a multi-sensor fusion positioning method is proposed based on extended Kalman filter with fuzzy confidence. By the proposed method, the wheel slip can be described and used to regulate the confidence level of the wheel odometry information in the fusion positioning system in real-time, and change the covariance matrix dynamically to improve the adaptability of the system to the subterranean environment and enhance the positioning accuracy. The experimental results show that the system is suitable for underground positioning, and the proposed positioning algorithm is of higher accuracy than the conventional single sensor positioning methods and the extended Kalman filter fusion positioning methods.

Author Keywords: extended Kalman filter with fuzzy confidence

articleTitle: Object Pose Estimation for UAV Navigation Using an End-to-end Lightweight CNN
abstract: This paper investigates the feasibility of using an end-to-end lightweight convolutional neural network to estimate object pose for the micro unmanned aerial vehicles. While the deep learning methods have achieved great successes in object detection, tracking, segmentation, etc., only a few solutions in state-of-the-art methods are designed to estimate object pose. In this work, we propose a lightweight uncalibrated neural network that directly estimates the 4-DoF gate pose from UAV uncalibrated monovision. The proposed method is trained and tested in Gazebo simulation and on a micro racing drone equipped with an Intel UP board computer. The experimental results in both simulation and real-world flying demonstrated that the proposed method could provide the UAV a coarse pose of a gate for its dynamic path planning.

articleTitle: Dynamic Incremental Rough K-means Clustering Considering the Spatial Location Distribution of Newly Added Data Points
abstract: Aiming at the inefficiency of traditional clustering algorithms in processing dynamic incremental data and ignoring the unreasonable division of newly added data points caused by the imbalance of cluster size, a dynamic incremental rough K-means clustering considering the spatial location distribution of newly added data points is proposed. In the process of clustering, the spatial location distribution of newly added data is considered into the algorithm. Besides, the degree of membership based on the imbalance of the cluster size can be dynamically adjusted by our algorithm in each update iteration. Experimental results show that the algorithm can correctly divide the newly added data points.

articleTitle: A Mixed Integer Programming Approach for the Resilience-Oriented Train Rescheduling Optimization in Railway Networks
abstract: Rail traffic control has received increasing attention in recent years, due to the destructive disruptions caused by floods, fires and equipment failures, etc. In this paper, we propose a resilience-oriented train rescheduling framework, which helps the rail transit system recover to the normal state as soon as possible in case of disruptions. Specifically, we first construct an event-activity network, in which the arrival and departure of trains are modeled as a set of events. Several groups of decision variables and linear constraints are denoted to model the rescheduling of trains. Considering the use of short-turning train rescheduling strategy and additional backup trains, we then formulate the problem into a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model, where the objective is to minimize the total delay time of trains against disruptions. Finally, numerical experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Eddy Current Probe Coil Based on COMSOL Finite Element Method
abstract: To study the influence of excitation frequency, lift-off distance and coil geometry size on the electromagnetic characteristics of eddy current probe in the process of eddy current testing, different coil models were established by COMSOL finite element simulation software based on the principle of eddy current testing. The simulation results show that the impedance of the eddy current probe rises with the increase of the inner and outer radius of the probe coil and the decrease of the height. The larger the inner and outer radius and the lower the height are, the higher the sensitivity of the eddy current probe is, and the more obvious the impact of the excitation frequency on the sensitivity of the eddy current probe is. The findings can provide a certain reference for the reasonable determination of excitation frequency and lift-off distance, and provide theoretical guidance for the optimal design of probe structure as well.

articleTitle: A Robust Multi-Object Tracking SLAM System in Dynamic Scenes for Stereo and RGB-D Cameras
abstract: Traditional visual SLAM systems mainly focus on localization and mapping in static environments, which might fail in highly dynamic environments. Most existing dynamic SLAM algorithms choose to remove the objects simply, and then lead to the loss of object motion information that is helpful for localization and navigation. This paper proposes a real-time multi-object tracking SLAM system for stereo and RGB-D cameras, exploiting instance segmentation information to perform localization and track the dynamic objects in highly dynamic environments. To more accurately distinguish between dynamic and static regions in the image, we present a region growing based method fusing the segmentation results with the depth images and a moving object judgement strategy. Furthermore, a novel model-free method is used to estimate the speeds and motion trajectories of dynamic objects. Extensive experiments are conducted on some stereo and RGB-D datasets to verify the presented system in the performance of self-localization, object tracking, and mapping.

articleTitle: Generation and Control of Color Flame Image Based on GAN
abstract: In order to improve the shortcomings of current flame image generation methods based on coding control, this paper proposes to describe the flame shape by the flame height and width, and generate corresponding color rectangles in advance according to the flame height and width. This approach converts the encoding into a more informative graph as a conditional input to the generator. The experiment shows that the flame height and width can be improved effectively by controlling the generated flame in graphic form. The IOU of flame achieves 0.906 and the authenticity achieves 91.4%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Infrared Image Preprocessing System based on FPGA
abstract: Infrared image processing is a conventional topic, but the hardware design and implementation for infrared image processing algorithms are full of challanges, especially for special purpose infrared detectors which have customized interfaces and protocols. Moreover, some customized infrared detectors only generate the infrared image with very poor quality. Therefore, in this paper, we design and implement an infrared image preprocessing system based on FPGA for customized infrared detectors. We propose a hardware architecture that includes the whole process from the input of detector, image processing, to final infrared video stream output and display. Our hardware architecture is able to adapt to different customized infrared detectors, which has the characteristics of real-time, low-power, dynamic parameter configuration, high processing efficiency and stable imaging effect. We have implemented it on Xilinx FPGA. The infrared imaging effect is significantly improved with limited FPGA resources (about only 1.6M LUT, 420 BRAM for all algorithm models on Xilinx zc706 evaluation board), the image processing speed can reach to 225Hz with the resolution of 320*256. Our preprocessing system can generate real-time video for display with 1920*1080@60Hz.

articleTitle: VAVRP: A Verification Architecture for Vehicle Routing Problem
abstract: Vehicle routing problem is a hot issue in the field of logistics distribution. We propose a verification architecture named VAVRP for vehicle routing problem. VAVRP provides researchers with a modular and extensible framework for vehicle routing problem. The framework is a BSD-licensed Python library. VAVRP includes four extensible and modifiable modules: initialization module, inter-routes neighborhood operator module, intra-routes neighborhood operator module, local search module. We conduct experiments on CMT, which consists of fourteen capacitated vehicle routing problem instances. Our experiments indicate that VAVRP performs significantly better than Google OR-Tools, which is a well-known open-source solver. VAVRP will be open-source at https://github.com/chaoranli20/VAVRP.

articleTitle: Predictive Sliding Mode Control with Extended State Observer for the High-Speed Vehicles
abstract: Considering the strong nonlinearity, fast time-varying and strong coupling dynamic characteristics of the high-speed vehicles (HSV), combining with the fact that the extended state observer (ESO) can effectively observe the total disturbance of the system and the predictive sliding mode controller (PSMC) has strong robustness and the ability to reduce chattering, a predictive sliding mode control method with extended state observer is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the HSV model is simplified for the attack angle control; Secondly, the tracking sliding mode surface is predicted and the sliding mode control law is derived by using the optimized performance index, which will avoid the switching function and reduce chattering effectively; Thirdly, a linear extended state observer (LESO) is designed to observe the parameters perturbation and the total disturbances of the system, the estimated value is compensated into the PSMC. Fourthly, the numerical simulation shows that the PSMC with LESO can track the step instruction of angle of attack stably even if there are parameters deviations and external composite disturbances. In addition, the control amount does not exceed the rudder deflection angle of the actuator, and the chatter phenomenon is effectively alleviated.

articleTitle: Design of ADRC Based on MPGA Parameters Self-tuning for Guidance System
abstract: The high-speed maglev train guidance system is an important device for the offset between the train and the track to ensure the safe driving of the train. In the process of operation, the interferences of guidance system are complex and changeable. In order to improve the tracking ability and anti-interference ability for gap change, this paper designs an Active Disturbance Rejection Controller (ADRC) for the guidance system of high-speed maglev train. To solve the problem of that parameters tuning of ADRC is complex and it is difficult to achieve good control effect by manual tuning, a parameter optimization method based on Multi Population Genetic Algorithm (MPGA) is proposed to intelligently tune the parameters of ADRC. The simulation results show that the parameters adjusted by the intelligent algorithm can make the ADRC have better control performance.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Safety Management in the Construction of Offshore Wind Farms
abstract: In order to implement the safety development thought of General Secretary Jin Ping that "life is at stake, development must not be at the expense of human life, this must be an insurmountable red line", strengthen the management responsibilities of personnel at all levels, and improve the safety awareness of operators. Reduce operational risks and implement the norms of the infrastructure intrinsic safety system. For offshore wind power, the current infrastructure construction site has complex construction conditions and high operational risks. Safety accidents are prone to occur frequently, safety risk control is not in place, there are many hidden safety hazards in field operations, and the safety management problems of contracting (sub- )contracting are more prominent. Some personnel have insufficient safety awareness, insufficient management capabilities and management methods, and insufficient implementation of main responsibilities. On the basis of inheriting safety production management, the innovative ideas for on-site operation safety management of offshore wind power infrastructure are proposed to realize a new model of infrastructure safety management. And through the development of the offshore construction safety management execution platform, the system and standards are implemented, the management chain is opened, and the safety management of all participating construction units on the site is unified into the management of the owner, forming an overall linkage mechanism. Wake up their safety awareness, follow the safety formula of "safe operation = create and maintain safety-level operating conditions + zero human error", and build a software platform with awakening workers’ safety awareness as the core and implementation of safety management system specifications as the main content. A new mode of on-site safety management and control of offshore wind power construction infrastructure as a management tool.

articleTitle: Research on Estimation and Precise Control of Wheel Cylinder Pressure for Integrated Electronic Hydraulic Brake System
abstract: This paper proposes a wheel cylinder pressure estimation and precise control strategy for an integrated electronic hydraulic brake system. Based on the Bernoulli equation and the P-V characteristics of the wheel cylinder, the estimated wheel cylinder pressure can be obtained. The wheel cylinder pressure control algorithm adjusts the pressure according to the relationship between the difference between the target wheel cylinder pressure and the estimated wheel cylinder pressure and the set threshold. To improve the robustness of the control algorithm, RBF-PID is used to design the solenoid valve controller. Finally, it was verified by MATLAB/Simulink and AMESim co-simulation. The test results show that the pressure estimation error and the steady-state control error are within 1bar and 1.8bar, respectively, which verifies the effectiveness of the strategy.

Author Keywords: wheel cylinder pressure estimation and control

articleTitle: Mechanical Parts Detection Algorithm Based on Enhanced Faster R-CNN
abstract: Industrial target detection has been a popular field of target detection, because it can improve the efficiency of industrial production intuitively. Many scholars at home and abroad have achieved many research results till now, but there are still some limitations in the traditional algorithms. Many algorithms can only adapt to the industrial manufacturing conditions partially, and cannot be applied well when changing to another industrial environment. Deep learning has exploded in popularity in the field of target detection during the last several years, but its application to industrial target detection is not mature. We postulate an enhanced Faster R-CNN-based industrial target localization algorithm for mechanical parts in this research. We constructed our own mechanical parts dataset by shooting sampling, and improved Faster R-CNN target detection algorithm in five aspects. The target detection model was trained by migration learning. The experimental findings showed that our industrial target identification method based on enhanced Faster R-CNN outperforms the classic VGG16 Faster R-CNN model and Resnet50 Faster R-CNN model in terms of target detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Bifurcation Analysis of a Ring-Hub-Shaped Neural Network With (n + 1) Neurons and Multiple Delays
abstract: In this paper, we concern about the local stability and Hopf bifurcation on a class of high-dimensional ring-hub-structured neural networks. Firstly, the associated characteristic equation of system is obtained by the Coates formula. Then, by taking the time delay as the bifurcation parameter, the sufficient conditions ensuring the local stability and the occurrence of Hopf bifurcation of system are derived. Finally, the theoretical results are validated by the numerical simulations. It is found that the time delay can heavily affect the dynamics of proposed system. In addition, the onset of Hopf bifurcation is closely related to the number of neurons.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Backstepping Sliding Mode Control Strategy for Single-phase Grid-Connected Inverter System under Weak Grid
abstract: To overcome the adverse effect of uncertainty and external disturbance on the quality of grid-tied current in LCL-type single-phase grid-connected inverter system under weak grid, a novel adaptive backstepping sliding mode control (ABSMC) strategy is proposed. Firstly, the imprecise dynamic mathematical model of the single-phase grid-tied inverter system with uncertainties is established. And then to overcome the shortcoming that traditional backstepping control relies on accurate model, this method is combined with another method with strong robustness to realize the global stability of the system and have strong robustness to the uncertainties in the system. Furthermore, in order to weaken the chattering phenomenon of SMC, the adaptive control is embedded in backstepping sliding mode control to adjust the switching gain value in real time. The experimental results show that the proposed control method is robust to the changes of filter parameters and grid impedance. In addition, the third-order LCL inverter system is divided into three subsystems to gradually design the virtual control input, which makes the design process simple, and this nested design process ensures the asymptotic stability of the whole system.

articleTitle: Instance Segmentation of Overlapping Cervical Cells Based on Boundary Tracking
abstract: The segmentation of cervical cell images with overlapping cells is a challenging topic. To solve this difficulty, this paper proposes a cell segmentation method by tracking the boundary for each cell based on the Semantic segmentation result. Inspired by the idea of target tracking to find the position of target in each frame, we try to find the radius of cell contour in each angle . First, use a improved U-net network to divide image pixels into cell nucleus, cytoplasm, background, and overlapping areas to achieve cell semantic segmentation. Then, use each cell nucleus as center to track the boundary point in different angle and finally get the cell contour. The experimental results show that the method in this paper can segment overlapping cervical cells effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Configuration of Electric Push Ship Energy Storage System
abstract: In order to improve the output of the energy storage device in the electric propulsion ship and make the diesel generator always work at the working point with high fuel efficiency, the capacity of the diesel generator and the energy storage device is optimized. Based on the analysis of the power demand of the whole ship and the output of the diesel generator under different working conditions, the power distribution rule of both the corresponding energy storage device and the diesel generator as the main power supply is proposed, and the calculation method of the capacity configuration is designed with the aim of optimizing the fuel efficiency and the capacity of the energy storage device. The results show that under the condition of meeting the normal sailing requirements of the ship, the energy storage device can be used to replace one diesel engine, and diesel engine always works at the working point with high fuel efficiency, and the fuel consumption can be reduced by 4.6%. The research results can provide reference for promoting the green of electric propulsion ship.

articleTitle: Bi-modal Emotion Recognition via Broad Learning System
abstract: With the growing service robot market, emotion recognition has attracted more and more attention in both academia and industry. Many research works have been done on emotion recognition based on facial expression and/or voice. Very few researches exploited the use of head postures in the emotion recognition algorithms. This is in contrast to the fact that body gestures are used as one of the important indicators of emotional states during our daily interpersonal interaction. In this paper, we investigate the emotional meaning of head postures. Using broad learning system, we have built an emotion recognition model based on features extracted from two modalities: facial expression and head posture. The model is simple in structure and takes much less training time compared to deep-learning algorithms. Experimental results on a public emotional video datasets show that this bi-modal emotion recognition model improves the recognition accuracy of passive emotional states, such as ‘sad’, ’worried’, compared to the BLS model based on single modality of facial expression.

articleTitle: ARISE-Based Cross-Coupling Synchronization Control for a Dual Redundant Hydraulic Actuation System with Extended State Observer
abstract: To realize high precision synchronous trajectory tracking control, a control method combining adaptive robust integral of the sign of the error (ARISE) controller and extended state observer (ESO) is proposed in this paper. Meanwhile, combining with the cross-coupling control method (CCC), Effectively alleviate the problem of force fighting caused by output asynchronization between two actuators. In this paper, two ESOs were constructed to estimate the disturbances of the second channel and the third channel respectively and make feed-forward compensation, so as to further suppress the estimated residuals of ESOs by using ARISE to improve the control precision of the system. The proposed controller can deal with the matched uncertainty and unmatched uncertainty in the system, and theoretically achieves an asymptotically tracking performance. Simulation results show that the ARISEESO+CCC control method proposed in this paper can achieve excellent synchronization performance in two actuators system.

articleTitle: An Improved Object Tracking Algorithm Combining LCT Kernel Correlation Filtering and Kalman Prediction
abstract: In the process of long-time object tracking based on LCT, aiming at the problems of re detection after tracking failure in the case of scale change, background similar interference and severe occlusion, the paper presents a better algorithm based on the combination of LCT kernel correlation filter and Kalman prediction. The Kalman filter is introduced into the re detection module of LCT. When the object tracking fails, the Kalman filter is used to predict the position of the object in the current frame before the re detection. Compared with the original algorithm, it avoids the whole frame image traversal search, reduces the search range of the object, and lower the interference of similar objects in the background. The experimental results show that the improved LCT algorithm has better accuracy and rapidity, and has better tracking performance in the case of object occlusion.

articleTitle: Robustness analysis of scale-free networks against cascading failures with tunable redistribution load parameters
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the robustness properties of scale-free networks against cascading failures, where the parameters of the redistribution load are assumed to be tunable. By analyzing the relation between the critical threshold and the redistribution load parameter, we find that the avalanche size is suppressed when the redistribution load parameter and initial load parameter are both taken to 1. In this case, the scale-free networks reach the strongest robustness level against cascading failures. Numerical experiments confirm our theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Data Backup and Recovery of Distributed Embedded System for Aircrafts
abstract: To ensure system reliability, aircrafts conventionally adopt hardware redundancy in data processing. However, the weakness of this method is wasting of resources and lacking of flexibility. Distributed design of embedded systems can be used to ensure the flexibility of data processing. When system fault occurs, affected applications can be rapidly transferred to the normally functioning embedded system to maintain operational continuity. Leveraging the compilation and linking principles of the source codes of embedded systems, minimal backup of application data can be achieved to reduce the pressure of bus bandwidth, allowing for rapid data backup and recovery when necessary. Three application data backup strategies are proposed to satisfy the requirement of real-timeliness of different applications. A simulation experiment was conducted, where a virtual machine was used to simulate two embedded system nodes to validate data backup and recovery. The experiment results show that when fault occurs on one node, the application can be transferred to the other node and continue to operate within one period.

articleTitle: Novel parafoil guidance with modern multiobjective evolutionary algorithms
abstract: Parafoil system proves to be a superior solution for air-drop applications due to the ability to maneuver through wind field and enable a precise, soft landing. Traditional guidance strategies combine geometrical consideration with the approximated solution of nonlinear differential equations. However, with current hardware/software development, guidance by modern multiobjective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) without assuming any predefined trajectories like Dubins path or S-turn seems promising. With software that implements parafoil landing dynamics and twenty state-of-the-art MOEAs, performances of a 5-second guidance updating strategy are compared against a naive random search. The computational time, distance error, and align angle with wind direction show good landing accuracy and optimal landing angle relative to the wind in the GNC framework of an autonomous parafoil air-drop system. Modern MOEAs have the potential of offering an effective, robust, and affordable autonomous parafoil guidance solution.

articleTitle: A More Efficient Deep-learning Processing Unit Architecture with Runtime Configurable Parallelism
abstract: Typically, the loop dimension varies greatly between the different layers of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). However, the loop dimension’s parallelism degree of most Deep-learning Processing Units (DPUs) is not runtime configurable. It results in low theoretical performance utilization for most high parallelism DPUs. To solve the problem, we propose a new DPU architecture, named Dataflow Driven Multicore Architecture (DDMA). It consists of multiple function cores, and the direction of data flow between them can be configured at runtime by a routing module. This design allows DDMA to improve parallelism degree while maintaining computational efficiency. To verify the property of DDMA, -we designed a Basic-DPU (B-DPU) based on it and obtained the Extended-DPU (E-DPU) by improving the parallelism degree of B-DPU. The experimental results show that the peak performance of B-DPU reaches 512 GOPS, and the computational efficiency reaches 91.9%, -which is 1.69 times that of the peer FPGA implementation under the same test algorithm. The peak performance of E-DPU reaches 1024 GOPS, and the actual performance is 1.96 times that of B-DPU. Meanwhile, its computational efficiency is 90.15%, almost the same as B-DPU.

articleTitle: Anti-swing positioning control for tower cranes based on prescribed performance
abstract: Aiming at the anti-swing positioning control problem of the 4-DOF underactuated tower crane system with external disturbances, a hierarchical sliding mode control method with prescribed performance constraints is proposed. In this method, performance function and error transform function are introduced to constrain the system state error, and then hierarchical sliding mode algorithm is adopted to complete the design of the underactuated control system. By constructing appropriate Lyapunov functions, it is proved that the error signal of the closed-loop system meets the prescribed performance requirements. Simulation results show that the designed hierarchical sliding mode controller with prescribed performance can achieve the dual control objectives of anti-swing positioning with strong robustness, faster convergence rate and higher convergence accuracy.

articleTitle: A state-of-charge uniformity control method for energy storage batteries based on distributed cooperative control
abstract: This paper proposes a state-of-charge equalization control strategy for energy storage battery modules based on distributed cooperative control. In the information layer, the energy storage module is regarded as an agent, and the state of charge (SOC) uniformity problem model is established by multi-agent system cooperative tracking. The distributed communication network between energy storage module modules is described by digraph. With the help of bounded S-like saturation function and based on the nearest neighbor principle, a bounded cooperative state of charge control law with adjustable control gain is designed. Assuming that the digraph contains spanning trees, the asymptotic stability of the whole closed-loop system is proved by Lyapunov Matrix Equation and LaSalle invariant principle. By adopting the method, the discharge of the energy storage module can be controlled based on distributed coordination, the charging state of the module can be synchronously reduced, and the service life and stability of the energy storage power station can be improved.

articleTitle: The 3D localization algorithm of INS/UWB based on PF assisted by LS-SVM
abstract: In indoor positioning, Inertial Navigation System (INS) and Ultra Wide Band (UWB) combined navigation and positioning are generally used instead of Global Position System (GPS) technology.For fusing the INS and UWB data seamlessly, Least Squares Support Vector Machines (LS-SVM) assisted Particle Filter (PF) filtering algorithm is presented in this paper. LS-SVM is used to map each state in the filtering process, and the particle filtering algorithm is used to optimize the navigation model. By using the proposed algorithm, the distance between INS and UWB reference node can be fused, and the measured data of INS can be corrected, and LS-SVM assisted PF filter is more stable. Moreover, an experiment has been done to confirm the proposed scheme. Experimental results indicate that the model designed about LS-SVM assisted PF is efficient to fuse INS and UWB data tightly. By comparison with PF, the proposed algorithm is able to decrease the error of position and add the localization accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Method of Rolling Force for High Strength Steel in Tandem Cold Rolling Mill
abstract: In the general tandem cold rolling process, the deviation of rolling force calculation is quite common. Particularly, when rolling the high strength steel, the rolling force deviation problem would be severe. This paper takes the rolling force calculation model of a CVC rolling mill as the research object, and the main content is to improve the calculation accuracy of actual rolling force. The accuracy of rolling force calculation is improved by combining the neural network model which driven by industrial big data, with the traditional calculation model of rolling force. The experimental results show that the direct combination of data driven and mechanism model can not only raise the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 0.7057, but also improve the accuracy of the model to 0.9974. Finally, it meets the requirements of on-line control.

articleTitle: Memory-Augmented Adaptive Control With Parameter Convergence Guarantee
abstract: A modified concurrent learning adaptive control, named memory-augmented adaptive control, is developed in this paper, which guarantees the convergence of parameter estimates without the requirement of persistent exciting condition and state derivative estimation. A stable low-pass filter is introduced into the error dynamics to filter out the state derivatives, circumventing the estimation of the unmeasurable state derivatives. And, the filtered basis matrix is also used in this adaptive control law to achieve the exponential convergence of the estimation error. Numerical simulations show that the proposed memory-augmented adaptive control performs better in tracking and estimation error convergence, compared to the standard adaptive control.

articleTitle: A hybrid prediction method for SOFC degradation prediction
abstract: The solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) is known as the most hopeful clean energy source in the 21st century due to its higher efficiency and lower pollution, but its performance degradation and durability have become bottlenecks hindering its large-scale commercialization. Accurately predicting the performance degradation trend of SOFC and timely diagnostic failures can maintain and adjust the equipment in advance, which is conducive to extending its service life. Data-driven and model-based both have certain limitations, and they are two traditional prediction methods. This paper proposes a solid oxide fuel cell hybrid prediction method based on the combination of empirical model and data-driven. Model-based prediction can capture the degradation trend of voltage. Data-driven prediction can describe local nonlinear characteristics in the degradation process. Then, according to the dynamically adjusted weight factor, the results predicted by the different methods are merged to get the culminating prediction result. Finally, the experimental results indicate the hybrid prediction method has higher forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: An Improvement of Lion Swarm Optimization by Using Normal Distribution Numbers to Select Cubs Movement Mode
abstract: In the Lion Swarm Optimization (LSO), the lion swarm is divided into three categories: lion king, lionesses, and lion cubs. Among them, the lion cubs have three movement modes: follow the lion king to move (FK), follow the lioness to move (FL), and be expelled as an adult (EA). Uniform random numbers (URN) are used to select a certain movement mode. In the paper, the validity of these uniform random numbers is first analyzed, and the conclusion that the cubs’ movement modes have a certain degree of blindness is drawn. Then, normal distributed random numbers (NDRN) are proposed to optimize the cubs’ movement selection strategy. The main body is effectively highlighted by placing the cubs’ FK movement mode in the central area of the normal distribution curve. Finally, 5 standard test functions and a problem of optimal processing time in Job-shop Scheduling are used to verify the effectiveness of the NDRN selection method. The results are compared with the original URN selection method, the convergence accuracy of optimization is increased.

articleTitle: Diffusion generalized spline nonlinear adaptive filters under Maximum Correntropy Criterion
abstract: Due to complex nonlinearities in general, linear adaptive filter is not suitable, the nonlinear adaptive filter using splines based on minimum mean square error criteria is proposed to identificate nonlinear systems in additive Gaussain noise environment. To address the issues of the more general nonlinear system structure and the addictive non-Gaussain noise environments disturbance, this paper proposes generalized spline nonlinear adaptive filters under maximum correntropy criterion (GSNAF-MCC). Meanwhile, GSNAF-MCC is extended to diffusion networks, resulting in the diffusion GSNAF-MCC (D-GSNAF-MCC). The proposed D-GSNAF-MCC decreases the steady-state error and improves the convergence speed. The simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithms have better performance compared with related SAFs algorithms.

articleTitle: Metro train scheduling optimization for virtual coupling based train control
abstract: As China’s economy grows and urbanization intensifies, interchange pressures on urban rail transport are increasing in parallel, and the capacity of the existing CBTC system is saturated. Therefore, this paper uses virtual coupling to reduce passenger pressure during peak periods. A collaborative optimization model is proposed to balance train utilization, train dwell time, and passenger waiting time to optimize train schedules. We use the CPLEX optimizer to solve the model and generate a train schedule based on the optimal solution. Numerical experiments based on real-world operations verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: A Novel Visual Perception Framework for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: Challenges and Approaches
abstract: Change detection (CD) is an important preprocessing process in visual perception. Due to the difficulties of collection and labeling images in water scnens, the design and validation of the change detection algorithm is more difficult than expected. In this paper, we present a novel visual perception framework based on parallel vision for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). The visual perception framework consists of artificial scenes, computational experiments and parallel execution. In artificial scenes, we construct a water scene and automatically generated pixel-level image annotation. Next, computational experiments are carried out on different domain dataset. The experiment results show that: 1) mixed images effectively improve the performance of change detection model; 2) domain shift problems still greatly affect the algorithm performance.

articleTitle: An improved WKNN location algorithm
abstract: With the widespread application of positioning technology, indoor positioning technology has become an indispensable positioning tool for contemporary people to travel. In indoor positioning technology, based on the weighted proximity (WKNN) algorithm has been -widely used. It is divided into two parts, offline collection and online positioning. Therefore, the stability and authenticity of the fingerprint database affects the positioning accuracy. Because the received signal strength (RSSI) of the indoor WiFi is easily affected by the indoor environment and multipath effects, the location fingerprint Affected, an improved mean filtering method is proposed. In the online positioning part, the measure of similarity distance in the algorithm is mostly Euclidean distance. In this paper, Manhattan distance is used as a measure of similarity distance in location matching algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved WKNN positioning algorithm is compared with the traditional WKNN positioning algorithm, and the improved WKNN positioning algorithm has a very good improvement effect.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Networked Systems with False Data Injection Attacks and Packet Dropouts
abstract: In this article, the state-feedback stabilization problem for a networked control system with packet dropouts and deception attacks is investigated. By integrating the system over the interval between two consecutive times at which the packets are successfully transmitted to actuator, the continuous-time system under consideration is first converted into a discrete-time system with stochastic parameters. Then, a sufficient condition is derived with the stochastic analysis technology. Subsequently, a state-feedback controller gain matrix is designed such that the mean-square exponential stability as well as a prescribed H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance of the close-loop stochastic system is guaranteed. Finally, two simulation examples are presented to substantiate the effectiveness of the designed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent modeling of lateral aircraft dynamic based on flight test data
abstract: System identification technology is an important means of aircraft modeling. In order to make up for the shortcomings of traditional system identification technology, which are complicated in calculation and limited in applicability, this paper studies the aircraft intelligent system identification technology based on black and gray box modeling. The black box model which is based on the recurrent neural network establish the dynamic relationship between the input and output variables of the aircraft; while gray box model treats the motion equation and aerodynamic coefficients of the aircraft separately, assuming that the motion equation is known, and uses an extreme learning machine to establish the forward neural network model of the aerodynamic coefficients. Thus two intelligent models of the aircraft are established, the grey box model is mainly used for model prediction for a long period, and can be utilized for flight simulation, the black box model is mainly used for online model prediction, and can be applied for model predictive control.

articleTitle: Magnetic anomaly detection on wavelet packet and support vector machine
abstract: There is still a lot of noise signal redundancy in the empirical frequency range of the vehicle magnetic anomaly detection (MAD) signal, and the extremely weak magnetic anomaly signal is still submerged in noise. This paper proposes a wavelet packet denoising algorithm combined with the denoising algorithm of the upper limit frequency of the magnetic anomaly feature. And because it is difficult to describe the magnetic anomaly signal in the characteristic layer in a single dimension, a multi-feature extraction method is used to process the magnetic anomaly signal. For the denoised magnetic anomaly signals, the dimensionless constants and singular values are extracted to construct feature vectors, and the support vector machine is used to classify and recognize the magnetic anomalies. Finally, through experiments, for the weak magnetic anomaly signal with an amplitude of the only 0.04nT, an accuracy of 80% can be achieved, and a good recognition effect has been achieved.

articleTitle: Multi-AGV pathfinding for automatic warehouse applications
abstract: Optimal coordination and scheduling of multiple automatic guided vehicles (AGVs) is one of the key issues of automatic warehouse systems. However, the existing algorithms perform unsatisfyingly on the large-scale number of agents and the map size due to the excessive time required for optimal scheduling. This paper proposes an alternate iterative conflict-based search (AICBS) algorithm. In this algorithm, path extension and conflict resolution are performed alternately, that is, checking whether there is a conflict at each step of the extension, and if there is a conflict modifying the routes of the two conflicting agents to avoid invalid plans caused by the path extension after the conflict, so as to save search time. In addition, the algorithm also reduces the time cost of conflict resolution by fixing the priority of agents on the vertexes and edges of the graph which is constructed from the map of the warehouse. The algorithm can be implemented on a general topology map, not only on a raster map, so that the time cost can be further reduced by compressing the map size. We compare the proposed algorithm with the conflict-based search algorithm in a raster map and apply it to a general topology map. Experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce the time for task coordination and scheduling of multi-AGV.

articleTitle: TDLAS-based Plume Tracing on an UAV in Outdoor Environments
abstract: An outdoor plume tracing method with a TDLAS gas sensor on a UAV is proposed in this paper. The TDLAS gas sensor is installed on a modified 3-axis aerial gimbal, and is oriented with a fixed angle Į to the vertical direction. During the flying of the UAV, the TDLAS is rotated continuously by controlling the yaw of the gimbal, scanning three-dimensional area beneath the UAV. With the time series of the detected odor concentration line integral (CLI), a searching path is planned to find and trace the plume to the odor source. The proposed plume tracing method is verified with the CPTS-3D simulation platform. The results of simulation experiments show that the proposed outdoor plume tracing method has high search efficiency and success rate.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Method for PV Panels Segmentation and Defects Detection with Infrared Images
abstract: The health condition evaluation of photovoltaic plants is considered a significant challenge for years. This paper proposed a framework for photovoltaic panels segmentation and defects detection in module-level using infrared Images through addressing three technical challenges: (1) providing some high-quality infrared images captured by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) during the inspection process; (2) an adaptive U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Net network is designed to locate the PV panels in the aerial images; (3) YOLOv4 is introduced to detect the PV defects in module-level. With the support of multi-scene data, the framework is evaluated by numerical experiments using the existing approaches as comparison benchmarks. The extensive results confirmed the efficiency and accuracy of the framework proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Adaptive Lattice Kalman Filter-SLAM for Robot Auto-navigation
abstract: This paper introduces the adaptive lattice Kalman filter (ALKF) into the SLAM problem to reduce the computational cost and improve the filtering stability. The lattice Kalman filter (LKF) algorithm based on the lattice rules has lower computational burden to maintain the state estimation accuracy by using fewer sampling points compared with other deterministic sampling method. The measurement noise is adjusted based on the measurement residual, and then the state variance is modified by using the fading factor under the modified measurement variance based on the lattice sampling points. Comparing with standard extended Kalman filter-SLAM, LKF-SLAM, the accuracy of the proposed ALKF-SLAM is valid and feasible in the simulations under the uncertain system noises.

articleTitle: A new invariant extended Kalman filter based initial alignment method of SINS under large misalignment angle
abstract: For the initial alignment of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) under the condition of large azimuth misalignment, a high-precision and fast initial alignment method is proposed. Firstly, in the Lie group space, the system matrix F and the measurement matrix H, which are relatively independent of the state estimate, are derived, and the invariant extended Kalman filter (INEKF) architecture. The INEKF not only eliminates the influence of the current state estimation error on the system matrix F and the measurement matrix H, but also suppresses the positive feedback and inconsistency problems that occur in the state update process of EKF. Then, the SINS initial alignment model is established based on INEKF. Finally, simulation results show that this method can effectively improve the speed and accuracy of the initial alignment, especially under the condition of a large misalignment angle, the alignment speed and accuracy are also greatly improved.

articleTitle: 3D object detection and state estimation method based on stereo vision and LIDAR fusion
abstract: Environmental perception is the foundation of autonomous driving, and a single sensor cannot handle the complex urban road environment efficiently. In this paper, we propose a vehicle object shape, position and motion state estimation method based on stereo vision and LiDAR fusion. First, images and point clouds of LiDAR are detected using YOLOv4 and Point-GNN, respectively. Secondly, to estimate the position and shape of the object, the paper proposes an estimation method using 3D points of image object and object type. Finally, the image and LiDAR objects are converted to the same vehicle coordinate system using the calibrated external parameters, the IOU and Global Nearest Neighbor(GNN) data association method is used to match the image object and the LiDAR object, and the matched object are fused to obtain the accuracy shape-position of the object, and the object is tracked using the extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm. This paper is validated on the KITTI dataset and real road scenes. The experimental results show that the average errors of object shape, position and velocity in 20m are 4.33%,4.41% and 2.34%, respectively.

articleTitle: Multichannel real-time video container numbers recogntion in container yard
abstract: The improvement of automation level of container yard operation is conducive to the improvement of operation efficiency and safety of container terminal and port. In practical engineering application, in the case of limited computing power, how to achieve the balance between speed and accuracy is worth discussing. This paper focus on how to balance the accuracy and speed for the real-time video container numbers recognition during monitoring. Through the research on the methods of text detection and text recogntion in deep learning, DBNet is used to the detection of container number, and SAR is used to the recognition of container number. In order to meet the real-time requirements, the feature extraction part of DBNet is modified to the lightweight network MobileNetV3, the feature fusion part is modified to the FPEM and FFM module, and the loss function is modified to DiceLoss; The feature extraction part of SAR is modified to lightweight network MobileNetV3, the sequence feature extraction part is modified to GRU module, and more data augmentation modules are added to enhance the generalization ability of the model. Experiments in container images dataset collected during the actual operation show that the proposed scheme can meet the requirements of accuracy and speed at the same time. Finally, through the application verification of multi-channel video monitoring and real-time container number recognition in container terminal yard, the scheme is implemented on the platform of Xeon e5-2690V3, GPU: RTX2080super(8G), memory of computer: 16G, in the case of reasoning using the shortest edge 1080, one recognition cost time is about 200ms, the video memory occupation include detection and recogntion is about 2.0G, and the recognition accuracy is more than 95%.

articleTitle: Flexible and wearable hydrogel-based triboelectric nanogenerator for self-power sensing in boxing match
abstract: Real-time monitoring of the interaction between boxing gloves and protective gear can provide extremely important information for high-quality guidance of the individual fighting training. However, the existing visual monitoring system is difficult to reflect the specific interaction force and the accurate hit position. Here, we designed a self-powered hydrogel-based triboelectric nanogenerator for real-time monitoring of combat training and rule judgment. The triboelectric nanogenerators with this unique structure can be manufactured on a large scale through a simple process. As a result, the developed sensor exhibits excellent sensitivity (0.93 uA/N•S) and ultra-fast response time (21 ms). On this basis, we made a 2×4 combat protective gear, which can obtain the strike position and punch speed in real time, and provide assessment and personal guidance for the athletes’ training. It is true that this work has not only opened up a new way to surpass the existing visual detection system for the real-time monitoring of the strike position and punch speed in combat training or competition, but also opened up a new way for the development of artificial intelligence electronic technology to intelligent sports.

articleTitle: Multi-target Rotating Encirclement Formations of Second-order Multi-agent Systems with Communication Noises
abstract: This paper investigates the encirclement formation problem of second-order multi-agent systems (SO-MAS)with communication noises. Firstly, the targets’ position is calculated by a distributed estimator. Secondly, a distributed control scheme is designed to make sure all agents achieve rotating encirclement formation, and time-varying gain is adopted to reduce the affect of communication noises. Then, based on the complex domain theory and Lyapunov theory, a sufficient condition for achieving the desired rotating encirclement formation is obtained. Finally, the numerical simulation shows the proposed scheme’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Collision avoidance of singular C–S model with reaction delays
abstract: Cucker–Smale (C–S) model is a celebrated flocking model. As an important issue, collision avoidance was extensively discussed especially when the communication is singular. However, for this model with delays, there is no result concerning collision avoidance. This note shows that there is no collisions between agents for the singular C–S model with reaction delays.

articleTitle: TransRAM: A classification model of breast pathology images that imitates the diagnosis process of pathologists
abstract: Breast cancer, one of the most common health threats to females worldwide, has always been a crucial topic in the medical field. However, manual diagnosis suffers a series of challenges, such as considerable time cost and low diagnosis consistency. In this paper, we proposed TransRAM, which merited both Transformers and Recurrent Models of Visual Attention, as a strong alternative for digital pathological diagnosis of the breast. This model imitated the diagnosis process of pathologists, paying attention to a series of local features on the pathology image and summarizing related information to arrive at the final diagnosis. TransRAM was evaluated on the Bioimaging Challenge 2015 Breast Histology Dataset (BACH) and achieved a classification accuracy of 90.94%, which was better than related publications. In addition, we compared the model effects under different parameter settings and visualized the model decision-making processes.

articleTitle: A Computation Analysis of Optimal Position for Arteriovenous Fistula Thrill Measurement
abstract: Arteriovenous fistula (AVF) is a commonly used vascular access to maintain hemodialysis patients. As an essential physiological feature of AVF, thrill signal can be measured to monitor the occurrence of stenosis. In this paper, the method of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation is used to study the thrill signal and its distribution on the skin surface, and an AVF model with skin tissue is constructed. The displacement field of the skin surface is obtained through simulation. Adopting Burg algorithm to analyze the displacement results and compare them with the power spectral density of pulse wave, the reliability of the simulation results is verified. In order to find the most suitable measurement area, nine different positions are selected as the measurement points on the interface representing the skin surface in the model. The displacement distribution of thrill signal on the surface of the skin is obtained by simulating the displacement of each measuring point, and The experimental results show that the amplitude of the anastomosis and the arterial segment near the anastomosis is larger, which is the preferred location for signal measurement.

articleTitle: Neural Network and Reinforcement Learning based Energy Management Strategy for Battery/Supercapacitor HEV
abstract: A novel energy management strategy based on neural network (NN) and reinforcement learning is proposed to split the power of lithium battery and supercapacitor for hybrid energy vehicle (HEV) driving. First, the NN state-action model is trained by using traditional energy management controller. Then, new data is generated and combined with the original data to optimize the NN model in further. The action sequences are generated randomly and evaluated by NN model. Only the first action is adopted and the next action is re-predicted to reduce the cumulative error caused by the inaccurate model. Finally, four different driving patterns are selected and the comparison with deep Q-Network method is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed energy management strategy.

articleTitle: Adaptive PI control with guaranteed transient and steady-state tracking performance for strict feedback systems
abstract: In this work, a neuroadaptive proportional integral (PI) control solution for SISO strict feedback nonlinear systems with model uncertainties, capable of guaranteeing prescribed performance bounds, is developed. First, we introduce a special speed function and transform the original error constrained system into an unconstrained one by transformation techniques. Then, by stabilizing the converted system, the error of the original system is guaranteed to evolve within the performance function boundary. And the virtual errors and tracking error converge to the pre-set region of accuracy within user-given time. Lastly, the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Impedance control of slag removal robot based on Q-Learning
abstract: Due to the time-varying contact force of molten metal, it is a challenging work to realize the accurate slag pushing of industrial robot. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an impedance control method based on reinforcement learning. Firstly, the impedance model of the industrial robot system is established, and the Maxwell stress model which describes the contact between the end-effector of the manipulator and the molten metal surface is established. Then, on the basis of the idea of Q-learning and system linearization, an online correction strategy of impedance parameters based on reinforcement learning is designed. At the same time, the stability of the proposed method is analyzed theoretically. Finally, the proposed intelligent impedance control strategy is successfully applied to the slag pushing simulation of Rokae robot. And compared with the existing control methods, the superiority of the control method is proved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Guide System for High-Speed Maglev Train
abstract: As an advanced development direction of rail transportation technology, the high-speed maglev transportation has the advantages of non-contact wear, fast operation, environmental protection, safety and reliability. The lateral stability of the guide system guarantees the safety of the train. In This paper, the design and realization of a guide system for high-speed maglev train are introduced. Firstly, the structure of guide system is designed in detail. Then the magnetic field of the guide system, including the electromagnet and the guide rail, is simulated and calculated using the finite element analysis software. The electromagnetic characteristics of the guide electromagnet are discussed, and the electromagnetic field distribution is analyzed. Finally, simulation and experimental test show that variations of the electromagnetic force with the current are coincident during loading process. It indicates the effectiveness of the design for guide system of high-speed maglev train. The study lays the foundation for further complex dynamic analysis of the guide system.

articleTitle: 3D shape measurement based on the novel non- aligned phase-coding method
abstract: As a kind of three-dimensional(3-D) shape measurement technology, the phase-coding method was widely used because of its high robustness. However, due to the interference of nonlinear and noise, error may appear in the edge of the fringe, which leads to 2π phase jump errors in the unwrapped phase map. To alleviate this problem, a new method based on non-aligned phase-coding was proposed, in which the phase difference of sinusoidal fringe patterns and fringe order patterns is a fixed value. Before the wrapped phase is unwrapped, the fringe order is re-corrected by the wrapped phase to make them aligned. Since the wrapped phase and the corrected fringe order are strictly aligned, the errors are eliminated. Finally, several groups of comparative experiments are carried out to demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Flexible auto job shop scheduling optimization based on genetic algorithm with catastrophe mechanism
abstract: Aiming at the flexible automobile job shop scheduling problem with the objective of minimizing the completion time, this paper uses a new genetic algorithm different from the previous methods, which adds the population catastrophe mechanism to the traditional algorithm; In this way, the efficiency of population evolution is improved. On the same scale, the new method expands the chromosome size, significantly improving the diversity and optimization capacity.

articleTitle: Spatial non-cooperative object detection based on deep learning
abstract: Vision-based spatial non-cooperative object detection is an significant technical support for intelligent on-orbit services, however, the development of related research in this field is relatively slow. Therefore, A tiny spatial non-cooperative object detection (SNCOD) dataset has been constructed, which is the basis of further study. At the same time, we introduce several state-of-the-art deep learning based detection models to explore their generalization ability in the field of aerospace. The experiment results illustrate that all the detectors adopted in this paper can perform well on our SNCOD dataset, even achieve 0.977 mAP. In addition, we explore the challenges for SNCOD, which would significantly enlighten future research.

articleTitle: Repeated Game Trade Interaction Strategy of Regional Integrated Energy System
abstract: Energy consumption transaction is an important part of the integrated energy system, which affects the large-scale utilization of clean energy and energy reform. At present, in order to optimize the energy structure and improve energy efficiency, the integrated energy system has been developed rapidly. Aiming at the optimization problem of integrated energy system, this paper proposes a transaction interaction strategy of regional integrated energy system based on repeated game, optimizes its operation, and establishes the energy station model. The existence of Nash equilibrium solution set of repeated game is proved by backward induction. Finally, the proposed game model is simulated and verified by taking a typical regional integrated energy system as an example, and the results show that the proposed method realizes the collaborative economic optimization operation of the regional integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Infrared small target detection based on local average contrast enhancement and corner response
abstract: Infrared (IR) small target detection plays an important role in the field of target detection. However, due to the small IR target texture feature is not obvious, low signal-to-noise ratio, strong clutter interference and other reasons, the IR small target detection and its challenges. Therefore, this paper designs a robust detection method which can accurately detect IR dim targets in strong background clutter environment. Firstly, the local mean contrast enhancement strategy is used to enhance the target and suppress the background of the IR image, and the influence of isolated noise is eliminated. Then Harris corner detection algorithm is used to calculate the corner response pixel by pixel for the image after contrast enhancement. Finally, a simple threshold segmentation is used to detect the IR dim small target. The experimental results show that our method has excellent detection effect in the case of very low SCR and strong background clutter. At the same time, compared with the existing methods, our method is more robust and has less false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Formalizing equivalence between real number completeness and intermediate value theorem
abstract: This paper reports on the formalization of the completeness of intermediate value theorem. This theorem as a fundamental property of continuous function on a closed interval, can be used to solve the existence of roots of equations. The intermediate value theorem is usually regarded as a corollary of completeness theorem of real number. In fact, completeness theorem of real number also can be derived from the intermediate value theorem. This formalization is based on the formal system we developed strictly following Landau’s “Foundations of Analysis”. Dedekind fundament theorem has been proved in this system, and further we prove the supremum theorem. Then we formally verify the equivalence between supremum theorem and intermediate value theorem, which shows its completeness. All the proof has been checked by Coq, and the proof process is normalized, rigorous and reliable.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-based Drift Control for Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: Drift maneuvers show promising capabilities for vehicle control under unstable conditions, which is significant for improving the maneuverability and safety of autonomous vehicles. However, the implementation of autonomous drift is challenging due to the complex dynamics of the vehicle under drifting conditions and the strong coupling of lateral and longitudinal control. In this work, a customized drift simulator of the target vehicle is constructed to capture its dynamics characteristics through vehicle modeling and parameter identification. In addition, a reinforcement learning-based drift controller is designed using the vehicle dynamics model as prior knowledge. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed controller in both steady-state drift and drift cornering.

articleTitle: A Position Control Algorithm of Bucket Wheel Reclaimer Based on LADRC
abstract: Bucket wheel reclaimer (BWR) is broadly used in the process of reclaiming operation in mines and metallurgical enterprises. The Accuracy and dynamic response performance of of its position control algorithm directly affects the efficiency of unmanned equipment. In this paper, a position control algorithm of BWR based on linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) is proposed, and a extended state observer (ESO) is designed to observe the total disturbance of the system caused by the uncertain friction due to high dust and muck as well as the parameter uncertainty related to different material quality of the loader. Besides, the stability of the observer is analyzed theoretically. Simulation shows that the algorithm can effectively achieve the control objectives, dynamic performance and steady-state error can be well considered, besides, the algorithm has strong anti-disturbance ability.

articleTitle: Diffusion Bias-Compensated Feature Sparse LMS Algorithms Over Networks
abstract: In recent years, distributed strategies are widely used in sparse parameter estimation of FIR filter. In some cases, the parameter may be non-zero only in one or several regions, meanwhile, if the input signal is polluted by noise, using traditional least-mean-square algorithm to estimate the parameter is biased. We propose the bias-compensated feature sparse least-mean-square algorithm in this paper, for exploiting the sparsity feature of the system and removing the bias by noisy. The superiority of our algorithm over the traditional methods is shown by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Mechanism Modeling and Analysis of Submerged Water Bath Cooling Molding Process
abstract: In this paper, a submerged water bath cooling molding system is introduced. The object to be cooled is a cavity with molten material inside. In the cooling molding process of this system, there is a high requirement for the uniformity of cooling temperature, because the cooling temperature has an important influence on the molding quality of the final product. The different parameters of the system will affect the uniformity of temperature in the cooling molding process. In order to further understand the influence of system parameters on molding quality, provide some guidance for industrial production of cooling molding, and improve the quality of cooling molding products. In this paper, the actual cooling molding process control system is abstracted and simplified, the mathematical model is established, and the state equation is obtained. The simulation experiment is carried out based on the mathematical model, the influence of the valve opening of cooling water inlet, the descending speed of cavity and the initial temperature of water in the water tank on the cooling temperature change in the cooling molding process is analyzed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of Strict-feedback Systems Under Input Delay and Output Constraint
abstract: An adaptive dynamic surface tracking control method for nonlinear strict-feedback systems with output constraint and input delay is proposed in this paper. We first construct a subsidiary system to counteract the influence of input delay, and then we consider a constraint of the output. In this case, a tangent barrier Lyapunov function is proposed to cope with the output constraint. Furthermore, we invoke a first-order filter to simplify implementation. Finally, we verify the effectiveness of this method through a simulation study.

articleTitle: Automatic Fast Experiment System Design Based on Matlab Embedded Code
abstract: Aiming at the problem of long development cycle and complicated programming for traditional embedded system design, an automated control algorithm development method using MATLAB embedded code generation technology is proposed. In this paper, the three-phase motor open loop control system is used as an example, the simulink model is implemented by the MATLAB Simulink, and the embedded system control code is automatically generated by TI integrated development environment (CCS) and MATLAB embedded coder, and verified on TI F28379D Launchpad. This model-based development process can accelerate code development cycle and improve product development efficiency from all phases of requirements analysis, algorithm design and finally integration testing, which will also reduce development costs.

articleTitle: Research on the Problem of Emergency Braking Rriggered by Train Control Vehicle Equipment
abstract: Aiming at the problem of train control vehicle-mounted equipment triggering emergency braking at Zhangqiu Station on Jiaoji Line, the fault-related data was analyzed, the fault was reproduced through laboratory simulation and the cause of the fault was determined. In order to minimize the impact of on-site operations, a solution was proposed by adjusting the deceleration parameters. The new version of the parameters still has the possibility of failure to calculate the braking curve under certain conditions, although the probability is extremely low. If you want to completely avoid this problem, you need to modify the host software to fundamentally solve this type of failure. The project team studied this software problem in depth, and finally solved it through the host software upgrade. The solution of this problem is conducive to improving the technical means of fault analysis related to the braking curve and optimizing the level of operation and maintenance of field equipment.

articleTitle: Boundary Output Feedback Control for A Class of Gantry Crane Systems via Backstepping Approach
abstract: In this paper, a boundary output feedback controller is addressed for a class of gantry cranes via the backstepping approach. The gantry crane is modeled into a dynamical system govern by partial differential equations (PDEs). Then, utilizing the backstepping technique, the dynamical PDE system can be transformed into a target system under the designed controller which only forces on the trolley. Besides, based on the operator semigroup theory and the Lyapunov stability theory, the solution to the target system is proven to be well-posed and exponentially stable. According to the inverse transformations and the stability of the target system, the dynamical system is confirmed to be exponentially stable. Finally, simulation and comparison are presented to verify the efficiency and the advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Environmental Complaint Text Classification Scheme Combining Automatic Annotation and TextCNN
abstract: The increasing awareness of the public in protecting the ecological environment has led to increased complaints text involving environmental issues. However, due to the short length of the complaint texts, irregular language descriptions, and strong professionalism, the conventional classification methods' applicability is poor, and manual classification is time-consuming and laborious. This paper proposes an automatic annotation¬based text classification method for environmental complaint reports. First of all, a tiny amount of labeled data was used to establish the corresponding field's cell vocabulary corpus. Secondly, the cell vocabulary was expanded through the large corpus pre-training model. Finally, the TextCNN model was trained to realize automatic labeling and classification of the unlabeled complaint text. Experiments show that the classification method based on the domain feature dictionary proposed in this paper reduces manual annotation error, performs better on large- scale data sets, and is a reliable classification method.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Prescribed Performance Control of Wheeled Mobile Robot with Skidding and Slipping
abstract: The trajectory tracking problem of mobile robot with slippage is very complicated. On the one hand, compensating for slippage under non-holonomic constraints is difficult; on the other hand, disturbances cased by slippage also needs to be suppressed in dynamics level. In this paper, a low complexity control scheme is proposed. By linearizing the model, non-holonomic constraints and complex virtual control law design are avoided. By using prescribed performance function (PPF), dynamics model information or its estimated structure is not required. The simulation results show the superiority of this method.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction of lithium-ion batteries based on the discharge voltage
abstract: The remaining useful life (RUL) is always important to the preventive maintenance of lithium-ion batteries. To achieve the accurate RUL prediction, a whale optimization algorithm (WOA) with multi-kernel relevance vector machine (MKRVM) model based on the discharge process data is introduced in this paper, health indicator (HI) that can characterize battery degradation is obtained from the discharge voltage, and the relationship between HI and capacity is evaluated by Person and Spearman. On this basis, a multi-kernel relevance vector machine (MKRVM) model is established. WOA is used to obtain the optimization weights of multi-kernel and enhance the performance of the model. Finally, the battery data from NASA is used to verify the performance of the model introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Detection for Nonlinear Industrial Processes Based on Distributed Weighted Stacked Autoencoder
abstract: Incipient faults in industrial processes can deteriorate into abnormal events or even severe accidents. It is still a challenge to detect them accurately due to their slight fault symptoms. In this paper, a distributed weighted stacked autoencoder (DWSAE)-based fault detection scheme is proposed to detect incipient faults by fully utilizing the local and global fault information. First, the local stacked autoencoder models are established for each operation unit, and the feature and residual spaces are obtained. The sliding window technique and singular value decomposition (SVD) are applied to the feature spaces and residual spaces to obtain local fault information indexes. The feature vectors and residual vectors are weighted by the fault information indexes and two local detection statistics in each operation unit are constructed.
