Second, the global stacked autoencoder model is established using all features extracted by the local stacked autoencoders and two global detection statistics are constructed. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified by a numerical example and Tennessee Eastman process.

articleTitle: Consensus of first-order multi-agent systems via event-triggered impulsive control
abstract: In this article, the control strategy with event-triggered (ET) asynchronous impulsive is studied for the consensus of first-order multi-agent systems (FOMAS). For each agent, only when state-related errors overstep the set threshold can controller update. Moreover, the proposed control method is that there is no Zeno-behavior and also avoids continuous communication between neighboring agents. Finally, through several numerical instances, the validity of the theoretical results is concretely verified.

articleTitle: Identification of Ship Course Model Based on Gaussian Process Regression
abstract: Course modeling is the base of ship’s steering controller designation. However, traditional hydrodynamic modeling methods such as MMG and Abkowitz model usually cost a lot. In this paper, a state-space model based on Gaussian process regression(GP) is proposed on ship course modeling. Select rudder angle and propeller speed as input variables, surge velocity, sway velocity and yaw increment as state variables. Simulation is carried out under multiple test data sets. The result shows that Gaussian process course model has better long-term prediction performance compared with linear course model.

articleTitle: A passive dynamic tuning filter monitoring system based on cloud server
abstract: In view of the widely application of passive dynamic tuning filter and the dispersed geographical location, to improve the harmonic control effect of passive dynamic tuning filter, protect the security of backend data of equipment, and analyze the backend data to optimize performance. The passive dynamic tuning filter monitoring system of cloud server is completed. Firstly, monitoring system for dynamic parameters of passive filter branch collection is developed. Secondly, one of the key data of passive dynamic tuned filter to display working status is selected. Finally, the data is collected by JAVA platform, which is based on the cloud server backend interface. Through monitoring data and the operation of equipment, remote control and other functions are realized.

articleTitle: Research on Lateral-Longitudinal Coupling Trajectory Tracking Control Method for Bilateral Electric Drive Tracked Vehicle
abstract: To improve the trajectory tracking accuracy of a tracked vehicle with a bilateral electric drive power system, a lateral-longitudinal coupling trajectory tracking control method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the longitudinal reference speed sequence is generated by an iterative algorithm with consideration of rollover and sideslip constraints. Based on the model predictive control (MPC) method, reference speed, kinematic model of the tracked vehicle, and dynamic constraints, a lateral-longitudinal coupling trajectory tracker is established to solve the motor speed control command on both sides. According to the ROS-VREP co-simulation test, the path tracking accuracy of the proposed control method is improved by 28.49% and 43.75% under the steering conditions of small curvature and large curvature, compared with the decoupling control method, respectively. In addition, the vehicle presents higher driving stability without sacrificing time cost. The algorithm is tested on the actual vehicle platform, and the results are compared with the simulation tests. It is observed that the accuracy is roughly the same, while the error is within an acceptable range.

articleTitle: Study on metal corrosion model in chlorine environment based on BP neural network
abstract: In the process of the development of chemical industry, with the continuous improvement of the production automation of chemical industry, the corrosion problem of chemical instruments is becoming more and more obvious. The corrosion of chemical instruments will directly or indirectly cause great economic losses to chemical enterprises. Therefore, in the development of chemical industry, with the continuous development and application of the automation trend of production units, the solution of chemical instrument corrosion problem is the key problem in the current chemical production process. In this paper, the corrosion data of instrument materials in chlorine environment are selected in the production of chlor-alkali industry. Based on the BP neural network training data, a mathematical model is established to predict the corrosion rate of metal materials. The experimental results show that the prediction results of BP neural network are basically consistent with the actual data, which proves the feasibility of applying BP neural network to predict instrument corrosion in chemical industry.

articleTitle: Robust model predictive control for time-varying time-delay systems with actuator saturation
abstract: For a class of continuous systems with actuator saturation and time-varying time delay, a robust model predictive control method is proposed. In this method, the problem of actuator saturation is solved by the method of sector region, which can greatly reduce the conservativeness of the controller. The complex min-max optimization problem is transformed into a convex optimization problem with solving a group of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). The robust model predictive control not only efficiently eliminates the negative effects of the time delays and actuator saturation but also ensures the stability of system. Simulation results show that the proposed method has strong robustness and application value.

articleTitle: Research on Question Answering based on Knowledge Graph of Military Industry Domain
abstract: With the rapid development of natural language processing, large amount of information makes people’s requirements for the effectiveness and efficiency of information retrieval more urgent. For researchers in the military industry domain, how to effectively retrieve information is becoming an urgent problem. To this end, this research concentrates on the military industry domain, using relevant literature as the corpus, and constructs a knowledge graph that includes five types of entities and four types of relationships. On the basis of this knowledge graph, we achieve the function of intelligent question answering of scientific research literature in the military industry domain. The contribution of this research is to provide information service support for scientific research.

articleTitle: A Leader-Follower Flocking Algorithm Based on Estimated Flocking States
abstract: This paper investigates the design of flocking control algorithms for a group of agents with leader-follower architecture where only a fraction of members have access to the global navigation information. To maintain the cohesion and alignment of the group, a consensus protocol is proposed to estimate the expected position and velocity of the flocking center by each agent, and a control algorithm with state feedback is designed to drive agents towards the estimated state. Navigation information is integrated into the process of distributed state estimation by leaders. In addition, a fuzzy-logic based repulsive function is employed to model the separation component for collision avoidance. A series of numerical experiments are performed, and verify that a group of agents are able to track targets of varying velocity without its acceleration information under the control of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Operating Performance Assessment for Dynamic Industrial Processes Based on CVA-TPLS
abstract: For industrial process, the operating performance assessment is very crucial in the aspect of improvement of process performance and comprehensive economic benefits (CEB) of enterprises actually. The static information of process data is investigated properly, while the data with dynamic characteristics are seldom exposed in traditional operating performance assessment methods. Hence, a novel operating performance assessment method combining canonical variate analysis and total projection to latent structure (CVA-TPLS) is proposed here for the industrial processes with dynamic characteristics. Canonical variate analysis (CVA) can extract the temporally strongly correlated variations from the process data, and total projection to latent structure (TPLS) can explore the performance-relevant features to reflect the process operating performance. Through combining CVA and TPLS, the proposed CVA-TPLS makes full use of variations with both dynamic and performance-relevant characteristics to assess the process operating performance. At last, the proposed method is applied to a numerical instance and the gold hydrometallurgrical industrial process, and the efficiency and feasibility is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Multi-agent Distributed Optimization Method for Thrust Allocation
abstract: Thrust allocation (TA) is a vital part of the dynamic positioning (DP) system of vessels equipped with azimuth thrusters. It determines the control input of each thruster device according to the control command generalized by the DP controller, which has a great impact on the control accuracy, stability, and flexibility of marine operation. In order to solve the TA problem, a multi-agent distributed optimization method based on distributed TA quadratic programming (QP) model in Cartesian coordinates is proposed in this paper. The proposed method considers the power consumption, the mechanical wear, the mechanical constraints, and the singularity from the perspective of multi-agent. The simulation examples show that the method proposed in this paper can realize optimal TA effectively without error.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Fault Detection Fuzzy Filtering for Networked Control Systems via Reduced-Order Approach
abstract: This paper studies the event-based reduced-order fault detection filter design issue for nonlinear networked control systems. The considered nonlinear systems are described by interval type-2 T-S fuzzy models, where the premise variables are different from those of the designed fault detection filter. For handling the mismatched membership function issue, a slack matrix technique is used to reduce the conservatism by utilizing the information of membership functions. On the basis of simplifying the design approach, a new reduced-order fault detection scheme is proposed. In addition, in order to save communication resources, an event-triggered communication scheme with switching threshold is introduced in this paper. Furthermore, sufficient conditions are provided to ensure the desired performance by applying Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: Task Sequence Planning Algorithm for Cooperative Assembly of Dual-arm Robot
abstract: Dual-arm collaborative robots have gradually become a research hotspot in the field of robotics due to their unique collaboration and flexibility, and they have a wide range of application prospects especially in the assembly manufacturing industry. However, the existing dual-arm robot lacks autonomy in assembly operations, especially when faced with a large number of randomly placed assembly parts, how to make the robot have independent assembly task decision-making ability is a challenge. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a new dual-arm robot collaborative assembly task sequence planning algorithm, which fully considers the constraints of the dual-arm robot's mechanical structure, kinematics, characteristics of objects to be assembled, interference between objects, etc.. Firstly, The algorithm uses the Monte Carlo method to analyze the working space of the left and right arms of the dual-arm robot, while taking into account the structural constraints of the robot. Then, according to the characteristics of the object to be assembled, the idea of interference sphere is proposed to analyze the interference between objects in the assembly task. The influence of the operation, and finally combined with the movement cost of the dual-arm assembly, the assembly task sequence is effectively planned. The algorithm was verified by simulation using the ABB YuMi dual-arm collaborative robot, and the experimental results proved the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation of high-speed railway dispatching software based on TODIM
abstract: To solve the problems of fuzziness and uncertainty in the quality evaluation of high-speed railway dispatching software, a TODIM evaluation method based on interval 2-tuple linguistic is proposed. This method uses interval 2-tuple linguistic as evaluation linguistic. The subjective weights and objective weights of attributes are obtained by subjective weighting method and maximum deviation method respectively, and then the combined weights of attributes are obtained by combination weighting method. On this basis, finally use TODIM to evaluate the quality of railway software. Compared with TOPSIS method, the rationality and effectiveness of this method are verified.

articleTitle: Class Imbalance in Facial Expression Recognition by GCN with Focal Loss
abstract: Dataset is important in facial expression recognition, but they may run into apparent imbalances caused by various collection scenes. This paper studies the class imbalance problem in the benchmark dataset for facial expression recognition. We focus on the design of focal loss function instead of cross entropy loss to solve the class imbalance. Graph convolutional network (GCN) is applied to achieve the facial expression recognition. Experimental results in Oulu-CASIA dataset and SFEW 2.0 dataset exhibit that the proposed programme improves the performances of facial expression recognition.

articleTitle: Sparse LSTM neural network with hybrid PSO algorithm
abstract: As an improved recurrent neural network, Long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network have been widely applied in many areas. However, redundant resources of calculation and memory are often required in the dense LSTM neural network and the over-fitting problem can even be caused. It hinders the practical application of network. To enhance the sparsity and generalization ability, the sparse LSTM neural network with hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm (SLSTM-HPSO) is proposed. Firstly, based on LSTM, the hybrid coding method is established to directly denote the state and value of network weights. Secondly, the fitness function which is composed of the network training error and ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> norm term is introduced to control the accuracy and sparsity of network, simultaneously. Thirdly, the update strategy is designed according to the coding method and fitness function to search for optimal solution. Finally, the proposed method is respectively 47.72% and 47.02% better than traditional LSTM neural network in terms of prediction accuracy and sparsity.

articleTitle: Generalized Deep Implicit Surface Network for Image-based Three-dimensional Object Reconstruction
abstract: Three-dimensional(3D) Object Reconstruction is an activate field in Computer Vision and Computer Graphics. Deep Implicit Surface Network(DISN) utilizes Signed Distance Function(SDF) to generate a high-quality 3D mesh model from a 2D image. However this method can only handle the image with a clear background, since it was trained with rendered images from ShapeNet dataset. To solve this problem, we propose a mask generating method based on saliency map to make DISN more generalized. By performing saliency detection algorithm and morphological operations on image, the object to be reconstruct can be obtained and background would be removed. In order to enhance the representing ability of local features, we propose a channel-weighted local feature extraction algorithm. Using modified sigmoid function, discriminative channels in feature map would have larger weights than others. We evaluate our methods on Pix 3D and Pascal 3D+ datasets. Experimental results show that our methods perform better than other works.

articleTitle: An improved DE algorithm for parameters identification of PEMFC
abstract: With the development of society, the consumption of energy continues to increase, and clean energy has received extensive attention for its environmental friendliness and renewability. Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is one of the critical clean energy sources, and its performance is affected by its mathematical model and corresponding unknown parameters in the model. In order to solve the PEMFC parameters identification issue more effectively, an adaptive differential evolution algorithm with the dynamic opposite learning strategy (DOLADE) is proposed. In DOLADE, the number of elite individuals and ordinary individuals is expanded to increase the exploration performance of particles; the population’s search space is adjusted dynamically to enhance the particles' exploitation performance. The strategy improves the tendency of particles to obtain global optimal solutions and reduces the probability of falling into local optimal solutions. The experimental results show that the DOLADE algorithm is competitive in effectiveness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of improved RRT algorithm in the U-turn of vehicle
abstract: This article provides a solution for the path planning problem of AGV(Automated Guided Vehicle) during the U-turn. Paper not only modifies the sampling strategy of the traditional RRT (Rapid exploration random tree) algorithm to speed up the convergence of the algorithm, but also integrates TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution) into the algorithm so that the route generated by the algorithm can meet the requirements of multiple indicators at the same time. In this way, the generation of invalid path is limited during the path planning, so the pruning step is omitted, and the running time of the algorithm is accelerated. The reliability of the algorithm is verified by simulation. The proposed method not only provides practical engineering significance for obstacle avoidance in an intelligent factory, but also theoretical reference value for other type of path planning.

articleTitle: A fast optimization method with the speed of light
abstract: By using purely resistive circuit, this paper proposes a fast optimization method that can obtain the optimal solution with the speed of light.

articleTitle: The prediction of the silicon content in hot metal based on GRU using DTFT denoising
abstract: The silicon content in hot metal reveals the blast furnace(BF) thermal state, which is closely related to the energy consumed and the quality of the product. So it is vital to predict the silicon content in hot metal for the monitor and operation of BF. Aiming at the challenge brought by industrial data noise and singularity during BF ironmaking process, this paper proposes the method of the prediction of silicon content using the time-series data. First there is the introduction of designing low-pass filter(LPF) based ondiscrete-time fourier transform(DTFT), and then the completion of missing value based on multivariate regression will be discussed. The algorithmof LSTM, GRU are explained as the theoretical basis of the models. Finally, their performance will be provided to prove the validation of the theoretical analysis. The result shows that GRU with DTFT denoising and completion of missing value has faster convergent rate than other models and can achieve the lowest MSE and highest hit rate.

articleTitle: The model prediction-based two-stage state estimation algorithm
abstract: For nonlinear coupled systems, the traditional filter algorithm has the disadvantages of large amount of calculation and insufficient estimation accuracy. In order to reduce computational complexity and improve estimation accuracy, this paper proposes a model prediction-based two- stage state estimation algorithm. Firstly, a two-level subsystem is established through model decoupling and reconstruction. Then the linear state estimation is obtained base on first-level linear subsystem by Kalman Filter (KF). Secondly, the predictive model is obtained by substituted the first-level state estimation into the second-level subsystem. The second-level nonlinear state estimation is obtained base on prediction model and KF. Finally, the state estimation of the nonlinear system is transformed into the state estimation of the linear system by the proposed two-stage state estimation filter. And in the end, the effectiveness of the filtering algorithm is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Parameter-dependent LMI condition for stability analysis of fractional-order linear time-invariant single parameter-dependent systems
abstract: The robust stability problem of FO-LTI (fractional-order linear time-invariant) single parameter-dependent systems is studied in this paper with the system order 1 < γ < 2. A polynomial-type matrix which is limited with bounded, computable degree in the LMI condition is proposed using the Kronecker product and Kronecker sum and can be applied in sufficient and necessary conditions for the stability conditions for such single parameter-dependent systems. This condition can also help calculate the range of parameter when the system stays stable. An example is used to prove that the main theorem is valid and may be applied.

articleTitle: Graph Attention based Point Cloud Registration
abstract: Point cloud registration is a fundamental but important technique in robotics and computer vision, such as 3D reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). The classical methods used hand-craft features extracted from each point cloud to estimate the rigid transformation between point clouds with iterative closest points (ICP) or its variants. Recently, deep learning has been widely used in object detection, segmentation and registration, especially the well-known work, PointNet, changed how we think about the representation of point clouds. However, the local information is ignored in PointNet as many works pointed out. In this paper, we advise to use graph attention to aggregate local features and a kind of cross attention method for point cloud registration. Firstly, we use a mini-ConvNet to extract point-wise features for sampled points and their neighbors. Then graph attention is applied to aggregate the local information from neighbor points to center points. We consider that previous works which directly estimate the transformation using the features from two point clouds ignore some relationship between the point clouds. Instead, we propose to explore the relation with a kind of cross attention. We perform extensive experiments to validate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Image Classification of Zinc Dross Based on Improved MobileNetV2
abstract: Zinc dross image classification is one of the key procedures to realize the automation of dross removal. Given the low efficiency of traditional deep convolutional neural networks for image classification, the improved MobileNetV2 image classification lightweight network is proposed for achieving real-time and high-precision classification of zinc dross images in this paper. The improvement includes three aspects. Firstly, the batch normalization method in MobileNetV2 is replaced by the group normalization method. Then, the Relu6 activation function in the network is changed to the Leaky Relu. Thirdly, the expansion coefficient used to control the dimension elevation is decreased, which makes the output channels of the pointwise convolution layer less. Comparison experiments were performed on the enhanced zinc dross image data set. Finally, the experimental results show that the parameter amount of the improved MobileNetV2 is just 1.33 million, which is 41.67% less than MobileNetV2. The improved MobileNetV2 has a 99.63% accuracy in the classification of zinc dross images, which is 1.46% higher than MobileNetV2. And the test time of the improved MobileNetV2 is 8.49 ms, which is 7.57 ms less than that of MobileNetV2.

articleTitle: Research on Solving the Target Point of the Supersonic Anti-ship Weapon Based on Passive Acoustic Measurement
abstract: The current weapon test environment is becoming increasingly complex, and the problem of solving the target point of the supersonic anti-ship weapon exists that radar measurements are vulnerable to electromagnetic interference and optical measurements are vulnerable to visibility. To address this problem, this paper uses a model based on passive acoustic measurement and proposes a method for solving the target point. In this paper, multiple acoustic arrays are used to measure the shock waves generated during the flight of the weapon, and the direction of the shock wave relative to acoustic arrays can be obtained. Gauss-Newton iteration method and plane intersection are used to solve the target point. Compared with the existing methods, this method does not require to know the speed of the weapon. In addition, this paper theoretically analyzes the factors that affect the calculation accuracy of the target point. Finally, this paper carries out the simulation under the condition that the measurement error of the acoustic arrays is 1°, and the results show that the average error of the target position within the target area does not exceed 0.35m, and the measurement system can meet the test accuracy requirements.

articleTitle: Keypoint Detection Based on Deep Learning to Improve Illumination Robustness
abstract: Towards the problem of extracting suitable feature points in computer vision, this paper presents a learning- based method to detect keypoints with repeatability and reliability when the light intensity changes drastically of weather or climate conditions. In contrast to patch-based neural networks, a fully convolutional neural network structure is designed that can operate on a full-size image after a forward pass to generate detection points and corresponding descriptors. We introduce feature pyramids, FCN network structures, cell boundary drift, and metric learning for boosting the repeatability and light robustness of interest point detection. Our model, when training on the AMOS image dataset, is able to repeatedly detect a richer set of interest points than other conventional corner point detectors and filter out reliable feature points by non-maximum suppression. Through intense experiments and in-depth analysis, the experimental results show that the proposed method greatly improves the light robustness of keypoints detection compared to ORB, FAST, SURF, and SIFT.

articleTitle: Simulation and Design of Underwater Six-Rotor Unmanned Helicopter
abstract: In this paper, a novel underwater robot with sixrotor mechanical structure is proposed different with existing mechanical structure and control method. The new designed underwater helicopter is called Underwater Six-Rotor Unmanned Helicopter, and it can perform full freedom underwater actions. Therefore, the proposed underwater helicopter has its own advantages compared with existing AUVs (Autonomous underwater helicopters) and ROVs (Remotely Operated Vehicles). The hardware and software structures of the proposed system are analyzed in deep. Moreover, the kinematic and dynamic model of proposed new vehicle is established. Finally, spiral shape trajectory tracking effect is simulated to verify theoretical model.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method of Knowledge Graph-Based Recommender System Based on FCE and GA-BP Neural Network
abstract: In the background of the big data era, the knowledge graph-based recommender system has been widely used in the field of intelligent manufacturing. The purpose of this paper is to fill the gaps in the evaluation of the knowledge graph-based recommender system and evaluate the engineering effect of the system. This paper establishes an evaluation indicator system of the knowledge graph-based recommender system and designs an evaluation method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and GA-BP neural network. The evaluation method uses the basic indicator data of the knowledge graph-based recommender system and it’s fuzzy evaluation result vector to train the GA-BP neural network. This method can obtain fuzzy evaluation results directly according to the basic indicator data. Finally, the experiment results show that the fuzzy evaluation results predicted by the GA-BP neural network have small errors. The evaluation method can objectively reflect the engineering effect of the knowledge graph-based recommender system and replace the traditional single fuzzy comprehensive evaluation effectively.

articleTitle: An improved non-local means filter for image mixed noise
abstract: The non-local means filter (NLMF) can improve the denoising effect of the image while retaining good edge details. However, the smoothing coefficient h needs to be manually determined before processing. In advance, the non-local means filter has a weak denoising ability for impulse noise and SPN salt-and-pepper noise. In order to overcome these problems, this letter improves the non-local means filter for image noise, with combining with median filtering, and using an adaptive smoothing coefficient h. The proposed method can be used to mixed noise. Gaussian noise, impulse noise, or salt-and- pepper noise are processed in this letter. Compared with median filter, mean filter and standard non-local mean algorithm, the adaptive non-local means filter proves the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Approach law sliding mode control for path following of underactuated ships with state observer
abstract: Aiming at uncertain model, unknown external disturbance and difficult velocity measurement in the path following of underactuated ships. A sliding mode control method combining approach law and state observer is proposed. Firstly, the reference heading angle is designed according to the backingstepping algorithm. Then, the sliding mode controller is designed to control the heading angle. The exponential reaching law is introduced to suppress chattering caused by the fixed switching gain coefficient of the conventional sliding mode control. Using extended state observer(ESO) and nonlinear observers to estimate external disturbances and hard-to-measure velocities. Lyapunov function is used to prove the stability of the system. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of controller are verified by comparative experiments.

articleTitle: A Parallel Association Rule Mining Algorithm Based on Spark and its application
abstract: The research of association rule mining (ARM) is very hot. Along with the increase of data size, single machine ARM algorithms have encountered difficulties in time and memory. Distributed computing could break this bottleneck. In this paper, a parallel association rule mining algorithm is proposed, which is called PFIBM-Growth (parallel frequent item binary matrix growth) algorithm. The algorithm constructs a binary matrix to compress and store data sets, and it uses simple matrix operations to mine frequent itemsets in parallel. In addition, we have applied this algorithm to the failure prognostic of primary air fans. We find that not only the algorithm is not bad, but also the association rules got from it could realize the failure prognostic of primary air fans.

articleTitle: Intelligent setting of zinc dust dosage for a cobalt removal process based on estimation of zinc dust utilization ratio
abstract: Cobalt removal process involves the addition of zinc dust to remove impurity ions. Reasonable setting of zinc dust dosage is crucial in avoiding excessive zinc dust addition and guaranteeing the cobalt removal performance. However, due to the fluctuation of inlet conditions and the complexity of reaction dynamics inside the reactor, the precise determination of zinc dust dosage is challenging. In this paper, an intelligent setting method for zinc dust dosage based on estimation of zinc dust utilization ratio is proposed. Firstly, considering the accumulative effect of the large-scale metallurgical reactor, the reactant accumulation ratio (RAR) is defined. Then dynamic linear slow feature analysis (DSFA) is conducted using RAR and related process variables. The selected slow features describing the underlying process dynamics are used as the inputs of neural network to estimate the utilization ratio of zinc dust. Finally, the zinc dust dosage is determined according to the estimation result of utilization ratio. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, experiments were carried out using the actual production data of a cobait removal process. The experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Virtual Sample Generation Method Based on Conditional Generative Adversarial Network
abstract: In the chemical production process, due to certain physical limitations and high measurement costs, it is sometimes difficult to obtain plenty of data points to improve the accuracy of the prediction model. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a novel virtual sample generation method to reasonably expand training sets, aiming to promote accuracy of prediction model. First, the outliers of the original samples are found by local outlier factor. Then, iterative midpoint interpolation is performed on each outlier to obtain a new sample x with a more uniform distribution, so as to fill the scarce area as much as possible. Second, the corresponding output of these new virtual samples are generated by a generative model based on conditional generative adversarial network. To observe the effectiveness of the proposed method, we used standard function dataset and purified terephthalic acid (PTA) production dataset for verification. Experimental results show that our method effectively improves the accuracy of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Fault observer for morphing aircraft with inaccurate attack angle and pitch rate
abstract: The fault observer design of morphing aircraft (MA) is studied with inaccurate angle of attack and pitch rate measurements. A new descriptor observer with robust characteristics is developed to estimate system states and faults. Sufficient conditions for the stability are obtained according to Lyapunov theory, and all signals are proved bounded. Simulations demonstrate the proposed algorithm and the descriptor observer are effective.

articleTitle: A New Method to Improve the Dynamic and Static Performance of Gyroscope Based on Fuzzy Strong Tracking Unscented Kalman Filter
abstract: In order to generalize Kalman filter (KF) to nonlinear system, compensate the random drift error of micro electro mechanical system (MEMS) gyroscope, improve the limited dynamic tracking ability of filter, and overcome the drawback of poor adaptability of strong tracking filter (STF) and strong tracking unscented Kalman filter (STUKF), in this paper, fuzzy strong tracking unscented Kalman filter (FSTUKF) is designed by combining fuzzy control algorithm with STUKF. The algorithm modifies the softening factor of STUKF in real time through fuzzy rules, and then adaptively adjusts the fading factor. Finally, the static and dynamic experiments are carried out. The experiments results verily the effectiveness and superiorities of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Surrogate-Assisted and Population Characteristics’ Transfer for Expensive Optimization Problems
abstract: To save computational costs for expensive optimization problems, an approach of surrogate-assisted expensive optimization problem based on population characteristics’ transfer (SAEO-PCT) is proposed in this paper. The method is based on the framework of multi-task evolutionary optimization. Specifically, the expensive problem to be optimized is regarded as one task, and the other task is based on the cheap surrogate model. The population distribution characteristics and elite individuals in the evolution are regarded as the population characteristics’ knowledge. In the process of evolution, the cross transfer between the tasks is adopted to regularly transfer the population characteristics in the surrogate-assisted optimization task to the time-consuming optimization task. At the same time, the population characteristics are also transferred within the task, and the population renewal is achieved through population reconstruction, to speed up the time-consuming calculation and optimization task. Benchmark experiments show that SAEO-PCT can successfully accelerate the convergence of the time-consuming optimization problems and save computational costs.

articleTitle: Quantitative prediction of load demand response capabilities for air conditioning systems
abstract: By exploiting thermal energy storage, short-term reducing power consumption of air-conditioning systems is able to participate in the load demand response to electrical power grids. This paper proposes a method to evaluate the demand response capability of air-conditioned rooms based on measurement data. First, the relationship between indoor steady-state temperature and air-conditioning steady-state power is calculated based on historical data of air-conditioned rooms. Second, a dynamic model is identified for an air-conditioned room and is exploited to quantitatively estimate the demand response capacity of the room. Experiments are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A heterogeneous master-slave teleoperation method for 7-DOF manipulator
abstract: Teleoperation is widely used because of its ability to extend human behavior and perception to slave robots. In this paper, we use a wearable exoskeleton as the master device for human-robot interaction, which can obtain the movement posture of the operator naturally and intuitively. The slave device uses a 7-DOF redundant manipulator similar to the human arm structure, which improves flexibility without being over redundant. In addition, an inverse kinematics method is proposed to meet the requirements of anthropomorphic remote operation of master-slave heterogeneity. Simulation experiments are carried out in combination with MATLAB and ROS RVIZ environment to prove the performance of the heterogeneous teleoperation control method.

articleTitle: On the accelerated extremum seeking driven by optimal stochastic perturbations
abstract: Nowadays, extremum seeking has become a hot topic and one important way is to use the gradient of the target function to determine the next instruction. Since the gradient cannot be directly derived in practice, two-sided extremum seeking algorithm with fixed step size is considered in this paper. On one hand, optimal randomness is discussed and it is found that Bernoulli distribution is the optimal randomness given some specific performance index. On the other hand, accelerated extremum seeking algorithm is provided and its properties are presented for convex quadratic functions. All the mentioned results are validated by simulation examples in each part.

articleTitle: Research on the dual-source laser monocular ranging method for UAV inspection of bridge pier cracks
abstract: The realization of UAV path planning through a ranging system is one of the key technologies for fully automatic bridge pier inspection. Taking into account the working environment, cost factors and system complexity of the bridge pier inspection equipment, the author designed an embedded ranging system with ARMv7-A as the core and a dual-source laser sensor and CMOS sensor as the core devices for collaborative ranging. On this basis, the characteristics of the dual-source laser spot are used to accurately divide the region of interest (ROI), and the spot centroid coordinates are extracted to achieve monocular ranging in a complex environment. Experiments show that the system has a measurement error of 0.4% and a range of 220 cm. It has the characteristics of good accuracy, strong stability, high convenience and low cost. This provides a new solution for path planning of fully automatic bridge pier inspection.

articleTitle: A fusion method for AUV collaborative location based on information gain weighting
abstract: In order to improve the global localization accuracy, the influence of gross errors and the real-time localization information in the cooperative localization of autonomous underwater vehicle system under clutter interference, a local information fusion algorithm based on information gain is proposed. In this paper, the reliability of each measurement information is investigated from information entropy theory, and the multi-group local filtering information of the multi-master underwater vehicle is optimized. Taking the information gain as the weight, the multi-group filtering results are fused to generate the localization information measured from the AUV. A parallel structure of local information filtering and information gain weighting method is proposed, which utilizes a real-time update mechanism to ensure that the input values of the information weighting algorithm come from the latest local filtering output values. In the end, simulation results demonstrate that this method can effectively reduce the absolute error of local filtering and improve the localization accuracy.

articleTitle: Detection method of various types of auto lamps based on improved Faster R-CNN model
abstract: Auto spray painting robots can realize the automation of various types of auto lamp spraying. The auto lamp detection algorithm is the key technology of the robot. The Faster R-CNN model is selected to detect the lamp, and some improvements are made to the model to achieve better detection effect. To generate more multi-dimensional feature expressions for auto lamps, residual network ResNet101 and feature pyra-mid network (FPN) are used to extract the features of auto lamps. Compatible Intersection over Union (CIoU) is used as the bounding box regression loss function to provide moving direction and more accurate position information for the bounding box and accelerate the convergence speed of the model. Through the auto lamp detection experiment, the average recognition accuracy of the improved model is 98.96%, and the detection speed is 0.46s per image. The improved model can realize the effective recognition of auto lamp types and meet the requirements of real-time processing.

articleTitle: Application of Fireworks Algorithm Improved Neural Network in Predictive Control of Ship Dynamic Positioning
abstract: The movement of the ship on the water surface is a kind of non-linear movement, and will be disturbed by the complicated environment. Considering the advantages of predictive control in nonlinear control and the ability of neural network to continuously learn and modify itself, neural network is used to train predictive model of predictive control. Aiming at that the back propagation (BP) neural network has some problems, such as weak generalization ability, low optimization accuracy and easy to fall into local optimality. And improved neural network based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO-BP) has improved the prediction accuracy of neural network to a certain extent, but it still has shortcomings. Introduce the Fireworks Algorithm (FA) to the neural network, use the FA to optimize the initial weight and threshold of the neural network, and apply the improved neural network (FA-BP) prediction model to predictive control. The results show that: compared with PSO-BP network, the control method based on FA-BP predictive model has better control performance.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of A Fractional Rumor Spreading Model with Time Delay
abstract: In this paper, a fractional order SIR rumour spreading model with time delay is investigated. The stability analysis and sufficient conditions for Hopf bifurcation are discussed. Firstly, a SIR rumour spreading model is established and the influence of time delay on rumour propagation is considered. According to the practical significance, the model is transformed into a fractional model, and the linearized system at the positive equilibrium point is obtained. The distribution of characteristic roots is discussed by calculating characteristic equations and the stability of the system at positive equilibrium point is studied. Then the bifurcation point is obtained by taking the time delay as the bifurcation parameter. The results show the stability at the positive equilibrium point of the system depends on the critical value of time delay. Eventually the accuracy of the conclusion is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Granger Causality Models with Gaussian Kernel Functions for Industrial Alarm Correlation Analysis
abstract: The alarm analysis between different variables is recognized as a complex and important subject in the process industry. However, the discrete type of alarm data and the unclear time-delay between alarm data of different variables discourage the use of traditional causality analysis methods. In this paper, a Granger causality model based on Gaussian kernel functions is used to analyze the correlation of industrial alarms. Firstly, aiming at the reduction of false alarms caused by chattering alarms and binary operating data associated with switching valves, the Gaussian kernel function method is used to convert binary data into continuous sequences. Secondly, Dynamic Time Warping approaches are used to perform similarity matching on continuous sequences, screening and correlating alarms. Finally, the Granger causality model is used to obtain the correlation between different variable alarms.

articleTitle: Terahertz Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning to Identify the Origin of Ginseng
abstract: An effective identification method of ginseng origin based on terahertz spectroscopy and machine learning was proposed. Extinction coefficients at terahertz frequency of ginseng collected from China, Canada and America are investigated using the proposed method, in the frequency range from 0.2 to 1.3 THz. Principal component analysis is employed to reduce the dimensionality of the original data and extract features. The processed data by principal component analysis is fed into a classification model established by random forest and support vector machines. The identification rate of two classification models can be achieved 88.5% and 87.5% respectively. Compared with SVM model, RF model can obtain better results. Ginseng from America and Canada is more similar and there are relatively high mistaken between Canada and America with both models. The results demonstrating that terahertz spectroscopy combined with machine learning can be used for the identification of the origin of ginseng.

articleTitle: First and Second Order Similarity Learning for Clustering on Grassmann Manifolds
abstract: It is challenging to cluster multidimensional data (such as image sets or videos) with complex intrinsic relationships and nonlinear manifolds structure. Inspired by the self-expression models for clustering in the linear space, researchers proposed several effective clustering methods in Grassmann manifolds space. However, these methods in the manifolds space obtain the affinity matrix by the self-expression coefficient, which may fail to fully consider the local structural relationships of data points on Grassmann manifolds. To address these issues, a first and second order similarity learning model for clustering on Grassmann manifolds (GFSOSL) is proposed. To consider the local structural relationships of data points and their neighborhood structural relationships, we learn the first order similarity (FOS) and second order similarity (SOS) simultaneously. Further, to constrain the rank of affinity matrix properly, the nuclear norm and Frobenius norm simultaneous constraint is proposed. The experiments have been constructed on some common image datasets and video datasets and the results demonstrate that the performance of our proposed algorithm outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines.

articleTitle: Multi-compensated Spatiotemporal Modeling For Polymer Flooding Distributed Parameter System
abstract: Polymer flooding is an important oil recovery technology, which is essentially a strong nonlinear and time-varying distributed parameter system (DPS). Most of the existing modeling work ignore the dynamic description of the reservoir intermediate states, resulting in a low prediction accuracy. Therefore, a multi-compensated spatiotemporal modeling method is developed in this paper. The highlights of the model constructed includes two aspects: (i) a bi-layer structure is designed, to describe the relationship between polymer injection inputs-reservoir intermediate states-moisture contents of production wells, (ii) a multi-compensated mechanism, including online updating of spatial dominant basis functions and time coefficients, is supplemented to reflect real-time spatiotemporal dynamics and minimize modeling error. At last, an actual polymer flooding case study is taken, and the better performance metric verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed modeling method.

articleTitle: Active Equalization Control System and Design of Lithium Battery
abstract: Aiming at the inconsistency in the use of lithium battery pack, an active balance control strategy is proposed in this paper. The principle of bidirectional flyback equalization circuit is analyzed. The SPI interface of MC9S12XEP100 is used to communicate with LTC3300 in serial, and the hardware system circuit is designed. According to the communication protocol of the equalization controller, the equalization command is written and executed, and an active equalization control method is designed. The experimental results show that the designed hardware circuit and software algorithm are feasible, the data transfer is stable and normal, and the energy flow between batteries can be realized, and the battery balance control requirements can be met.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Control in Sensorless Brushless DC Motor
abstract: Because the traditional brushless DC motor is in extreme environments, its position sensor cannot be used and the control effect is not good. Therefore, according to the mathematical model of the brushless DC motor, the rotor position information is obtained by the rotor position detection method, and the fuzzy PID control is proposed as the motor system control device, and compared with the simulation result waveform of the motor rotor speed under the PID control, the fuzzy PID control is obtained. Due to the fuzzy rules, PID parameters can be adjusted in real time, so that the output speed of the position sensorless brushless DC motor is more stable and effective than the PID control method.

articleTitle: Graphical Platform of Intelligent Algorithm Development for Object Detection of Educational Drone
abstract: With the rapid development of drone technology and Artificial Intelligence, the application of the combination of AI and drone has become more and more attractive. The educational drone fills this characteristic, and it also accords with the demands of the market. It is supported that the users usually program and control the educational drone by means of graphical programming. However, it is relatively cumbersome to implement Artificial Intelligence algorithms in educational drone. It is difficult to understand and use intelligent methods for children. This paper introduces a graphical intelligent algorithm development platform that adopts the Scratch graphical programming language and Artificial Intelligence algorithms. Firstly, we proposed an implementation architecture with three parts. Secondly, we use visual graphical programming to build and learn Artificial Intelligence methods and models. Finally, the target detection function of educational drone is treated as an example to prove the effectiveness of the proposed platform. The paper proposed a new development tool for the AI-educational drone. It will promote the application of the AI into the education of children.The platform adopts a combination of front and back ends, using back-end servers for algorithm implementation and neural network training and testing.

articleTitle: Optimal design of agricultural park considering carbon emission
abstract: The way of cultivating crops in greenhouse has been widely popularized in China. The regulation of crop growth environment under greenhouse conditions needs strict technical support to meet the environmental requirements for the growth of vegetables and fruits in greenhouse. At present, the energy supply methods used in most greenhouses are wet curtain fan and heat pump, but people often control the start and stop of wet curtain fan according to previous experience. Because there are many uncertainties of wet curtain fan, its mathematical model cannot be determined, and the accurate control of equipment cannot be realized, which often leads to serious energy waste and increases the cost of enterprises. Therefore, this paper proposes the method of CCHP instead of wet curtain fan, using CCHP (Combined Cooling Heating and Power) and heat pump to supply energy for greenhouse, establishes a optimization model through energy plus and MATLAB, and optimizes the capacity and operation scheduling of CCHP system core equipment and heat pump by using nondominated sorting genetic algorithms (NSGA - II), which verifies the effectiveness of the method and solution algorithm proposed in this paper. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce CO2 emissions and further save costs, so as to reduce the economic cost of greenhouse production.

articleTitle: Estimating Correlation Between Brain Consciousness and Depth of Anesthesia Based on EEG
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is an intuitive indicator for judging the patient’s level of consciousness and the depth of anesthesia (DOA) in clinical surgery. Evaluating the patient’s DOA according to EEG can assist the anesthesiologist to more accurately determine the type and dose of anesthetics. However, due to the irregularity of EEG waveform, it is difficult to directly give the correlation between the patient’s level of consciousness and DOA. From this point of view, in this article, the nonlinear dynamic methods and the frequency-domain methods are combined to analyze EEG, and characteristic parameters are used to analyze the changing trend of the patient’s level of consciousness during general anesthesia. Then the Elman Neural Network (ElmanNN) and the Long and Short-Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM) are used to extract the temporal features of the characteristic sequence segments and identify the patient’s DOA in the current period of time and predict the DOA in the next period of time. The results show that in the recognition and prediction of the DOA, when the aforementioned characteristic indicators are input as the combined parameter, the test accuracy of the ElmanNN is 88.46% and 82.69%, and the test accuracy of the LSTM is 90.38% and 74.04%. Compared with other feature combination methods, this model is more accurate in determining the patient’s DOA.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Networks for Coupled Matrix Equations Based on Gradient Search
abstract: A gradient-based neural network is investigated and analyzed for coupled matrix equations. First, a non-negative function is established to construct the neural network. Then, a recurrent neural network is developed to find the solution of coupled matrix equations. Some convergence results of the presented gradient-based neural network under different activation functions are developed. Moreover, a modified version of the designed neural network is proposed for the considered equations. Numerical examples are given to show the advantages of the developed methods.

articleTitle: LAF-Net: Local attention fusion for point cloud semantic segmentation
abstract: How to utilize locally implied geometric features for points has attracted more and more attention in recent past. To tackle this dilemma, we present a novel local attention fusion module for 3D points semantic segmentation, called LAF-Net, which fuses low-dimensional contents and high-dimensional semantic features to get multi-resolutional features for points. With a modest computation cast, our LAF-Net achieves better experimental results than the several methods.

articleTitle: Automated Web Service Composition Considering Service Intension and Extension
abstract: In service-oriented computing, the way of creating value-added services by automatic composition of existing ones, as a service collaborative pattern, is gaining a great development trend. But most existing methods are based on matching of input and output parameters of services. In fact, there are always other restrictions or conditions on available services that make them not universally applicable. Existing methods did not fully consider this situation, even though this kind of constraint makes a big difference on service composition. To this end, this paper discusses the consideration of service constraints, and defines the concepts of service intension and service extension following our previous work. On this basis, SIDE (Same-Intension Different-Extension) service set is defined, and two algorithms are proposed to solve the problem that SIDE service set is unknown when composing services. This work conducts experiments on a public test set from ICEBE05 to evaluate the proposed methods. The comparison result shows the effectiveness of our algorithms.

articleTitle: Feedforward-Control-Oriented Identification: A Robust Iterative Learning Approach
abstract: Feedforward controller plays an important role in the achievement of high servo performance in the field of industrial electromechanical systems. Although existing instrumental-variables-based iterative feedforward tuning (IFT) methods show a promising prospect on improving estimation accuracy, the robust approaches have not developed. In this paper, a robust IFT approach is proposed through a combination of instrumental-variables-based system identification and learning control. It transforms the feedforward controller design to a system identification problem, and then to a typical H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> state feedback problem. A simulation example is provided to confirm its superiority.

articleTitle: On-line Inspection System for Finished Circuit Board Based on Machine Vision
abstract: Based on the rough positioning and precise positioning methods of visual detection, ROI multi-partition, BP feature analysis within the partition and multi-factor model detection methods are adopted to detect the surface defects of the components themselves and the welding quality of the components. The detection is based on hierarchical classification and block detection and machine learning function. The components that are prone to problems will be tested in the first order to improve the detection efficiency, eliminate the unqualified products as soon as possible, and send the qualified products to the next process as soon as possible to improve the production efficiency. The software design of the detection system is based on C++ programming language and Halcon visual library. After the image is collected, the image is preprocessed, and the image gray stretch is used to enhance the image contrast. By means of mean filtering, two-dimensional threshold segmentation and Sobel operator edge algorithm are adopted to quickly and accurately obtain the region of interest in the visual image background. According to the ORB algorithm and related algorithms, the template matching feature recognition is carried out, the area detection is carried out, the surface defects of components are detected, and whether there are flip-side welding defects or not. This testing system is suitable for on-line testing of PCB products in large quantities.

articleTitle: 3D Point Clouds Classification and Segmentation Network Based on Global Features
abstract: Point cloud classification and segmentation are the primary tasks in 3D computer vision with great application value. Recently, several methods adopt deep neural networks to solve the problems by directly taking the point clouds as input due to their simplicity and effectiveness. However, existing methods only focus on extracting local information of the point cloud and ignores the global features which carry information of great importance in 3D geometric space. Inspired by the way humans observe a 3D object (analyzing its 3D overall characteristics first and then combining it with more specific details), we propose a global feature-based dynamic graph convolutional neural network (GF-DGCNN) to simultaneously fuse global and local features of point clouds. Firstly, the feature extraction module is used to calculate global features of the point clouds, and then the local geometric features of the point clouds are extracted by edge convolution. Finally, the accuracy of the classification and segmentation problem is improved by fusing the global features and local features of the point clouds. Experimental results show that the proposed GF-DGCNN achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks, including ModelNet40 and ShapeNet.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method of Ocean Current Impacting on Underwater Vehicle Navigation Based on D Numbers Theory
abstract: In view of the threat brought by complex marine environment to the navigation safety of underwater vehicles, a navigation safety situation evaluation method based on D numbers theory is proposed in this paper after considering the plane ocean current impacting. Firstly, through the brief analysis of the influence of ocean current on the vehicle navigation, the evaluation indicators are determined, and a D numbers construction method based on interval distance is proposed. Then, the D numbers integration representation is used to obtain the overall evaluation of each indicator on the quantitative evaluation grades. Finally, the super-standard weight is used to determine the weight of each indicator, and the comprehensive safety situation index is obtained after the fusion of multiple indicators. The simulation results show that the proposed approach can reflect the actual situation to a certain extent, and has a reference significance in the safe navigation of underwater vehicle.

articleTitle: Multi-class MI-EEG Classification: Using FBCSP and Ensemble Learning Based on Majority Voting
abstract: How to decode multi-class motor imagery EEG and decipher an individual’s intents more accurately has always been a problem worthy of study in biomedical field. In the process of recognition and classification of 2-class motor imagery EEG, the Common Spatial Pattern (CSP) algorithm detects ERD /ERS by calculating the spatial filter and achieves great success. In this paper, we use self-frequency Segmented Filter Bank Common Spatial Patterns (FBCSP) with the one versus one (OVO) multi class extension on the classification of 4-class MI-EEG (BCI Competition IV Datasets 2a), and the Majority Voting strategy is adopted for the individual classifiers we select. We finally get a considerable classification result and the comparison of different methods shows that the performance of ensemble learning based on voting strategy is better than that of using individual classifier.

articleTitle: A Cluster Head Selection Strategy Based on Node Compactness for Dynamic Clustering in Event-Driven Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: In some monitoring sensor networks, event-driven data transmission and clustering are adopted to reduce energy consumption. When an event occurs, the sensor nodes in the event area form a cluster and transmit data to the cluster head (CH), and then the CH fuses the data and sends it to the sink node. As the event moves, the cluster needs to be reformed and the CH has to be dynamically updated. This paper proposes a dynamic clustering scheme based on node compactness (DCND) for event-driven wireless sensor networks (WSNs) with uneven node distribution. In order to reduce the energy consumption of the network and improve energy efficiency, a CH selection strategy based on node compactness is developed. The compactness of each sensor node in the event area is calculated, and the node with the largest compactness is selected as the CH. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme can balance and reduce network energy consumption, and extend the life cycle of the network.

articleTitle: Review on Hybrid Power System of Hydrogen Fuel Cell Passenger Vehicles
abstract: As a direction of development, hydrogen fuel cell passenger vehicle has a wide market due to its environment- friendly, high conversion efficiency, rapid filling of hydrogen and modularization. According to the connection mode, the hybrid power system topology is divided into direct connection structure and indirect connection structure, each of them has its own advantages and disadvantages. According to the power capacity of the fuel cell system and the battery, it can be divided into three kinds of types: energy compensation, power hybrid and full power, and the type of full power would be the trend for fuel cell passenger vehicle. This article studies on three typical mass-production full-power hydrogen fuel cell passenger vehicles in the world, including Mirai, NEXO, and CLARITY. Analysis are made on their power system topology and parameters, in order to provide references for industry research.

articleTitle: Public Opinion Evolution Based on the Flocking Algorithm
abstract: Surrounded by the explosive development of information, people always present different views and attitudes towards a social event, and how to create a topic to have an impact on the public opinion evolution imperceptibly and effectively has become a promising topic. In order to have a public opinion evolution model close to reality, this paper proposes a dynamic topological network with a high degree of verisimilitude and improves the public opinion evolution algorithm based on the flocking algorithm. Moreover, we propose an innovate attempt of combining the movement-mode with the opinion-exchange algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed network public opinion evolution model can impact the public opinion evolution with autonomous, efficient and complete convergency, while simultaneously show the powerful capability of our model in handling the problem of public opinion guidance in social networks.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Assessment of Blockchain Using Confrontation Deduction
abstract: blockchain technology is one of the strategic emerging information technologies. It integrates a variety of technologies such as cryptography, peer-to-peer network, consensus algorithm and smart contract, and has been gradually applied in various fields. The contradiction between the rapid development of blockchain industry and the incompleteness of evaluation system and technical means has become increasingly prominent. The vulnerability of blockchain system is an important part of blockchain evaluation system. It is of great significance for the development of blockchain technology and large-scale application to fully study the vulnerability of blockchain system and conduct quantitative evaluation or real-time monitoring. This paper systematically analyzes the vulnerability of blockchain, and puts forward the technical indicators to evaluate the vulnerability of blockchain. Based on the vulnerability technical index of blockchain consensus algorithm and industrial blockchain consensus algorithm PBFT, a consensus algorithm confrontation deduction model is designed, and the vulnerability index of blockchain system using PBFT is experimentally simulated and evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy PI Control Method of GDI Engine Common Rail Pressure
abstract: The rail pressure of engine common rail system fluctuates with different driving conditions. The constant value control of rail pressure is one of the key technologies to improve the emission and dynamic characteristics. Fuzzy algorithm is used to adaptively adjust the parameters of PI controller under all working conditions. According to the information of the reference rail pressure, the change rate of the reference rail pressure and the rail pressure error, the parameters of the PI controller under each working condition are adjusted by fuzzy reasoning, The rail pressure of the common rail system is adaptively controlled under idle speed, acceleration, high-speed driving, moving condition and sudden change condition. The simulation results show that the fuzzy PI method is superior to the traditional control method in tracking accuracy and response speed, and meets the requirements of the actual common rail system rail pressure control.

articleTitle: A Corner Feature Detection Algorithm for 3D Grid Map
abstract: Nowadays, multi-robots begin to gain advantages when performing tasks in more and more complex environments. However, how to merge maps without any priori information and mutual observation is very important and is still an unsolved problem. Extracting corner feature points from the map and complete the following up data association can help merge maps for multi-robots. This paper proposed an algorithm based on sliding window and 3D convolution operator to extract corner features. We established a sliding window and used the 3D convolution operator to screening the corner feature from a 3D grid map. The proposed algorithm was directly based on 3D grid maps making it can extract comer feature for subsequent map fusion. Experimental results in the Google public datasets and our own datasets validated that the proposed algorithm can extract the corner features from 3D maps precisely and effectively in a variety of environments.

articleTitle: Optimization for Operation and Information Process of Railway Logistics
abstract: In order to improve the transportation organization and informatization level of railway logistics base, this paper analyzes its informatization status and problems, puts forward optimization methods, and puts forward optimization suggestions for the operation process and information process of logistics base, so as to help improve the operation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on a Visual SLAM Loop Closure Detection algorithm based on a VGG-19 network
abstract: With the current rapid development of robotics technology and intelligent industrial transportation systems, the algorithms of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) for Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV) receive more and more researchers’ attentions. In current stage, a big challenge is how to effectively improve the pose accuracy of AGVs. When a visual SLAM has been running for a long time, the position estimation errors between frames are usually inevitably generated and accumulated to the next state, which will eventually cause the AGVs to produce pose drifts. To solve this problem, it is necessary to perform a Loop Closure Detection (LCD) and perform inter-frame constraints for remote frames. In this paper, a LCD based on a Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition (VGG-19) network is proposed for improving the pose accuracies of AGVs. Experimental results show that the accuracy of this method is 6.5% higher than that of traditional Bag of Words (BoW) method.

articleTitle: Improved simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation controller for hypersonic vehicle
abstract: Aiming at the reentry control law for hypersonic vehicle, this paper proposes an online adaptive control law. The online estimation of the key parameters is based on the states of the aircraft so that the cumbersome on-line parameter adjustment process of traditional methods can be eliminated. Based on PID theory, and combined with the states of the aircraft, the design of the control law can be completed. Simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) algorithm is used here to estimate the parameters of the traditional controller. At the same time, in order to meet the requirements of fast and time-varying state quantities of hypersonic vehicles, this paper improves the traditional SPSA method so as to improve the efficiency of the algorithm to a great extent. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is robust and can meet the control law design requirements.

articleTitle: Narrowband RFI Suppression Based on Gaussian Function for UWB Synthetic Aperture Radar
abstract: Ultra-wideband synthetic aperture radar (UWB SAR) working at very high frequency or ultrahigh frequency (VHF/UHF) not only has the characteristics of all-weather, all-weather operation and high-resolution imaging, but also has the strong penetration capability, which can detect and image the concealed target under the vegetation. However, there are a large number of radio frequency interference (RFI) signals in the VHF/UHF band. The UWB SAR system will also receive the RFI signal when receiving the target echo signal, which will seriously affect the detection ability and imaging quality of the UWB SAR. The frequency domain notch method is one of the most common methods of the RFI suppression in the UWB SAR imaging, which transforms each pulse echo signal to the range frequency domain to concentrate the energy of the RFI signal and set the threshold to suppress the RFI signal. But the RFI suppression performance of frequency domain notch method depends heavily on the interference threshold, and the RFI suppression of each pulse echo separately will always lead to a large amount of the residual interference. Thus, a narrowband RFI suppression method based on Gaussian function for the UWB SAR is proposed in this paper. Because the RFI signal has the narrowband characteristic, the proposed narrowband RFI suppression method based on Gaussian function transforming the echo signal into two-dimensional frequency domain, which can concentrate the energy of the RFI signal further than that into range frequency domain only, so that the RFI signal can be extracted by the Gaussian function and then eliminated. The simulation results show that the narrowband RFI suppression method based on the Gaussian function has the better effect of the RFI suppression than the frequency domain notch method.

articleTitle: Transient chaos analysis of a modified Sprott-C system with hidden attractor and multistability
abstract: In this paper, a modified Sprott-C chaotic system is proposed, which shows rich dynamic behaviors. Firstly, the Poincare section and power spectrum are used to analyze the chaotic characteristics of the system with given parameters. And then the type and stability of the equilibrium points of the system are analyzed. When the system contains stable equilibrium points, the transient chaos of the system is analyzed by introducing a simplified model of z-axis time series. When the z-axis time series of the system reaches the maximum value M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>, the system trajectory collides with the edge of the basin of chaos, which leads to the transient chaos. Finally, The multistability of the system is analyzed, When the initial points are different, the chaotic attractor and periodic attractor coexist, and the chaotic attractor is the hidden attractor.

articleTitle: Load Clustering for Power System Combined With Dimensionality Reduction Method
abstract: With the development of the electric power industry, the accumulated data on electricity is gradually showing a massive trend. To effectively classify the massive load data, a power load clustering method combined with a dimensionality reduction method is proposed in this paper for classifying the daily load curve sets. The principal component analysis method is first used to realize the dimensionality reduction processing and the typical feature extraction of the daily load curve set; Then the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is utilized to cluster the dimensionality reduction curves. Simulation results show that the proposed method has great advantages in the extraction of typical characteristics of load data and load classification.

articleTitle: Application of Modified Control Strategies for Temperature Control Process of Conditioning Cylinder with Large Delay-Time
abstract: Systems with a ratio of delay-time to time constant greater than 1 are often difficult to be controlled, especially the robustness would be severely deteriorated. First, a simplified predictive PI controller is proposed, which utilizes predictive PI algorithm to tune the parameters of PID controller. Then, a pseudo-predictive PI controller is designed based on the simplified predictive PI controller. This controller utilizes the heating effect of the conditioning cylinder on the tobacco and combines the characteristics of the combined integral and predictive PI. Finally, the two control strategies are respectively applied to the first order plus delay time model, and the simulation results show that both control strategies have good properties of dynamic response, anti-interference, and no overshoot, when compared to commonly used control strategies, such as fuzzy PID. Most importantly, the robustness of both control strategies is excellent.

articleTitle: Distributed Broad Learning System With Quantized and Censored Communications
abstract: As a novel neural network model, the broad learning system (BLS) has been used extensively due to its simple structure and few model hyperparameters. This paper presents a distributed BLS algorithm with quantized and censored communications (DQC-BLS). The DQC-BLS algorithm is based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). In order to reduce the high communication cost, the DQC-BLS algorithm improves the communication mechanism between the in-networks agents by introducing quantization and communication-censoring strategies. Quantization reduces the number of bits for each transmission whereas communication censoring reduces the number of communications. The experimental results verify that the DQC-BLS algorithm can reduce communication costs while maintaining similar performance on the test set.

articleTitle: Power Load Equipment Classification Based on Fuzzy Style K-plane Clustering
abstract: As the increasing amount of load equipment connected to the power system, the traditional extensive load aggregation cannot meet the demand for refined management and control. Through the analysis and processing of the massive data accumulated during the operation of the load equipment, the load equipment with the same electricity consumption habits will be pre-clustered, which has guiding significance for the fine aggregation and control of the load.
