This paper uses the fuzzy style K-plane clustering algorithm (S-KPC) to perform cluster analysis on a variety of load equipment, excavate the style characteristics in the load equipment power consumption data, realize the classification of load equipment, and analyze the clustering of different equipment response potential. Taking the measured data of load in a certain area as the research object and comparing the S-KPC algorithm with other clustering algorithms, the results show that the clustering algorithm can mine load style characteristics and significantly improve the accuracy of classification.

articleTitle: A Fractional-order Sliding Mode Control Method for the USV Path Tracking
abstract: For the purpose of path tracking control of under-actuated ships, and to solve the problems of inaccurate ship speed acquisition, unknown external disturbances and the uncertainty of the ship model, in this paper, a fractional-order sliding mode controller based on sliding mode variable structure control and fractional calculus is proposed. The controller proved the stability and effectiveness of the controller through the Lyapunov theory; Besides, the corresponding simulation verification is carried out. Through the final simulation results, the control method can show that it can effectively reach the path tracking ability of USV, reduce the “chattering” phenomenon of sliding mode, and the controller’s response time and robustness have a better performance.

articleTitle: Sequential probability ratio fault test method of diesel-electric locomotive system based on Kalman filter
abstract: This paper studies the system fault diagnosis of diesel-electric locomotives. First, a simplified model of locomotive speed control is established based on the diesel-electric locomotive system, and then use the delta operator to discretize the linear system and use the kalman filter to obtain the output value predicted by the system model, the predicted output value is compared with the actual value to generate a residual signal, and then the sequential probability ratio test method is introduced for analysis the statistical characteristics of the residual signal, the construction of the decision function and the decision rule, and the monitoring of the system operation status to detect system failures. The research results show that the fault detection method proposed in this paper can effectively realize the process monitoring, and the false alarm rate is low, and the detection speed is fast.

articleTitle: Task space adaptive neural tracking control for uncertain flexible-joint robot with output constraints
abstract: This paper investigates the task space trajectory tracking control of uncertain flexible-joint (FJ) robot with time-varying output constraints. Different from most of the existing results, nonlinear state-dependent functions (NSDF) are employed to cope with output constraints, and an exponential observer (EOB) is utilized to approximate the uncertain kinematics. Radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) is designed to approximate the uncertainty of system dynamics, and only one parameter needs to be adjusted, which can greatly reduce the computational burden. Based on the backstepping method and the command filter (CF), an adaptive trajectory tracking controller is proposed for FJ robot. It is proved by Lyapunov synthesis that all signals in the closed-loop system are bounded and the output tracking error converges to a small neighborhood near zero and the output does not exceed its constraints. Finally, the simulation results of a two-link FJ robot system are utilized to validate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Design of A Beauty Matching App Based on Support Vector Machine
abstract: In order to meet consumer’s huge demands for cosmetic match, this project plans to develop a cosmetic match application --- Beauty, based on support vector machine. Beauty, according to pictures including different shapes of face, can adopt Principle Component Analysis (PCA) to optimize image pixel, get the lower dimension feature vector to support vector machine’s input, and then adopt cross-validation and grid-search to select penalty parameter c and kernel parameter g to train the model. Finally, different facial pictures are tested respectively by making use of these models. And then consumers can get the most suitable recommendation in accordance with classification results.

articleTitle: A Robust to Distractor Detection Method for Multi-layer Industrial Parts Based on Stereo Vision
abstract: In robot grasping tasks, it is a challenge to achieve rapid and accurate object detection. Particularly, the layout of industrial parts is multi-layer, multi-type and disordered (see Fig. 1), so the object detection only relying on RGB image method does not perform well. In this paper, we propose to apply stereo vision combined with convolutional neural network to achieve precise identification and positioning of the multi-layer industrial part. In order to improve the detection accuracy, we use point cloud transformation in stereo vision to preprocess the obtained image information, which takes full advantage of the spatial structure relationship between each object. Based on the historical data of the research objects, the results show that our method can improve the recognition rate of multi-layer industrial parts than the traditional RGB object detection algorithm under the same conditions.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Quantitative Inversion of Soil Organic Matter Based on IPLS-UVE Band Optimization
abstract: Affected by the local natural environment, sandy soil has the characteristics of low content and poor stability. Reasonably increasing the utilization rate of this kind of soil is one of the effective ways to improve crop planting. Compared with traditional measurement methods, hyperspectral quantitative inversion modeling can quickly and accurately predict soil organic matter (SOM)content. After preprocessing the hyperspectral information by Savitzky-Golay and first-order differential processing (SG-1D), this method uses interval partial least squares (IPLS) to model the whole waveband sequentially, and select the characteristic band between 600-800nm for the first time, then combined with the uninformed variable elimination method (UVE) to better optimize the feature vector. The results verify that the IPLS-UVE model has a great improvement in the prediction accuracy of the inversion model under the band selection. The number of bands is reduced from the original 204 to 30, and the prediction set determination coefficient R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.917, and the prediction of root mean square error RMSE=1.748 g kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, and the predicted relative analysis error RPD=3.474. The results illustrate that this method can optimize the selection of soil characteristic bands and thus effectively improve its SOM prediction.

articleTitle: A Robust Lidar-Inertial Localization System Based on Outlier Removal
abstract: Localization and mapping are important for mobile robots. Lidar inertial system has more advantages than single lidar system to deal with rapid rotation. However, in lidar inertial systems, people often ignore the effect of outliers on track accuracy. In this paper, based on the working framework of LIO-SAM, we take a solution to deal with this problem. Firstly, we extract non-ground points from depth images. Then we cluster non-ground points and filter the clustered objects that are less than a given threshold. The features extracted from the depth image are used for scan-to-map matching to obtain the lidar odometry factor. Finally, the factor graph is used to optimize fusion. The results show that our proposed method effectively reduced the error of the estimated trajectory compared with LIO-SAM, and its accuracy is higher than those single lidar systems of LOAM and LEGO-LOAM.

articleTitle: Rheumatoid Arthritis Detection method based on Mask R-CNN
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune rheumatic disease with the feature of joint erosion. The disease mainly occurs in middle age, and women are more susceptible than men. In clinical, radiologists mainly use hand radiographs to observe the appearance of joints to determine the degree of disease. In order to reduce the pressure of long-term repetitive work of radiologists and improve screening efficiency, we propose a detection method based on Mask RCNN. We use an in-house dataset that contains 99 images and is annotated by professional rheumatoid arthritis doctors. Using this method, we can quickly identify the diseased joints from all hand joints and determine their exact positions. This network can automatically detect diseased joints with higher detection accuracy and faster detection speed than other methods.

articleTitle: A Two-Branch Feature Modulated Network for Single Image Deraining
abstract: Rain removal from a single image has been attracting much research attention in computer vision. However, most exiting deraining methods explore the function maps from the input rain images to the clear deraining images, which ignore the information of rain streaks for modulating the feature maps of the deraining image. In this paper, we proposed a two-branch feature modulated network (TBFMNet) for exploring the clear deraining image and rain streak, respectively. During the network, the feature maps of the image branch are modulated by the attention feature maps from the rain-streak branch. Meanwhile, attention feature maps are extracted based on spatial attention unit (SAU) and channel attention unit (CAU), which can explore the essential spatial position and channel weight of rain streak. The extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method significantly boosts performance for single image deraining, including light rain scene and heavy rain scene.

articleTitle: Adaptive estimation and control of uncertain series elastic actuator systems
abstract: For series elastic actuator (SEA) used for robotics, there are many uncertain parameters in their models, which are difficult to obtain based on the design configurations. In this paper, to solve the problem of estimating the unknown model parameters of the SEAs online, we suggest a new adaptive law. Parameter estimation error obtained by filtering input and output measurements to drive the adaptive law, so that can rigorously prove the performance of the exponential convergence of the parameter estimation error. Moreover, in order to synchronously parameter estimation and motion tracking, the idea of using the estimation errors in the adaptive law is further adopted by an adaptive control integration. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed methods is verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Fire Detection Method in Infrared Image Based on Improved YOLO Network
abstract: In order to improve the low recognition accuracy caused by low pixels and few available features when using the infrared image for fire detection, a fire detection method in infrared images is proposed. The convolutional layer is used to replace the down-sampled pooling layer in the original network to reduce the loss of features. CSP_Resnet network and SPP network are introduced to fuse the shallow features with the in-depth features, realize the effective extraction of infrared small target features, and improve the model’s detection accuracy. Experimental results show that the improved model reduces the false alarm rate of using infrared cameras to detect fires. In the self-made dataset, the mAP of fire detection reaches 94.35%, which is 6.06% higher than the original model, proving that the method can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of fire.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control Based on Disturbance Compensation Reaching Law for Pressure Difference in Cement Mill
abstract: For the cement vertical mill system, firstly we establish a model of the internal pressure difference in the mill. Then we use the sliding mode control method with the disturbance compensation approaching law, which adopts delayed disturbance estimation technology, and the control law can be realized without knowing the upper bound of the equivalent disturbance in advance. At the same time, the saturation function is introduced, so the bandwidth of the quasi-sliding mode domain is reduced by setting the appropriate size of boundary, which will improve the control accuracy of the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Water Supply Pipeline Robot Based on Propeller
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to carry out internal inspection for underground narrow pressurized water supply pipelines, a pipeline robot that uses propellers to provide propulsion has been developed. First, the structure principle and movement characteristics of the pipeline robot are analyzed, and the structure and size of the robot are designed based on the commonly used 100mm inner diameter water pipe. Secondly, the robot electric control system is designed, which can control the robot in real time and obtain video and posture information. Finally, the test prototype was manufactured and placed in the simulated pipeline for actual operation. The results show that the pipeline robot can adapt to pressured water supply pipelines with an inner diameter of 100mm and above, can automatically adapt to changes in the curvature of the pipe wall, can pass through right-angle elbows with a turning radius of 50mm, and has good motion characteristics.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Industrial Fault Detection Method Based on Bayesian Randomized Principal Component Analysis
abstract: For monitoring the nonlinear processes efficiently, this paper proposes one improved fault detection method called Bayesian random principal component analysis (BRPCA). Different from the traditional kernel matrix used in the nonlinear modeling, BRPCA uses random Fourier mapping to perform nonlinear transformation on the data in the original input space, and then establishes a randomized principal component analysis (RPCA) model to monitor the process changes. This kind of nonlinear modeling based on random mapping has lower computation complexity. Considering that the single RPCA monitoring model may not provide a comprehensive monitoring on the different kinds of faults, a multi-model fusion strategy using Bayesian inference mechanism is introduced to construct the ensemble RPCA model by integrating the multiple RPCA models. The application study on the Tennessee Eastman chemical process demonstrates that the BRPCA method not only has higher computational efficiency than kernel PCA, but also can detect fault samples more effectively.

articleTitle: ESO-Based Active Stability Control of Tank Guns on the Move with Uncertainties
abstract: This paper focuses on stability control of tank guns on the wove with uncertainties including modeling errors, road incentives and driving speed effects. A nonsingular terminal sliding mode (NTSM) based on extended state observer (ESO) controller is synthesized which can handle with the heavy uncertainties. Constructing an ESO to observe the lumped uncertainties including parameters nominal value error, external disturbance, etc., and the NTSM control law can ensure the stability in finite time. A multi-body dynamic model is established in RecurDyn as the control object, which can imitate the uncertainties above. The co-simulation results verify that the proposed controller can suppress the effects on the move and maintain much better performance than traditional FLC and PID controllers.

articleTitle: Research and Control of Active Power Factor Correction Based on Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation
abstract: This paper presents a new method for active power factor correction based on space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM), which can effectively filter out harmonics of the power grid. Considering the system stability and reliability, the reactive power compensation is essential for a power system. In this paper, the static abc coordinate system is transformed into the synchronous rotation dq coordinate system, and the current and voltage in the dq coordinate system are controlled by double closed-loop feedback, which realizes the bidirectional energy transfer and improves the power factor of the power grid

articleTitle: Robust Trajectory Tracking Control of an Uncertain Robot with Time-varying Error Constrains
abstract: In this article, a robustness adaptive trajectory tracking control strategy is proposed for a robot with uncertainties and error constraints. An asymmetric barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) is adopted to handle the problem of asymmetric time-varying error constraints and enhance the robustness of the control. The adaptive neural network (NN) is used to estimate the complex uncertainty dynamics. Moreover, consider the compensator to improve control accuracy. Using the proposed control strategy, asymptotic tracking can be implemented, and the tracking error does not violate the predefine boundary. All signals of the closed-loop system are proved to be semi-globally uniformly ultimately bounded (SGUUB) via Lyapunov analysis. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Attitude Control for a Kind of Heavy-Lift Launch Vehicle Based on Super-Twisting Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the attitude control problem of heavy-lift launch vehicle, an adaptive control method based on super-twisting algorithm is proposed in this paper, which avoids the high frequency chattering of traditional adaptive control, and has a simple structure. Firstly, the attitude dynamic model of heavy launch vehicle is described as an attitude control system based on quaternion. Then, an adaptive super-twisting controller is designed for the system, and the stability of the closed-loop system is proved. Finally, the proposed control method is compared with the traditional adaptive control method, and the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can make the system error converge to zero more quickly, while effectively suppressing chattering.

articleTitle: Parallel Control-Based Event-Triggered Optimal Control for Constrained Discrete-Time Nonlinear Systems
abstract: This study proposes a new event-triggered optimal control (ETOC) method for discrete-time (DT) constrained nonlinear systems. First, a new triggering condition is proposed. We show the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system using the proposed triggering condition and analyze the degeneration degree of the real performance index. Second, to perform the proposed ETOC method effectively, parallel control (PC) combined with adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) is applied. Finally, the validity of the ETOC method is validated by a simulation.

articleTitle: Image block encryption integrating hyper-chaotic system and neural network mechanism
abstract: a new image block encryption integrating algorithm based on four-dimensional hyperchaotic system and neural network mechanism is cnstructed. Firstly, a hyperchaotic system is proposed, which combines with cloud model, meanwhile generates a series with better randomness as key stream. Then key stream, neural network mechanism and Feistel block strueture are combined to encryption the image. Finally, the experimental results show that the algorithm has good security.

articleTitle: An Improved C2oDE based on Stochastic Ranking: A Further Study
abstract: Constraint Handling Techniques plays an important role when solving Constrained Optimization Problems. In the previous paper, an improved constrained composite differential evolution (C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>oDE) based on stochastic ranking (SR) is proposed with the aim to check if some other combinations of CHTs can be more effective during the two phases of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>oDE. This paper further studies the effect of the selection probability P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> in SR with problem characteristics considered. Experimental results confirm the corresponding relationship between problem characteristics and P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf>, which can give some inspiration when designing new algorithms.

articleTitle: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis Based on Transformer and Low-rank Fusion
abstract: Human emotion expressions are usually expressed as multiple modalities of information, such as natural speech, facial expressions and vocal signals. The information of each modality contains the features of human emotion, and the mutual verification between different modal features can greatly improve the accuracy of sentiment analysis. Therefore, it is important for sentiment analysis to fully explore the features of multiple modalities and analyze the correlation between the features of different modalities. A fusion model MulT-LMF based on MulT and LMF is proposed in this paper, and the LMF model is applied to the output part of the MulT model. The MulT model helps to construct the interaction information among the modalities, while the LMF model helps to further extract the correlations among the modal features. The model in this paper is tested on public multimodal sentiment datasets, including CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI and IEMOCAP. Experimental results show that the model achieves better results in most cases.

articleTitle: The F10.7 Solar Radio Flux Prediction Based On LSTM Neural Network
abstract: The precision of the 10.7 cm solar radio flux (F10.7) prediction is of great significance for the orbital prediction of low earth orbit satellites. In this paper, the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network is used as the prediction method of F10.7 data. The design of the network model and the selection of parameters are introduced as well. Meanwhile, this paper evaluates the prediction performance of the model by using relevant indexes. The result demonstrates that it is a suitable method to predict the F10.7 data and show its tendency. Besides, the prediction effect of the LSTM neural network results in a better effect than which the traditional backpropagation neural network demonstrates.

articleTitle: A Novel High Gain Magnetically Coupled Impedance Source Inverter With Coupled Inductor Voltage Multiplier Cell
abstract: The II-source inverter reduces the dependence of the inverter on the straight-through duty cycle and avoids the occurrence of the limit duty cycle by introducing the coupled inductor ratio of three windings on the basis of the traditional Z-source inverter. However, in order to achieve high voltage boost of Π-source inverter, large coupled inductor ratio is easy to cause excessive leakage inductance. The voltage is raised by embedding coupled inductor voltage multiplier cell and an additional coefficient n is added to realize three-degree-of-freedom adjustment. Combined with the clamping structure, the leakage inductance energy is absorbed. In this paper, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Application of Data Quantitative Analysis in the Diagnosis of Satellite Attitude and Orbit Control System Health Status
abstract: Relying on the organic organization and cooperation of the multifunctional organs in the body, the organism completes the basic form of life. Attitude Orbit Control System of Satellite (AOCS) is composed of multiple sensors and actuators. It is effectively organized and processed by the on-board computer to complete the attitude and orbit control tasks of the satellite platform. This article compares AOCS to “organisms” that require long-term health diagnosis and treatment and organically decomposes their nominal functional blocks. Then an AOCS quantitative health assessment method is proposed that the health quantitative diagnosis system designed based on. And it can calculate the satellite AOCS quantitative health status score to support the maintenance of the on-orbit satellite AOCS efficiently.

articleTitle: Mission Planning of MAV/UAV Cooperative Combat based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Manned/unmanned aerial vehicles (MAV/UAV) cooperative combat mission planning is an extremely complex decision-making and optimizing problem. The purpose of this is to maximize the overall combat benefit with minimum cost by allocating reasonable targets for different types of aircraft, and proposing rough path planning for coordinated combat formations. Based on the background of OODA integrated combat cycle, this paper establishes the combination optimization model of MAV/UAV cooperative combat, and solves the problems of heterogeneity and resource limitation of MAV/UAV cooperative combat task planning by improving multi genotype genetic algorithm. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of this method are proved by the combat mission of MAV/UAV formation cooperating against ground fixed targets.

articleTitle: Finite-Time H∞ Control for Discrete-time Drilling Toolface System with (x, v)-dependent Noises
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of Toolface control for stabilized platform in rotary steerable systems (RSSs). First, a discrete-time nonlinear stochastic model of the drilling Toolface system (DTS) is presented. The DTS involves the noises caused by changes of rotary inertia, which is associated with state and disturbance. The load torque, the outer housing speed and system states are estimated by a linear extended state observer (LESO), which can improve the robustness against unknown disturbance input. Then, the existence condition for the finite-time H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller is derived, and the gain of controller is obtained by solving a linear matrix inequality (LMI). Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by an emulation trial.

articleTitle: Adaptive Tracking Control for Rotary Steerable System with Sensor Faults
abstract: In this paper, the problem of fault tolerant tracking control is investigated for rotary steerable systems (RSSs) with sensor faults and unknown mismatched disturbances. Firstly, the fuzzy logic systems (FLS) are employed to fit the unknown functions caused by the sensor faults. Then, an adaptive fuzzy tracking control (AFTC) frame is designed for RSSs, which can ensure that the tracking error is converged to a small set and the closed-loop RSS (CLRSS) is semi-global bounded. Finally, a simulation of the RSS is used to verify feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Extended State Observer Based Sliding Mode Control for Ball-Beam System
abstract: This paper develops a linear extended state observer (LESO) based sliding mode controller (SMC) for the ball-beam system. Firstly, the model of the ball-beam system is established as a nonlinear system, in which the kinematic relationship of the angles between the gear and beam are considered. Then, the total disturbance including internal and external that is estimated by LESO and SMC is designed and implemented to control the ball position by adjusting the angle of the beam. As a result, a LESO based SMC is developed. Finally, we apply the LESO based SMC to the ball-beam system using MATLAB SIMULINK and Googol GBB2004, and compare the performances with other traditional methods, such as PD and active disturbance rejection control (ADRC). Both simulation and experiment results show that the combination of SMC and LESO performs better than the other two.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Extraction Algorithm of Building Edge Contour Based on Plane Graph
abstract: In the high-rise building construction industry, the design and layout of the climbing frame should be carried out by identifying the outline of the buildings, so this paper proposes an automatic and efficient extraction algorithm of building edge contour based on plane graph. Under the BIM platform, block the building plan vertically and horizontally, and then the top and bottom contour lines, the leftmost and rightmost contour lines in each block are found, which are connected end to end and stored in the SQL Server database in a classified manner, thus realizing the automatic extraction and storage of the building edge contour lines, making sufficient preparations for the design and layout of the climbing frame. It has a certain application value in the field of construction.

articleTitle: Semi-passive Walking Control of Biped Robot with Muscle Model
abstract: In this paper, the plane stable walking control problem of a semi-passive biped robot with a muscle model was studied. The spring in the Spring-loaded inverted pendulum (SLIP) model was replaced by the modified Hill muscle model, and the dynamic equations of the biped robot in the single support and double support stages were established by the Lagrange method. Human-like control strategies include a combination of passive and active contraction of the leg muscles to keep the total energy of the system near a certain value and controlling the height and forward velocity of the particle by adjusting the landing position of the swinging leg. Based on theoretical analysis, simulation was carried out in the MATLAB environment. The results show that the control method proposed in this paper can realize the stable periodic walking of the biped robot based on the muscle model. When the system is adjusted with external disturbance, the total energy can be restored to balance and the robot can re-enter the stable periodic walking. Moreover, compared with the SLIP model, the proposed control method has stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Used-Car Price Evaluation Using Mean Encoding and PCA based DeepFM
abstract: With the rapid development of the used-car industry, the demand for used-car price evaluation is increasing. Existing studies combine simple data preprocessing method with the traditional machine learning model, which cannot effectively model the complex interactions between features. In this paper, we propose a deep learning approach for used-car price evaluation which combines Mean Encoding, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Deep Factorization Machine (DeepFM). Firstly, the approach preprocesses the used-car data through Mean Encoding and PCA to avoid the high dimension of features. Then, the approach utilizes DeepFM to learn low-order and high-order interactions of the preprocessed features, and the output of network is taken as the price of used-car. We use real used-car trading data from Aliyun for experiments. Compared with LR, FM and DNN, the proposed approach can achieve superior performance of used-car price evaluation more efficiently.

articleTitle: A Round Inductosyn Measuring System Based on Quadrant Comparison and Adjustment Fusion Algorithm
abstract: Round inductosyn has been widely used in harsh industrial applications because of its strong adaptability to extreme environment. The traditional round inductosyn measuring method was not sufficient for getting the continuous absolute angle under severe temperature changes. A new fusion algorithm based on a resolver-to-digital converter hardware circuit is presented to adapt these conditions. In hardware, the circuit improves the measurement accuracy. In software, a fusion algorithm based on quadrant comparison and adjustment was presented. This method solves the trip point of the absolute angle caused by the zero deviation in coarse and fine channel, and can be easily applied to any round inductosyn with integer channel number. This measuring system can adapt to the variation of coarse data caused by the temperature changes. Experiment results show that the round inductosyn measuring system is correct and highly reliable, which can still obtain accurate absolute angle under strong interference.

articleTitle: An improved Wang-Mendel algorithm in Engine Test Bench control system
abstract: The Engine Test Bench system needs to tune the PID parameters every time the engine or dynamometer is replaced. In order to realize the self-tuning of PID parameters, a kind of Wang-Mendel algorithm (WM) which is improved by the Fuzzy C-Means Clustering (FCM) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) is applied to the system. According to the characteristics of the Engine Test Bench system, Data of different characteristics is selected to train the prediction model, so as to predict the PID parameters. This paper first introduces the control structure of the Engine Test Bench system, next introduces the fuzzy prediction model, and then uses the FCM algorithm for data mining and GA to optimize the weight in the WM algorithm. Finally, the prediction model is obtained and the prediction results are used in the actual engineering for testing. The results show that the improved algorithm has higher accuracy and practicability.

articleTitle: Hybrid Strategy based Timetable Rescheduling for High-Speed Railways under Disturbances
abstract: High-speed railways are occasionally subject to emergencies such as extreme weather, device faults or foreign matter intrusion, and these circumstances will lead to train delays when trains fail to run as the original plan. Rescheduling strategies are an important part of train dispatching in dealing with train delays. This paper proposes the hybrid strategy to solve the timetable rescheduling problem for high-speed railways under disturbances. A mixed-integer linear programming model is built with consideration of train retiming, reordering, limiting overtaking times and increasing unplanned dwellings. To minimize the total delay time, a genetic algorithm is used to optimize the objective function. The part of Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway line is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid strategy. The simulation results indicate that, under different delay scenarios, the rescheduling strategy proposed in this paper reduces the total delay time by more than 25% and 12% respectively when it is compared with the FCFS (First Come First Served) rescheduling and the strategy of limited overtaking times and unplanned dwellings. It limits the trains overtaking times and ensures fairness in the operation between different classes of trains.

articleTitle: An improved memristor emulator with a new shaping function
abstract: Recently, an emerging memristor has aroused people's research enthusiasm in many fields due to its unique properties and potential applications. However, because of its inaccessibility, the memristor emulator has been used as a good substitute to study the features and applications of it. A new shaping function circuit is designed here and used in the current-controlled memristor model. Mathematical analysis and simulation results of the constructed model show that the new emulator has a larger hysteresis loop than the prior, and moreover it has a distinct pinched hysteresis loop until 15kHz. Comparison with the existed emulators highlights the advantages of the new one.

articleTitle: Application of Iterative Learning Control in X-Y Precision Planar Motion Platform
abstract: The size of the tracking error is one of the important indicators to measure the control system of the X-Y Precision Planar Motion Platform. Iterative learning control (ILC) can obtain higher tracking accuracy through multiple iterations. However, it is found in experiments that the tracking error of the XY precision motion stage using ordinary PD-type iterative learning will eventually fluctuate in a relatively range, and some high-frequency Noise will seriously affect the stability of the system after many iterations. Aiming at the above problems, a PD-type variable gain open-closed loop ILC with a low-pass filter is proposed. This control scheme can effectively remove high-frequency noise and reduce tracking errors. Finally, a hardware-in-the-loop real-time simulator is used to conduct a comparative experiment. Through comparison with PID controller and ordinary PD-type ILC, the experimental consequence show that this arithmetic has a smaller tracking error than the other two algorithms.

articleTitle: The application of frequency and voltage compensation modules to improve the robustness of microgrid control system
abstract: In a typical low-voltage microgrid, multiple distributed generation inverters are connected to the large grid through a common connection point. In order to simulate the characteristics of synchronous generator without interconnection line parallel structure, droop control is widely used in grid connected inverter control system to realize power distribution of distributed generation. In order to improve the anti-interference and dynamic performance of distributed power inverter in low-voltage microgrid, frequency and voltage compensation are introduced in adaptive droop control to improve the system robustness. The simulation results of MATLAB / Simulink show that the proposed control strategy can improve the transient performance of microgrid.

articleTitle: Research on Typical Load Classification of Electricity Users Based on Bad Data Detection
abstract: The development of smart grid provides technical support for data collection and analysis on the electricity user side. It is of great significance to fully mine user data information and extract typical load patterns for load prediction and energy consumption management. In this paper, the classification of typical load patterns of electricity users is taken as the research center. Firstly, in order to ensure the quality of user load data, the B-spline function is adopted to detect and correct the bad data in the load data. Subsequently, the daily load curve base reflecting the characteristics of users’ electricity consumption is established through normalization of the daily load curve, and the fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm is utilized to cluster the established curve base to obtain a typical daily load curve that reflects the characteristics of users’ electricity consumption. The validity and practicability of the proposed algorithm in data quality detection and load curve clustering are verified by the case measured data.

articleTitle: Strategic Thinking on Coping with the Quantum Reform of International System of Units
abstract: The international system of units(SI) is the cornerstone of the international measurement system. In 2018, it completed a major change in quantization, which is completely based on natural constants, making a revolutionary change in the international measurement system. First of all, this paper analyzes the shortcomings of the physical definition, expounds the reason and significance of the quantization of basic unit. Secondly, it deeply analyzes the important influence of the SI quantization on quantum measurement and quantum measurement industry, puts forward the strategic thinking of the National Institute of Metrology, China, and focuses on the major strategic planning ideas of China's quantum measurement personnel training, talent introduction and team building under the SI quantization. Finally, the construction and development of the advanced quantum measurement system and personnel training system after the SI quantization in China are prospected.

articleTitle: Set-membership filtering based Bi-directional DC-DC converter state estimation algorithm for lithium battery formation
abstract: This paper presents an improved zonotopic set-membership identification method adapted in Bi-directional DC-DC converter estimation for lithium battery formation. Firstly, the Bi-directionl DC-DC converter is modeled by a two-qudrant operating convertor. Then, at predictive step, a novel expansive zonotope is obtained by affine transformation of the zonotope calculated. Besides, at updated step, a strip space is constructed by using observations obtained. Singular value decomposition idea is used to reduce the zonotopic dimension, so as to prevent the shape of zonotope from becoming more comple, and the reduced zonotope is tightened again with the strip space. In the simulation part, the inductive current and capacitive voltage of Bidirectional DC-DC converter are estimated accurately, and the compactness of the algorithm are verified in Buck mode and Boost mode, respectively.

articleTitle: A fractional-order IMC controller for high-order Sigma-Delta modulator
abstract: A fractional-order internal model control (IMC) is proposed for high-order Sigma-Delta (ΣΔ) modulator in the paper. Designing a high-order ΣΔ modulator is difficult due to the complex parameters' tuning and system instability. IMC is used to effectively reduce the tuning parameters and also improve the system robustness of ΣΔ modulator with respect to model-plant mismatch and system noises. Additionally, the tuning parameters are optimized by PSO, which is more convenient to achieve the parameters. The simulation results show that the proposed IMC is useful for improving the performance for high-order ΣΔ modulator.

articleTitle: Elapse-time-dependent SMC for discrete-time uncertain stochastic jump systems
abstract: This paper is concerned with the issue of elapse-time-dependent sliding mode control (SMC) for discrete-time uncertain stochastic jump systems with semi-Markovian parameters. A elapse-time dependent sliding mode function is designed according to the concept of semi-Markov kernel (SMK), which allows that the jump between two adjacent modes is jointly regulated by the sojourn-time probability distribution functions (ST-PDFs) and the transition probabilities (TPs). Considering the upper bound of the ST, some relevant conditions are obtained to ensure the uncertain S-MJSs to be δ-error mean square stable (MSS) under the framework of linear matrix inequalities, and the proposed elapse-time dependent SMC laws guarantee the finite-time reachability of the assigned sliding region. A numerical simulation is provided to validate the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Dynamic Event-Triggered Stabilization for Markov Jump Delayed Complex-Valued Neural Networks
abstract: The paper addresses the problem of stabilization for Markov jump complex-valued neural networks with time-varying delays. The Markov model is adopted to describe the abrupt changes in the parameters of system. In order to make better use of the limited network bandwidth, a novel dynamic event-triggered scheme (DETS) is developed to schedule the data transmission. Based on the Lyapunov stability theory, the delay-dependent stability criterion is presented. Finally, the simulation results are given to verify the usefulness of the proposed stabilizing method.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Location Method Based on WIFI-PDR
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of long wireless positioning preparation time and poor positioning accuracy, an improved WiFi-PDR indoor wireless positioning method was proposed based on WiFi positioning and Product-Design-Review(PDR) positioning technology. In the offline database establishment stage, Ultra-Wide-Band(UWB) positioning technology was introduced to reduce the preparation time, while WiFi and PDR positioning were used simultaneously in the online stage. The two technologies will learn from each other and optimize each other to improve positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Partial Connected Neural Architecture Search Based on Continuous Particle Swarm for Hyperspectral Image Classification
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is widely used in Hyperspectral Image (HSI) classification, but the approach of designing network manually is time consuming and requires expert knowledge. Nowadays, a method called Neural Architecture Search (NAS) based on gradient descent has been prompted to automatically design the network, but the method can still hardly get the optimal architecture. Hence, this paper comes up with the PC-CPSO method, which is based on Continuous Particle Swarm Optimization (CPSO) to connect partial channels to search the optimal architecture. In this way, the optimal architecture can be searched in less time while reaching high accuracy. In order to do that, a SuperNet with considerable cells is necessary so as to make discrete architectures share parameters. Then, the sampled subset-channels are used for searching operation and reducing spatial redundancies. After that is the directly coding strategy introduced to match the architecture. Finally, CPSO comes to find the optimal PC-CPSO which is designed as HSI classifier. Experiments are carried on two widely-used datasets based on full bands and selected bands of HSI. The result verifies that our method outweighs on the memory-consumption, time-cost and accuracy.

articleTitle: Parallel Building Process Management System
abstract: With the development of industrialized building and intelligence technology, it becomes necessary and possible to realize building process intelligence management. In recent years, digital twins and parallel management get more and more attentions in academic research and industrial applications. This paper addresses how parallel building system performs intelligence management on industrialized building process. Firstly, actual building model and artificial building model are created according to actual building system. Then business driving engine and simulation engine drive actual building model and artificial building model, respectively. Participants receive and send messages by software interfaces. Business driving engine changes the status of actual building model and sends the changes to simulation engine. Simulation engine updates the status of artificial building model and runs artificial building model with various parameters. Then it sends the parameter with the best effect to business driving engine. Business driving engine sends recommendations to participants according to the best parameter. Thus, building process intelligence management is achieved.

articleTitle: An Iris center localization algorithm based on improved snakuscule
abstract: Iris center localization is one of the key technologies in attention detection, eye tracking, etc. In order to improve the accuracy of iris center localization for low-resolution images captured under natural light, an iris center localization algorithm based on improved snakuscule is proposed. The algorithm combines the facial landmark detector, snakuscule energy model and iris center quality inspection module. On the basis of the snakuscule, an active radius and an adaptive iteration strategy are adopted, which can ensure the real-time performance and improve the detection accuracy at the same time. Firstly, facial landmarks are used to segment eye ROI. Then, a snakuscule model is initialized based on eye landmarks. During its iteration, either single-pixel iteration or skip iteration is adaptively selected to improve the detection speed of the iris center. Finally, the iris center is inspected to detect whether the forecast center is effective or not. The cascade classifier based on V-J detector is used to re-detect the eyes of the images whose forecast center are ineffective, and then the model will iterate again. The proposed algorithm is tested on BioID dataset. The nomalized error of the proposed algorithm is 85.6%, 96.7% and 99.2% in e d 0.05, e d 0.1 and e d 0.25, respectively. The detection accuracy reaches the mainstream level, which verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Hopf Bifurcation Analysis of A Economic System with Two Time Delays and Diffusion Based on Macro−Control
abstract: In this paper, we propose a economic model with two time delays and diffusion based on macro−control and study its related dynamics. We mainly analyze the equilibrium stability of the system and the existence of Hopf bifurcation. The results show that Hopf bifurcation will occur when the hysteresis parameter exceeds the critical value. Finally, the main results are illustrated by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Vision Control System of Pipeline Robot
abstract: As the "blood vessel" of the city, pipelines are all over the underground of the city. To inspect the pipeline conveniently and intuitively, the pipeline robot needs to enter the pipeline and transmit the real-time image inside the pipeline through the camera module of the robot. However, most pipeline robots rely on manual attitude control for turning and other operations. This paper studies the problem of automatic navigation when the robot is running in the pipeline with high water pressure, which can assist the operator to control the robot.The basic principle is that the video signal of the camera is transmitted to the host computer through the optical fiber, and the upper computer processes the image to determine whether to turn and the direction of turning, and then sends instructions to the attitude change module. This method can accurately judge the turning direction, and good results are obtained in the experiment.

articleTitle: ICP algorithm point cloud registration method based on a new improved Harris Hawk algorithm
abstract: To address shortcomings of ICP algorithm, which is sensitive to the initial position and easy to fall into local optimum, we propose a Harris Hawks Optimizer (HHO) point cloud registration method combining PCA preprocessing and parallel population initialization. The PCA method is used to align the point clouds with the main axes and perform the main axes correction. Since the six input variables in the population initialization stage of HHO point cloud registration are different and independent, the initial population of HHO algorithm is initialized by the parallel initialization method. The results show that the improved algorithm is able to successfully overwhelm the fault of ICP algorithm, and its global seek performance and optimization accuracy are more advantageous, and the algorithm operates efficiently, with high registration accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Resonant DC-DC Converter with Wide Input Voltage Range
abstract: A novel multi-resonant converter is proposed in this article, which can achieve a wider range of voltage gain in a narrow operating frequency range. By adding the LC-series circuit parallel with the magnetizing inductor, the converter has a better voltage gain characteristic. The switches can realize zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) and the diodes can realize zero-current-switching (ZCS) naturally. The operating principles are introduced in this article. Finally, a 1-kW prototype is simulated and the results in given.

articleTitle: Research on Oscillatory Hydrofoil Deformation Measurement Method Based on Image Edge Fitting
abstract: Flexible hydrofoils used in oscillating hydrofoil tidal power generators are subjected to deformation by the flow field when moving underwater. To investigate the mechanism by which the hydrofoil deformation affects the energy acquisition performance of the device, the hydrofoil deformation needs to be measured. Based on the specific characteristics of hydrofoil images, this thesis applies edge fitting in image processing to hydrofoil deformation measurements. By detecting the edges of the hydrofoil image during its motion, the edge features are fitted to the deformation boundary curve and the deformation variables are obtained. In order to simplify user operations and achieve batch processing, the deformation measurement algorithm is developed for software development and automatic deformation measurement to improve efficiency. Experiments have shown that the method is able to measure deformation more accurately, and that the accuracy of the software is less than that of manual measurements, but significantly more efficient.

articleTitle: Improved hybrid genetic algorithm for location and volume determination of distributed power supply
abstract: In order to allocate the distributed power more reasonably, improve the quality of power supply and reduce the cost, a distribution network optimal allocation model is established in this paper. Considering the investment, network loss cost and load power supply cost, an improved hybrid genetic algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to optimize the genetic algorithm, and the elite population was taken as the initial population of the genetic algorithm, and the parameters of the genetic algorithm were adjusted by using the improved three-tangent crossover method and the adaptive mutation to improve the stability of the algorithm. Through the improved algorithm, the appropriate location and capacity are obtained, and the network loss, voltage quality, the investment and operation of the distributed power supply and the total cost of the grid supplying power to the load side are obtained. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm are verified by the simulation of the IEEE-33 node distribution system.

articleTitle: Optimized adaptive tracking control for nonlinear differential game systems
abstract: This paper designed a tracking control method for nonlinear differential game systems by using the adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) technique. In contrast to existing results of tracking control, the optimization problem with finite-horizon constrains is considered. To realize both trajectory tracking and performance optimizing, we isolated an error function from the optimal cost function. In general, the optimal controller for the nonlinear differential game system is unavailable since the nonlinear Hamilton-Jacobi-Issacs (HJI) equation is even impossible to be solved by analytical methods. Therefore, neural networks (NNs) are applied to estimate unknown optimal cost function and control strategies. Then, sufficient conditions are derive to demonstrate the closed-loop tracking error system and weight approximation errors are uniformly ultimately bounded (UUB). Finally, the validity of the results obtained are proved by introducing a numerical example.

articleTitle: An Observer-Based Attack Detection Method in Cyber-Physical Power System
abstract: This paper presents an observer-based detection strategy to detect false data injection attack (FDIA) under unknown disturbances in cyber-physical power system. We design an observer based on L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> technology which can enhance the sensitivity to attack signal and robustness to unknown disturbances such as measurement noise. Meanwhile, a time-varying threshold is proposed to overcome the constraints of precomputed constant threshold based on L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> technology. Simulation results based on a 2-generator 6-bus model are presented to verify the performance of the proposed observer.

articleTitle: Causality Analysis of Industrial Process Based on Improved Convergent Cross Mapping
abstract: The equipment of an industrial process is interconnected and coupled with each other. The abnormality of one equipment often causes multiple alarms. How to analyze the real cause of failure from a wide range of alarm messages is an urgent problem to be solved in modern industrial process. Causality analysis will be conducive to assess the causal relationships between devices, trace the path of disturbance propagation, and locate the root cause of the failure. In this paper, a causality analysis framework based on convergent cross mapping is proposed. In the proposed framework, the Cao algorithm is first used to determine the phase space embedding dimension, and then convergent cross mapping is executed and a hypothesis test method is employed to detect whether the convergence condition is satisfied, finally the time delay between variables is detected to distinguish between unidirectional strong coupling causality and bidirectional causality. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by a numerical case firstly, and then the algorithm is applied to the continuous stirred tank heating process to analyze the causal relationship between the key variables in the process.

articleTitle: Decoupling and Fast Estimation of RCS Disturbance and Fault
abstract: Focusing on the reaction control system disturbance and fault, a decoupling and fast estimation method is proposed. First, the finite-time unknown input observers are designed combining unknown input observers, sliding mode control reaching laws, and sliding mode observers to decouple the fault and realize fast and accurate disturbance estimation. The proof of the estimation error finite-time stability based on Lyapunov theory is given. Second, the obtained disturbance estimation is introduced into existing finite-time observers to achieve rapid and accurate fault estimation. Finally, the proposed method is applied to a reaction control system and the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control Based on Multivariable Disturbance Observer
abstract: This paper proposes a multivariable disturbance observer based on the state space model. The relationship between the input sequence and the output sequence is analyzed through the state space model and described by a numerical matrix. Then the equivalent disturbance can be estimated by the numerical matrix which replaces the inversion of the transfer function matrix. Subsequently, a coefficient matrix and a filter matrix are adopted to make a good tradeoff between disturbance rejection performance and control effort. Simulation results verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed multivariable disturbance observer.

articleTitle: Integrated Position and Attitude Stabilization of Spacecraft for Eddy Brake based Detumbling
abstract: The present study handles the integrated translational and rotational stabilization problem during the space debris detumbling by using eddy brake. By doing so, firstly, a coupled position and attitude dynamics with electromagnetic effect is formulated for a service spacecraft relative to a tumbling debris. An effective model simplification is then conducted such that the nonlinear dynamics can be transformed into a perturbated linear one. In what follows, the parametric method based on eigenstructure assignment for linear systems is utilized to design a feedback controller to guarantee both translational and rotational stabilization. At last, numerical simulation verifies the effectiveness and robustness of the given control strategy.

articleTitle: Image-free localization and tracking of multi-targets based on single pixel detection
abstract: Using single pixel detection method to locate and track the target without image has the advantages of low sampling rate and high tracking speed. However, previous image-free positioning scheme can only locate and track one moving object at a time. When there are multiple moving objects, entanglement solutions will be generated. This paper proposes an image-free localization and tracking scheme of multi-targets, which can simultaneously track multiple targets under low sampling rate. The scheme consists of three steps: single pixel measuring, matching and positioning. Firstly, we design two groups of patterns of digital mirror device and project them to the targets in different angles successively, then two sets of bucket detector values are obtained. Secondly, we treat the vector of bucket detector values as virtual images and use the image matching method to get the possible locations of multiple targets. Finally, by comparing the possible locations obtained from the two sets of bucket detector values, we can get the correct positions of the targets. We verify the effectiveness of the proposed method under different noise conditions with simulations. This method improves the previous image-free localization and tracking scheme, it can simultaneously locate and track multiple targets in the case of low sampling rate, which provides an idea for future multi-target localization and tracking schemes.

articleTitle: Constellation Design of Prompt Global Arrival System
abstract: Reentry vehicles of Prompt Global Arrival System (PGAS) are subject to various constraints during reentry process, the boundary of reachable domain is wide and irregular. Therefore, the model of traditional earth observation can not apply to PGAS. To address this issue, a constellation design method of PGAS is proposed in this paper, it can establish the multi-objective optimization model that meet the requirements of the PGAS and overcome the limitations of the model of traditional earth observation. Firstly, the method establishes the multi-objective optimization model of PGAS. Secondly, it judges the situation of coverage of the target at any time based on the connection among the subsatellite point track, the reachable domain and the target. Finally, it sets revisit interval and the total number of the constellation as performance optimization indexes, the optimization method is NSGA2. The simulation results are analyzed to verify the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Waveband selection of Infrared Spectrum Based on Sine Cosine Algorithm
abstract: Infrared spectrum analysis is the main technical mean for qualitative and quantitative analysis of gase mixture. In the process of spectral analysis, too many dimensions of infrared spectral data and too much irrelevant information will have adverse effects on the modeling effect. Therefore, waveband selection is very important to improve the accuracy of model analysis. In this paper, infrared spectrum data which obtained from 938 gas mixture samples is prepared for component gases quantiative analysis, which the concentration ranges from 1% to 10% (methane), 1% to 15% (ethane), and 1% to 10% (propane). In order to improve the accuracy of the component gas quantiative analysis model, sine cosine algorithm (SCA) is proposed to select the waveband of the infrared spectrum data of gas mixture. Experiments results show that the average MRE of the three component gas analysis models deduce from 47.98% to 23.54%, and the average dimentions of the selected waveband spenctrum data deduced from 1866 to 270. The model precision and calculation efficiency are greatly improved.

articleTitle: A Multi-modal Panoramic Speaker Localization Method
abstract: As a supporting technology in the field of human-computer interaction, speaker localization method has been a research hotspot in recent years. However, the existing single-mode speaker location methods cannot meet the requirements of stability and rapidity. For improve the accuracy and effective positioning range of speaker localization system, a multi-modal panoramic speaker localization method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the coarse position of the speaker was preliminarily obtained by sound source localization. Then, according to the initial positioning of the speaker, whether the image used for face recognition need to be stitched is decided. What’s more, the position of speaker is calculated by face detection and calibration. Finally, the results of voice and image localization are fused by coordinate transformation. The proposal is tested on self-built experimental system, and the experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on The Fault Diagnosis Method of Oil-Immersed Transformers Based on The Improved DBSCAN Algorithm
abstract: For the problem of dissolved gas analysis (DGA) of oil-immersed transformers for fault diagnosis, the type of faults occurring in oil-immersed transformers is determined by density clustering of DGA data using the DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) clustering algorithm, while some parameters in the DBSCAN algorithm are optimized and improved. The maximum average correlation coefficient is used as a criterion to optimize the distance degree between samples to cluster the DGA data set. Finally, tests are conducted with the actual data as a basis for classifying the suspicion of different noise vectors, and fault diagnosis is performed by data outliers, which further proves that this method is practically feasible.

articleTitle: Berth and Quay Crane Scheduling Optimization Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Berth and quay crane resources are the key resources of container ports, which are expensive and limited. Reasonable allocation of these two resources can effectively reduce the operation cost and give full play to the productivity of the port. In this paper, an optimal mathematical model considering the specific allocation of quay cranes is established in order to realize the joint scheduling of continuous berth and quay cranes. The decision variables include the berthing priority, berthing position, number of quay cranes and minimum quay crane number assigned to container ships. An improved genetic algorithm is used to solve this problem. In the algorithm, solutions generated according to specific rules are put into the initial population. The population is divided into two parts for independent evolution, and the information exchange is carried out every fixed generations. Through numerical experiments, it is verified that the improved genetic algorithm has better optimization effect.

articleTitle: Exponential stabilization of nonlinear networked DC microgrid system under DoS attacks
abstract: This paper investigates the exponential stabilization problem of the nonlinear networked DC microgrid system with multiple constant power loads (CPLs) under denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. Firstly, based on the periodic DoS attack model and the switched state feedback control law, the switched control system model of DC microgrid under periodic DoS attacks is established. Secondly, the exponential stability criterion of the system is derived by using the attack parameter dependent time-varying Lyapunov function method. Then, according to the nonlinear and network attacks nature of DC microgrid system with multiple CPLs, a new design method of nonlinear networked DC microgrid system controller is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed method is proved by simulation.

articleTitle: Psychological Resistance Recognition Based on Acoustic Features Extraction
abstract: Psychological resistance can express the change of the client's psychological state, which is considered to be an important factor affecting psychological counseling. This paper proposed a method of psychological resistance recognition based on acoustic features extraction. The method includes three main steps, i.e., statistical acoustic feature extraction, feature selection, and classification. Our method uses statistical acoustic features to express psychological resistance, and analyzes the application value of high correlation features obtained from feature selection in the recognition of different psychological resistance. This method can be used to determine the high correlation features of psychological resistance adaptively, and avoid the deficiency of subjective judgment. A speech database of psychological resistance is built for research needs, in which three psychological consultants and four subjects are involved in psychological counseling with 1200 sentences in speech. The experimental results verified the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: On positive edge consensus control of descriptor multiagent systems
abstract: This paper investigates an observer-type positive edge consensus problem of the continuous-time linear descriptor systems under the undirected topology. A distributed relative state feedback protocol, whose dynamics are determined by communications between agents and their neighbors, has been proposed to ensure the multiagent system positive edge consensus. In terms of graph theory and linear matrix inequalities, the necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of the observer and the convergence of the multiagent system have been given. Moreover, several corollaries are also presented, where the design freedom has been remarkably improved. Finally, a numerical example is shown to demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the main results.

articleTitle: Multi-AGVs dispatching strategy in automobile assembly line based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: AGVs (Automated Guided Vehicles) are widely used in automobile assembly lines, optimizing the AGVs dispatching strategy in automobile assembly line is of important academic significance and application value. In actual production process, assembly lines require multiple types of AGVs to work in coordination, which requires a intelligent dispatching strategies to solve this complex dispatching problem and can be applied to different situations. Hence, a deep reinforcement learning method based on DQN algorithm is proposed to optimize the dispatching strategy. Appropriate reward function is designed according to the demand materials of every station, and experience replay mechanism is used to improve the algorithm performance. In addition, this method is applied to AGVs dispatching simulation, and the results are given.

articleTitle: An Angle-Bias Based Gait Phase Estimation using Thigh Angle Information
abstract: Gait phase detection and estimation are widely used in both rehabilitation therapy and powered prosthesis control. Phase variable that computed form thigh angle and thigh angle integral to estimate gait phase has received huge attention. However, the thigh angle integral is prone to drift and the most intuitive way of resetting the integral is usually not robust enough. To solve this problem, we conducted a simulation study to find the root cause of the integral drift of the thigh angle. Furthermore we provided a method that just offsetting thigh angle and saturating thigh integral to avoid integral drift. Simulation and experiment results show that the propose method is feasible and effective, and the robustness and adaptivity of the proposed method are verified by a varying walking speed experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Detection Algorithm of Intelligent Transportation Target Based on Mobilenet_SSD
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G and artificial intelligence, autonomous driving and smart transportation have attracted more and more attention. Traditional target detection algorithms have deep network layers and a large number of parameters, and a lot of time is required for model detection, which seriously affects the real-time performance of the detection system. The Mobilenet_SSD network uses deep separable convolution to reduce model parameters, thereby shortening computing time. In this paper, we use the Mobilenet_SSD model and optimize the frozen network structure using the openvino tool and combine it with asynchronous operations for computation. Experimental results show that the use of Mobilenet_SSD in combination with the openvino tool and asynchronous operation techniques further improves the detection performance of the system.

articleTitle: Coordination Method of Functional Safety and Cyber Security for Industrial Control Systems
abstract: In order to ensure the reliable execution of the functional safety of industrial control systems and effectively resist more and more serious cyber attacks, it is necessary to explore a technical solution suitable for industrial control systems to effectively ensure the compatibility of cyber security and functional security measures. Taking typical SIL3 and SL3 industrial control systems as examples, based on functional safety measures, cyber security measures are analyzed one by one, and potential contradictions between them are identified. Coordination solutions of functional safety and cyber security are given by combining event tree and risk analysis. Finally, integrated protective measures of functional safety and cyber security of industrial control systems are obtained.The results show that the cyber security measures determined by the coordination method are compatible with the original functional safety measures, and the coordination method can be used to guide the cyber security design of industrial control systems.

Author Keywords: coordination of functional safety and cyber security

articleTitle: Toward Precise Point Location in Mouse Pose Estimation by Multi-scale Supervised Network
abstract: Mouse pose estimation has been used in animal behavior analysis that plays an important role in biological neuroscience and behavioral science. Computer vision community mainly focuses on human pose estimation. Human pose estimation locates joints by regressing the Gaussian heatmaps of joints. Compared with the human pose estimation task, the mouse pose estimation requires the precise location of key points. A naive solution is that mouse pose estimation borrows the network from the human pose etstimation with the smaller Guassian heatmaps. However, smaller Gaussian heatmaps empirically make the model difficult to be trained and even not be converged, leading to an inferior accuracy. In this paper, we propose a muti-scale supervised network by adding the spatial constraints into the state-of-the- art the top-down to down-top structure. Concretely, the small Gaussian heatmaps are added as supervision informations at the each scale of the down-top path. With the multi-scale supervison, the resulting features of the down-top scales progressively locate the joints and make training process fast to converge. Besides, a multi-stage fusion is proposed to makes that the multi-scale supervison at the down-top path could transfer into the top- down one from the next stage. Two datasets, a benchmark dataset and a dataset published by ourself, are used to demonstrate the effectiveness of methods.

articleTitle: Containment Coordination Control for Networked Euler-Lagrange Systems with Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics
abstract: This article addresses the containment control for multiple Euler-Lagrange (EL) systems with unknown nonlinear dynamics under directed graphs, where the dynamic systems about the leader agents and the follower agents are heterogeneous. Due to the limited communication conditions, many follower agents cannot obtain information of leader agents directly, so the states of all followers are compensated by using a compensator. On this basis, a new adaptive control scheme is proposed under directed networks. Ultimately, a simulation example verifies the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Adaptive disturbance observer-based control for stochastic systems with heterogeneous disturbances
abstract: The paper discusses a kind of stochastic system with disturbances from different sources. stochastic disturbances which can not be available and white noise are both considered. A novel disturbance observer is made and observe these arguments which is unknown. An improved ADOBC scheme is established with the integration of LMI and adaptive technology. A theorem is given and demonstrate that the system is asymptotically bounded when disturbance with unknown parameters exists. A numerical simulation result is given to prove that the designed aproach can always achieve high performance no matter the modeled disturbance is harmonic disturbance or stochastic disturbance.

articleTitle: Control method of adaptive delay wind tunnel based on total pressure characteristics
abstract: Hypersonic wind tunnel test has high requirements for the quality of flow field, and it takes a long time for the wind tunnel flow field to reach the ideal state. In order to improve the operation efficiency of conventional hypersonic wind tunnel and reduce the test cost, a simulink model of wind tunnel operation control is established, and an adaptive delay wind tunnel control method based on total pressure characteristics is proposed. The results show that the Simulink model is feasible; The adaptive delay control method can effectively reduce the fluctuation time of the total pressure in the stable section and increase the effective operation time of the wind tunnel. In addition, when the adaptive delay control method is adopted, the intervention control pressure has a reasonable range.

articleTitle: Fault sample size quadratic allocation method of sequential verification based on Sobol sequence
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the current testability sequential verification cannot guarantee the certainty, randomness and coverage requirements of the extracted fault mode, which leads to the insufficient credibility of the testability index evaluation, a method of quadratic allocation of sequential verification fault sample size based on Sobol sequence is proposed. Firstly, based on the hierarchical Bayes network model, the allocation factors of nodes and fault modes are determined by FMECA information. Then, by comparing the homogeneity of different sequences, the sampling sequence is determined, and the sequential verification method of quadratic allocation of fault sample size is further proposed. Finally, the paper makes a comparative analysis through the actual cases. The results show that, compared with pseudo-random sequence sampling, the method can effectively reduce the random error introduced by sampling unbalance, ensure the representativeness and coverage of fault modes extracted by sequential verification testability, and have stronger engineering applicability.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Detection Model for Typical Objects in Streetscape Dataset
abstract: This paper proposes a sparse training strategy which the weighting factor decays globally and dynamically, and a channel pruning method for models with shortcut connection. The detection model trained on yolov5 for the streetscape dataset needs to be pruned. To improve the detection accuracy of the pruned model, this paper presents a knowledge distillation loss function based on the idea of greed for object detection. By virtue of these strategies, we obtain a relatively lightweight detection model with smaller size, fewer parameters and higher detection accuracy of the typical objects in our streetscape dataset, providing reference for future application of detection models to in-vehicle embedded devices for street objects monitoring.

articleTitle: Active and passive compliance control based on a new type of series-parallel hybrid leg structure
abstract: To reduce the impact force when the foot end of the legged robot is in contact with the ground and improve its flexibility, a new type of series-parallel hybrid leg structure is proposed. This structure is driven by the motor and is designed on different axes of the hip joint to reduce processing. It is difficult to increase the space utilization rate simultaneously, and the spring device is used to achieve good passive compliance. The co-simulation of Adams and MATLAB is used to verity the active and passive compliance effects. The experimental results show that the single-leg structure proposed in this paper has good passive compliance characteristics, and the admittance control can be used to realize its active compliance control.
