articleTitle: The memory-based control design for uncertain NCSs with two-event-generator mechanism
abstract: This note is concerned with memory-based controller design for networked control systems (NCSs). A novel two-event-generator mechanism, constituted by an adaptive memory-event-triggered scheme (METS) at sensor side and a event-triggered scheme (ETS) at controller side, is proposed to save network communication resources. Two type of memory-based certain and uncertain NCSs models are established, respectively. Then, two sufficient conditions for the asymptotical stability of NCSs are proposed, and the criterions of memory-based state feedback gains and event-triggering matrices are co-designed. Finally, the conclusions are verified by the pendulum system and the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Output regulation of linear time-delay system via sample-data control
abstract: This paper addresses the output regulation problem of linear time-delay system by the sample-data control approach. Based on the emulation design method and the results under the continuous-time feedback controller, we successfully present two different type of sample-data feedback controller to solve output regulation problem with constant perturbations or reference input. The theoretical results obtained in this paper have been verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: A Belief Base Optimization Method with Multi Time Step for Anchor-free Cooperative Location
abstract: In this paper, a tightly-coupled fusion scheme based on Inertial Measurement Uint (IMU) and ranging is proposed, which can reduce positioning drift in anchor-free cooperative location. Specifically, the dead reckoning results of multiple times and errors in ranging are comprehensively considered. The error relationship among multiple times is constructed, and the most suitable initial state is obtained by minimizing the errors of multiple times. Experimental results show that the proposed method is better than Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) in trajectory drift suppression of multi-intelligent node cooperative location.

articleTitle: Simultaneous state and disturbance estimator based robust model predictive control of Microgrid’s frequency regulation
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of constrained output regulation of microgrids. First, a dynamic model of the isolated-mode microgrid is developed. Second, a reduced-order observer is designed for estimating the unknown states and disturbances. Then, the predictive regulation of the microgrid output frequency was achieved by using an optimization method based on a maximum-minimum strategy. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed results is verified by using simulation examples.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of K2 Algorithm Based on Topological Sorting
abstract: In the complex chemical process, some key process features need to be monitored, such as safety which is the key to a stable development in modern process industries. Due to the increasing difficulties of modem processes, it is becoming more and more difficult in fault tracing and diagnosing. BN (Bayesian Network) is a promising model for tracing and inferring the fault. The traditional method to build a BN in structure learning is the K2 Algorithm. However, this algorithm depends on the given input awfully. To solve this problem, this paper put forward an improved algorithm to develop the performance in building a BN structure. The main idea of this proposed method is topological sorting. The proposed algorithm is called a topological-sorting based K2 Algorithm (TS-K2) where the algorithm inputs are improved. One of the inputs is the maximal size of parent node which is the algorithm termination condition. The other input is the node order in the searching space, which will be the key feature of the K2 Algorithm. It determines the quality of the algorithm output accuracy. The ASIA Network is used to verify the performance of the proposed algorithm. The simulation result shows that TS-K2 Algorithm has better performance than the traditional K2 Algorithm.

articleTitle: Force Control of Swirling Sucker for Underwater Concrete Drilling Robot
abstract: Underwater concrete drilling is essential for underwater structure leakage management. However, in practice, underwater concrete drillings are usually performed by professional divers, whose efficiency is low when operating on depth limit. In this paper, a suction force control system to control a swirling sucker is proposed, which is used to provide stable suction force during the drilling operation for underwater drilling robots. First, a mathematical model of the sucker system is established through system identification. Second, drilling force control system framework is proposed, including an estimator for the drilling force estimation, and a sliding-mode controller to control the suction force and reject drilling force disturbances. A testbed is constructed, and the experimental results show that the proposed control system can respond well to disturbances and maintain the drilling stability.

articleTitle: Study on anti-interference performance of three-phase voltage mode PWM rectifier
abstract: the operation of three-phase voltage type PWM rectifier often contains harmonics, voltage fluctuations and other problems. In this paper, based on the traditional sliding mode controller, the first-order active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is introduced to control the outer voltage loop, and the state variables observed by the linear extended state observer (LESO) are fed back to the sliding mode controller for feedforward compensation. The controller has resonance suppression ability and strong disturbance immunity, and does not depend on the accurate mathematical model. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by simulation and experiment. The results show that the control strategy has the advantages of good dynamic performance, strong robustness and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Design and verification of RPN Neutron Source Test Robot
abstract: Nuclear instrument system (RPN) source test is a key test before the first loading of nuclear power plant core, which directly affects the availability of measuring channel during loading and the efficiency of loading work. An automatic test method of neutron source for nuclear instrument based on robot technology is proposed by studying the traditional test method of neutron source carried manually. The engineering application shows that this method can greatly improve the efficiency of nuclear instrument source test and reduce the requirement of test manpower, and at the same time can minimize the radiation dose of neutron source operator, which has good economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Research of Influence Diffusion Based on Multi-agent Theory in Social Networks
abstract: Studies on information dissemination and influence diffusion in social networks have received extensive attention from researchers, but most look at information diffusion from a global perspective. Since most studies did not describe personalization in detail, in this paper, combined with social networks analysis and multi-agent modeling method, a new distributed modeling method for influence diffusion in directional networks is proposed. In the given model, a wealth of individual psychological factors are added to describe personalized characteristics. The simulation results show that the model is more suitable for simulating the diffusion of influence in the real world, providing a reference method for exploring the relationship between individuals and complex social phenomena.

articleTitle: PDE-based Adaptive Control of a Flexible Manipulator with Actuator and Sensor Faults
abstract: In this paper, we propose a PDE-based adaptive control law for single link flexible manipulator considering actuator and sensor faults. The kinetic equation of the flexible system is described by partial differential equation (PDE), which can avoid the control overflow problems. An adaptive control strategy is developed for an actuator fault and two sensor faults compensation, which can control the angular displacement and suppress the elastic vibration simultaneously. We show the proof of the flexible closed-loop system via Lyapunov direct method and extended LaSalle’s Principle. The simulation is provided for illustrating performance of the designed control method.

articleTitle: Fractional order transcriptional regulation model for Hela cell BPI gene of cervical cancer
abstract: The treatment and research of cervical cancer are the hot issue in medical care. A reasonable mathematical model is helpful for revealing the regulatory mechanism of cancer genes. This paper studied a new method to reconstruct transcriptional regulation model with fractional differential equation. Both model error and observation error are considered to improve the model accuracy, then multi-objective particle swarm algorithm is applied to identify the model order and parameters together, in which Adam-Bashforth-Moulton method is used to solve the fractional model. The results on simulation experiments prove that the proposed multi-objective optimization algorithm has higher identification accuracy than single-objective optimization. The experimental results on the BPI gene data of HeLa cells in cervical cancer show that fractional order model proforms more reliably for real data than integer order model, and the multi-objective optimization algorithm is more robust for model inference.

articleTitle: Sparse Bayesian Learning for Off-Grid DOA Estimation in Alpha Noise
abstract: Sparse Bayesian (SBL) method is widely used in DOA estimation recent years. This method can obtain high performance with fewer snapshots. However, it depends on the probability density of noise, which usually assumed to be Gauss distribution. And the performance of this method reduces in alpha noise which do not have a probability density of closed-form expression. In this paper, we proposed an algorithm which can deal with this situation using SBL algorithm. To reduce the computational complexity of SBL algorithm, an off-grid method is proposed. Simulation results show that algorithm can obtain high performance in alpha noise efficiently.

articleTitle: Apply of Multi-scale Model Method Based on Wavelet Transform
abstract: With the development of technology, demands of control accuracy and operation optimization get more and more higher. High precision model is the footstone for control and optimization. A multi-scale model method based on wavelet transform is proposed to establish appropriate model for complex product process. Wavelet transform is used to decompose parameters into different scales, then several models are set up. The form of the models can either mechanism based or data based. Then all models’ output would be added to obtain a more accurate predictive value. The simulation results of coal mill modeling showed, comparing with traditional signal-scale model method, performance of multi-scale model method is better.

articleTitle: Recognition of traffic lights based on YOLOv3-tiny
abstract: A traffic signal recognition algorithm based on yolov3-tiny is proposed in this paper. Based on yolov3-tiny network architecture, for network adjustments, some feature layers were removed, only two independent prediction branches were retained, with accuracy in exchange for speed and reduced hardware performance requirements. This adjustment allows the algorithm to be further optimized, can maintain high recognition, achieve the goal of real-time identification of traffic lights. In data set preparation, Extract the video into a picture file by timestamp using OpenCV-Python, And then use the Labellmg to mark the red, green and yellow traffic lights in the picture dataset, txt types of files that yolo models can call directly, Form a data set. In training models, Using a yolov3-tiny model downloaded from yolo website, Save the data set to the model file structure, And then modify the configuration file, Finally, configure the PyTorch virtual environment that the model runs, After running the program, you get a PT model, Call this model using Python, You can identify traffic lights in pictures and videos. Through actual testing, The accuracy of model recognition trained by this method is more than 94.97%.

articleTitle: A deep transfer learning model for personalized blood glucose prediction
abstract: The prediction of blood glucose concentration by deep learning can preferably guide a direction in the treatment of diabetes patients. However, insufficient medical data of individual patients and pathological differences between patients affect the performance of deep learning neural network models. This paper uses the authentic blood glucose data of hospitalized diabetic patients to train a deep learning model, and then uses the data of individual patients to adjust the model through transfer learning. The results demonstrate that the deep transfer learning model has better prediction performance than the original deep learning model, support vector regression (SVR), and BP neural network.

articleTitle: Frequency model of dual-loop optoelectronic oscillators
abstract: Optoelectronic oscillators (OEO for short) can generate RF and microwave signals with high spectral purity and low phase noise. They are widely used in wireless communication and radar systems. According to the number of loops, OEO can be divided into three structures, including single loop, double loop and multi-loop. The double-loop OEO has the advantages of relatively simple structure, high side mode rejection ratio and good stability, and is widely used. However, there is no accurate frequency model yet, which limits the accuracy of frequency modulation and further optimization of parameters. In this paper, the transfer function of double loop photoelectric oscillator is established based on the theory of single loop photoelectric oscillator. On this basis, the frequency model of the double loop photoelectric oscillator is proposed, and the simulation of the model under different parameters is carried out. At last, parameter selection is briefly discussed. The results show that when the power distribution factor of the two loops is the same, the frequency of the double-loop OEO has a simple corresponding relationship with the change of the loop length. At this time, the double-loop OEO is equivalent to the special single-loop OEO, which is convenient for frequency modulation. The frequency model can be used for frequency tuning, parameter design and optimization of photoelectric oscillator, and has high application value.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Vehicle Adaptive Cruise Strategy Based on CarSim
abstract: This article studies vehicle adaptive cruise control (ACC) strategies based on a layered longitudinal control structure and its application on CarSim. In the acceleration control of the lower layer, the inverse longitudinal dynamics model is used to calculate the required engine torque or brake pressure according to the required longitudinal acceleration. At the same time, a certain buffer width is used in order to avoid frequent driving and braking switching. The upper-level control of ACC is mainly divided into two parts: distance tracking and switching of speed or distance control modes. An anti-saturation PID algorithm and a switching strategy are used for distance tracking. Finally, a co-simulation platform combined CarSim and Matlab/Simulink is implemented to verify the effectiveness of ACC control strategies. The simulations are carried out for several working conditions and the results show the effectiveness of the ACC strategies.

articleTitle: A Novel BCI Paradigm Combined with Augmented Reality
abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) were useful in many scenarios; however current computer screen-based BCIs (CS-BCIs) were not wearable. We proposed AR-BCI, a BCI combined with augmented reality, in which a translucent head-mounted display (HMD) was used as the user interface so that the users could wear this AR-BCI and see virtual stimuli and real environment simultaneously. We recruited ten subjects in this study. Each subject completed predefined tasks with the AR-BCI (as the experiment group) and a CS-BCI (as the control group) respectively. We used the accuracies and information transfer rates (ITRs) of the BCIs as the performance metrics. The experimental results showed that two BCIs had almost the same accuracies (about 81% for the AR-BCI and about 82% for the CS-BCI) and almost the same ITRs (about 11.3 bits/min for the AR-BCI and about 11.7 bits/min for the CS-BCI). The AR-BCI we proposed might be useful for a disability assistance scenario.

articleTitle: Exponential Stability and H∞ Performance Analysis for Spatially Interconnected Systems with Time-varying Delay
abstract: The problems of exponential stability and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance analysis for spatially interconnected continuous-time time-varying delay (SICTD) systems are considered in this paper. An appropriate Lyapunov-Krasovskii (L-K) functional is constructed for proving the exponential stability of SICTD system. A delay-dependent sufficient condition is then proposed to ensure the exponential stability and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance of the SICTD system. Meanwhile, we also obtain a sufficient condition ensuring the exponential stability and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance for the spatially interconnected systems (SISs) with constant time delay via the L-K method. A simulation of the vehicle platoon model is carried out to illustrate the validity of our deduced results.

articleTitle: Finite-time H∞ control for marine surface vessel trajectory tracking with uncertainty and disturbance based on second-order sliding mode observer
abstract: In this article, the trajectory tracking control problem of marine surface vessels (MSV) with uncertainties and time-varying disturbances is investigated. A robust adaptive trajectory tracking control scheme is proposed based on finite-time H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control and a second-order sliding mode observer (SOSMO). The control scheme is simple in design, has strong robustness and fast convergence, and is not only globally stable in a finite-time in the closed-loop system, but also in a finite-time the expected attenuation level bounded by the L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> norm to obtain satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: RUL Prediction for Lithium-ion Batteries Using Combination Forecasting based on SVR and LSTM
abstract: Forecasting the remaining Useful Life (RUL) of Lithium-ion battery has been a major concern in the energy industry. The poor learning ability of local features and insufficient learning ability of large amounts of data are some problems existing. In order to solve the existing problems, a data-driven prediction method combining support vector regression (SVR) and long short-term memory (LSTM) is proposed. Taking standard deviation as the criterion, the method continuously optimizes the constrained multivariate function through sequence quadratic program, and iterates to obtain the minimum error value to calculate the optimal weight corresponding to each model, then the prediction accuracy is improved by combination. The experimental results show that the root mean square error of the combination forecasting is around 1% when the number of cycles is specified, which provides a good reference for improving the performance of the battery management system.

articleTitle: Patterned Fabric Defect Detection Based on Double-branch Parallel Improved Faster-RCNN
abstract: In the weaving of patterned fabrics, surface defects are the main factor affecting quality of fabrics. Due to the low efficiency of manual detection, a deep learning methods for fabric defect detection is introduced. Faster-RCNN is a target detection algorithm that takes into account both accuracy and speed, but the original Faster-RCNN network is not suitable for fabric defect detection situation where there are large differences in the size and shape of the defects. Therefore, a double-branch parallel Faster-RCNN network for large and small target defect categories is proposed. The network structure of the two branches SF-Net(small Faster-RCNN network branch) and LF-Net(large Faster-RCNN network branch) are optimized and improved respectively. At the same time, two methods of weighted difference and post-processing are taken to effectively use the information of the template images. A series of experiments are conducted on real fabric datasets. In the experimental part, compared with baseline, our method improves mAP and AR by 4.3% and 6.5%, respectively, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Fault-tolerant Predictive Control Based on Three-phase Four-switch in Motor
abstract: As an important part of AC motors, inverters have a vital influence on the running performance of the motors. Aiming at the problem of unbalanced potential at the midpoint of three-phase four-switched capacitors in motor fault-tolerant control, this paper analyzes the control principle based on the three-phase four-switch fault-tolerant topology. A control strategy for establishing a new cost function in predictive control is proposed and a corresponding model is established. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation and comparison results.

articleTitle: Guaranteed Tracking Performance Control for A Microsatellite with Attitude and Angular Rate Constraints
abstract: A novel guaranteed tracking performance control for a microsatellite with attitude and angular rate constraints is proposed in this paper. Both the transient and stable attitude prescribed tracking performances are enhanced by integrating the time varying barrier Lyapunov function and dynamic surface control. Furthermore, the angular rate constraints are also considered and guaranteed by the fixed boundary barrier Lyapunov functions. Comparing with the existing prescribed performance control (PPC) methods, the proposed method can achieve the prescribed performance and need less computation. The stability analysis is obtained by using the Lyapunov stability theorems and numerical simulation results are verified to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Transient Performance Analysis of Five-Machine Rework Production Lines With Bernoulli Machines, Finite Buffers and Batch Production
abstract: In many production systems, defective parts are not directly discarded because of production costs, but are sent to the rework line for reprocessing. In the current literature, the steady-state performance of rework lines have been studied extensively. However, for small and medium-volume production systems, the production lines run most of the time under transient conditions. Steady-state analysis is not appropriate in such situations. Therefore, it is critical to study the transient behavior of the rework systems. This paper considers a five-machine rework line with batch production. We derive the state transition probabilities of the five-machine rework system through the dynamic characteristics. Moreover, the transient performance indices are studied. Finally, an illustrative example is given to demonstrate the reliability of the method, and the properties of rework production systems are investigated.

articleTitle: Adaptive Boundary Control of a Gantry Crane System with Parametric Uncertainty
abstract: In this study, an adaptive boundary control method is investigated for the gantry crane system with parametric uncertainty and boundary disturbance. Firstly, utilizing Hamilton’s principle, the governing equation and boundary conditions described by partial differential equations and ordinary differential equations are derived. Then, two cooperative adaptive boundary controllers and two adaptive laws are designed to suppress the vibration of the flexible cable and compensate for the unknown mass of the trolley and payload of the system. Besides, the stability of the gantry crane system is presented by Lyapunov’s direct method and rigorous mathematical analysis. With the proposed control scheme, the uniform ultimate boundedness of the gantry crane system is achieved. Finally, numerical simulation results are given to demonstrate the advantages and feasibility of the proposed control approach.

articleTitle: A New Impedance Control Method for End Effector Manipulator of Autonomous Unmanned System
abstract: This paper proposes an improved fractional proportional-integral-differential (PID) impedance control method with dynamic parameters for the end effector manipulator of autonomous unmanned system. It can conduct versatile manipulating tasks which have great potential application. Force and position sensors are used for compliance control in collision situations. The proposed method makes the action of the robot smooth in a changing environment of the autonomous unmanned system’s tasks. The trajectory of the robot changes when touching obstruct because of the force restriction. A new variable selection parameter matrix S is designed to merge the impedance control and the admittance control. Fractional PID controller is also added to modify the dynamic property. Comparing with the PID and traditional impedance controllers, our method improves the tracking accuracy with less vibration. The simulations show the robot moves smoother and batter force tracking than PID and impedance controllers.

articleTitle: Improved A* algorithm for automatic guided transport vehicle path planning
abstract: For the automatic guided vehicle (AGV) path planning problem, an improved A* algorithm is proposed for solving it. The algorithm combines the warehouse environment to generate rasterized information. Firstly, an AGV model with a safe driving area is established to avoid the AGV from crossing the obstacle vertices diagonally; secondly, heuristic function is improved in the traditional A* algorithm and an adaptive heuristic function is designed to obtain the globally optimal solution more efficiently; thirdly, a geometric method is used to shave off the redundant linear points and unnecessary corners in the path search; finally, A new feasible point is generated at the corner of the obstacle and a path is obtained that contains a start point, feasible points and an end point. The data output display that the improved A* algorithm can effectively plan a path with shorter distance and safer transportation, reduce the path search time, lower the corner angle of the AGV, and plan an optimal path with higher quality.

articleTitle: MMC circulating current suppression strategy based on complex resonance controller
abstract: Modular multilevel converters (MMC) have been widely used and studied in field of high-power electric energy conversion due to their good scalability and harmonic characteristics. During the operation of the MMC system, there will be circulation current problems, which will cause system loss and power switch tubes to heat or even burn. How to suppress the system circulation has become one of the key technologies to guarantee the stable operation of MMC. This paper proposes a strategy based on complex resonance control (CRC)to suppress system circulation current, use coordinate transformation to convert its component into the actual voltage vector, Circulation suppression is obtained by constructing a virtual two-phase stationary coordinate system to suppress them. The method is accompanied by submodule capacitance voltage equalization control. The validity of its control method is examined in the simulation software.

articleTitle: LSTM-Based Prediction Model for Tool Face State of Sliding Directional Drilling
abstract: For sliding directional drilling, because of the lack of quantitative control experience and the difficulty of physical modeling, the control parameters of the torsional pendulum system are artificially chosen according to the motion state of the tool surface, which leads to the effect of directional control depends on the artificial experience, thus the control efficiency is uneven, the problem of human resources cost is large and the efficiency is low. Aiming at more effective controlling of torsion pendulum in sliding directional operation, an intelligent prediction model for tool face state based on Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) network is proposed to make more effective decisions for control parameters. Experiments show that the temporal sequence and nonlinear law in sliding directional operation can be well learned. Moreover, the effectiveness of the proposed prediction model is tested on several real oil drilling platforms. The research results have great potential applications in intelligent and automatic directional drilling process.

Author Keywords: The process of sliding directional drilling

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Comment Texts Based on CNN-BiGRU-Attention
abstract: In recent years, deep neural network models have become more and more widely used in the field of sentiment analysis. Compared with traditional machine learning algorithm-s, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks (CRNN), etc are more stable and accurate. However, these algorithms are prone to overfitting during the experiment, resulting in lower accuracy and precision. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a feature extraction method based on convolutional neural network (CNN) and bidirectional GRU model, the two features are fused in the full connection layer, which contains both the text features and the semantic relationship between the front and back of the text, then we output the results through a layer of attention mechanism and softmax function. Finally, after many experiments, it has been proved that our model works better than baselines in the accuracy, precision, recall rate, and F value by 3 to 5 percentage points, which proves the feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Optimization of auto lamp spraying trajectory based on improved PSO algorithm
abstract: In this paper, the optimization method of lamp spraying trajectory is studied, the parabolic coating thickness accumulation rate model is established, and a segmentation algorithm based on lamp spraying is proposed. Taking the deviation between the thickness of the overlapping area and the ideal thickness as the optimization objective, the width and the spraying speed of the two adjacent spraying paths are determined. An improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm based on edge recombination operator is proposed for the optimal combination of all spraying trajectories on the lamp surface. Simulation experiments and spraying experiments verify the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Industrial Anomaly Classification Method Based on EMD Metric Loss
abstract: Anomaly Classification is critical for the efficient and secure operation of industrial equipment. However, the accuracy of many present anomaly classification methods tend to decline, particularly when there are multiple anomalies. In this paper, an anomaly classification method on the basic of Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) metric Loss is presented. Firstly, the anomaly classification is defined as a case of optimal image matching. Then, a novel EMD metric loss based on triplet is designed for extracting discriminative local features. Finally, a simple classifier support vector machines (SVM) can be adopted to realize the multi-anomalies classification. It is proved that the presented anomaly classification method has better performance than the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Long-short Memory with Feature Representation by Latent-variable Model for Industrial Soft Sensor
abstract: In modern industry, soft sensor of quality variables is essential for the safety, stability, and optimization of the processes. However, it is very hard to construct accurate soft sensor models in the horrible industrial environment. Firstly, the complex nonlinearity and variability are widespread in industrial process data. In order to extract useful information efficiently, feature representation is needed. As a probabilistic latent-variable model, variational auto-encoder (VAE) can map the observed data to the latent variable space and represent features in data robustly. Hence, the VAE is used as a feature extractor in this article. In order to solve KL vanishing in the standard VAE, a weighted VAE is developed to control the process of training. Besides, dynamic feature is also an important characteristic that should be considered in the process industry. To capture the temporal dependence in the time series, a long-short memory is utilized in this article, which can deal with the data in sequence and is used as a regressor. Finally, a long-short memory with feature representation by latent-variable model is proposed, which takes into account the nonlinearity, dynamics, and variability simultaneously. In order to prove the feasibility of the designed method, experiments were carried out on the real blast furnace ironmaking process. Through comparison with other methods, it is proved that this model can improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Continuous Teacher-Student Learning for Class-Incremental SAR Target Identification
abstract: In this paper, we propose a class-incremental SAR target identification approach based on continuous teacher-student learning. The main challenge of class-incremental SAR target identification is catastrophic forgetting: as the learned model tend to adapt to the most recently seen new identification task, they forget what they have learned before and therefore lose performance on the tasks that were learned previously. Our method aims at introducing the teacher model, which can utilize data from tasks so far, to prevent the student model from catastrophic forgetting. For each task, the teacher model learn to capture the knowledge contained in the tasks by now. When a new task is presented, the student model is encouraged to learn from the teacher model so that the information on which the previous task relied is retained. At the same time, we also make the student model to review its own knowledge to further alleviate catastrophic forgetting. The evaluation of continuous SAR target recognition task shows that this method reduces forgetting effect.

articleTitle: Real-Time Solutions of Time-Varying Separable Integral Equations (TVSIE) Using Zhang Equivalency
abstract: As technology rapidly increases, the integral equation becomes an important mathematical tool to solve different problems. In addition, the time-varying problems are also one of the current research focuses, and Zhang equivalency (ZE), proposed by Zhang et al, is an effective theory to solve time-varying problems. In this paper, we concentrate on the time-varying separable integral equation (TVSIE) to verify the feasibility and superiority of ZE. To begin with, we present our general problem formulations, and then, we introduce the concept of ZE and the generation of ZE solutions. Moreover, we present two examples (i.e., one with a convergent analytical solution and another with a diverging analytical solution) and conduct two groups of numerical experiments to show the performance of ZE. Finally, we further present another two examples (being more complex and without analytical solutions) and their numerical experiments to substantiate the advantage of ZE.

articleTitle: Deep Residual Network with D-S Evidence Theory for Bimodal Emotion Recognition
abstract: In this paper, the Deep Residual Network (ResNet) with Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory is presented for bimodal emotion recognition through applying facial expression and speech emotion information. By acquiring discriminative emotion features and performing bimodal fusion of emotions, this method can overcome the limitations of single modal emotion recognition and obtain higher recognition accuracy. The key areas of emotional features and spectrograms are firstly used to acquire low-level characteristics of emotion. Moreover, two ResNets are designed to select high-level emotion semantic features. Furthermore, under the structure of D-S evidence theory, the output probability values are used for achieving emotion fusion to improve the effectiveness of bimodal emotion recognition. The experimental studies on the eNTERFACE’05 database demonstrate a recognition accuracy of 88.67%, which is a noteworthy improvement of 23.11% and 9.32% compared to an individual mode of facial expressions and speech, respectively.

articleTitle: Weld Point Cloud Segmentation Algorithm Fused Contour Feature
abstract: In the scene of industrial quality inspection, the traditional point cloud segmentation algorithm applied to weld point cloud segmentation has the disadvantage of slow segmentation speed and low segmentation accuracy. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a weld point cloud segmentation algorithm which fuses contour features, the algorithm separates the contour and searches for key points of contour features, partitions the weld contour, then uses the RANSAC algorithm to remove the straight point cloud in each area, and finally retains the remaining point cloud and maps it back to the three-dimensional space. The experiment compared the RANSAC plane segmentation algorithm, the region growing segmentation algorithm and the improved segmentation algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved segmentation algorithm has the advantages of faster segmentation speed, higher segmentation accuracy and good robustness, and solves the problems of over-segmentation and under-segmentation in the traditional point cloud segmentation.

articleTitle: Anti-disturbance Heterogeneous Formation Tracking Control Based on Time-varying Gain Extended State Observer
abstract: In this paper, the issue of TVF(time-varying formation) tracking control and anti-disturbance for UAV(unmanned aerial vehicle) and UGV(unmanned ground vehicle) heterogeneous system is studied, which requires that multiple UAVs and UGVs can maintain the desired time- varying formation under unknown external disturbance. Firstly, the anti-disturbance TVF model for UAV and UGV is established. Then, in order to estimate the time-varying uncertainty, the time-varying gain extended state observer(TVGESO) is constructed. And also, the anti-disturbance formation tracking control protocol is designed. The feasibility conditions of realizing TVF in heterogeneous system are further analyzed, and the parameter selection method of the protocol is given. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control Design of Quadrotor UAVs Using Symbolic Regression
abstract: This paper presents a mathematic dynamic model of a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (QUAV) by using the symbolic regression (SR) approach and then proposes a hierarchical control scheme for trajectory tracking. In the dynamic modeling, the uncertain partial physical parameters and unknown model structure are both taken into account. Therefore, SR is adopted to construct the dynamic model described by analytic equations, which relieves the burden of modeling. To facilitate position tracking control of a QUAV, the design of controller can be decomposed into two parts: a proportional-integral controller for the position subsystem is first designed to obtain the desired horizontal position and the backstepping method for the attitude subsystem is developed to ensure that the Euler angles and the altitude can fast converge to the reference values. Further simulation results are shown to demonstrate the effectiveness of SR for modeling.

articleTitle: Cooperative Group Control Strategy in the on-Ramp Area for Connected and Automated Vehicles under Mixed Traffic Environment
abstract: To improve the traffic efficiency of mixed traffic in the context of vehicles merging at the main lane and on-ramp intersection, this study proposes a cooperative control strategy consisting of the merging sequence for multi-subgroups and vehicle group control. Besides, a technology framework of centralized planning and distributed control is utilized to implement the proposed cooperative merging strategy. In particular, the game approach is used to generate the optimal cooperative merging sequence in the road-side unit (RSU) of centralized planning. Then, the appointed leading connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) of subgroups will respectively follow the commands by the proposed vehicle group control method under the merging area. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can reduce the travel time and fuel consumption, and improve the comfort of passengers.

articleTitle: GSA test analysis and optimization strategy for shifting quality of automobile transmission
abstract: The rapid development of social economy leads to the improvement of people's quality of life, and the development of transportation network and industrial technology promotes the rapid growth of the domestic automobile industry. Users are no longer limited to considering vehicle power, driving safety and fuel economy when buying cars, but also pay more attention to driving maneuverability and shift comfort. At present, the domestic is not comprehensive to shift characteristics test evaluation development, subjective evaluation method cannot determine the specific factors affecting shift quality, and greatly influenced by artificial factors, there is also a lack of objective test and analysis, so the lack of perfect vehicle shift control system optimization method, this paper tries to select from two aspects of static and dynamic evaluation index, evaluation system to build transmission shift test, Combined with the test data, the specific factors are analyzed. The transmission is optimized by adding the Schäffler positioning mechanism with the sector block, adding the linear bearing at both ends of the fork shaft, adding the counterweight block of the shift arm, and changing the round hole of the synchronizer jaw hole into a square hole. These systematically improve and enhance the transmission's shift smooth. After optimization and improvement, we evaluate and analyze the method again, and verify the feasibility of the method with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of Autonomous Driving Vehicles via Output Feedback MPC
abstract: This paper aims at addressing a model predictive control technique for trajectory tracking of autonomous driving vehicle under the condition that the system states are difficult to be measured. Firstly, a linearized error model and an dynamic output feedback controller are established, and then an augmented closed-loop model is obtained to predict the dynamic behavior of autonomous driving vehicles. In addition, the dynamic output feedback model predictive controller is derived by minimizing the upper bound of an infinite horizon quadratic objective function which explicitly takes the input constraint into account. Finally, the optimization problem of dynamic output feedback model predictive control (DOFMPC) is solved by linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) technique, and the first one of the optimized control sequence is implemented. It is proved that the output feedback predictive control strategy realizes the goal of accurately tracking the reference trajectory on the simulation platform of CarSim and Simulink, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Multiple Omnidirectional Mobile Robots Control
abstract: Three-wheeled omnidirectional mobile robot (TWODMR) is a new type of holonomic mobile robot, which performs better moving flexibility than nonholonomic mobile robot. In this paper, we focus on the multi-robot formation control problem of three-wheeled omnidirectional mobile robots. The deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm is applied to carry out the formation motion planning and controlling task and the artificial potential field (APF) algorithm is used as a comparison. According to the experiment results, the DDPG algorithm solves the multi-robot formation control problem. The DDPG algorithm optimizes its control strategy and the trained DDPG controller achieves more accuracy and adaptability than the APF controller.

articleTitle: Research on Warehouse Layout Optimization Under "Double Carbon" Target
abstract: Achieving the "double carbon" goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality is also an issue facing the logistics industry. As an example in this paper, taking warehouse layout proposes an improved systematic layout planning (SLP) method that combines mathematical models and dynamic analysis on SLP. This method constructs a dual-objective mathematical model by quantifying the relationship of logistics influencing factors between functional warehouse areas. The genetic algorithm is used to solve the model and obtain the warehouse layout optimization plan. Finally, the optimization plan is modified and adjusted with the dynamic analysis to get the optimal layout plan. Combined case studies show that the optimal approach's warehouse function area layout is more reasonable than the original method. The SLP and genetic algorithm combination replaces traditional manual calculation, avoids human operation errors, and improves accuracy and work efficiency. It provides a new perspective for similar logistics companies in low-carbon development and industrial automation upgrades.

articleTitle: Unsupervised identification of high-emitting mobile sources based on multi-feature fusion
abstract: Road remote sensing monitoring device is an excellent mobile source exhaust monitoring equipment, which can realize the data collection of exhaust emission without affecting the vehicle driving. But it is very sensitive to external influencing factors. In the traditional vehicle inspection, the vehicle is often determined whether it belongs to the high emission category by a preset pollutant concentration threshold, which ignores the influence of external factors on pollutant emissions. To solve this problem, an unsupervised identification method of high emission sources is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the key influencing factors of pollutant emissions are screened out using random forest algorithm; secondly, a multi-featured cluster analysis model is constructed to obtain high emission category labels by unsupervised way. The experimental results show that the number proportion of high emission category samples is consistent with the highly skewed emission distribution of road mobile sources, which verifies the effectiveness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Distributed Finite-Time Secondary Control of DC Microgrids Based on Virtual Capacitance
abstract: The distributed finite-time secondary control for the DC microgrid is introduced in this paper. When the microgrid's operating state changes, the finite-time secondary controller can accelerate the DGs' output voltage and current convergence speed and improve the system's rapidity. Virtual capacitors are added to distributed secondary control to increase the DC microgrid's inertia. The simulation example verifies that the finite-time secondary controller can effectively improve the response speed of the microgrid and proves that virtual capacitors can effectively enhance the anti-interference ability of the microgrid.

articleTitle: An Endogenous Security Protection Framework adapted to 5G MEC in Power Industry
abstract: The power industry has a large number of 5G communication requirements, especially on the side of the distribution communication network. There are many points and a large number of devices need to be monitored or controlled in real time, and 5G could meet the power demand well. However, different from the existing power backbone communication network, 5G's MEC brings convenience and high real-time services on the one hand, but on the other hand, because MEC sinks part of the network's business capabilities and computing capabilities closer to the user side, it faces risks such as large attack exposure, poor microservice isolation, and difficulty in ensuring the security of the underlying data. Therefore, it is urgent to carry out security protection research that adapts to 5G MEC. Based on the characteristics of power 5G MEC, this article proposes an endogenous security protection framework that adapts to power 5G MEC, which can effectively resist various security threats.

articleTitle: Estimation of urban arterial travel time based on dynamic bayesian network
abstract: Estimation and prediction of urban arterial travel time is important for the development of transportation field, especially measures and methods of traffic management and control. This article presents a modeling method for estimating and predicting arterial travel time based on Dynamic Bayesian Network. The probability distribution model of travel time conditioned on different traffic states is constructed by combining the traffic flow theory at intersections and Dynamic Bayesian Network. The Cell Transmission Model that was applied to accurately describe the evolution process of state variables and the travel time observations were obtained by trajectory data, then the relationship between the traffic state and travel time was established by Dynamic Bayesian Network. The EM algorithm and particle filter algorithm are used to iterate the static parameters of the road (such as traffic signal parameters) through machine learning, so as to estimate and predict the distribution of arterial travel time in real time under the current traffic state. The data of Changping District of Beijing were selected to verify the validity of the probability distribution estimation of travel time in this paper, then the direction and value of subsequent improvement and application were proposed.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Model for Traffic Data Quality Based on GRA and TOPSIS
abstract: With the increasing of motor vehicles, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) has become a major trend, and the traffic data quality is becoming a critical issue which has great influence on the system. In order to evaluate the quality of traffic data, a comprehensive evaluation model based on Grey Relational Analysis(GRA) and Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution(TOPSIS) is proposed in this paper. On the basis of comprehensive analysis of traffic data, integrity, effectiveness, relative error of an occupancy speed model and relative error of an occupancy flow model are defined as four evaluation indices. Correlation coefficient is used to determine the reasonable weights. Then, the comprehensive evaluation value is computed by combining TOPSIS method and GRA method, which makes the improved grey correlation method not only has the positive reference sequence, but also has the negative reference sequence. Therefore, the results of the comprehensive evaluation show the difference and correlation between traffic data more obviously, which is more conducive to distinguish the quality of data. Finally, compared to GRA and TOPSIS, the experimental results show that the novel model is more scientific, objective and effective.

articleTitle: PID Control for Aeroengine Based on Sparrow Search Algorithm
abstract: To address the problem of aeroengine PID parameter optimization and tuning, this work employs the excellent performance of the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) with high convergence accuracy and fast convergence speed to propose a self-tuning PID control method (SSA-PID) for aeroengine parameters. Considering that the oil supply output by the actuator may have a substantial overshoot, the proposed technique adds a penalty mechanism for the overshoot at the output, designs and improves the fitness function weighted by performance indicators, and effectively avoids the possible excessive overshoot and sharp oil supply phenomenon of the engine oil supply. The SSA-PID simulates and verifies the mathematical models of the turbofan engine’ s steady-state operating points on the ground and at high altitudes. The results show that the SSA-PID control method has better parameter tuning and optimization effects, a faster speed step response, and generates a fuel supply that does not have a targe overshoot, thereby proving its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Identification method of offset interference rudder angle and its application in ship steering control system
abstract: Even if the rudder angle is zero, there will be an interference torque equivalent to non-zero rudder angle due to installation error and Asymmetric wind wave resistance when the ship is sailing at sea, this equivalent rudder angle is the rudder angle offset or interference rudder angle. In order to obtain the disturbance rudder angle value, according to the ship motion model of the first-order linear KT equation, this paper uses the Kalman filtering algorithm to estimate it and applies it to the ship maneuvering control process, which improves the problem that the calculation time of the disturbance rudder angle integral in the traditional PID control is too long. Through MATLAB simulation experiments, the estimation results of different ship model parameters and different sea state levels are compared and analyzed. The estimated interference rudder angle of the algorithm is almost consistent with the actual setting value, which proves the effectiveness and practicability of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Prediction of Remaining Useful Life of Bearing Based on Long Short-Term Memory Network Optimized by Slime Mould Algorithm
abstract: For resolve the trouble of low prediction accuracy and poor generalization ability of the neural network in the prediction of remaining useful life (RUL) of bearing, a prediction manner because of the combination of slime mould algorithm (SMA) and long short-term memory (LSTM) was proposed. The hyperparameters of the LSTM were automatically optimized by using the SMA with dynamic search ability. The trained SMA-LSTM model was adopted to calculate the RUL of bearing. The simulation effects indicate that the optimization effect of SMA is improving than the grey wolf optimizer and genetic algorithm. The SMA-LSTM model is improving than the SMA-SVR and SMA-BP model in bearing RUL prediction, which proves the capability of the put forward method.

articleTitle: Trace AI Simulation of Feedforward Neural Network Visualization Optimized by Genetic Algorithm Based on Unity3D
abstract: The application of self-driving cars and automatic navigation technology requires a mature AI operation that can continuously deep learning. Training AI using traditional Neural Networks requires a large number of samples and a standard example for negative feedback adjustment. For this kind of tracking AI, a standard example cannot be obtained to make it negative feedback. This article uses Genetic Algorithm to screen ability. The weights of the Feedforward Neural Network are screened from generation to generation to obtain the solution weights. Use Genetic algorithms to replace feedback regulation in traditional neural networks, and it doesn’t require a large number of samples to form a data set. This article uses Unity3D software as a platform to establish a visual tracing of unmanned vehicles based on deep learning AI. The experimental results show that the visual tracing of unmanned vehicles can avoid obstacles and find target points autonomously, with an average fitness value of more than 3. Simulation results show that this algorithm is optimized and efficient for tracking AI. Which can be used in unmanned vehicle navigation, cargo robot handling and logistics, and has a wide range of application values.

articleTitle: Research on sensorless control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor
abstract: The research on the sensorless control of PMSM by using control algorithm is a hot topic in the field of motor control. A PMSM sensorless control system based on low speed pulse high frequency stator flux injection is proposed. The traditional stator flux estimator is improved. The high frequency signal is introduced into the low pass filter to improve the accuracy of the stator flux estimator in the low speed operation of the motor. In view of the situation that the control system without position sensor is susceptible to torque ripple in PMSM, the disturbance torque observer is used to suppress the voltage error caused by the disturbance torque. In this paper, the PMSM rotor position and speed observer is designed, and the magnetic pole judgment criterion is designed to improve the observation accuracy of the observer. Finally, experiments are carried out to verily the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Density Based Clustering Approach to Underdetermined Blind Source Separation
abstract: Blind source separation(BSS) is the process recovering the source signals unknown. Once the number of observed signal is less than the source, it can be referred to underdetermined blind source separation(UBSS). In this paper, one mathematic model based on Sparse Component Analysis(SCA) applied to UBSS is introduced, which can be summarized in two steps after preprocess of signal. What makes the method in this paper different from the classic is the ability of estimating the number of source signals. In this paper, mixture signals are preprocessed by short time Fourier transform(STFT) to strengthen the sparsity, after which some points called single signal point(SSP) are selected for further process. Then based on Density Peak Clustering(DPC) clustering, the method in this paper can precisely get the source signal number while figuring out the channel matrix also called mixture matrix in step one by plotting the decision graph of SSP. After acquiring the estimated matrix, in step two using L1 norm the source signals are finally recovered. With experiments for vocal signal, it has been proven that the method in this paper has a better performance than some other methods which is further demonstrated in the rest of paper.

articleTitle: Continuous-Time Linear Parallel Output Regulation
abstract: A novel parallel output regulation method is presented in this paper. The framework of the parallel output regulation problem is first introduced. Then, the existence of parallel controller is analyzed detailly in the situation that only the measurable information is obtained. Finally, the simulation example is given to show the performance of the presented method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Arbitration for Minimal Intervention Shared Control via Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In shared control, humans and intelligent robots jointly complete real-time control tasks with their complementary capabilities for improved performance unavailable by neither side on its own, which is attracting more and more attentions in recent years. Arbitration, as an indispensable part of shared control, determines how control authority is allocated between the human and robot, and the definition of that policy has always been one of the fundamental problems. In this paper, we propose an adaptive arbitration method for shared control systems, which minimizes the deviation from the human inputs while ensuring the system performance based on deep reinforcement learning. We provide humans the maximum assistance with the minimal intervention, in order to balance human’s need for control authority and need for performance. We apply our method to real-time control tasks, and the results show that our method achieves high task success rate and shorter task completion time with less human workload, while maintaining higher human satisfaction.

articleTitle: UFN-GAN: An unsupervised generative adversarial network for remote sensing image fusion
abstract: Different sensors acquire different images in the same area, such as multi-spectral (MS) images and panchromatic (PAN) images. Normally, the MS images possess high spectral resolution but low spatial resolution, while PAN images are opposite in the distribution of spectral and spatial information. Image fusion is a common method to obtain the information of PAN and MS images simultaneously. To generate clearer fusion image with abundant information, we design an unsupervised fusion net based on generative adversarial network (GAN), named UFNGAN for remote sensing image fusion. In our proposed UFNGAN, an adversarial net is designed between our generator and two discriminators to adequately retain the spectral and spatial information of original images without supervision. MS images and PAN images are fused by our generator, which consists of an encoder and a decoder. Our encoder is used to extract deeper feature maps of the original images, and the decoder is applied to rebuild images. Furthermore, the Spatial-Information-Enhancement (SIE) model is utilized to obtain spatial information of MS images for enhancing PAN image, and the Edge-Detection-Registration (EDR) method is applied to register the original images to avoid fused images distortion. At last, experiments are performed on QuickBird and GaoFen-2 datasets.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of LQR Course Keeping Control for Small Unmanned Surface Vehicle
abstract: A simple and effective modeling method and optimal control strategy are designed for the small unmanned surface vehicle (USV) which was developed by ourselves independently. Firstly, based on the classical Nomoto modeling theory, a linear autoregressive time series model is established indirectly using system identification technology, which could describe the dynamic relationship between the equivalent rudder angle and the heading angle deviation of the ship. Then, based on this model a linear quadratic regulator (LQR) is designed and the detailed real-time control comparisons with a classical PID control strategy and a conventional fuzzy control strategy are conducted. Finally, the real-time control results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed modeling method and the LQR control strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling of Czochralski silicon single crystal growth process based on improved stack autoencoding
abstract: The growth process of Czochralski silicon is a strong nonlinear time-varying process with multiphase and multi-field coupling. Its quality is closely related to modeling, so it is necessary to accurately model it. Among them, how to better learn the characteristics of silicon crystal growth process has become a difficult. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved stack autoencoding method to realize the deeper mining of features. According to the experimental data of crystal growth in single crystal furnace, the performance of the improved model is compared with that of the stack autoencoding before the improvement, and the effectiveness of the improved model is verified.

articleTitle: RAFT-SLAM: Deep Optical-Flow Assisted Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
abstract: Current simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems usually depend the feature point detection and matching to establish correspondences between frames. However, feature point such as Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) or Oriented Fast and Rotated Brief (ORB) may not be successfully detected and matched in less textured scenes. Recent advances in deep learning based optical flow makes it possible to establish stable and dense correspondences between frames even in less textured scenes. We propose in this paper the RAFT-SLAM which integrate an advanced deep learning based optical flow module into the SLAM system, the correspondences estimated by optical flow and feature point matching are fused in a seamless manner yielding high quality cross-frame correspondences which also enhances the accuracy of the localization. Experimental results have demonstrated the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy of Multi-energy Electrical Propulsion Ship Based on Biogeography-based Optimization
abstract: The optimization model of energy management strategy(EMS) of the ship is established in this paper. The solar irradiance dataset is generated from the real meteorological data and the prediction equation of hourly solar irradiance. The fluctuation curves of the power demand of the other marine electrical loads during navigation are generated from the time proportion of each navigation state and the probability density function of the loads power demand. Then vast navigation scenarios are generated by combining the above two types of data sets, and several representative typical navigation scenarios are found through cluster analysis. To compare the optimization efficiency of the optimization models based on particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) and Biogeography-based optimization (BBO), the simulation experiments were carried out in different typical navigation scenarios respectively. The experiment results show that BBO can further improve the optimization efficiency of the optimization model of the EMS than the PSO.

articleTitle: DCLN: Diverse Curriculum Learning with Neuroevolution in Six-Player Poker Tournament
abstract: Recent successes in human-computer gaming AI development have achieved super-human performance in sophisticated confrontation games. Since the Nash equilibrium of multiplayer games is difficult to solve even within only two players, multiplayer poker has always been an challenging problem in the field of Artificial Intelligence. From the perspective of game theory, the pursuing of diverse polices is necessary in non-stationary environment, which is deeply rooted in the non-transitive structure of game. In this paper, in order to provide a tractable solution for multiplayer poker, we first uses the Team-maxmin equilibrium to re-define the solution concept of multiplayer poker without communication in the game playing process. Secondly, we utilize the diverse curriculum learning with neuroevolution (DCLN) method for offline opponent exploitation, try to improve the competitiveness and diversity of the multiplayer poker agent gaming with various opponent. Experimental results show that this kind of agent has the ability to evolve and can defeat different play-styles opponent.

articleTitle: Distributed MPC for Automatic Generation Control of Power System with Wind Power and Battery Energy Storage Systems
abstract: Automatic generation control (AGC) is an crucial function to guarantee the stable and safe operation of the multi-area interconnected power system. On the one hand, the intermittent and random fluctuation of the grid connected new energy generating units brings great challenges to AGC. On the other hand, the fast and accurate output of battery energy storage system (BESS) provides a new way to control the frequency of the electric power system. A distributed AGC model including the thermal power plant, the battery and the wind turbine is proposed. A distributed model predictive control (DMPC) strategy is designed to achieve the control of the system. The strategy is used to coordinate the outputs of thermal power plant and battery to keep the frequency of the system stable. The results of the simulation in a two-area interconnected electric power system prove the proposed method is useful.

articleTitle: A Registration Method of Multi-View Point Clouds Using Turntable and Monocular Structured Light
abstract: This paper describes an effective coarse registration method for multi-view point clouds which benefits from the high accuracy of the structured light 3D measurement system. In this method, we place a calibration ball in the center of the turntable, and then use the structured light system to obtain the point cloud of one side of the calibration ball. The center coordinates of the calibration ball are then calculated by spherical fitting to establish the relationship between the camera and turntable coordinate systems. In addition, the coordinate transformation among multi-view point clouds is calculated according to the preset rotation angle. Based on the data obtained in the previous two steps, multi-view point clouds are unified into the same coordinate system to achieve coarse registration as a reasonable initial value for the iterative closest point (ICP) algorithm. Finally, through the ICP algorithm for precise registration, a complete point cloud of the object is obtained. Experiments on 3D reconstruction for multiple objects confirm the efficiency of the proposed registration method. Code has been made available at: https://github.com/ZengZhiK/Structured-Light-MultiView-Reconstruction.

articleTitle: Soldier Threat Assessment Method Based on Bayesian Network
abstract: Since it is very important for soldiers to obtain threat information in battlefield environment, this paper determines the threat elements of soldiers in battlefield environment based on METT-TC elements proposed by the US Army Laboratory for battlefield needs and combined with domestic literature. In this paper, a threat assessment method of soldiers based on Bayesian network is proposed. Aiming at the problem that Bayesian network cannot deal with dynamic threats, this paper proposes a threat assessment method of soldiers based on dynamic Bayesian network. The threat assessment of soldiers is compared and verified by simulation examples. The results show that the dynamic Bayesian network model has good accuracy and real-time performance, which proves the superiority of the dynamic Bayesian network model. The simulation results are consistent with the expert experience evaluation, and this method has good practicability.

articleTitle: Two-stage Parameter Estimation for the Hammerstein Nonlinear ARX Systems
abstract: In this paper, a novel two-stage parameter estimation scheme for Hammerstein nonlinear ARX (Autoregressive Exogenous, ARX) system using multi-signal processing is studied. The designed combined signal consisting of binary signals and random signals is used to separate parameter estimation issue of the Hammerstein system, which facilitates parameter estimation procedure. In the first stage, based on input and output data of binary signals the unknown parameters for linear block are estimated by using recursive least square algorithm. In the second stage, to improve the convergence rate of estimation parameters, the weights of neural-fuzzy network are learned by using particle swarm optimization algorithm according to random signals. The simulation results show that for the Hammerstein nonlinear ARX systems the proposed method can accurately identify the system parameters.

articleTitle: A High Power Factor Control Method Based on Torque Loop for Electrolytic Capacitor-less IPMSM Drive System
abstract: Compared with the electrolytic capacitor motor drive system, the reliability of the electrolytic capacitor-less motor drive system can be enhanced. To achieve a high input power factor and reduce the harmonics of grid input current, the torque loop control strategy is adopted to control inverter power (and its equivalent torque). The torque controller adopts a proportional-integral-resonant (PIR) controller, which can track the DC signal and the sinusoidal signal. The design method of controller parameters is proposed in this paper, which is helpful to design this torque controller simply. In addition, when the grid input voltage is relatively low, the control effect of inverter power is poor and the DC-link voltage pumps relatively high. Aiming at these problems, the strategy of the power modification is proposed and it is implemented by equivalent voltage feedforward compensation method. The control methods mentioned above are verified by MATLAB simulation. The grid power factor can attain 0.982, and the grid input current harmonics satisfy the EN61000-3-2 standard.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of Sub-module Capacitors of Modular Multi-level Converter Based on Adaptive Observer
abstract: This article first introduced the structure and working principle of the modular multilevel converter(MMC), and then according to the sub-module(SM) capacitor input excitation and circuit structure characteristics, the state equation of the capacitor is derived, and it is clear that the system matrix is zero and the control matrix can identify the target. By constructing an adaptive observer, the capacitance value and leakage resistance of the capacitor were estimated to realize the fault diagnosis of the system. Simulation experiments had shown that the proposed parameter estimation method is effective.

articleTitle: A Direct and Robust Method for Ego-Motion Estimation
abstract: In general, the motion of the a camera is recovered through dense optical flow or sparse optical flow methods. However, these methods have high computational complexity, and sparse feature points are always usually unreliable in real video sequences. In this paper, we propose an effective and robust ego-motion estimation method based on geometric and photometric constraints, which can directly estimate the parameters of camera motion from video and avoid to calculate optical flow. Additionally, in order to improve the robustness against outliers, we propose a coarse-to-fine iteratively reweighted least squares strategy by introducing error entropy and textural degree to measure the confidence of image patch matching. Experimental results on synthetic and real challenging videos demonstrate that our method can effectively and reliably estimate ego-motion, especially in when there are partial occlusions such as blockage of vehicles and shaded areas.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Based on Deep Residual Shrinkage Network and Maximum Mean Discrepancy
abstract: The working environment of rolling bearings is complex, and it is often influenced by noise When the condition changes, a large number of samples with known fault types cannot be provided in the previous condition. These two reasons lead to the decrease of the accuracy of fault diagnosis on testing samples. This paper proposes a transfer learning way based on deep residual shrinkage network and maximum mean discrepancy (DRSN-MMD), which can be used in bearing fault diagnosis under complex and changing conditions. Deep residual shrinkage network (DRSN) has the capacity to eliminate redundant information from vibration signals because soft thresholding is inserted. As a classical criterion to measure the distance between source and target domain, maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) can be used in transfer learning. In our paper, DRSN is used to extract fault feature, and MMD is applied as loss function on model training. In contrast with other methods, the proposed DRSN-MMD approach has higher diagnosis accuracy on the well-known Case Western Reserve University bearing dataset.

articleTitle: Velocity Optimization for Multi-Climbers of the Space Elevator during Climbing
abstract: As a promising future space transportation system, space elevator becomes more and more popular in the aerospace area and the related study becomes significantly. First, A rigid tether model with 2-DOF was established by Lagrange method. Then, the mass of Components of space elevator was studied. At last, to demonstrate the influence of the climbers moving on the system vibration characteristics, the stability of the system and the effect of the climber moving with different acceleration time and deceleration time on the system residual oscillation were studied. Optimizing the time of acceleration and deceleration phases could suppress the residual oscillation and improve the efficiency and economy of the system.

articleTitle: False Data Injection Attack Modeling and Impact on Vehicle Platooning
abstract: Vehicle platoons with small inter vehicle distances that leads to the reduction of fuel consumption and it can help increase traffic throughput in the transportation system. Network communication is an indispensable component for vehicle platoon, but it is also vulnerable to be attacked by cracker. The false data injection attack as a typical cyber attack which affect vehicle platoon is studied in this paper. First, the attack is modelled as additive attack and multiplicative attack. Then, in order to give a better evaluation for traffic safety and efficiency, a new assessment method is proposed for the evaluation of vehicle platoon. At last, numerical simulations are presented to test the cyber attack impact on vehicle platoon and the results shown that the multiplicative attack with more destructive effect on platoon.

articleTitle: Improved Model Predictive Current Control of PMSM based on Luenberger Observer
abstract: Model predictive current control (MPCC) of PMSM is a control tactics with great potential. Compared with the traditional current control method, it has excellent advantages in simply constructed structure and dynamic reply rate. It is also applicable to the consideration of nonlinear factors and constraints of the system. However, the PMSM control system has the characteristics of strong coupling and time-varying parameters. As a result, the predictive model is apt to be mismatched, which leads to prediction error and control performance degradation of MPCC. Aiming at the problem of parameter mismatches and sampling delay, the Luenberger state observer is proposed. The simulation results show that the MPCC based on Lunberger observer can effectively suppress the influences of motor parameter disturbances, which verifies the effectiveness of the MPCC method.

articleTitle: A memristive chaotic system with conditional symmetry and Its circuit implementation
abstract: By retrofitting primitive chaotic system, a conditional symmetric memristive chaotic system is constructed, and its coexisting attractors and offset boosting arestudied. By simulating the phase orbit,Lyapunov exponent spectrum and bifurcation diagram of the system, the dynamic analysis of the system is carried out carefully. After studying the parameters of the system, it is found that the system has the characteristics of offset-boostable control and partial amplitude control, The simulation software Multisim is used to simulate the memristive system and memristor, and the expected experimental results are obtained.

articleTitle: Target Recognition of Live Working Robots for Distribution Networks using LIDAR Point Cloud
abstract: In order to satisfy the requirements of the operation tasks of the live working robots for distribution networks, an approach to electrical equipment recognition using the LiDAR point cloud is proposed. After the point cloud is collected, the preprocessing operation is performed to eliminate interference points and retain the point cloud of the operation area.
