In this paper, a Korean sentence similarity calculation model based on local inference and difference analysis(Kor-Sim) is presented, Kor-Sim resolves the problem of insufficient capture of potential semantic information by traditional similarity calculation method.First, the Korean word vector can be obtained by using GlowVe, secondly the embedding vector can be effectively represented by BiLSTM, thirdly the semantic expression of the sentence is strengthened by local inference.Finally, by using difference analysis, the minute semantic differences between sentences can be captured by the interaction of sentences.The experimental results show that the Kor-Sim model can improve the accuracy of the similarity calculation in Korean sentences.

articleTitle: Occlusion Face Image Inpainting Method Based on Multi-scale and Contextual Attention
abstract: In order to solve the common issues of unclear repaired images and incoherent semantics in occluded face image inpainting, we propose a two-stage generation network that combines multi-scale joint and contextual attention. The first stage of the network uses a multi-scale parallel encoder-decoder to obtain preliminary inpainting results, and the second stage uses the context attention module to refine the inpainting details. Based on the idea of generating adversarial networks (GAN), we introduced a global&local discriminator to maintain the consistency of global and local content. Apart from the adversarial loss caused by GAN, our method also combines spatial attenuation reconstruction loss and a similar Markov random fields loss for training to further enhance the quality of the produced images. A large number of experiments on the CelebA and CelebA-HQ face datasets show that our method can obtain a relatively good inpainting effect.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Model of Coal Mills based on FPGA
abstract: In view of the harsh operating environment of the coal mills of thermal power unit and the frequent occurrence of coal mills defects, this paper evaluated the operating status of the coal mills and command whether it was in a fault condition or not. The evaluation and judgement was based on the SIS system of thermal power plant to collect the pulverized coal temperature, primary wind speed, coal mill outlet temperature and other variables. In this paper, the relevant parameters of the coal mill are analyzed and the main variables affecting the vibration of the coal mill are determined. Then based on BP neural network, this paper carried out fast implementation through FPGA and verified its feasibility and correctness in Modelsim-altera simulation software. This paper also predicted the state of the coal mill’s operating, and the sliding window method (deviation degree) is used to diagnose and warn the fault of mill outlet temperature, outlet pressure, motor current and vibration. With the simulation and verification of the historical operation data of coal mills in a thermal power plant, the proposed fault diagnosis model of coal mill based on FPGA self-learning has high precision and is easy to implement in engineering.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Targets in Videos Using Non-Invasive Brain-Computer Interface
abstract: A novel video-target recognition method is proposed in this paper by directly translating the Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals of an operator when watching the video. In order to explore the neural signatures of the video-target recognition, we use the continuous wavelet transform (CWT) to analyze the EEG signals before and after a video-target recognition. It is found that the amplitude of EEG signals increases significantly in the θ (4 ~ 8Hz) and α (8 ~ 13Hz) bands when the operator recognizes a video target. Then we use the time-frequency features to construct the classifier. The experimental results show that the average area under the curve (AUC) of the classification model can reach 0.8413, which shows that the proposed method has good performance. This method can be used as a supplement to the existing machine intelligence based methods of video-target detection.

articleTitle: The Adaptive NN Control of an Uncertain Robot with Time-varying Output Constrains
abstract: This paper studies the adaptive tracking problem for a uncertain robot with output constraints. An asymmetric barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) is adopted to deal with the problem of time-varying output constrains and enhance the robustness of the control. In order to deal with system uncertainties, the adaptive neural network (NN) is utilized to estimate the unknown dynamic model parameters and external disturbances. The adaptive compensator is designed to compensate for NN estimation errors and improves the tracking accuracy. All the state errors are semi-globally uniformly ultimately bounded (SGUUB) by Lyapunov analysis, and the asymmetrical output constraints are not violated. Simulations are used to verify the feasibility and robustness of the designed control strategy.

articleTitle: An Improved Substation Equipment Recognition Algorithm by KNN Classification of Subspace Feature Vector
abstract: With the development of intelligent substation construction technology, 3D recognition of substation equipment is becoming more and more important. This paper proposes an improved substation equipment recognition algorithm based on KNN classification of subspace feature vector, in which the number of dividing subspaces is unchanged to maximize keeping the shape features of equipment point cloud, and solves the problem of distorting shape feature of point cloud caused by normalization. At the same time, this paper preselects the standard devices from the template library by size screening of standard devices to reduce the comparison range of recognition and shorten average recognition time. The experiment results show that recognition accuracy of the improved recognition algorithm is improved by 2%-8% and the average recognition time is reduced by an order of magnitude, which shows the effectiveness of the recognition method of this paper.

articleTitle: Differential Game Guidance Law for 3-Party Game with Incomplete Information
abstract: The research of optimal guidance law is the emphasis in the field of missile guidance. Among them, the research based on the two-party game has been relatively complete. With the development of modern weapons of war, the game between the two parties has been unable to meet the needs of actual combat, and a more complex tripartite game has been introduced into the design of the optimal guidance law. However, the current research on the three-body game is still limited to the condition of complete information, and there is a lack of research on the condition of incomplete information. In this paper, based on the Linear Quadratic Performance Index (LQPI) approach, we propose to use the Cubature Kalman filter(CKF) to perform the online estimation of the final state performance index weighting matrix and the input performance index weighting matrix of the aircraft. Finally, an optimal guidance law for incomplete information conditions was proposed. Extensive simulations and experiments verify the feasibility of the new guidance law.

articleTitle: Fast ADMM algorithm with efficient communication for distributed optimization of multi-agent systems
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed optimization algorithm based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) for the distributed optimization problem of multi-agent systems, called ADMM with adaptive penalty terms and conditional communication (for short, AAPCC), by using the local information of agents to update the adaptive penalty terms to speed up the convergence speed while by restricting the communication conditions of agents to reduce the communication cost of agents in the iterative process. Thus, the communication cost of the system is reduced while the convergence speed is ensured. Numerical simulation experiments show that in a multi-agent system, compared with the classical ADMM, AAPCC can better balance the convergence speed and communication cost, suitable for multi-agent systems that require fast convergence speed and less communication cost.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy based on Hybrid-Systems Algorithm and Radial Basis Function Neural Network for HEV
abstract: In the paper, an energy management strategy (EMS) based on the hybrid system predictive control algorithm and radial basis function neural network algorithm (RBFNN) is constructed for hybrid electric vehicle(HEV). First, an velocity predictor is proposed based on the RBF-NN and the Chebyshev filter, which aim to improve the calculated accuracy. Based on the detailed analysis, the driveline system is simplified into an hybrid dynamic system and optimized by Mixed integer linear programming algorithm. Through the simulation, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated in two driving cycles. Results show that the proposed approach improve the internal combustion engine (ICE) fuel economy.

articleTitle: Deep learning of Hash Method for Fast Image Retrieval
abstract: Most of the image retrieval technology are complex and advanced methods to improve the accuracy of retrieval. They also have deep net layers, which costs much time to caculate the result. When we need deal with complex image task, it will be hard to complete the fast image retrieval.This paper presents a convolutional neural network combining with the fast encoding technology under the hash algorithm to improve fast retrieval time and accuracy. In order to keep the existing accuracy and retrieval speed of the network, we present a Hash method path of the network combining witn the dual networks. By clustering analysis and AlexNet,we get lots of high dimensional feature. Then these feature is put into Hash-coding algorithm. The algorithm will output binary feature to match the target image. Through learning similar graph pairs, Hash net work shorten the distance between the similar images, and achieve fast clustering. Then it realizes image retrieval and outputs the most similar picture. Complete the search task.

articleTitle: PMSM current predictive control based on disturbance torque observer
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is easy to be affected by torque ripple and dead time of inverter when it runs at medium and low speed, resulting in poor control characteristics of PMSM. In order to solve this problem, this paper takes PMSM in medium and low speed as the research object, and replaces the traditional PI control with current predictive control. At the same time, a disturbance torque observer is introduced to estimate the voltage error caused by the disturbance torque of the motor model in real time, and feedback to the input terminal to counteract the impact of the disturbance on the motor. Finally, through MATLAB / Simulink and experiments, it is verified that the proposed scheme can effectively improve the dynamic characteristics of the motor, suppress external interference and improve the control performance of the motor.

articleTitle: A Discussion of the Mapping from the Unified Search Space to the Search Space of the Optimized Task in Evolutionary Multitasking Optimization
abstract: Multitasking evolutionary algorithms enable the communication of information between different tasks and the mining of valuable knowledge by encoding all individuals into a unified search space. The mapping of decision variables of the same dimension for different tasks in the unified search space has the same dimensional index, i.e., the same encoded position. In this paper, we disrupt this mapping relationship so that decision variables of the same dimension for different tasks correspond to different encoded positions in the unified search space, to analyze and discuss the effect of this mapping relationship on the performance of the algorithm. A series of experimental results suggest that the mapping relationship between the decision variables of different tasks in a multitasking evolutionary algorithm has a significant impact on the performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Study on Reachable Domain for Aeroassisted Orbit Transfer Vehicle
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to obtain the reachable domain (RD) for space vehicle using aerodynamic force to transfer between two orbits, which is generally called Aeroassisted Orbit Transfer Vehicle (AOTV). The problem of RD for AOTV is addressed in an analytical approach by numerical optimization under a certain constraint condition. For solving this problem, firstly we describe RD for AOTV as an angle interval located on the target orbit. Secondly we transform the problem of RD to a numerical optimization problem about the upper and lower bound of this interval and give the optimization indexes and constraints. Then we can obtain the RD by using a numerical optimization method. Finally some simulations are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of this numerical optimization method.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of cancer tissue eletroporation base on mesh transport network method
abstract: Electroporation-based therapies utilize intensive pulsed electric fields to destroy the electric shield and plasm insulation of the cellular membrane, which is promising in the non-thermal ablation of tumors. A simulation study to probe the membrane electroporation in the homogeneous prostate cancer tissue is presented. Mesh transport network method (MTNM) based on a two-dimensional Voronoi diagram is used to explore the ablation effect with different polarity and direction of pulsed electric fields. Simulation results suggest that, compared with bipolar electric field burst, more cell is electroporated under the action of unipolar electric field burst, and electroporation occurs faster in the cellular membrane perpendicular to the electric field. The study can be inspirational in the electrochemotherapy in irregularly shaped cells and complex pathological tissue.

articleTitle: Enabling Pointing Assistance in Adaptive Interfaces Using Mouse Pointing Intention Prediction
abstract: Understanding pointing intention and providing corresponding support when the user performs pointing tasks are helpful to enhance the input efficiency of graphical user interfaces and improve the experience of user-machine interaction. Existing solutions include pointing facilitation techniques and adaptive interfaces may become impractical because they do not reliably predict mouse click intention well. This paper proposes a new method to enable pointing assistance in adaptive interfaces by predicting mouse pointing intention based on mouse movements. We model the mouse movement trajectory as a multivariate time series and adopt sequence learning models to predict the intended pointing target in real-time. The pointing areas in the adaptive interfaces will make adaptive changes when the number of prediction results in the possible targets queue reaches the set threshold. Analyses and evaluations were conducted using data from 10 subjects through our built prototype system. Experiments indicate that our method was able to predict the target within 600 milliseconds before completing the pointing task with an accuracy of over 90%. Participants felt that the adaptive system could bring convenience when performing pointing tasks without high adaptation costs.

articleTitle: Weapon Target Assignment for Surface-to-air Defense with an Improved Reinforcement Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Decision optimization in surface-to-air defense and coordinated weapon target assignment can improve the defense effect and the utilization rate of weapons. Considering the constraints of weapon capability, a multi-target optimization model is established to maximize the damage probability and minimize the weapon consumption cost. A dual population genetic algorithm improved by reinforcement learning is designed to solve this model. The chromosome exchange ratio is controlled by reinforcement learning to ensure population diversity. Experimental results verify the convergence speed and accuracy of the improved reinforcement genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A novel iterative algorithm for Riccati matrix equation in discrete-time Markov jump system
abstract: In this paper, a novel iterative algorithm is proposed to obtain the positive definite solutions of the discrete coupled Riccati matrix equations. Based on the idea of the inversion-free iteration, the iterative method is developed to reduce calculating the inverse of the matrices by introducing Schulz iteration. Further, latest updated information and a weighting coefficient are introduced to raise the convergence performances of the established algorithm. Finally, a numerical example is provided to validate the effectiveness of the presented algorithm.

articleTitle: Digital Estimation of Three-tank System over Networks with Packets Loss based on TrueTime
abstract: The control problem of networked three-tank system is studied when the data packets can be lost randomly between sensors and controllers, controllers and actuators. Using the theory of vector recovery and state estimation for networked control system, the compensator and state estimator are calculated by solving a linear programming problem and linear matrix inequalities, respectively. Based on the model of three-tank control system, the simulation experiment of networked control system is carried out by Matlab/Simulink and the network/packet-loss is simulated based on TrueTime toolbox. The simulation results show that the method of digital estimator can compensate the influence of packets loss on the performance of control system.

articleTitle: Online self-learning optimal control for residential energy system based on adaptive dynamic programming
abstract: The optimization and management of residential energy system is more complex because it contains time-varying load and random renewable energy. This paper designs an online self-learning strategy to control energy storage system (ESS), so as to realize the optimal economic dispatching of residential energy system. Firstly, the optimal system operation model is established and analyzed. In order to prolong the service life of energy storage, a penalty function is added to the utility function. Then, a data-based action dependent adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) is designed to reduce the operation cost of system, and the value iteration algorithm is applied to approximate the optimal control strategy and value function. The online method can flexibly deal with the fluctuation of data in the system. In addition, reasonable control of the charge and discharge behavior of residential energy storage can increase the utilization of photovoltaic (PV) and decrease the operation cost of residential energy system. Finally, the simulation results proved the effectiveness of the designed optimal control method.

articleTitle: A Review Of Crowd Evacuation Simulation Based On Model
abstract: In recent decades, crowd evacuation simulation has been a research topic. This paper has reviewed the simulation methods of crowd evacuation based on emotion contagion, which simulated more realistic crowd evacuation. The aim of this paper is to introduce the simulation methods of crowd evacuation, which are in common use for research to this field, and to discuss and analyze different emotional contagion models, such as ASCRIBE model and the epidemiology model of emotional contagion.

articleTitle: Modified Kalman filter without covariance matrices for one kinetic linear model
abstract: The covariance matrices of measurement and process noise are essential for standard Kalman filter algorithm in practice. In this paper, we will focus on the fundamental estimating problem that there is no priori knowledge about covariance matrices of measurement and process noise for a kind of kinetic system model. To cope with this challenging problem, a modified Kalman filter, terms as MKF-RCE, is proposed based on the basic statistical approach under the framework of Kalman filter. Finally, the stability are verified by simulation experiments to demonstrate that MKF-RCE is optimal in sense that estimate sequence from MKF-RCE is asymptotically convergent with the ideal sequence from Kalman filter with exact covariance matrices.

articleTitle: Group Consensus Control of Multi-Vehicle Systems with Actuator Faults
abstract: The group consensus control of multi-vehicle systems has practical engineering significance. This paper mainly solves the group consensus control problem of the multi-vehicle systems under switching topology and actuator faults. An adaptive control gain is introduced to solve the problem of switching topology and actuator faults caused by network attack. An adaptive group consensus control protocol is designed to achieve group consensus. The stability condition of the system is obtained by Lyapunov function. The system is bounded when directed graph satisfies in-degree balance. Finally, the effectiveness of control protocol is verified through vehicle simulation.

articleTitle: Self-Attention based Temporal Intrinsic Reward for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: This paper proposes a self-attention based temporal intrinsic reward model for reinforcement learning (RL), to synthesize the control policy for the agent constrained by the sparse reward in partially observable environments. This approach can solve the problem of temporal credit assignment to some extent and deal with the low efficiency of exploration. We first introduce a sequence-based self-attention mechanism to generate the temporary features, which can effectively capture the temporal property of the task for the agent. During the training process, the temporary features are employed in each sampled episode to elaborate the intrinsic rewards, which is combined with the extrinsic reward to help the agent learn a feasible policy. Then we use the meta-gradient to update this intrinsic reward model in order that the agent can achieve better performance. Experiments are given to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Occluded Pedestrian Attention Network : An occluded pedestrian Detector
abstract: Pedestrian detection performance improves greatly with the development of convolution neural network. However, occlusion remains a challenging issue. To solve the problem, in this paper, we proposed a new pedestrian detector called Occlude Pedestrian Attention Network (OPAN). We use anchor settings, which will highlight the features from the pedestrian region. In addition, spatial-wise attention mechanism and channel-wise are used for regression and classification branch separately and guide the detector to pay more attention to the visible part of the pedestrian. Experiments on Caltech and CityPerson datasets show that the proposed algorithm has better performance than RetinaNet. Compared with RetinaNet, the performance is improved 10.65% and 8.44%. Compared with other latest pedestrian detection algorithms, the performance is also great.

articleTitle: Research on automatic conversion algorithm of plate-shaped parts CAD drawings to 3D models based on Revit
abstract: In order to visually display the construction process of the climbing frame of the building construction protection platform and enrich the content of the construction climbing frame part family, this paper proposes an algorithm for automatically turning over and building a family of plate-shaped climbing frame parts, which is used to generate 3D Autodesk Revit models from AutoCAD 2D drawings of various plate-type components of all-steel attached scaffolding, and form various part family files. In the Revit platform, identify the CAD drawings of the parts, extract the geometric element information such as closed polygons and arcs from the layers, analyze the coordinate position to obtain the closed curve and height of the bottom contour and the number of hole diameter positions, extend the bottom contour of the solid to the required height to obtain the external contour three-dimensional model, use hole information to form hole outline and extend the contour of the hole in a hollow way and use it to cut the external contour model, realize the 3D model building of plate-shaped parts and form plate-shaped part family files. This solution can be used to automatically build 3D models of plate-shaped parts with holes and without holes, improve the efficiency of plate-shaped parts reversal, and lay the foundation for subsequent 3D model building of composite parts. There is certain application value in the field of computer-aided building construction design.

articleTitle: Stability and Hopf Bifurcation of a Fractional Economic Model with Time Delay
abstract: In this paper, a fractional order economic model with time delay is proposed and its related dynamics is studied. We mainly study the equilibrium stability of the system and the existence of Hopf bifurcation. By taking the time delay as the bifurcation parameter and analysing the characteristic equation, we find that when the time delay exceeds a certain range, the system will lose stability. The results show the stability at the positive equilibrium point of the system depends on the critical value of time delay. Finally, the correctness of the theories obtained are verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A novel Method for Solving the Uncertain Run-time Assembly Line Balancing Problem via the Improved Branch and Bound Method
abstract: Assembly line balance is an important issue in the production systems and is consist of many sub problems. The problem of the uncertainty operation time is the significant one, which actually exists but is rarely mentioned in the current research literatures. This paper develops a novel algorithm to tackle the uncertain operation time in the assembly line. For the developed algorithm, the tasks are allocated to the different workstations regarding the uncertain operation time, firstly. Then the minimum number of workstations and the minimum idle time of each workstation is computed. With the difference from the current models, the concept of protection time is constructed so that the uncertain running time is sufficiently regarded and measured in the developed algorithm. As a result, the 4 governing rules and mechanism for determining upper and lower limitation is developed based on the branch and bound method. Finally, experiments on the benchmark data set verify the effectiveness of the developed algorithm.

articleTitle: Finite Time Tracking Control for USV with External Disturbance
abstract: This paper investigates the novel control scheme of robust nonlinear disturbance observer (RNDO) with backstepping technique for the tracking of the underactuated marine surface vehicle (USV). In order to enhance systems’ robustness, RNDO is designed to estimates external environment disturbance in finite-time. Furthermore, the finite time tracking controller is developed via nonsmooth backstepping technique incorporating the RNDO to achieve position tracking , yaw tracking and velocity tracking control. In order to solve the problem of "complexity explosion" in the traditional backstepping method, a nonlinear filter is introduced to generate the derivative of virtual control law. A Lyapunov-based stability analysis proves that the tracking error of USV can converge into a small neighborhood around zero in finite time.

articleTitle: Multi-Mode Autonomous Mission Planning Approach for Earth Observation Satellites
abstract: The autonomous mission planning method completes the arrangement and planning of imaging missions and data downlink missions on-board, thereby greatly improving the efficiency of the Earth Observation Satellite (EOS) for rapid response and convenient use. The existing mission planning methods of EOS generally use single mode, such as batch processing or periodic rolling planning which are difficult to handle changing conditions, emergency missions, and other complicated issues simultaneously. This paper proposes a multi-mode autonomous mission planning approach for EOS. The approach provides a collaborative scheduling mechanism for three planning modes, which include long-period mssion pre-planning mode, short-period rolling re-planning mode, and emergency mission dynamic planning mode. Finally, simulation results validates that the proposed method can plan missions considering the constraint conditions autonomously; re-plan the mission when the environment information has been changed; and plan the emergency missions on time.

articleTitle: Design of Non-fragile Tolerant Tracking Controller based on State Feedback Fault
abstract: The fault-tolerant follow-up controller on the basis of linear matrix inequality approach is researched aim at liner time systems. The export of the controlled systema track the export of the specific signal by means of the fault-tolerant tracking controller. Different from the existent researching works, in the scheme course of follow-up controller, we suppose that the follow-up controller has indeterminate noise, namely, non-fragility. Therefore, the follow-up controller we designed has the capacity to resistance interior noise. At the same time, the fault-tolerant control problem when the state variable signal fails is considered, and the tracking control performance can be guaranteed when the state signal feedback fails. Using H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> theory and Lyapunov theory for stable analysis. The solved conditions of the error-resilient tracking controller was researched in the form of linear matrix inequality approach, and gain parameters of controller can be directly solved through the LMIs tools box. Finally, the effectiveness of designed non-fragility fault-tolerant follow-up control unit is evidenced by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Motion Planning and Tracking Control of Space Underactuated Manipulator via Intelligent Algorithm
abstract: This paper presents a motion planning and tracking control strategy via intelligent algorithm for the space Pendubot. Such system consists of two sub-systems with first active joint: the planar Pendubot and vertical Pendubot. Based on the structural characteristic of the above systems, the control objective is to move the endpoints of the two subsystems to the same target position simultaneously. First, we build a unified dynamical model for the space Pendubot. Then combined with the control objective of two sub-systems, we plan the feasible trajectory for active links. The feasible trajectory includes two parts: the active link is moved to the target states along the first-part trajectory; the second-part trajectory containing the parameters have the same states as the first-part trajectory, and the underactuated link is indirectly controlled by adjusting the parameters. Furthermore, we employ the differential evolution algorithm (DEA) to get the optimized trajectory parameters, so controlling all links to the target states simultaneously. In this way, the control objective of the space Pendubot is realized. Simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed stratagy.

articleTitle: Visual speed measurement algorithm based on the features of subway platform screen door
abstract: In view of the phenomenon that track braking is prone to wear and idling, which affects the hardware speed measuring equipment of the train system itself. On the basis of image processing technology, a train visual speed measurement algorithm based on the characteristics of subway platform screen door is proposed, which forms external feedback with the subway's own speed measurement equipment to measure and monitor the subway. Firstly, the continuous image sequence is obtained by imagization of the incoming video, and then the continuous time series image is binarized by OTSU algorithm. Then, the characteristics of image changes in the process of train operation are analyzed, and the gray histogram of the whole image and the gray histogram of feature area are analyzed. The shielded door area of subway platform is selected as the area of interest for the identification of train door features. The number of white pixels in the binarization image of the shielded door area is counted. It can well distinguish the image features of door features, window features and car features when they pass through the region of interest, and record the time series frames of door passing to calculate the frame difference between adjacent door frames. Finally, according to the detected door frames, the frame difference and door distance are obtained to calculate the arrival speed of the train. Some platforms of Zhengzhou Metro Line 3 are tested with this method. Through analysis and calculation, the average speed of the train from the 1st door to the 11th door passing through the designated position is 11.86m/s, 9.87m/s, 8.74m/s, 8.53m/s, 8.39m/s, 6.71m/s, 5.89m/s, 5.11m/s, 4.27m/s, 1.79m/s respectively. This shows that the method can be used independently of the train control system to measure the speed of subway train entrance and form feedback with the train's own speed measurement system.

articleTitle: Image denoising with heterogeneous low rank matrix factorization
abstract: Low rank matrix factorization (LRMF) is an important research direction in computer vision. It can learn low dimensional subspace from high dimensional data. LRMF is mostly constructed by L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> loss function and L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> loss function in optimization problems. And whether LRMF is constructed by L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> loss function or L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> loss function, it is important to describe the noise in the dataset. In order to describe the noise in the dataset well, this paper describes the noise from a pixel-level perspective to construct LRMF. Considering that there maybe uneven light intensity and differences in light reflection intensity between different parts of each picture in the dataset, this paper assumes that all noise in the image dataset is heterogeneous. Based on this assumption, this paper describes the noise in the dataset by the Student-t distributions with different parameters, and constructs two hierarchical Bayesian models, and deduces all the parameters of the models design through variational Bayesian inference. It not only improves the calculation accuracy of the LRMF, but also improves the calculation speed of the model to a certain extent. A large number of experiments on face reconstruction and medical image denoising prove the superiority of the methods.

articleTitle: Neighborhood decomposition based variable neighborhood search for the capacitated p-median problem
abstract: Capacitated p-median problem (CPMP) is a combinatorial optimization problem with several applications. In this article, we propose an efficient heuristic approach called the neighborhood decomposition based variable neighborhood search (NDVNS) algorithm for the CPMP. The proposed algorithm combines an efficient variable neighborhood search method and an neighborhood decomposition strategy. Experimental results on 3 sets of benchmark instances show that the proposed NDVNS algorithm performs well on the small-scale instances compared to some existing algorithms in the literature. In particular, the proposed algorithm is able to obtain the best known solution for all the tested instances in a short computational time.

articleTitle: Line of the Sight Cone Artificial Repulsion Force Method for Autonomous Obstacle Avoidance in Space under the Model Predictive and Inversive Control Guidance
abstract: Aiming at the obstacle avoidance problem in the process of the space rendezvous, docking and relative guidance, analysis and compare with the main methods and ways of the autonomous path planning and the obstacle avoidance in motion. Based on the image profile of the obstacle under the spacecraft relative navigation field of view, building dynamically the space obstacle line of sight cone model in real time; Under the condition of the spacecraft’s velocity vector point to the inside of the line of the sight cone, we design an artificial exclusion potential field which is perpendicular to the velocity vector and push the velocity vector away from the line of the sight cone. Combined with the model predictive and inversive control guidance, we propose a method which is combined with the model predictive and inversive control guidance and the line of the sight cone artificial repulsion field. The simulation result indicates that the method we proposed can avoid the traditional artificial repulsion field method ’s problem, which include the crossing obstacle space, bounces and oscillates around the obstacle space and fly around the distance. This method can better avoid the spacecraft fall into a local stabilization point, effective implementation autonomous avoidance of the space obstacles.

articleTitle: Fast Calculation of Cross Ambiguity Function for Passive Radar Based on SMGO
abstract: For passive radar system, the distance and speed of target can be determined by locating the peak of cross ambiguity function between the reference signal and the echo signal. However, the calculation of cross ambiguity function is expensive so that signal processing in real-time for passive radar system is challenging. To solve this problem, conventional traversal methods are mainly dedicated to reducing the calculation expense of cross ambiguity function. This paper proposes to utilize the Set Membership Global Optimal algorithm to reduce the evaluation number of cross ambiguity function needed for peak search. Then, the computational burden for determining the distance and speed of target is further lessened by combining the optimization method proposed and the conventional traversal methods. Feasibility and efficiency of this method are verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Switch Type Series Compensation of Distribution Network
abstract: Due to the relatively small population density of the 10kV and 35kV rural power grids and the 35kV high-voltage power grids in most parts of Northwest, Inner Mongolia and Northeast China, the power load is relatively scattered and fluctuates, and long-distance power transmission is common. The resulting voltage quality problem at the end of the load is serious, especially when the heavy load starts and stops, the voltage fluctuation problem is particularly prominent. At present, to solve this problem, most of the parallel compensation measures are adopted, and the effect is extremely limited. However, the conventional series compensation device has a good effect, due to the complexity of the technology, the high price and the bulky volume, it cannot be widely promoted and applied in the 10kV-110kV power grid. State Grid Inner Mongolia Eastern Electric Power Company is located in the northeast, and the above-mentioned voltage problems of the 10kV-35kV power grid are prominent. State Grid Inner Mongolia Eastern Electric Power Company organized relevant departments and experts to conduct extensive investigations. It is understood that the current fast vacuum circuit breaker developed based on fast eddy current drive technology can achieve a closing time of about 10ms, and the opening time can be controlled within 5ms, and the use of high-energy capacity zinc oxide groups has been widely used in China. If fast vacuum circuit breakers and high-energy capacity zinc oxide are used in high and medium voltage series compensation devices, the problems of large area, complex equipment structure and high cost of series compensation devices will be solved.

articleTitle: Deep Place Recognition for 3D LiDAR Point Cloud with Transformer
abstract: 3D point cloud-based place recognition has gotten more attention since 3D LiDAR sensors are widely used for robotic applications and autonomous driving. Most of the existing deep point cloud-based methods take a few regular number points or image-like formats as inputs which are inability to make full use of point clouds’ geometric information. This paper proposes a novel place recognition approach that is flexible and effective to handle diverse numbers of 3D LiDAR point clouds in large-scale environments. The approach is composed of feature extraction and a global descriptor encoding. The feature extraction consumes the 3D LiDAR point cloud with KPConv that can extract features efficiently and flexibly. Before the global descriptor encoding, a transformer module is employed to aggregate the contextual information that exploits the relationship of all features. The NetVLAD layer encodes the features into a global descriptor for recognizing a similar place rapidly. The proposed approach is evaluated on the KITTI odometry dataset, which demonstrates the validity of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Multi-Convolutional Neural Network Framework For Network Connectivity Robustness Prediction
abstract: Connectivity robustness reflects the ability of a complex network maintaining its basic connected structures and functions under various external attacks. Conventionally, connectivity robustness is evaluated by simulating attacks, which may take expensive computational resources, especially for large-scale networked systems. Past studies have shown that convolution neural networks (CNN) have excellent performance in both regression and classification. Complex networks are transformed into grey images and processed by CNNs. In this paper, a multi-CNN framework is come out to predict the connectivity robustness, where each CNN performs either network classification or robustness prediction. Experimental studies are carried on four network topologies under random and targeted attacks. The simulations results shows that the proposed multi-CNN approach can precisely predict the connectivity robustness of complex networks. Further experiments also shows that multi-CNN performs better than single CNN method.

articleTitle: Network Topologies of Multi-agent Systems: An Overview
abstract: Multi-agent systems (MASs) have obtained extensive attention due to its practical adhibitions, namely, sensor networks, urban traffic and environmental monitoring, etc. Not only that, the related network topology has also been widely concerned by researchers, since the information transfer among agents completely depends on these topologies. This paper reviews some network topologies involved in the research of MASs and summarizes recent relevant progress and practical applications. Firstly, three special topologies and several general topologies are reviewed, meanwhile, the characteristics of these are delineated and compared from several perspectives, namely, the adjacency matrix, the Laplacian matrix and its eigenvalues. Moreover, in order to better comprehend the research situation of network topology, some recent progress related to the consensus problem of MASs under different topologies are reviewed. Moreover, for highlighting the practicability of network topology, this paper also concludes with a summary of practical applications of different topologies in many areas. After the review, a promising research issue is proposed.

articleTitle: Stabilization of discrete time stochastic linear systems with time delay via event-triggered control
abstract: This paper presents the stabilization problem of a class of discrete-time stochastic linear systems with time delay using an event-triggered control(ETC) strategy. For the general linear systems, we propose a new event triggering mechanism and deduce sufficient conditions for mean square exponentially stabilizability(MSES) and almost sure exponentially stabilizability(ASES) via ETC. The results show that the stability of the system depends on the system parameters (time delay, noise, event trigger threshold parameter, and unstable characteristic value of the original system). When the feedback control is disturbed by low-intensity noise, the unstable system can be stable in the mean square. Finally, the validity of the theoretical results is illustrated through a simulation example.

Author Keywords: mean square and almost sure stabilizability

articleTitle: Optimal Safety Problems Allocation by PSO Algorithm in China Railway Bureau
abstract: For the sake of solving the existing safety problems, this paper utilizes the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to allocate and divide the problems into different safety supervisors in railway bureau. Firstly, some basic concepts in optimal safety allocation problem are given in this paper. Secondly, objective functions and constraints on optimal safety allocation problem are introduced and the corresponding mathematical model is based on the node set and the edge set. Thirdly, the PSO algorithm with bounds is provided to solve the optimal safety allocation problem. Finally, simulation results show that the PSO algorithm with bounds can effectively solve the safety allocation problem when the number of safety problems is equal to 30 and the number of safety supervisors is 3 and 4, respectively.

articleTitle: Dynamic Event-Triggered Algorithm for Average Consensus of Networked Multiagent Systems
abstract: Average consensus(AC) problem of networked multi-agent systems(MASs) with limited communication bandwidth is dealt with. A sample-based dynamic event-triggered(ET) algorithm is designed to save communication resources of agents and reduce controllers’ update frequency and achieve the exponential convergence to the average consensus value. A dynamic variable related to agents’ states is designed in the ET function which can enlarge the time interval of consecutive ET instants and reduce computing and communication burdens. Since the sampling control mechanism is employed in our algorithm, Zeno behavior can be naturally excluded. Furthermore, only periodical detection of ET function is required such that the algorithm can be easily implemented in the actual systems. Our results are validated via numerical simulations.

articleTitle: An improved cellular automata model of traffic flow with look-ahead potential1
abstract: This paper presents an improved automata model for traffic flow based upon models for cellular automata and traffic flow. The proposed model is concerned with the headway and multiple velocities. The proposed model enforces the stochastic rules for moving a car on the basis of traffic in front of it. Rules for updating the velocity of car relies upon the location of the car as well as front traffic and their velocities. In particular, by using numerical simulations, the model proposed in this study can reach the steady-state more quickly for random perturbations.

articleTitle: Video Moving Object Detection Technology Based on Deep Learning
abstract: In the field of computer vision, video intelligent recognition technology is still a research difficulty. With the improvement of power grid automation, video monitoring system has been widely used in power grid. In power application scenarios, real-time monitoring of the scene and equipment can make the power grid truly unattended and make the power grid operation more secure. In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of power scene video intelligent recognition and improve the real-time performance of video processing, a video moving target detection technology based on lightweight convolutional neural network is proposed. Firstly, the image preprocessing technology is used to process the collected image, so as to filter the interference of background and other factors on device recognition; Then, a lightweight convolutional neural network structure mobilenet is designed as the feature extraction module of the target detector; Then, the multi-target detection algorithm based on R-FCN is used to locate the inspection equipment; Finally, the deep neural network compression technology based on network sharing and quantization is used to compress the target detection model to reduce its memory occupation, so as to improve the real-time performance of target detection. The experimental results show that the method can accurately locate and recognize the moving target in the video, and can be applied to the intelligent recognition task in the power scene.

articleTitle: A Selective Harmonic Extraction Method Based on Recursive Generalized Delayed Signal Superposition
abstract: It is essential to provide continuous power supply services with high power quality in the power grid. Active power filters (APF) are conventionally utilized to improve the power quality by performing harmonic currents and reactive-power compensation in power systems. However, the APF can not operate stably under the condition that the compensating current exceeds its rated capacity. In order to improve the compensation performance and dynamic response of threephase active power filter, an improved selective harmonic detection method based on recursive generalized delayed signal superposition (RGDSS) operators is proposed. The proposed method can reject the odd-order harmonic currents, and its dynamic response during transients takes half a fundamental time-period. Compared with GDSS, RGDSS can reduce system complexity, computation effort and storage memory overhead. Simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Flexible Quality Inspection Robot System for Multi-type Surface Defects
abstract: Automatic defect detection is an essential part of quality inspection in industrial production. It can improve the effectiveness and reduce the cost for labor. Most of the detection systems are designed for specific tasks and they usually could not adapt to multiple types of objects simultaneously. In this paper, a general and flexible defect detection system is established for multi-type surface defects, it can achieve defect detection tasks for complex 3-dementional surface with different types and material, which has a precision of 95.3% and recall of 96.2%. A database of surface defects is also built to help the system to manage the data, recognize unknown defects and analyze the possible problems in the production line.

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Driving System of Geothermal Regenerating Units for Expressways Asphalt Pavement Based on Multi-agent
abstract: Based on the theory of multi-agent system, a formation unmanned driving system for geothermal regenerating units on expressways asphalt pavement (GRU-EAP) is proposed in view of the existing problems such as low operating accuracy, high energy consumption and poor construction environment. Through PID trajectory tracking control and fuzzy + acceleration feedforward PD (FAFPD) control, five construction vehicles formation unmanned driving is realized. It has been successfully applied in the construction of Tai-Xin Expressway K38-K58 and Beijing-Shanghai Expressway K422-K476 sections. The horizontal control precision is ±5cm, and the longitudinal control precision is ±20cm, which meets requirements of geothermal regeneration construction technology.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation Algorithm of Gravity Sensor Considering Scale Factor Asymmetry
abstract: The existing linear calibration scheme of inertial navigation system accelerometer only calibrates the bias, calibration factor and installation error of gyro and accelerometer, but does not study the system error of scale factor asymmetry term of inertial device accelerometer in dynamic environment. In this paper, data mining is carried out on the basis of a large number of airborne, marine and land-based gravity measurement data accumulated by experiments. Under the condition of gyroscopic measurement, by introducing the model of scale factor asymmetry term, the parameter two-step iterative method is carried out to calibrate the scale factor asymmetry term coefficient of gravimeter accelerometer. The calibration effect is verified by gravity residual experiment, and the experimental results prove its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Multi adaptive semi-supervised learning based on Evidence Theory
abstract: Semi-supervised classification(SSC) trains few labeled samples and a great many of unlabeled samples to obtain a good classification model. Graph semi-supervised learning is one of the main research directions of SSC. It uses unlabeled samples and the few limited labeled samples to build a more reliable graph model and spreads the label information on the graph model. However, the traditional graph semi-supervised learning algorithms are time-consuming and can not well reflect the underlying data distribution of high-dimensional data. To deal with these problems, we propose an Multi adaptive semi-supervised learning based on Evidence Theory (MASSL). MASSL uses some multiple feature subspaces of original data to train different adaptive semi-supervised learning models, and uses Fuzzy Cautious ordered weighted average reasoning method and Evidence theory to combine the different results to obtain a better recognition effect. Experimental results show that the proposed approach can effectively exploit unlabeled data and perform better compared with prevailing related approaches.

articleTitle: Method of Feature Selection via the Feature Ensemble Clustering and Selecting
abstract: Clustering the feature into clusters and selecting the representative features from the clusters is often used in the method of feature selection. However, the current clustering ensembles cannot reduce the effects of certain base clustering, which would degrade the accuracy of the final result, and the feature information and redundancy between features are not fully considered for the existing method. The method of feature selection via the feature ensemble clustering and selecting is constructed to tackle the challenge. The ensemble clustering with adaptive weighted adjustment is developed to reduce the impact of the noise on the clustering ensemble, and centrality-entropy score is provided to help selecting the representative features in the obtained cluster. Extensive experiments on real data set are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness and the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of nonlinear singular time-delay systems based on Hamiltonian functional method
abstract: In this paper, the problem of stability analysis for a class of general nonlinear singular time-delay systems is studied by using Hamiltonian functional method. Firstly, the equivalent singular delay Hamiltonian form of the original system is established by using the Hamiltonian implementation method. Then, based on the equivalent Hamiltonian form and strict equivalent method of the system, the singular delay Hamiltonian system is transformed into a singular delay Hamiltonian differential algebraic form, and an appropriate Lyapunov function is constructed to analyze the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Wafer Map Defect Recognition Based on Improved 2DPCA Method
abstract: The effective recognition of the wafer map defect patterns is of vital importance to ensure the high product quality the wafer manufacturing process. The present Two- Dimensional Principal Component Analysis (2DPCA) based wafer map defect recognition methods only consider the overall information of defect maps, and ignore the hidden between-class information. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved 2DPCA called Weighted-Class 2DPCA (WC2DPCA) method to recognize the defect pattern of the wafer maps. The WC2DPCA method considers the information of the classes in the feature subspace of 2DPCA, and designs the weights for representing the relationship between the classes in the feature subspace. The wafer maps projections on the feature subspace not only have common information in the same patterns of wafer maps defects, but also have the discriminant information between different wafer maps defect patterns. Experimental results on the benchmark WM-811K data set demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed WC2DPCA method in wafer map defect recognition.

articleTitle: Non-fragile state estimation for Markov jump systems by event-triggered scheme
abstract: This article focus on the non-fragile dissipative state estimator design issue for delayed Markov jump systems(MJSs). The event-triggered scheme is employed to alleviate the network bandwidth resource. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, a state estimator is established, which guarantees the estimation error system is stochastically stable with dissipative. Then, the simulate results are presented to demonstrate the validness of the proposed state estimator design method.

articleTitle: Surface Vortex Image Segmentation in KR Desulfurization Based on Improved SegNet Model
abstract: In the process of hot metal KR desulfurization stirring, the visible length of the agitator blade exposed in the vortex on the liquid surface can reflect the mixing and dispersion effect of desulfurizer. Therefore, the Surface vortex information o is of great significance to the desulfurization control parameters setting. In this paper, an improved SegNet model is proposed. Based on the SegNet network model, the encoder of the network is replaced with a lightweight network structure, and the deep separable convolution is used to replace the conventional convolution, so that the model is simplified and the number of parameters is greatly reduced. The activation function in the network is modified to Mish function to strengthen the feature extraction ability of the network. The experimental results show that, on the established KR desulfurization liquid surface vortex image data set, the processing speed of the trained model reaches 49ms per frame. The segmentation mean pixel accuracy of KR liquid surface vortex image reaches 98.97%. And the mean Intersection over Union(mIoU) reaches 98.23%. Compared with the SegNet network model, the segmentation accuracy and rapidness of the proposed model are improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research of Airborne Radome Electrical Thickness Measurement System Control Algorithms
abstract: The Airborne Radome Electrical Thickness Measurement System (ARETMS) is designed to detect the electric thickness of the radome with irregular complex rotation. The ARETMS contains vertical lifting axis. The system uses the double horn transmission method in the measurement process. The digital and analog files of airborne radome are processed by discretization. The ARETMS transforms the three-dimensional coordinates into the coordinates of the five-axis machine tool through coordinate transformation and projection. In this study, the system establishes a virtual axis, which keeps correlation with five real axes to work synchronously. The ARETMS improved the accuracy and efficiency of radome electrical thickness measurement greatly, and figured out the nonconforming area which could help to fix the radome.

articleTitle: Real-time Walking Speed Estimation by Involving Phase Variables based on Deep Learning
abstract: Lower limb prothesis is neccessary in daily avtivities for unilateral transfemoral amputees and gait analysis plays an important role in user-friendly knee-ankle prothesis research. Walking speed is recognized as an important feature that influences joint trajectories, the estimation of which is vitual to guarantee walking fluency and symmetry. In this paper, walking speed is estimated in real-time by involving phase variable and radius as the inputs of deep learning network. Virtual Constraint control algorithm is used to generate prosthetic joints trajectories as functions of phase variable through the entire gait by collecting thigh angle from an Inerial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor mounted on the thigh. Besides, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network is applied to train the estimation model. In consideration of the tight relationship between walking speed and phase plane curves, this research utilizes horizontal and vertical coordinates, variable and phase radius as the inputs of deep learning network instead of directly using raw sensors data. The simulation experiments proved that this algorithm could estimate the speed effectively, and be more accuate than using raw sensors data.

articleTitle: A Reduced-Order Protocol for Bipartite Consensus of Linear Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a new reduced-order dynamic output-feedback protocol to solve the bipartite consensus problem of homogeneous linear multi-agent systems. Necessary and sufficient conditions for the solvability of the bipartite consensus problem are derived and the consensus state trajectories are obtained in an explicit form. Compared with existing results, the novelties of the proposed protocol are two-fold: Firstly, the protocol relies on relative output information of agents within each group and secondly, the protocol state ultimately converges to zero if bipartite consensus is reached. Furthermore, a numerical example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed protocol.

articleTitle: Adaptive Visual Control of Robotic Manipulator With Uncertainties in Kinematics and Dynamics
abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel adaptive scheme for uncalibrated visual feedback systems of robotic manipulators to address the uncertainties in the kinematics and dynamics, which resulted from unknown parameters in the camera and the robotic manipulator’s physical model. A mixed estimated method is adopted to parameterize and estimate those unknown parameters in a practical model. To ensure the capability of the introduced controller, we claim novel adaptive algorithms to make the estimated errors of those unknown parameters converge to a small range. Numerical simulations confirm the validity of the presented scheme, whose image tracking error converges asymptotically towards zero via the Lyapunov method.

articleTitle: Research on fault location of active distribution network considering multi - source information
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of the fault location method based on the traditional particle swarm algorithm in terms of slow calculation speed and low accuracy, a particle swarm algorithm with multi-source information is proposed. Firstly, on the basis of the original algorithm, the time-varying inertia weight factor is introduced to reflect the number of iterations and the weight factor for adjustment, and the screening mechanism is added to reiterate the high fitness particles to avoid falling into local optimum. Considering the problem of low fault tolerance rate of feeder unit information, the user unit information is used as redundant information, and the D-S evidence theory is used to fuse evidence, so that the distribution network fault can be accurately and quickly located. Finally, the effectiveness is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Reference Database Expansion for Deep Belief Network based CSI Device-Free Localization
abstract: Device-free localization (DFL) based on Channel State Information (CSI) has received widespread attention for its non-invasiveness and easy deployment as a new indoor localization technology. The machine learning is one of the main research methods for DFL, while it constructs a fine-grained reference database laboriously. In this paper, we propose a CSI reference database expansion approach based on Kriging Interpolation to address the problem. Concretely, we collect CSI amplitude of specific locations, then estimate all sub-carriers information for other locations through Kriging Interpolation to expand database, and finally use Deep Belief Networks (DBN) as the localization model. The experiment is carried out in real environment. The experiment result verifies the proposed approach addresses the difficulty of insufficient database and collecting data for a long time efficiently, as well as improves the localization accuracy.

articleTitle: A Discontinuous Controller Design for Distributed Optimization of Uncertain Euler-Lagrange Systems
abstract: This paper aims to study a class of distributed optimization problem of Euler-Lagrange (EL) systems with uncertainties. Assume that each EL agent can only obtain position-dependent gradient value of private local cost function and relative position with adjacent agents. We propose a class of discontinuous distributed controllers to force the position of each EL agent to the optimal solution to a total cost function exponentially, which can be analyzed by composite Lyapunov function. The theoretical result is illustrated by an example of radio eavesdrop.

articleTitle: Alarm deadband design based on the reliable distribution estimation of alarm deviations
abstract: Deadbands are widely used in industrial alarm systems to decrease nuisance alarms as much as possible. This paper proposed a way to design deadband widths based on alarm deviations. A key technical issue is to determine an appropriate sample size of alarm deviations, in order to yield a reliable estimation of the probability distribution of alarm deviations. This issue is resolved via Bayesian estimation theory, and an optimal deadband width is designed by exploiting historical data samples in normal operating conditions. Industrial examples are provided to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Torque Distribution Towards Power Saving for Distributed-driven Electric Vehicles
abstract: This paper presents an optimal torque allocation strategy for distributed-driven electric vehicles based on linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) strategy and neural network. A hierarchical control structure is adopted to coordinate the control effort of each part, using a steady-state single-track model to interpret driver’s intention, a closed-loop controller to stabilize yaw motion, and a control allocator to achieve the minimum power consumption of in-wheel motors. LADRC is selected as the yaw rate controller to generate the desired direct yaw moment for the pursuit of excellent control accuracy and strong anti-disturbance performance, while the optimization method is introduced to solve the control allocation problem for the redundantly actuated system. Considering the real-time operation demand, we choose NN to fit the optimal solution based on the off-line data obtained through stochastic pre-training and Co-simulations of Matlab/Simulink and CarSim using experience-replay and soft-update training tricks. HIL experiment verifies the feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Stable Grasping Control of Three-finger Manipulator based on Sliding Detection
abstract: Robots need tactile sensors for sliding detection when achieving a hand-like grasping. In this paper, the tactile array sensor is installed on the fingers of the three-finger manipulator, and the contact force is collected during the grasping process. The contact force is transformed by Wavelet Transformation to obtain the detail coefficient. According to the analysis results, the sliding detection is carried out. On this basis, a stable grasping control strategy that can restrain sliding is proposed, and the experiments are carried out on it. Experiments show that the adopted sliding detection method can detect whether the object is sliding or not, and the proposed control strategy can adjust the grasping force of the finger after the sliding is detected, which improves the stability of grasping.

articleTitle: Switching control for spacecraft body-fixed hovering to tumbling target by using second order sliding mode
abstract: In consideration of the on/off operational mode of jet thruster, the relative orbit control problem of spacecraft hovering to tumbling target in target’s body-fixed frame is discussed. By utilizing the discontinuous nature of sliding mode control (SMC) method, a second order SMC law is designed to tackle the uncertain system dynamics and external disturbance. Based on the homogeneous criteria of high order sliding mode (HOSM), the sufficient conditions of control parameters are given to guarantee the finite time stability. Finally, numerical simulations about spacecraft hovering to tumbling target are carried out to verify the performance with developed switching control algorithm.

articleTitle: Improvement of Distance Judgment Based on Wolf Pack Algorithm
abstract: The original wolf pack algorithm has two distances to compare and determine whether ferocious wolf participates in the siege behavior. In order to improve the accuracy of optimization, a new distance is described as the approaching siege distance by expanding a certain range. An equation for calculating the approaching siege distance is given, and the distance between ferocious wolf and the head wolf is specified if ferocious wolf reach the approaching siege distance, which is able to participate in the siege behavior. Furthermore, on the basis of proposing the approaching siege distance, three step weights are introduced to make the step lengths of the three intelligent behaviors change in the iterative optimization and also improve convergence accuracy. Finally, through 5 standard test functions and a problem of optimal processing time in Job-shop Scheduling, the results are compared with the original wolf pack algorithm, and the effectiveness of the improved wolf pack algorithm is verified and the accuracy of optimization is increased by 1 to 3 orders in magnitude.

articleTitle: Control of Raw Materials Releasing for a Manufacturing System with Product Quality Downgrade
abstract: In some manufacturing systems, when raw materials of higher quality product are released into the system, the quality of a small part of finished goods is likely to be downgraded because of some random factors like machine failure. To improve the service level of products with different quality levels and minimize the average production cost, the releasing of raw materials for products with various quality levels should be well controlled. In this research, we construct the mathematical model of raw materials releasing control problem for manufacturing systems with quality downgrade. A hedging point control policy is proposed for this problem, and the structural characteristics of this policy are revealed by solving the linear programming problem. The control policy can drive the system state to the hedging point effectively. Furthermore, numerical experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed policy and the impact of the hedging point on the average production cost.

articleTitle: Some counterexamples on the non-existence of period solution, solution equivalence and finite-time stable equilibria for fractional order systems
abstract: Fractional order system, as a generalization of the classical integer order system, has attracted increasing attention during the past several decades, due to its prominent advantages. In recent literatures, some strange properties are reported, such as i) the existence of non-constant periodic solutions in fractional order systems is impossible; ii) there does not exist an integer order system whose solution is equivalent to that of fractional order systems and iii) the equilibrium of fractional order systems cannot be finite-time stable. Our investigation clearly shows that the three mentioned properties are not really non-existent. These mistakes are demonstrated by counterexamples.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Early Warning of Wind Turbine Pitch System based on Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network
abstract: To reduce the downtime of wind turbine caused by the fault of pitch system that usually has a high failure rate, a fault early warning method based on long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network is proposed. According to the operation characteristics of the pitch system, monitoring parameters recorded by SCADA, such as wind speed, generator speed, rotor speed, wind direction, pitch angle and output power, are utilized to establish the fault early warning model. Compared with the model based on BP neural network, the prediction accuracy of the LSTM model is effectively improved. The weights and thresholds of the LSTM neural network are optimized, and a reasonable threshold is set to determine the fault early warning criterion for the pitch system. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, the LSTM model is applied to the fault early warning for a 1.5MW wind turbine pitch system. The results show that the LSTM model can give early warning about two and a half days before the fault occurs, verifying the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Flight Vehicles Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: A control strategy for flight vehicles with input uncertainty and unknow external disturbance based on intelligent active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is investigated in this paper. Firstly, a longitudinal short period model of flight vehicle with input uncertainty and unknown external disturbances is formulated, then the state feedback controller is proposed for the system based on ADRC. The extended state observer (ESO) is proposed to estimate and compensate the external disturbance and uncertainties. Lyapunov functional method is introduced to demonstrate the stability and robustness of closed-loop system. To improve the transient performance and simplify the design process, deep reinforcement learning is proposed to optimize the parameters of controller and filter. The feasibility of the proposed technique is further specifies based on numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: High-Resolution representation object pose estimation from monocular images
abstract: This paper addresses the 6D challenge of monocular 6D pose estimation on small targets and weak texture objects. We propose a monocular object pose estimation algorithm, High Resolution Object Pose Estimation (HRPE) based on the high-resolution feature representation, which detects the 2D keypoints and uses the Perspective-n-Point (PnP) algorithm to compute the 6D pose. HRPE can maintain high-resolution feature representation through parallel convolution of multi-resolution feature branches and repeated cross-scale fusion, generating more precise pose estimation. Experimental results show that HRPE surpasses the existing state-of-the-arts, and achieves a significant accuracy improvement for small objects, which demonstrates the effectiveness of high-resolution feature representation on pose estimation.

articleTitle: Passivity-based One-cycle Control of Swiss Rectifier in Electric Vehicle Battery Chargers
abstract: With the widespread use of electric vehicles (EVs), the development of high-quality and efficient battery chargers has become the last mile problem. This paper describes a high-performance control scheme for the Swiss rectifier (SR) in EV battery chargers, named passivity-based one-cycle control (POCC). By combining passivity-based control (PBC) and one-cycle control (OCC), the range of sampling error for the SR’s output current is strictly limited, and improve the reliability of battery charging. Thus, the qualities of input-output currents can be improved, simultaneously. Besides, compared with the classic dual closed-loop PI control (DCLPIC), the proposed passivity-based one-cycle control method can further reduce the total harmonic distortion (THD) of the input current, thus decreases the rectifier’s negative feedback to the grid. Meanwhile, the amplitude of charging current ripple can be reduced to improve the reliability of battery charging. Lastly, simulation examples are applied to validate the proposed POCC method.

articleTitle: A new artificial bee colony for vehicle routing problem with drones
abstract: Truck-drone delivery is a hybrid one combining the advantages of both vehicles including large capacity of truck and high travel speed of drone together and leads to some generalized routing problems such as vehicle routing problem with drones (VRP-D). In this paper, VRP-D is addressed and a new artificial bee colony (ABC) is applied to minimize routing cost. Two bee swarms are produced and an effective evaluation process is used to determine employed bee swarm and onlooker bee swarm dynamically. Variable neighborhood descent is constructed by using 15 neighborhood structures and adopted in employed bee phase and onlooker bee phase in different ways. Computational results reveal that the proposed ABC can obtain better solutions than the compared algorithm and has promising advantages on VRP-D.

articleTitle: Design of an Access Control System Integrating Face Recognition with Temperature Measurement Based on K210
abstract: In the context of the epidemic, people are at the risk of being infected in public places due to the large number of people there. Taking temperature to see whether a person is "having a fever" is a common method for infection identification. A non-contact access control system integrating face recognition with temperature measurement can be easily applied to various temperature-taking occasions,while improving the security of access control. Combined with the WeChat mini program and Alibaba Cloud Internet of Things (IoT), the access control system is designed through hardware selection and software design. This system has such functions as real-time display of visitor’s information, face recognition, body temperature taking, and access control.

Author Keywords: Integrated face recognition and temperature measurement

articleTitle: An Efficient Protocol Conversion Mechanism Between Profinet Network and IPv6 Backhaul Network for Industrial Internet
abstract: With the rapid development of the Industrial Internet, the requirements for interconnection of heterogeneous industrial networks have increased. Thus, how to realize efficient protocol conversion between different industrial networks has become an important issue. This paper presents an efficient protocol conversion mechanism between Profinet network and Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) backhaul network, which implements data communication between the two heterogeneous networks via the basic conversion functions, and guarantees the quality of service (QoS) such as priority and periodicity. A test system is built, and the experimental results indicate that the proposed conversion mechanism can achieve the efficient interconnection between Profinet network and IPv6 backhaul network.

articleTitle: A flocking algorithm of multi-agent systems to optimize the configuration
abstract: Generally, the flocking algorithms with informed agents lead to the generations of the quasi α-lattice which are not so desired as the α-lattices in formation control of multi-agent systems (MASs). Therefore, a flocking algorithm is proposed to form an α-lattice with informed agents in this paper. Under the control of the designed algorithm, the informed agents are connecting to the virtual leader dynamically, which is the key of forming the α-lattice. More precisely, if there are other informed agents closer to the virtual leader in certain informed agent’s neighborhood, the connection between it and the virtual leader will be cut off.
