The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm for forming an α-lattice is comprehensive proved and validated by several numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Design of Fractional-order PID Controller for Path Tracking of Wheeled Mobile Robot
abstract: In this paper, a path tracking control scheme based on the fractional PID controller is proposed to solve the path tracking problem of differential drive wheeled mobile robot. The velocity-based kinematic dynamic model are established for the differential drive wheeled mobile robot first, and then the preliminaries of fractional calculus theory and particle swarm algorithm (PSO) are introduced. Moreover, a mobile robot path tracking control system based on the fractional PID controller is designed, the controller parameters are optimized through an improved PSO algorithm. The simulation results can verify the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Output Feedback Tracking Control for Second-Order Nonlinear Systems in Predefined Time
abstract: This paper investigates the tracking control problem for second-order nonlinear systems by output feedback. First, a novel predefined-time state observer is designed by introducing a time-varying scaling function. Then, a continuous predefined-time control law is presented with the help of the sliding mode control method. The proposed control law has no singularity problem and it can ensure the upper limit of the resulting convergent time can be predesignated without relying on initial conditions. Finally, a simulation example is carried out to testify the efficiency of the present control law.

articleTitle: A novel active inverse memristor emulator with improved low frequency feature
abstract: Based on several active elements, a modified inverse memristor emulator is proposed, which presents better performance than the previous emulators. The published inverse memristor emulators with active blocks show that lobes’ size of pinched hysteresis loops (PHLs) shrinks early with decreasing the applied frequency, while the new one can show good cyclic hysteresis phenomenon when low frequency signal is applied. Obviously, the lobes’ area of the improved inverse memristor emulator widens faster than the existed active models with increasing frequency in the low frequency range. And the circuit model just only includes two second generation current conveyor (CCII), one analog voltage multiplier and six passive elements.The improved emulator is demonstrated by implementing LTspice simulations and verified by experiments. A comparison between the proposed model and the representative current-controlled one highlights the superiority of the former in the lower frequency range.

articleTitle: Design of adaptive compliance control algorithm for upper limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot
abstract: In order to improve the compliance and accuracy of upper limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot system, this paper proposes an algorithm of adaptive compliance control combining admittance control and adaptive global fast terminal sliding mode control(AGFTSMC). Firstly, The exoskeleton platform and the control system consisting of the hardware system and software system are introduced. Secondly, The dynamic model and admittance control model of the robot system is established, and the adaptive global fast terminal sliding mode controller is designed. Thirdly, The stability of the system is proved by Lyapunov theory. Finally, the experiments of both passive mode and active mode are designed. The variation characteristics of trajectory tracking deviations, human-computer interaction forces and dynamic parameter estimation are compared and analyzed. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the adaptive compliance control algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dynamic Evolution and Station-Keeping of Starlink
abstract: In recent years, low-orbit Internet constellations such as Starlink and OneWeb have developed rapidly. Compared with traditional mid-to-high orbit navigation constellations, mega-constellations in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) show the characteristics of dense satellite distribution, and greater impact by perturbation, which leads to a higher risk of collisions within the constellation. Therefore, station-keeping is very important for mega-constellations. In this paper, a dynamic model combining the J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and the analytical solution of low-order atmospheric drag is established, and the phase evolution of co-orbiting satellites is simulated and analyzed. Based on the Two Line Elements (TLE) data of the Starlink, the control accuracy of its station-keeping is inverted and analyzed.

articleTitle: TD-GAT: Graph Neural Network for Fault Diagnosis Knowledge Graph
abstract: As an important resource for artificial intelligence applications, the ultimate goal of the knowledge graph (KG) is to make artificial intelligence smarter. In recent years, graph representation learning and graph neural networks are essential to the improvement and application of knowledge graph. In this paper, in order to solve the fault diagnosis problem of the system at runtime and realize the intelligent auxiliary decision-making of fault diagnosis, we introduce the knowledge graph technology. However, according to existing research, although some papers have used knowledge graphs in the field of fault diagnosis, they are only limited to use existing fault knowledge data to build knowledge graphs. therefore, this paper proposes a new method of knowledge graph embedding and knowledge reasoning for fault diagnosis knowledge graph, called TransD Graph Attention Network (TD-GAT). This model (TD-GAT) explicitly learns the entity representation of the knowledge graph in an end-to-end learning mode. Finally, this paper uses the fault entity classification task as an example to demonstrate the superiority of our model (TD-GAT) in the fault diagnosis knowledge graph we have established.

articleTitle: A Variable Step Sizes Perturb and Observe MPPT Method in PV System based on Flyback Converter
abstract: Aiming to track the maximum power point of photovoltaic power generation, a variety of strategies are proposed. The P&O method is a general and available policy, but traditional P&O strategy cannot track MPP quickly, accurately and stably. A variable step sizes P&O method is proposed to optimize the traditional P&O method. The background and working principle of MPPT and Flyback converter are introduced. The traditional P&O approach is critically considered, and a new variable step sizes P&O approach is presented. The simulation is carried out by Matlab/Simulink, and some curve results are obtained. The results of different sizes of steps and irradiation environments are analyzed. The results present that the variable step sizes P&O strategy could obtain MPP faster at lower oscillation rate at steady-state, and increase the efficiency and output of the renewable power generation based on solar photovoltaic.

articleTitle: Multi-AUV collaborative search for multiple targets in a dynamic obstacle environment
abstract: Aiming at the problem of dynamic obstacles encountered in the path of multi-AUV collaborative search for multiple targets under the two-dimensional grid map, a multi-AUV search algorithm based Glasius Bio-Inspired Neural Network (GBNN) is proposed. First, a two-dimensional grid map based on the AUV search environment is built, and a corresponding two-dimensional biologically inspired neural network model based on the two-dimensional grid map is realized. Each neuron in the neural network corresponds to each location unit of the grid maps one by one; Then, dynamic obstacles are introduced into the search path, and the AUV path is independently planned according to the activity output value of GBNN. Finally, the experiments show that the target search algorithm proposed in this article can not only avoid static obstacles in the raster map, but also avoid dynamic obstacles to search for multiple targets. It compares with the traditional biologically inspired neural network algorithm (BNN). In contrast, the algorithm has a shorter search path, shorter time-consuming, and stronger real-time performance.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Hydrodynamic Model of Ship Using EKF
abstract: The obtain of key parameters of MMG (Ship Manoeuvring Mathematical Model Group) model plays a key role in predicting the maneuvering motion and improving maneuverability of ship. To solve the problem of difficulty of traditional methods in obtaining model parameters, a method for identifying MMG model parameters based on Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, in order to improve the identification accuracy, the MMG model is approximated by the third-order difference method and transformed into the EKF model equation. Secondly, based on the fourth-order Runge- Kutta method, the Pseudo-Random Binary Sequence (PRBS) test data and the 1° right turning test data of the MMG model are obtained by simulation. Thirdly, during the identification process, batch identification and simulation data are used to identify the hydrodynamic coefficients of the MMG model; consequently, the parameter identification results are obtained and error analysis is performed. Finally, comparing different types of maneuvering motions between the original model and the identification model, it is verified that the identification model based on EKF shows good generalization ability and contributes to predict the ship motion well.

articleTitle: KC-PointNet: Attentional Network For 3D Point Cloud Processing
abstract: Point cloud analysis has always been a challenging problem mainly due to the orderless nature of point cloud. PointNet uses point-wise MLP to solve this problem and achieves impressive results. But one limitation of PointNet is that they treat all the points and all the feature channels equally, this is unreasonable since there are always some key points and key feature channels are crucial to recognizing the object which should be paid more attention to. In order to overcome these two shortcomings, we propose the Key-point and Channel Attention (KCA) module, a simple but effective plug-and-play attention module for point cloud processing. In this module, point wise attention learn to select the key points, while channel wise attention learn to select more distinctive feature channels, which will make our features more representative. Our KCA module is also lightweight which introduces minor computation efforts.We evaluated our method on the public benchmark ModelNet40 and verified its effectiveness in classification tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Single-stage Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Control Based on SSA Optimized LADRC
abstract: In a single-stage photovoltaic grid-connected control system based on a quasi-Z source inverter (qZSI), the current inner loop controller based on improved active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) is designed to improve robustness, and the parameters of LADRC are optimized by the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) to further improve performance. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional PI control, the LADRC algorithm based on SSA optimization has superior performance.

articleTitle: A formation control method of UAV Based on accelerated neural network
abstract: This paper studies the cooperative control of multi-UAV formation. Based on the traditional PID algorithm, a cooperative flight control method based on accelerating neural network is proposed. Firstly, aiming at the low efficiency of traditional PID control algorithm, a PID controller based on neural network is proposed to improve the control accuracy and stability of the algorithm. In order to solve the problem of slow convergence speed of neural network, the momentum term and gradient factor are introduced to improve the convergence speed of the network, which significantly improve UAV formation flight dynamic response. The UAV formation simulation results show that the algorithm can improve the convergence efficiency of the original algorithm and also has certain robustness.

articleTitle: IFFC Design of Armed Helicopters Based on Improved Non-monotone Trust Region Algorithm with Logarithmic Barrier Method
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of aiming attack in high maneuvering flight of armed helicopters, this paper proposes a new integrated fire/flight control system (IFFC) scheme of an armed helicopter based on an improved non-monotone trust region algorithm. Firstly, a scheme of the IFFC for unguided weapons is designed through the flight characteristics of the armed helicopter. Secondly, taking the continuously computed impact point (CCIP) aiming principle into consideration, the fire control calculation equations are obtained by using the vector diagram and the transformation relationships of various coordinate systems. Thirdly, substituting the values of the weapon line into the integrated fire/flight coupler and using the logarithmic barrier method to ensure the flight safety, the aiming error equations are proposed and solved through the improved non-monotone trust region algorithm. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Detection of False Data Injection Attack in smart grid based on iterative Kalman filter
abstract: Aiming at the difficulties on detection of false data injection attack (FDIA) in smart grid, a novel approach called state residual analysis which is based on iterated extended Kalman filter (IEKF) is explained in the article. Firstly, the classic power system is modeled and the principle of FDIA is analyzed. Then, the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF) is improved combined with the framework of Kalman filter as follows. By judging the approximation degree to the state of each iteration, the weighted statistical average method is designed to determine the new iteration value to update the state and measurement. After that, the state of the system is analyzed based on the above dynamic estimation algorithm IEKF. It is deduced that there is a change in the estimated state of the system which can be used as the criterion of attack detection due to the existence of covert FDIA. If the change exceeds the detection threshold, the system will be judged to be under attack. Finally, the standard IEEE-14bus test system is used for simulation experiments to confirm the approaches mentioned.

articleTitle: Super-twisting algorithm for second-order sliding mode control
abstract: In this paper, a prescribed-time super-twisting algorithm of second order sliding mode control is proposed, which makes the convergence time independent of the initial state and other parameters of the system. The designed SOSM is insensitive to external interference and has strong robustness. Then, the sliding mode controller of the first-order system is designed by using the algorithm, and its Lyapunov stability is proved. Finally, the effectiveness of the control method is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Large-scale Autonomous Navigation and Path Planning of Lunar Rover via Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Future lunar surface exploration needs to be carried out in areas with more complex terrain and richer scientific research value without prior information. Therefore, the patrol device needs to be able to autonomously detect terrain and obstacle avoidance when planning exploration tasks. However, Deep reinforcement learning has been successfully applied in various game-like environments, and it is a challenging task to apply deep reinforcement learning to the navigation and obstacle avoidance detection of the rover on lunar surface. We propose an autonomous decision-making method for lunar vehicle patrols based on deep reinforcement learning. The algorithm first uses lidar for simultaneous positioning and graphing. For the constructed static three-dimensional point cloud map of the lunar surface, it is described as a two-dimensional grid using octree-map projection The grid map is processed by the long-short time memory (LSTM) to process the two-dimensional grid obstacle information. Using dueling deep Q network (dueling DQN) with multi-step learning to train the planetary vehicle automatic path planning, and finally in the ROS static obstacle environment simulation verification experiment, the simulation results verify that the proposed method is effective and adaptable for the lunar rover in different terrain environments.

articleTitle: Analysis and circuit implementation of a new fourth-order multi-wing chaotic system based on memristors
abstract: In this paper, a new fourth-orders memristor chaotic system is obtained by introducing a smooth memristor model as the feedback term based on the modified three-orders chaotic system. The system can generate double-wing, four-wing chaos or hyperchaos for different parameters and initial conditions. Through the analysis of Lyapunov exponent and other dynamics, we can see that the system has complex chaotic, hyperchaotic, and continuous chaotic. Other dynamical behaviors such as multi-stability and extreme multi-stability are found by comparing phase and bifurcation diagrams, and equilibrium point calculations. Finally, the chaotic behavior is successfully verified by circuit simulation.

articleTitle: Path Planning Algorithms for USVs via Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: With the application of Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) in complex and changeable environments, therefore it is particularly significant to enhance its autonomous navigation ability. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is a emerging method that combines the perception ability of deep learning (DL) with the decision-making ability of reinforcement learning (RL). Since it was put forward, DRL has achieved remarkable results in theory and application. In addition, DRL has the ability of perception and decision-making simultaneously, and shows strong learning ability. Therefore, DRL algorithms can be applied to solve the path planning problem of USV. In this paper, pointing at solving the path planning problem of USV, the horizontal 3-DOF motion model of USV is established, and the DQN algorithm is applied to settle USV path planning problem. Finally, the above algorithm is verified on the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Path planning for ground target reconnaissance based on improved Astar algorithm
abstract: Aiming at solving the problems of complex and huge calculation and poor threats avoidance capabilities of UAVs carrying airborne reconnaissance equipment in ground targets tracking path planning, an improved Astar algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the improved Astar algorithm is combined with the track point extension method, and its evaluation function is improved based on traditional algorithms, so as to improve the real-time performance of the algorithm and reduce the amount of information stored in the algorithm. Secondly, add the threat cost to the heuristic function and assign weights. The simulation results show that the calculation of improved Astar algorithm is reduced and the planned path can avoid the threats well.

articleTitle: Analysis of Belief Propagation Based Cooperative Localization and Target Tracking Schemes
abstract: The target tracking is an fundamental ability for many oceanic applications, such as ocean surveillance, underwater rescue and etc. Due to the good mobility of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), they are the ideal devices to carry out the target tracking. However, their position accuracy severely affect the target tracking performance. Thus, in this paper, aiming at the problem of target tracking using multiple AUVs, we introduce two AUV cooperative localization and target tracking schemes. The two schemes are designed based on belief propagation and carry out the localization and tracking serially and in parallel, respectively. The features and differences of both schemes are compared and analyzed in detail. Moreover, their application prospects in underwater scenarios are discussed and further validated through simulations. As a result, two schemes have their own advantages in different situations and are suitable for multiple-AUV applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Parameter Decoupled Estimation for PMSM using Adaptive-Genetic-Algorithm
abstract: For permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSMs), because of the influence of environment, magnetic saturation and so on, the electrical parameters are inconstant and thus it is critical to accurately identify these parameters. This paper proposes an effective PMSMs parameter estimation method to improve the identification accuracy and anti-interference ability. Specifically, this paper considers the influence of the voltage-source inverter (VSI) and magnetic saturation fitting polynomial in the PMSMs model. Then, in order to reduce the coupling interference of the parameters, this paper proposes a multi-parameter decoupling method based on adaptive genetic algorithm(AGA) for accurate parameter estimation. It decouples the PMSMs model into three parts by different speed to identify resistance, inductance and flux linkage separately. Compared with the existing methods, this approach can effectively identify the parameter in the PMSM model, which is verified experimentally on a laboratory PMSM.

articleTitle: A Channel-aware Attention Network for Crowd Counting
abstract: With the rapid increase of urban population, crowd counting is a popular yet difficult topic. However, the problem of scale variation in high-density scenario remains under-explored. To address this problem, we propose a channel-aware attention network in this paper. The channel attention module attempts to handle the relations between channel maps and highlight the discriminative information in specific channels. Thus, it alleviates the misestimation for background regions. Experimental results on ShanghaiTech and UCF-QNRF benchmark datasets prove that our approach achieves compelling performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Development of a novel type operator training simulator framework for air separation process
abstract: In process industry, operator training simulators (OTS) are becoming widely used. With the help of these systems, plant operating staff can be trained for understanding the dynamic behavior of the process, standardizing the operation skills and, more importantly, avoiding catastrophic accidents caused by human errors. Most of the current OTS are developed using commercial process simulation software, which is troublesome to maintain and modify. In this work, a novel type OTS framework is proposed. Within this framework, virtual distributed control system (DCS) is used to reflect the form of physical DCS, and multi model fusion algorithm based on linear parameter varying (LPV) identification model is used to represent the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the process. The actual process data is used to verily the accuracy of the training model. Finally, an OTS is designed based on the framework for complex load change operation of air separation process. Implementation results show the practicality of the method.

articleTitle: A Novel DCNN Based MI-EEG Classification Method Using Spatio-Frequency Information
abstract: Deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) has been successfully applied to improve the classification performance of motor imagery (MI) tasks in the electroencephalogram (EEG) based brain computer interface (BCI). However, there is still a great challenge about how to extract effective features from EEG signals. So, a novel parallel DCNN structure-based MI-EEG classification method is proposed in this paper. Fast Fourier transform is utilized to transform EEG signals from time domain to frequency domain. Then, μ and β rhythms, which are related to MI tasks, are redivided into three sub-bands. The averaged power is calculated for each sub-band. In order to utilize the position information of electrodes, azimuthal equidistant projection is adopted to convert the 3-D location of each electrode into 2-D position. Then, Clough-Tocher interpolation algorithm is employed to generate a spatio-frequency image for each sub-band. Furthermore, a parallel DCNN (pDCNN), which includes three DCNNs correspondings to three sub-bands respectively, is designed to extract and classify spatio-frequency features. The BCI2000 dataset is adopted, and the average accuracy and Kappa value reach 90.25% and 0.81 respectively, which are greater than that of the existing methods. These experimental results show that the effectiveness of the proposed MI-EEG classification method.

articleTitle: Robust Adatpive Sliding Mode Tracking Control for an AUV
abstract: In our work, the research on trajectory tracking with time-varying disturbances is investigated via robust adaptive sliding mode control (RASMC). We first design a nonsingular sliding mode surface for tracking error system and show that the sliding mode surface is continuous. Then, since the underwater environment is very complex and the AUV’s mathematical model is strongly nonlinear and highly coupled with uncertainties, we propose the robust adaptive law to ensure the superior robust performance of AUV system. The obtained results suggest that the proposed controller can reduce chattering and tracking error by designing a nonsingular sliding mode surface.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach Using Gated Recurrent Unit for Prediction of Landslide Displacement Based on Spatial-Temporal Features of Multi-Monitoring Points
abstract: The existing prediction models concentrated on the displacement prediction based on one monitoring point with obvious displacement characteristics, and there have been few results considering the multi-monitoring points with unobvious characteristics. This paper proposes an improved multi-monitoring-points-based method to predict landslide displacement using gated recurrent unit (GRU) neural networks. Firstly, the weighted undirected graph and the Gaussian function are employed to propose a star topology location tensor (STPT) for extracting spatial features between the predicted points and the surrounding adjacent monitoring points. Meanwhile, the GRU is utilized to extract temporal features of monitoring data. Then the future displacement is predicted using the spatial-temporal features. By using a displacement dataset of the Baishuihe landslide, the effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated in the comparison with the existing models.

articleTitle: Backstepping Integral Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode Based Fault-tolerant Control of Dual-motor Synchronous Anti-backlash Servo System with Extended State Observer
abstract: Considering the actuator failures of the dual-motor synchronous anti-backlash servo system, this paper proposes a robust fault-tolerant control strategy to ensure the system stable operation when the above faults occur. Firstly, the position controller is designed by the backstepping integral nonsingular terminal sliding mode control method with a double power reaching law. To avoid the excessive control value caused by the derivation process, the reference position signal is smoothed by a command-filter. Meanwhile, the linear extended state observer is introduced to compensate the whole disturbance of the system which improves the robustness ability of the system. Secondly, an adaptive torque distribution controller is designed to solve the motor actuator failures. When one side motor failure is detected, the controller can adaptively change the proportional gain of the motor torque/current command to guarantee the system can still work normally in the single motor driving condition. The co-simulation experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: backstepping integral nonsingular terminal sliding mode control

articleTitle: Data-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Control: Application to New Energy Aircraft PMSM
abstract: As the power of the new energy aircraft, the performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) directly determines the reliability and stability of the flight state. The complex coupling characteristics (strong nonlinearity, time-varying parameters, multiple working modes) essentially exist in the PMSM speed control system, which makes it difficult for traditional control methods to meet application requirements. Aiming at the PMSM speed control, this paper proposes a novel data-driven deep reinforcement learning method. The system operating data is utilized, and a deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) agent is established to fully characterize the system data relationship. Instead of the speed loop and current loop in traditional PID control, DDPG intelligent controller directly outputs the quadrature axis voltage. The problem of poor torque dynamic performance caused by the slow response speed of the current loop in the traditional speed control system is effectively solved. Simulation results demonstrate that, under three different typical operating conditions, the proposed method can meet high requirements of PMSM control system. Compared with the traditional PID controller, the DDPG controller shows excellent dynamic and steady-state characteristics, and has stronger robustness and stability.

articleTitle: Research on control of LCL grid connected inverter based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control Strategy
abstract: In the weak current network, this paper takes the single-phase LCL grid connected inverter as the research object. Firstly, the LCL grid connected inverter is analyzed and modeled. The resonance problem of LCL filter will affect the output current quality of the inverter. In this paper, the passive damping control method is used to reduce the resonance peak of LCL filter. Because the micro grid often contains harmonics and voltage fluctuations when it is integrated into the large grid, it is difficult to accurately establish such a complex and time-varying model. Active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) has a certain ability to suppress resonance. All internal and external disturbances and parameter uncertainties can be called "generalized disturbances", which are estimated and compensated by the observer. Then, the first-order ADRC is designed and applied to the passive LCL grid connected inverter, and the stability and immunity of the control system are analyzed in detail. Finally, it is compared with the traditional PR control, and the effectiveness of ADRC is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Tremor Attenuation For Robot Teleoperation By A Broad Learning System-Based Approach
abstract: It is a meaningful yet challenging task to achieve the synchronous of a teleoperated robotic manipulator and a human operator, for which one of the key problems to be overcome is the elimination of the physiological tremor from human hands. To address the problem, a tremor attenuation filter based on the broad learning system is established. This filter shows universal approximation properties and fast learning speed. Meanwhile, different trajectories have different network optimal parameters. Hence, incremental learning algorithms are combined because they only need to learn new information and can achieve fast-updating to obtain the desired performances. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Miniature Biological Eagle-Eye Vision System for Small Target Detection
abstract: Small target detection is known to be a challenging problem. Inspired by the structural characteristics and physiological mechanism of eagle-eye, a miniature vision system is designed for small target detection in this paper. First, a hardware platform is established, which consists of a pan-tilt, a short-focus camera and a long-focus camera. Then, based on the visual attention mechanism of eagle-eye, the cameras with different focal lengths are controlled cooperatively to achieve small target detection. Experimental results show that the designed biological eagle-eye vision system can accurately detect small targets, which has a strong adaptive ability.

articleTitle: Quantized Preview Control of Networked AGV Systems with Data Dropout
abstract: This paper studies the quantized preview controller design problem for networked AGV (Autonomous Guided Vehicle) systems with data dropout. The nonlinear AGV path tracking system is transformed into a linear parameter varying (LPV) model, and an augmented system is established by taking into account both the path tracking model and the preview model. The influence of data dropout on path tracking accuracy is minimized and the closed-loop systems is stabilized through satisfying certain inequality conditions, which can be solved readily through LMI toolbox. At last, the effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper is verified by Carsim/Simulink joint simulation.

articleTitle: Three Degree of Freedom Gyroscope Control Based on Three-Step Control Scheme
abstract: In order to realize the angle trajectory tracking control of a three degree of freedom (3-DOF) gyroscope, the state tracking of the desired trajectory angle of the end degree of freedom by controlling the control quantity of the joint. A three- step control scheme based on model is designed, which is composed of steady-state-like control, reference dynamic feedforward control and error feedback control. By adjusting the control parameters, it is proved that the control scheme can achieve the state tracking of the desired trajectory angle of the end degree of freedom by controlling the control quantity of the joint. Achieving the tracking control effect of the 3-DOF gyroscope angle trajectory, and the tracking error is input to the stable state. The simulation and experimental results show that the 3-DOF gyroscope terminal degree of freedom based on the three-step control scheme can asymptotically track the desired angle trajectory. At the same time, the control scheme is compared with LQR state feedback control method, which verifies that the control effect is better in control accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Robotic Arm Intelligent Grasping System for Garbage Recycling
abstract: The recycling of garbage is an effective way to protect environment. However, garbage recycling is still adopting manual sorting which is of low efficiency and may damage to the health of operators. To improve the efficiency of the garbage recycling, it is considered to use an automated robot system which integrates modern control method of robots and machine vision to replace manual sorting. Using a robotic arm and a RGB-D camera, a visual servo robotic arm grasping system was produced, which mainly depends on tools in robot operating system (ROS). The object recognition kitchen (ORK) in ROS is used to identify and locate the grasping targets. The relationship between the camera coordinate system and the robot coordinate system is established by hand-eye calibration technology. The kinematics calculation and motion planning of the robotic arm are completed with the help of ROS-Moveit!. Through experimental testing, it is estimated that the hand-eye calibration is accurate, and the robotic arm can perfectly grasp the target object.

articleTitle: A Particle Swarm Optimizer with Variable Neighborhood Size and Ring Topology for Multimodal Multiobjective Optimization
abstract: Plenty of problems in practical can be classified as multimodal multiobjective problems, whereas few algorithms for solving it and difficult for the existing multiobjective evolutionary optimizers. This paper proposes a novel multimodal multiobjective evolutionary algorithm based on particle swarm optimizer with variable neighborhood size and ring topology. An index-based ring topology is utilized to induce stable niches and refine the search area. The variable neighborhood size strategy is designed to adjust the neighborhood size within the ring topology. The performance of the proposed algorithm is compared with three state-of-the-art designs over 8 multimodal multiobjective optimization test functions. And the comparative results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm provide competitive performance for multimodal multiobjective optimization problems.

articleTitle: Capacity Prediction and Remaining Useful Life Diagnosis of Lithium-ion Batteries Using CNN-LSTM Hybrid Neural Network
abstract: To obtain an accurate remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is a key objective of battery prognostics and health management. Traditional prediction methods depend on sufficient prior knowledge of battery degradation mechanism and complicate artificial feature engineering. Artificial features are lack of generalization of model adaptability and may lose significant information to depict the long-term dependencies. To embrace these challenges, we proposed a novel deep-learning enabled approach for battery RUL prediction based on hybrid neural networks. The one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN) was employed to automatically extract multiple features of the charging curve. Then, the long shortterm memory (LSTM) network was implemented to capture the long-term underlying relationship among the degraded cycles and battery capacity. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method could predict battery RUL with a maximum mean error of 15.65 cycles on NASA dataset. Compared with traditional RUL prediction methods, the proposed method can provide a novel and promising end-to-end solution in RUL diagnosis.

articleTitle: Reinforcement-learning-based path planning for UAVs in intensive obstacle environment
abstract: In intensive obstacle environment, the available flying space is narrow, which makes it difficult to generate feasible path for UAVs within limited runtime. In this paper, a Q-learning-based planning algorithm is presented to improve the efficiency of single UAV path planning in intensive obstacle environment. By constructing the space-action state offline learning planning architecture, the proposed method realizes the rapid path planning of UAV, and solves the high time-consuming problem of reinforcement learning online path planning. Considering the time-consuming problem of Q-table re-training, a probabilistic local update mechanism is proposed by updating the Q-value of the states to reduce the high time-consuming of Q-table re-raining and realize the rapid update of Q-table. The probability of Q-value updating is up to the distance to the new obstacle. The closer the state is to the new obstacle, the higher its probability of re-training. Therefore, the flight trajectory can be quickly re-planned when the environment changes. Simulation results show that the proposed Q-learning-based planning algorithm can generate path for UAV from random start position and avoid the obstacles. Compared with the classical A* algorithm, the path planning time based on the trained Q table can be reduced from second to millisecond, which significantly improves the efficiency of path planning.

articleTitle: Position Sensorless Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Adaptive Sliding Mode Observer
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motors(PMSM) are popular in AC motor applications due to their small size, high efficiency. They have appeared widely in various areas of life. Due to the high-frequency chattering problem caused by sliding mode observer sensorless control of PMSM, an SMO with piecewise control function is designed in this paper. At the same time, based on the back EMF output of the SMO, the gain of the SMO is adapted to reduce the system bucket vibration problem caused by the conventional SMO. Finally, a simulation experiment was carried out in MATLAB/SIMULINK and compared with the conventional SMO. The results show that the improved SMO has achieved a better control effect.

articleTitle: A new preassigned finite-time tracking control for strict feedback nonlinear systems with dead zone
abstract: In this article, a new neuro-adaptive preassigned finite-time tracking control method is investigated for a class of strict-feedback uncertain nonlinear systems with uncertain external disturbance and unknown dead-zone inputs. The new method designs a neuro-adaptive preassigned finite-time controller with tracking differentiators by using a preassigned finite-time performance function. In this research, the uncertain nonlinear functions can be approximated by the neural networks, and the derivative of virtual control is estimated by some tracking differentiators to avoid differential expansion. The method of this article is easier than the normal design method of finite-time control. The proposed controller can ensure that the tracking error of the system converges into a preassigned small region of the equilibrium point within a given finite time. Finally, a contrast study is given to illustrate the validity and superiority of the proposed scheme. Because the tracking differentiator has better ability to reduce the amplitude of the practical control, the proposed method can get better control effect under the smaller control input signal.

articleTitle: Autonomous Aerial Refueling of Multiple UAVs: An Efficient Rendezvous Scheduling Approach
abstract: Autonomous aerial refueling (AAR) is an important capability for the future successful deployment and operation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), so it is necessary to design an efficient rendezvous scheduling approach. In this paper, a general strategy for refueling missions is proposed for intensive refueling firstly, and then the tanker flight path and virtual queue sequence points are designed. Secondly, to obtain the optimal refueling time under the strategy, an integer linear programming (ILP) algorithm based on the branch-and-bound method is proposed, and some planning is further made for the waiting queue adjustment. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated by simulation via two indexes, namely, the minimum oil volume and average volume of the receivers at the start of the refueling.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation of Cooperative Target allocation of UAV based on Analytic Hierarchy Proces
abstract: In this paper, an effectiveness evaluation method is proposed to evaluate the effectiveness of UAV group target allocation behavior, and the evaluation results are given under the background of UAV group with suicide attack ability to deal with multi-targets. The analytic hierarchy process is used to establish the evaluation index system, determine the index weight, establish the efficiency evaluation model of goal allocation, and draw the experimental conclusion by giving the quantitative numerical score of the effectiveness evaluation of goal distribution, the characteristics and effectiveness of the results of different allocation methods are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Prediction of drilling rate of penetration (ROP) based on PSO-SVR algorithm
abstract: The automation and intelligence of geological equipment can greatly improve the efficiency of geological exploration, which is the development direction of geological equipment. The automation and intelligence of the drilling rig is a complex system engineering. One of the key points is to accurately predict Rate-of-Penetration(ROP) through the relevant information of the drilling point stratum and the drill bit. In order to improve the accuracy of prediction of ROP, this paper proposed a drilling ROP prediction model that uses particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize parameters c and g of support vector regression(PSO-SVR). First, this model used four drilling parameters(rotation speed [RPM], weight on bit[WOB], flow rate [Q], Depth)as inputs to establish a support vector regression machine learning model for prediction of drilling ROP. After then, considering the influence of the kernel function on the model generalization performance, this paper conduct a comparative experiment with different kernel functions, which show that the Gaussian kernel can make the model have better generalization performance.Finally,the difficulty to select penalty factor c and Kernel function factor g was solved by particle swarm algorithm. The particle swarm algorithm uses its own advantages in searching for the global optimum to search for the optimal parameters c and g of SVR. The proposed model is derived from Drilling site,the results show that the proposed method better than BP neural network and traditional SVR model in prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Structural Components Recognition Method for Malfunctioned Satellite based on Domain Randomization
abstract: In the process of long distance non-cooperative target recognition, due to the lack of prior information, it is necessary to identify the structural components of the non-cooperative target in order to formulate the next step of approaching and capturing tasks. Most of the existing satellite recognition algorithms are based on known targets, which have poor generalization ability and cannot cope with the complex shape characteristics of space targets. This paper proposes a satellite structural components recognition algorithm based on domain randomization. Firstly, SolidWorks software is used to build the three-dimensional model of the satellite. Then, the satellite structural components dataset is generated by randomly rendering the structural components and background of the satellite 3D model. The labeled model is trained by YOLOv4 network. Finally, a physical experiment is carried out, and the experimental results show that this method provides a feasible intelligent engineering scheme.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Service-oriented Advanced Avionics System based on Evolutionary Game
abstract: Service-oriented advanced avionics system could implement system integration and information sharing by servicizing resources with multi-participant. In this system, each participant is bounded rational and may take aberrant behaviors. Different participant behaviors will cause the system to evolve towards different directions. In this paper, the evolution of service-oriented advanced avionics system is studied from the perspective of service management. A tripartite asymmetric game model is established to describe the participant behaviors. The replicated dynamic equation is applied to analyze the system stability. The sufficient condition of system stability is given. The research work contributes to predicting and controlling the evolution of this system accurately. The simulation results indicate that the game model and analysis method are correct and practical.

articleTitle: A PSO-RBF neural network for BOD multi-step prediction in wastewater treatment process
abstract: The single-step prediction of the effluent biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) in wastewater treatment process (WWTP) cannot provide the information for future trends, which will affect the decision-making for subsequent control strategies in WWTP. To solve this problem, a radial basis function (RBF) neural network soft-sensing model based on PSO algorithm (PSO-RBF) is proposed for multi-step prediction of the biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) in WWTP. First, we propose an RBF model for multi-step prediction based on MIMO strategy. Then, the PSO algorithm is used to optimize the RBF parameters. Finally, the proposed model is applied to a four-step BOD prediction in WWTP. Experimental results show that this model can better predict BOD in multiple steps compared to traditional models.

articleTitle: A New Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolution Network For Traffic Prediction
abstract: Accurate traffic flow prediction plays a very important role in the intelligent transportation system (ITS), which is of great importance to traffic planning and traffic management. The traffic flow in the urban road network is influenced by the topology structure, thus the current traffic condition is not only related to the traffic condition of the last few moments, but also influenced by the condition of their neighboring roads. Traditional urban traffic flow prediction methods does not take full account of spatial structure factor, resulting in low prediction accuracy. In order to achieve more accurate prediction result, the prediction model uses graph neural network to extract the road spatial structure, and unlike the previous traffic flow prediction model, a linear layer is used to capture the temporal correlation in the traffic flow. Experiments prove that the model has great prediction ability and better feature extraction capability.

articleTitle: Improved Genetic Algorithm to Solve FJc|Mij|Cmax Scheduling Problem
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of FJc|M<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ij</inf>|C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> scheduling problem, with the goal of minimizing makespan among all jobs, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. This paper designs a two-dimensional array modeling method, which effectively improves the decoding speed, and proposes a random greedy initialization population method based on the shortest machine processing time, which effectively improves the quality of the initial solution and increases the diversity of the initial population. When updating the population of each generation, this paper designs a method of merging populations, which effectively improves the convergence speed of the algorithm. Finally, the improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the benchmark problem, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Incomplete Multi-view Clustering for Single cell RNA Sequencing Data
abstract: With the rapid development of sequencing technology, researchers can obtain a large number of single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data which is useful for analysis of cell fate decision and growth process at individual cell resolution. But due to the limitations of sequencing technology, the data acquired has dropouts which may affect the results of down-steam analysis. Therefore, many algorithms have been proposed to impute the data before clustering, here in, imputation and clustering are considered as two separate processing stage. In this paper, we adopt a clustering algorithm—Incomplete Multiple Kernel k-means Clustering with Mutual Kernel Completion (MKKM-IK-MKC) to analyze scRNA-seq data. It unifies imputation and clustering into a process. Comparing with some existing "two stage" (imputation +clustering) algorithms, the experimental results on five scRNA-seq datasets from various species demonstrate the effective performance of our new proposed method.

articleTitle: Online identification of nonlinear quantization system with non-uniformly sampled data
abstract: This paper proposes a weighted adaptive multi- innovation recursive least squares algorithm for online identification of quantization Wiener systems from non- uniformly sampled data. First, according to the lifting technology, the mathematical derivation process of the model to be identified and the properties of the quantize are discussed. Secondly, based on the least squares algorithm, the correction terms of the previous moment and the multi-innovation theory are introduced. A weighted adaptive multi- innovation recursive least squares algorithm is presented by adjusting the correction terms at the current and previous moment. Finally, Take the logarithm quantization of non-uniform sampling Wiener system as an example to verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Continuous twisting damping Control of DFIG-Based Wind Farm to Improve Interarea Oscillation Damping
abstract: Aiming at the interarea oscillation problem of large power system with doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) connected, an additional damping control strategy of DFIG wind farm based on continuous twisting algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, according to a modified two-area power system with DFIG the dynamic mode of power system is established. Then, the speed difference of the synchronous generator (SG) is selected as input signal and employed in the reactive power control with the rotor side converter (RSC) of DFIG. Finally, the proposed damping control is applied to a modified two-area power system and a modified 39-bus power system to verify the effectiveness. Simulation results show that the strategy is superior to the strategy without conventional power system stability (PSS) and the strategy with conventional PSS in stability effect and robustness.

articleTitle: An Optimized Image Dehazing Algorithm Based on Local Entropy Theory
abstract: Aiming at the problems about color distortion and obvious hierarchical changes of the sky regions in the results of current image dehazing algorithms, this paper proposes an optimized method. We understand the process of image dehazing from the perspective of information gain, and uses the local entropy and brightness features of the image as the main quantitative characterization to recognize the sky area. According to daily life, the sky area in images has the characteristics of small local entropy and high brightness. This conclusion is verified by the analysis of multi-sample images. After obtaining the approximate sky area recognition results, the open operation and the mean filter are used to optimize the sky image. Finally, the image optimized is used as the guide image, and the fusion is performed between the sky image and dehazing image obtained by the traditional method. Compared with the existing methods, the method proposed by us has the following advantages: strong recognition basis and high accuracy; theoretically improved speed; robust. This paper verifies the effectiveness of the method by subjective comparison and objective analysis of four samples using different methods.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Single-Mode Four-Switch Buck-Boost Converter
abstract: Four-switch Buck-Boost converter has high conversion efficiency in three-mode or two-mode operation. However, it has disadvantages such as inherent noise caused by switching operation mode, and upper bridge needs auxiliary power in continuous opening state. A single-mode control strategy of four-switch Buck-Boost is proposed. Control value and output, input and output transfer function of the converter work in Buck-Boost mode are derived. PID controller and double pole double zero compensator is designed for this transfer function. Comparing the control methods that combine voltage feedforward compensation with traditional PID control and double-pole double-zero compensation respectively, the effectiveness of feedforward control is obtained. Rationality of the controller is verified by the Matlab/Simulink simulation model. Effectiveness of this method is verified by setting up the UPS experiment platform.

Author Keywords: double zero and double pole compensation

articleTitle: Lateral Motion Control and Analysis for Autonomous Vehicles Considering Road Curvature
abstract: Vehicle lateral motion control technology is the cornerstone of autonomous driving, and the influence of the road curvature on control performance is worthy of attention. This paper proposes a robust lateral motion controller and analyzes the effect of the road curvature on control performance. Firstly, the lateral motion controller is designed based on the suboptimal ℋ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control. The ℋ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control problem is transformed into the feasibility problem of linear matrix inequality. Then, an algorithm considering different dimensions of the tracking errors is proposed to search for feasible candidate controller gain. The appropriate controller gain is chosen considering the anti-interference and lateral motion control performance. Finally, co-simulations with Simulink and CarSim are performed. The effectiveness and robustness of the proposed controller are demonstrated via the comprehensive analysis of time domain and frequency domain.

articleTitle: Type Identification of Partial Discharge Signal Based on EMD Decomposition and GWO-SVM
abstract: Partial discharge is an important symptom and manifestation of insulation faults in power systems, and its type identification is of great significance to the operation of power grid systems. In order to accurately identify the type of partial discharge in the high-voltage switchgear, the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) method is used to decompose the partial discharge signal and extract the characteristic information. On this basis, in order to solve the subjective selection problem of the SVM kernel function g and the non-negative penalty factor C, the gray wolf algorithm (GWO) is used to optimize these two numbers, and the support vector machine (GWO-SVM) classification based on the gray wolf optimization algorithm is established model. Experimental results show that compared with genetic algorithm-based support vector machines (GA- SVM), multilayer perceptrons (MLP), and k-nearest neighbor classifiers (kNN), GWO-SVM can more accurately identify the types of local discharge sources.

articleTitle: Selective Ensemble RVFLN Multi-task Learning for Landslide Multi-point Displacement Prediction
abstract: Landslide displacement prediction has always been a vital application field in artificial intelligence, which has profound research significance. However, traditional landslide displacement prediction methods usually only predict the displacement of each monitoring point separately, without considering the correlation between adjacent monitoring points, resulting in low prediction efficiency. In this paper, we propose a selective ensemble Random Vector Functional Link Network multi-task learning (se-RVFLNM), which can simultaneously predict the displacement of diverse monitoring points on a landslide surface. In the proposed model, to further improve the prediction performance, we combine multi-task learning with multi-point displacement prediction, and construct RVFLN through the displacement of several consecutive serial time points as input. Furthermore, we adopt selective ensemble to select unrelated individual models from all trained models to form an ensemble. Finally, a large number of experiments using real landslide displacement data from Dahuaqiao Hydropower Station in Chian verified the effectiveness of se-RVFLNM.

articleTitle: A Local Sensitive Discriminant Analysis Method Based on Mahalanobis Distance: Application of Industrial Process Fault Diagnosis
abstract: Industrial data suffers from high dimensionality and non-linearity in fault diagnosis. Therefore, it is important to extract effective features from measurement space to enhance fault diagnosis accuracy. In this paper, a Local Sensitivity Discriminant Analysis method based on Mahalanobis distance (LSDA-M) is proposed for fault diagnosis. LSDA-M not only focuses on the local geometric structure of high-dimensional data which is useful for subsequent classification, but also introduces discriminant information. Meanwhile, when measuring the distance between nearest neighbours, the Mahalanobis distance is used in LSDA to eliminate the correlation interference between variables. Finally, a group of Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) data are utilized to validate the our proposed LSDA-M method and the positive results proved that our methodology is effective.

articleTitle: Novel TD3 Based AUV Path Tracking Control
abstract: This paper investigates the path tracking problem of an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) at constant depth. For traditional methods cannot effectively solve problems such as strong coupling of AUV, we propose a method based on Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradient (TD3) and S-plane algorithm, named as S-TD3. We use S-plane for guided exploration and pre-train the actor neural network with the obtained data. Then we use the ε — greedy method to select the training strategy during the training. Finally, we illustrate with simulations that our method fits the desired path well and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: The motion planning of Six-Degree-of-Freedom manipulator based on P-Rob
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low efficiency of path planning of robot manipulator in high-dimensional joint space, and to further improve the smoothness of motion of the robotic system during the movement, the trajectory planning algorithm is explored and the path planning algorithm is improved of the six-degree-of-freedom robot manipulators system based on Personal Robotics (P-Rob). The trajectory planning simulation experiments of the robot manipulators system were implemented using joint space and Cartesian space trajectory planning, and the trajectory planning method suitable for the P-Rob system was explored. The path planning of the robot manipulators was optimized using the improved fast-expanding random tree algorithm, and the improved path planning algorithm was confirmed to be more efficient through Matlab simulation analysis. Finally, experiments were conducted on the actual P-Rob model, and the experimental results showed the practicality and efficiency of using the motion planning algorithm designed in this paper for a robot manipulators system of the same structure.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of peer-to-peer RSS/TOA measurements for UAVs
abstract: Cooperative localization is one of the effective methods to restrain multipath fading and shadow fading in the urban environment whose positioning accuracy mainly depends on the ranging precision and the positioning effect of unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs). Distance estimation including time of arrival(TOA) and received signal strength(RSS) whose accuracy is influenced significantly by the ranging model especially in antenna direction and random error modeling. In this paper, firstly, the improved TOA and RSS ranging model containing compensation of antenna direction is given by the static fitting experiment. Furthermore, the random error of TOA and RSS ranging is modeled as logarithmic function and polynomial function separately. Finally, the weighted least-squares method is proposed to verify the effectiveness of the improved model.

articleTitle: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Fault Detection under Multiple Failure Modes
abstract: Fault detection is an important part of Prognostics and Health Management(PHM). Nowadays, neural networks have made remarkable achievements in the field of fault detection. However, when multiple failure modes exist, for different failure modes, the occurrence frequency of different faults varies greatly. Some faults are common while some are rare. It is difficult to identify rare fault samples because they are indeed rare. In this paper, a knowledge distillation based fault detection method that crosses different fault modes is proposed, which distills knowledge from detection model for common faults to detection model for rare faults, so as to enhance the model’s ability to detect rare faults. Comparative experiment conducted on a real-world ion mill etching machine dataset shows the proposed method can not only improve the accuracy of the model for rare faults, but also improve the stability of outputs.

articleTitle: Infectious Diseases Dynamic Transmissibility with Age Structure and Medical Resources
abstract: Tendency forecasting of infectious diseases, such as COVID-19, is urgently required to evaluate outbreak risk and control decisions. Although transmission models based on natural factors like virus propagation, temperature, and human modality are studied carefully, social factors cause high flexibility on dynamic propagation change under actual virus spreading conditions. We propose a time-variant relevance-based infected recovered extreme learning machine to generate a quantitative forecasting model with social factors. Also, embedded distance is used to measure the similarity and realize flexible forecasting based on social impactors. We investigated the age structure and the medical supply under the COVID-19 pandemic with nonidentical open-source data We found that embedded distance with the proposed model is highly consistent with projection accuracy, and the proposed method can achieve higher accuracy than existed methods. Based on the forecasting model, age distribution and medical supply make a difference in COVID-19 transmission. Areas with the middle proportion of the aged population face higher outbreaking risks, and sufficient medical supply control the infection speed efficiently within three weeks. This study provides an efficient projection of dynamic transmission under the social impact on infectious diseases pandemics.

articleTitle: A Fast Photometric Stereo Algorithm with Un-calibration Lights for Surface Reconstruction
abstract: To solve the problem of complex and time-consuming for light calibration in photometric stereo vision, a three-dimensional(3D) reconstruction algorithm of photometric stereo vision based on isotropic illumination reflection model is studied. For different isotropic materials, the normal direction corresponding to this point is estimated by observing the similarity of the change of light reflection intensity of a point on the object surface under different lighting conditions. Through the dimension reduction method, the original inherent characteristics of the object surface are preserved, and then the normal direction of each pixel on the object is obtained by analyzing the similarity between pixels on the image. Experiments show that this method has good wide applicability, avoids the problem of light source parameter calibration, and has the advantages of fast reconstruction speed.

articleTitle: Consistent Control for SOH of Energy Storage Batteries Based on Game Theory
abstract: The rapid development of new energy vehicles has brought new problems--how to deal with retired batteries. Although the use of retired electric vehicles (EVs) batteries in the energy storage system saves the cost, the state of health (SOH) of each battery is difficult to be consistent, which affects the life of the entire energy storage system. Therefore, this paper proposes a Nash equilibrium consistency control method based on the complete information game, which can adjust the adopted depth of discharge (DOD) based on the current SOH and expected SOH. As a result, the SOH eventually tends to be consistent. The influence of energy storage battery SOH on state of charge (SOC) consistency is fundamentally solved, which provides a theoretical basis for battery SOH consistency equalization. It improves the utilization rate of energy, prolongs the service life of the energy storage battery, and reduces the operating cost. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensor-Free Method with BP Network to Achieve Drag Teaching on the 7-DoF Collaborative Robot
abstract: Drag teaching is an effective way to realize the user-friendly characteristics of the collaborative robot. Aiming at the limitations of traditional drag teaching technology, we propose a teaching method without the external force/torque sensor combined with a neural network. Specifically, the dynamics model of the robot is established based on Lagrange equation, and then the parameters of the dynamic model are identified by a neural network; Based on the servo motor’s current value and combined with the dynamic model, the external force disturbance is estimated equivalently in the drag process; In the stage of trajectory reproduction, spline interpolation is used to smooth the trajectory waypoints. Finally, we verify the effectiveness of the proposed method through simulation and physical experiments.

articleTitle: Mechanical Structure Design and Obstacle Crossing Reliability Analysis of Magnetic Absorption Wall Climbing Obstacle Robot
abstract: Wall climbing robot can realize mobile operations in vertical wall environment, which has great scientific research significance and application prospects for improving production efficiency. Domestic and foreign researchers have conducted a lot of research on wall climbing robots and designed many types of wall climbing robots. However, there is relatively less research work on robots that can cross obstacles and perform obstacle crossing operations. In many application scenarios, robots need to be adsorbed on the iron plate to ensure reliable adsorption of the robots and at the same time to ensure that the robots can crossing obstacles. This problem is one of the problems that have not been completely solved in the design of specialized wall climbing robots. Therefore, oriented to large-scale vertical wall maintenance work scenarios, a magnetic absorption wall climbing obstacle robot that can cross obstacles on the wall surface is designed and manufactured. The obstacle stability of the robot and the dangerous force conditions of the robot is analyzed to verify the rationality of the robot mechanical structure design.

Author Keywords: magnetic absorption wall climbing obstacle robot

articleTitle: An Improved Deep Forest Model Combining Adaptive Synthetic Sampling for Automatic Lithology Identification
abstract: As lithology is an important attribute describing reservoir characteristics, lithology identification is of great significance for oil exploration and development. Because of the shortcomings of low precision and high cost in traditional methods, machine learning (ML) technology has become the focus of logging lithology identification research. However, the lithology samples imbalance and unextracted complementary information in logging curves limit the performance of ML models. In this paper, an improved deep forest (DF) model combining adaptive synthetic sampling (ADASYN) is proposed to realize automatic lithology identification. To balance lithology samples, ADASYN is adopted to minority lithologies oversampling. Extreme learning machine is utilized as base learner instead of random forest to advance the classification ability and generalization of the DF algorithm. The implied complementary information in logging curves is mined by multi-grained scanning of the algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified on the logging datasets of Jianghan oilfield. It is proved that the model can realize accurate lithology identification of unbalanced logs.

articleTitle: A New Distributed Localization Approach for Multi-Robot Formation Control Systems
abstract: This paper considers the distributed localization problem for multi-robot formation control systems. For the scenarios when GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) signals are not reliable and landmarks are not enough, high-precision inertial sensors are essential for the accurate localization of multi-robot formation systems. To deal with this issue and save cost, a new distributed localization strategy is proposed, where only leader robot is equipped with high-precision inertial sensors while the other follower robots are equipped with low-cost sensors such as cameras and low-cost LiDARs etc. It is assumed that satisfactory relative pose information between leader and follower robots can be obtained. Three distributed localization scenarios are considered for the multi-robot formation control systems. Experiment results verify the effectiveness of the algorithms proposed.

articleTitle: Internal Short Circuit Fault Diagnosis for Lithium-ion Battery Using a Novel Voltage Prediction Method
abstract: The internal short circuit (ISC) of lithium-ion battery seriously affects the safety of electric vehicles. The detection of ISC faults is crucial for the safe operation of batteries. This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for ISC using a novel voltage prediction method based on correlation coefficient and a residual evaluation method based on cumulative sum test. The diagnosis of ISC faults is realized by evaluating the residuals between the predicted voltage and measured voltage. And the method only uses measured battery voltages as fault diagnosis signal and has practicability and feasibility. Different levels of ISC faults are emulated by connecting different resistors in parallel to a certain battery. Under Urban Dynamometer Driving Schedule test, the experimental results verify that ISC faults can be diagnosed promptly and accurately.

articleTitle: Rapid Classification and Evaluation Method of the Temperature Stress of Continuous Welded Rail Based on the Metal Magnetic Memory Technique
abstract: How to realize the rapid and real-time monitoring of the temperature stress of continuous welded rail (CWR) is an important problem related to the safety and stability of the railway. Its goal is to give early warning and guide the maintenance of the railway in time, so asto avoid the occurrence of the safety accidents [1]. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a quantitative evaluation method of the temperature stress of CWR based on the metal magnetic memory (MMM) technique.Taking a section of CWR in Baoding, Hebei Province as the research object, the magnetic Barkhausen noise (MBN) technique is used to mark the MMM signal. The MMM signal is analyzed both in the time domain and the frequency domain. The frequency-domain analysis is to perform the wavelet packet decomposition on the MMM signal, and calculate the relative wavelet packet energy of each subband and the wavelet packet energy Shannon entropy as the frequency-domain features. On this basis, the support vector machine (SVM) algorithm is used to establish the quantitative model for the evaluation of the temperature stress. The experiment results show that this method can evaluate the temperature stress of CWR quickly and quantitatively, and provide a principle for the evaluation of the safety and stability of CWR.

articleTitle: Stereo Matching Algorithm Based on CGAN
abstract: Most of the current end-to-end stereo matching algorithms use 3D convolution, which leads to high computational cost. Therefore, this paper proposes a algorithm based on CGAN to solve this problem. Because the result of prediction is presented in the way of disparity map, the task of disparity prediction can be regarded as the task of image generation. The generator in CGAN converts the pairs of images into the disparity maps. The generated image or the ground truth will be input to the discriminator in CGAN to identify whether the input image is a generated sample or the ground truth. The errors calculated from the generated results and the discriminant results guide the training of the generator and the discriminator to form a adversarial process until both are optimal. Our proposed method does not use 3D convolution, which not only simplifies the realization process of stereo matching, but also reduces the calculation cost on the premise of ensuring certain accuracy. We evaluated our model on the Scene Flow dataset and achieved a good result by comparing different architectures.

articleTitle: A New Method of Pulsar Candidate Detection Based on Bagging
abstract: As the sensitivity of detection equipment increases, it is necessary to select pulsar signals from a large number of candidates. In order to solve the disadvantages of large workload and low efficiency of traditional manual screening, a pulsar candidate detection method using Bagging algorithm is proposed. In this paper, nine features are extracted on the basis of pulsar cumulative contours, and the bagging algorithm is used to detect the observed candidate signals. Simulation experiments verily the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Key Data Automatic Test system for Decentralized Autonomous Computer
abstract: As the core equipment of decentralized autonomous Centralized Traffic Control (CTC), the decentralized autonomous computer automatically generates instructions according to the train operation plan, and sends them to the computer block interlocking system, which realizes the monitoring and control of railway station signal equipment and so on. Whether the basic data is correct or not directly affects the transportation efficiency and even endangers the driving safety. Taking the interlocking queue mapping table and interlocking route table of decentralized autonomous computer as examples, this paper develops the automatic test management system, sets up the data test environment, and realizes automatic data test. The system improves the data testing efficiency and the accuracy of the data, reduces the testing personnel’s work intensity, and provides effective technical support for the implementation of CTC system engineering.

articleTitle: TLD Tracking Algorithm Based on Feature Fusion
abstract: Various places in life are related to target tracking. In order to ensure that the tracked objects can be correctly identified, the accuracy of the algorithm needs to be continuously improved. This article focuses on the problem that the recognition rate of TLD (Tracking-Learning-Detection) algorithm decreases and even tracking drift occurs when the target undergoes rapid movement, rotation, and deformation. These situations are not expected to happen. Therefore, this paper proposes to add HSV color space and local binary pattern (LBP) to the traditional TLD algorithm. Through this method, the recognition accuracy of the tracked target is improved when the target is moving, rotating, and deforming rapidly, thereby improving the robustness of the algorithm. After a large number of experiments and analysis in this paper, this method can achieve correct detection and accurate tracking of target objects in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Semiglobal Stereo Matching Algorithm Based on Improved Census Transformation
abstract: Binocular stereo matching is in an effort to obtain disparity maps from binocular images taken by the same camera. Existing methods resulted in mismatches in the discontinuous regions. In this study, we put forward a innovative binocular stereo correspondence method based on an improved census transformation. After that, semiglobal stereo matching algorithm was performed on matching cost aggregation stage. Finally, we further conducted Left and Right Consistency Check and median filter to generate better disparities. The results indicated that compared with the original census transform, the disparities obtained by our method was continuous and dense, and the mismatch rate is lower.

articleTitle: Fault detection and diagnosis of pneumatic control valve based on fuzzy method
abstract: This paper proposes a fault detection and diagnosis method based on fuzzy model. T-S fuzzy model is used to fit the normal operation process and the nonlinear model of each fault. When a fault occurs, fault detection is performed using the residuals in normal model. Then, the faulty fuzzy models are used to diagnose a fault. DAMADICS simulation platform is used to obtain several fault data, which are some of the possible faults in the real system. The proposed fault detection and diagnosis method based on fuzzy model is able to detect and diagnose the simulated faults.
