articleTitle: H_/H∞ fault detection observer design for fractional-order singular systems
abstract: This paper studies the fault detection observer design problem for fractional-order singular systems. A singular H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</inf>/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> observer is designed to meet the system admissibility, fault sensitivity and disturbance robustness indices simultaneously. Three theorems about the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</inf>/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance and observer design are given. Sufficient conditions are obtained in the form of linear matrix inequalities. Finally, numerical simulation is used to test the correctness and validity of the presented theorems and methods.

articleTitle: Underwater Object Detection of an UVMS Based on WGAN
abstract: To solve the problem that the underwater image quality is not high, which leads to the inaccuracy of UVMS target detection based on convolutional neural network, an underwater target detection method based on WGAN is proposed. Firstly, the classic data expansion method is used to expand the data set. Then, WGAN based method UVMS is used to synthesize data enhancement to improve the performance of detection network in underwater target detection. RetinaNet is used as a target detection network, and sea cucumbers are used as a typical research target for experiments. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of UVMS is improved by 17% in underwater target detection. The proposed method provides a good technical support for autonomous fishing of UVMS.

articleTitle: The distributed localization and circumnavigation of multiple targets based on bearing-only measurement in three-dimensional
abstract: In this paper, the distributed localization and circumnavigation task of multiple agents along multiple stationary targets using bearing-only information in three-dimensional (3D) space is investigated. Firstly, a distributed estimator is proposed to locate the targets and the multi-target center since the positions of the targets are unknown. Then, based on the estimator, a circumnavigation controller is proposed to force each agent to move around the multi-target center with circular trajectory. The convergence of the proposed algorithms is proven. The validity and stability of the proposed algorithms are verified by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Ship energy distribution optimization based on multi-objective Antlion algorithm
abstract: In order to realize the optimal operation of multi-energy ship power system with the dual objectives of economy and environmental protection under the system constraints, the ship power system was studied, and a ship power management control strategy that coordinated economy and environmental protection was proposed. The latest intelligent algorithm, multi-objective Ant-lion algorithm, is adopted to solve the problem of energy management power allocation strategy, which can effectively suppress the load fluctuation and improve the environmental performance and economy. The simulation results show that the model can guide the power distribution of ship power network.

articleTitle: Estimating the Location of HFSWR Extended Targets Based on Clustering Algorithm
abstract: The constant false alarm rate(CFAR) algorithm is a commonly used target detection algorithm in high-frequency surface-wave radar(HFSWR). However, when the false alarm probability of CFAR is set too high, an independent HFSWR target will be detected as multiple extended targets with similar locations. In order to obtain the number and location of independent targets, this paper applies the clustering algorithm to HFSWR extended target detection. First, the basic structure of the Range-Doppler(RD) spectrogram is introduced and the existence form of targets in the RD spectrogram is analyzed; Second, the steps of estimating the actual position of HFSWR extended targets based on the clustering algorithm are introduced; Finally, clustering experiments are performed on the simulated data and the measured data respectively. The experimental results show that the clustering method used in this paper can effectively estimate the locations of the extended targets.

articleTitle: An Improved CornerNet-Lite Method for Pedestrian Detection of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Images
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a key component to analyze the outdoor scene, which has an important part in object detection of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images. The original ComerNet-Lite is sensitive to shooting angle and environments, making it difficult to detect pedestrians in case of distortion, blur and small scale. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved ComerNet-Lite framework, which can effectively detect pedestrians in unknown angles and complex environments. First, CornerNet-Lite is improved by introducing the stacked hourglass module into the backbone to raise the ability to capture features and extracting information at every scale of UAV images. Second, we employ soft non maximum suppression (Soft-NMS) to improve pedestrian detection accuracy by modifying the confidence and detection box of the adjacent pedestrian. Finally, we evaluate improved CornerNet-Lite on the VisDrone2019 dataset achieves satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Computational Guidance Law Based on Data- Driven Online Adaptive Critic Designs
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive critical design method, which using neural network (NN) approximator in Actor/Critical structure to calculate the approximate solution of the optimal control problem of missile-target interception scenario online. The method is based on Policy Iteration (PI) algorithm, the PI algorithm starts from the initial admissible control to find the optimal solution iteratively. In this paper, the initial admissible control input is chosen as proportional navigation control law. By online data sampling, the implementation of the algorithm does not need to use the explicit knowledge of the internal dynamics of the nonlinear system. The numerical simulation is provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed guidance law.

articleTitle: Design of stabilizing controllers for underactuated TORA system
abstract: Translational oscillator with a rotational actuator (TORA) is an underactuated nonlinear mechanical system with two degrees of freedom (DOF). This paper discusses the stabilizing control problems for this system. Two stabilizing control strategies are presented based on Lyapunov theory and backstepping idea. The first strategy uses the backstepping idea to construct a Lyapunov function. The nonnegativity of the Lyapunov function guarantees the stabilizing control objective of the TORA to be achieved. The second one transforms the system into a cascade system. And the stabilization of the system is ensured by the cascade backsteeping theory. Simulation results demonstrate the validity of our developed control methods.

articleTitle: Multi agent consensus control based on improved sliding mode controller
abstract: This paper discusses the consensus of the second-order multi-agent pilot follower system. The absolute value term is used to improve the convergence speed of the sliding mode controller and suppress chattering when approaching the sliding mode surface. The improved first-order sliding mode controller and the improved boundary layer-based sliding mode controller are designed respectively and the stability analysis is carried out respectively. Its effectiveness is verified by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Motion planning of autonomous mobile robot based on ELANFIS
abstract: Aiming at the problem of target reaching and avoiding obstacles in the nonlinear motion planning of autonomous mobile robots, a new motion planning method is proposed. Due to the uncertain factors brought by the unknown environment and modeling errors to the control system, the performance of the precise controller is poor and the design requirements are high. Designed an adaptive fuzzy neural network planning method based on extreme learning machine (Extreme-ANFIS), which combines the easy-to-express characteristics of fuzzy control and the self-learning of neural network, and introduces the theoretical idea of extreme learning machine, which reduces the computational complexity of the traditional adaptive fuzzy neural network. The simulation experiment results show that the designed controller based on the fuzzy neural network can achieve the expected effect through the learning of training samples.

articleTitle: Distributed Robust Secondary Control Strategy for AC Microgrids With Bounded Disturbances
abstract: In AC microgrids, distributed generators (DGs) play an important role in energy conversion. The distributed secondary control method not only needs that the frequency of all DG units converge to the reference information, but also satisfies the overall control objective of active power sharing, simultaneously. However, under the influence of external bounded disturbances and some uncertain factors, the insufficiency of anti-disturbances ability has always been a pain point. Therefore, a distributed robust secondary control strategy with exponential consensus speed is designed, which can effectively resist bounded disturbances and realize fast exponential convergence. Lastly, the effectiveness of the control algorithm is validated through simulations of multiple scenarios, and the advancement is demonstrated by comparing it with the classic method.

articleTitle: Construction and Reasoning Method of Fault Knowledge Graph with application of Engineering Machinery
abstract: This paper studies the construction and reasoning method of engineering machinery fault knowledge graph, which provides a new idea for assisting the troubleshooting of engineering machinery. Aiming at the problems of low reuse rate of maintenance experience resources, scattered and non-standard naming of relevant maintenance documents, and low processing efficiency, this paper proposes a fault knowledge graph method based on deep learning, and embeds the knowledge graph into the multi-task learning framework to improve the generalization ability of the model and finally achieve the purpose of aid decision making (ADM). For the maintenance documents of engineering machinery, the natural language processing (NLP) technology is used to extract entities and relations. Then the convolution neural network model (CNN) is used to extract the features of text data and classify them. According to the preset rules, the resource description framework (RDF) triples are formed to generate fault knowledge graph. The fault knowledge graph embedding (KGE) task and the ADM task are two subtasks of multi-tasking learning framework, and the ADM model is obtained by alternating iterative train the two tasks. The effectiveness of the proposed fault diagnosis method is verified by using the maintenance documents of a domestic excavator.

articleTitle: Cluster Consensus of Multi-Agent Systems With Switching Topology Under Event-Triggered Strategy
abstract: This paper focuses on cluster consensus of multiagent systems (MASs) with sampled-data-based event-triggered scheme under switching topology. A Markov process is applied to describe a switching process of communication topology. By conceiving a novel Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF), some sufficient conditions according to matrix inequalities for the existence of control gains are developed. An example of simulation is shown for the validity of the above conclusion.

articleTitle: User Behavior Monitoring Mechanism of Online Shopping Processes based on Hierarchical Colored Petri Net
abstract: Online shopping has developed very rapidly with the rise of economy, but due to its open network environment, many security issues have also appeared. Among them, behavior risk has become a new security challenge in the online shopping process. Thus, this paper proposes a monitoring mechanism for the behavior risk of online shopping users. Once there is risky information in the user’s session, it can be monitored and processed in time. In this paper, the modeling method based on Hierarchical Colored Petri Net (HCPN) is used to depict the monitoring mechanism, and the CPNTools is used to generate the state space diagram to validate the correctness of the model. This monitoring mechanism supplements the analysis theory of user behavior risk during online shopping processes. The proposed method can be used to protect consumers’ legitimate interests in real-time.

articleTitle: UAV Swarm Exploration With Byzantine Fault Tolerance
abstract: Swarm robots need Byzantine fault tolerance to ensure their tasks can still be complete even if malfunctioning or malicious robots exist. Nevertheless, advancement in implementing Byzantine fault tolerance is not suitable for the UAV swarm exploration task. This study aims to contribute to this growing area of research. We presented an implementation of Byzantine fault tolerance for swarm robots, proposing a theoretically more effective and flexible approach than previous approaches. We integrated a multi-agent foraging algorithm with a BFT consensus algorithm for the UAV swarm exploration task, providing a method that can be generalized to similar multi-agent cooperative tasks. We developed a ROS-based framework to incorporate such algorithms into swarm robots, facilitating robotics development and testing. Empirical results of the UAV swarm exploration task imply our approach’s advantages.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cruise Control of Virtual Coupled High-Speed Trains
abstract: The adaptive cruise formation control problem for multiple high-speed trains (MHSTs) with input, speed and minimum tracking distance constraints under virtual coupling (VC) is proposed in this paper. First, the dynamic equation of MHSTs is created based on the law of kinematics. The communication topology is modeled by graph theory. Next, the speed limit, minimum tracking distance with adjacent trains are dealt with by using the ideas of the potential function. The resistance and unknown disturbances are dealt with by using adaptive control. Then, a cruise control protocol for MHSTs to track the expected trajectory is designed. The Lyapunov theory is used to prove the system stability. Finally, numerical experiments are conducted, which illustrates that the control protocol is effective.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Evaluation Based on Multilayer Perceptron Neural Network
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated multilayer perceptron network based on Easy-Ensemble to learn the imbalance transient stability data of power system. Firstly, it uses principal component analysis to reduce the dimensionality of the data and analyzes the composition of each principal component according to the principal component factor loading matrix. Secondly, it reduces the scale of stability data by under-sampling, combines unstable samples and under-sampled samples into multiple new balanced training sets. This method trains several different multilayer perceptron with the balanced training set. There are different evaluation results of different multilayer perceptron, the voting integration strategy is used to choose the final evaluation of power system. The evaluation performances of single model and integrated model are compared, and the results show that the integrated learning model has higher sensitivity and accuracy for system instability.
